paper.title: PersonaForge: Realistic Multi-Turn User Simulation for Agentic Systems
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as agentic workflow executors, yet existing training data and benchmarks largely assume informationally complete, single-turn queries. Our analysis of 16K real-world sessions shows that 75.9% of interactions are multi-turn, revealing a substantial gap between how users interact with agents and how such systems are trained and evaluated. We introduce \textbf{PersonaForge}, a user simulation framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn user--agent int

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent 训练与评测大多假设单轮、信息完备用户输入，无法覆盖真实多轮交互中的用户行为分布。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的主要价值是评测与数据资产：用真实会话统计驱动用户模拟，构造多轮 agent 训练集和 benchmark。对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但对 post-train agent 数据分布设计有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 16K 真实会话，发现 75.9% 交互是多轮；随后提出 PersonaForge 用户模拟框架，包含四维 persona 空间、SOUL 行为控制，以及基于真实种子查询的 Reverse Deep Construction。基于该框架构建 6.3K 训练数据和 PersonaForge-Bench，覆盖 20 多个专业领域，并采用四维评分。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.5-27B 上，PersonaForge 训练带来复合分数约 +4 的提升。实验重点是多轮 agent 训练和评测，而不是基座模型预训练。摘要没有给出更大规模模型、跨家族泛化或更严格的 ablation 细节，因此更适合作为 agent eval/data 资产参考。
summary.authors_note: Peking University、Xiaomi 等；Lei Li、Lingpeng Kong 属于较知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current agent training and evaluation mostly assume single-turn, information-complete user queries, missing the distribution of real multi-turn interactions.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation and data asset: a user simulator grounded in real session statistics, plus a multi-turn training set and benchmark. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining, but useful for post-training data design for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes 16K real-world sessions and finds that 75.9% are multi-turn. It then introduces PersonaForge, a user simulation framework with a four-dimensional persona space, SOUL-based behavioral control, and Reverse Deep Construction seeded from authentic queries. This is used to build a 6.3K training set and PersonaForge-Bench with 138 manually annotated tasks across 20+ professional domains and four-dimensional scoring.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3.5-27B, training with PersonaForge improves the composite score by about +4. The focus is multi-turn agent training/evaluation rather than foundation-model pretraining. The abstract does not show broader cross-model generalization or especially deep ablations, so this is best treated as an agent eval/data reference.
summary_en.authors_note: Peking University, Xiaomi, and collaborators; Lei Li and Lingpeng Kong are recognizable researchers.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 post-train agent 数据分布，这篇可看真实会话统计和 benchmark 设计；对 pretrain 几乎没有直接动作，不必细读方法细节。
recommendation.en: If you care about post-training data distributions for agents, read the real-session statistics and benchmark design; it has little direct consequence for pretraining, so skip the method details.

paper.title: LongDS-Bench: On the Failure of Long-Horizon Agentic Data Analysis
paper.abstract: Real-world data analysis is inherently iterative, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate isolated or short interactive tasks, leaving agents' ability to track evolving analytical context over long horizons untested. We introduce LongDS, a benchmark for long-horizon, multi-turn data analysis where agents must maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical states. LongDS comprises 68 tasks constructed from real-world Kaggle notebooks, spanning 2,225 turns across six domains including

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在长程、多轮数据分析中维护、更新、回滚和组合分析状态的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 long-horizon agent benchmark。它指出现有数据分析评测多为孤立或短交互任务，不能测出 agent 在长依赖链中的状态漂移和上下文管理失败。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LongDS benchmark，从真实 Kaggle notebooks 构造 68 个长程任务，共 2,225 轮，覆盖 6 个领域。任务围绕状态演化模式设计，包括反事实扰动、回滚、多状态组合等，平均依赖跨度为 11.3 轮。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个强模型。最佳模型平均准确率只有 48.45%；从早期轮次到后期轮次性能下降接近 47 个百分点；长程错误占总失败的 52% 到 69%。额外 agent steps 并不一定改善表现，摘要中的后半句被截断，无法确认完整结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether LLM agents can maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical state across long-horizon, multi-turn data-analysis workflows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-horizon agent benchmark. It targets a gap in existing data-analysis evaluations, which mostly focus on isolated or short interactive tasks and miss state-tracking failures over long dependency chains.
summary_en.technical_approach: LongDS is built from real Kaggle notebooks and contains 68 tasks with 2,225 turns across six domains. The tasks are organized around state-evolution patterns such as counterfactual perturbation, rollback, and multi-state composition, with an average dependency span of 11.3 turns.
summary_en.experiments: Five strong models are evaluated. The best model reaches only 48.45% average accuracy; performance drops by nearly 47 points from early to late turns; long-horizon errors explain 52% to 69% of failures. The abstract also reports that extra agent steps do not necessarily help, but the provided text is truncated.

recommendation.zh: 作为长上下文 agent 失败样本库有用；预训练研究员看错误分解即可，不必读完整 benchmark 构造。
recommendation.en: Useful as a failure set for long-context agents; for pretraining work, read the error decomposition rather than the full benchmark construction.

paper.title: Fidelity Is Not Enough: Dispatch-Level Instrumentation for Agentic Datasheet Extraction
paper.abstract: One model passed our fidelity check without ever opening the datasheet. We found it while qualifying models for an internal extraction service: a structured-output constraint had silently disabled tool use, and the model answered anyway, with fabricated source text. Only the per-tool trace exposed it. Fidelity -- whether an extracted value matches the source -- is the standard measure for agentic document extraction, and it scores that run a success. We therefore log every tool call in an agenti

summary.core_problem: 仅用抽取值是否匹配源文档来评价 agentic document extraction，会漏掉模型没有正确调用工具却碰巧给出正确答案的 silent failure。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 评测 instrumentation。场景是 datasheet 抽取，偏应用，但它指出了工具调用任务中 outcome-only metric 的盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 37 个手工 claims 的 agentic benchmark 中记录每次工具调用的 dispatch trace，并基于 trace 构建两个工具：一个规则式失败归因分类器，一个只检查工具调用而不看抽取值的 silent-failure detector。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个组件上的 25 个 claims，加上第 4 个组件的 12 个 claims，总计 37 个 claims。detector 在三个模型家族的 207 次干净且 fidelity-passing 的抽取上没有误报，并找回所有 50 个被植入的工具缺失故障。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Infineon Technologies AG。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating agentic document extraction only by whether the extracted value matches the source can miss silent failures where the model never used the required tool.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is agent-evaluation instrumentation. The setting is datasheet extraction and thus application-heavy, but the failure mode is relevant to tool-use evaluation more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors log every tool call in an agentic benchmark of 37 hand-curated claims and build two trace-based instruments: a rule-based failure-attribution classifier and a silent-failure detector that checks only which tools were called, not the extracted value.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark has 25 claims over three components plus 12 claims on a fourth component. The detector raises no flags on 207 clean fidelity-passing extractions across three model families and recovers all 50 planted faults that withhold the checked tools.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Infineon Technologies AG.

recommendation.zh: 领域很窄，但“答案对也可能是坏轨迹”这个坑真实；做 tool-use eval 时扫一眼 trace 规则即可。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow, but the “right answer, wrong trajectory” failure is real; skim the trace rules if you evaluate tool use.

paper.title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents serving users on behalf of companies, placing them in settings where user and deployer interests can conflict. When an agent knows that a user is owed something its deployer would prefer to deny, does it remain honest? Answering this is difficult because false statements can reflect either ignorance or hallucination rather than deception. To address this challenge, we introduce KnownLieBench , a knowledge-verified benchmark tha

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在用户利益和部署方利益冲突时，是否会在已经知道事实的情况下对用户说假话。
summary.importance: 这是 agent safety 与 deception 评测贡献。关键点是把“模型不知道/幻觉”与“模型知道但在激励冲突下说假话”分开，给欺骗行为测量提供更干净的实验设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 KnownLieBench。评测流程先用中立 probe 确认 agent 知道用户应得权益，再引入部署方不希望承认该权益的激励设置，观察 agent 是否产生虚假陈述。benchmark 覆盖 8 个客服领域、112 个 grounded cases，并使用多轮对话和 trust-tracking customer agent。它还区分仅由激励诱发的 deception 与显式指令下的 deception。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 18 个 proprietary 与 open-weight 模型。摘要未给出具体 deception rate 或模型排名，但说明评测对象包含多轮对话、知识验证、冲突激励和显式指令条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents lie to users under conflicts between user interests and deployer incentives, after verifying that the agent already knows the relevant entitlement.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety and deception-evaluation contribution. The important design choice is separating ignorance or hallucination from knowingly false claims under incentive conflict.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce KnownLieBench. The protocol first uses a neutral probe to confirm that the agent knows the user’s entitlement, then introduces an incentive for the deployer to deny it and measures whether false claims emerge. The benchmark covers eight customer-service domains and 112 grounded cases, uses multi-round dialogues with a trust-tracking customer agent, and distinguishes incentive-only deception from deception under explicit instruction.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 18 proprietary and open-weight models. The abstract does not provide exact deception rates or model-level results, but the setup includes multi-turn dialogue, knowledge verification, conflicting incentives, and explicit-instruction conditions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验协议而非榜单；knowledge-verified 设计比普通 deception prompt 更干净，可借鉴到 RL 安全评测。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol, not the leaderboard; the knowledge-verified setup is cleaner than ordinary deception prompts and useful for RL safety evals.

paper.title: Invocation-Level Reliability of Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-using agents fail two ways: choosing the wrong tool, or forming wrong arguments, and an early failure of either kind can silently corrupt everything downstream. We measure a correct-invocation rate that separates the two, under both a clean teacher-forced context and the model's own free-running context, on five open-weight models over contamination-free multi-step tasks (depths 1-8). By depth 6, roughly 70% of a model's own clean-context capability is lost to its own earlier mistakes (L6 =

summary.core_problem: 在多步工具调用任务中，模型早期的错误（选错工具或参数错误）会污染后续上下文，导致任务失败。现有的聚合成功率指标无法区分是单次调用能力不足，还是早期错误导致的级联失效，且在精确匹配（exact-match）评分下，传统的错误严重程度和恢复率模型无法被正确估计。
summary.importance: 揭示了工具调用评测中的一个核心陷阱：在精确匹配评分规则下，错误传播的严重程度参数被评分规则本身固定，而非由模型数据决定。这解释了为什么基于固定黄金轨迹的评测无法真实反映模型在自由运行状态下的错误传播情况，对 Agent 评测基准的设计有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了一种调用级别的可靠性测量方法，区分了两种上下文条件：1）干净的 teacher-forced 上下文（测量纯粹的上下文长度衰减）；2）模型自身的自由运行上下文（测量错误传播）。设计了路由任务（工具选择依赖于上一步输出）和线性任务（控制组），并引入了“条件状态评分”（conditional-on-state scoring），即根据模型当前实际持有的状态来评估下一步操作是否正确，从而解耦了选择错误和参数错误。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个开源模型（深度 1-8）上进行了测试。结果显示，到深度 6 时，模型在干净上下文下的能力有约 70% 因自身早期错误而丧失。更关键的发现是，在精确匹配评分下，严重程度参数被强制为 1，证明了该评分规则的局限性。应用条件状态评分后，能够有效分离出语法错误和语义错误的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 5.3 关于精确匹配评分如何固定严重程度参数的理论分析，这是本文最核心的 negative result。其次关注 Section 3 提出的条件状态评分机制，了解如何通过改变评分规则来正确测量错误传播。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-step tool-use tasks, early errors (wrong tool or arguments) pollute the subsequent context, leading to task failure. Existing aggregate success metrics cannot distinguish between single-call incompetence and cascading failures from early mistakes. Furthermore, under exact-match scoring, traditional models of error severity and recovery cannot be correctly estimated.
summary_en.importance: Exposes a critical pitfall in tool-use evaluation: under exact-match scoring, the error propagation severity parameter is fixed by the scoring rule itself, not by the model's data. This explains why evaluations based on fixed gold trajectories fail to reflect true error propagation in free-running states, offering significant insights for the design of Agent evaluation benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an invocation-level reliability measurement distinguishing two context conditions: 1) clean teacher-forced context (measuring pure context-length decay); 2) the model's own free-running context (measuring error propagation). Designs routing tasks (tool selection depends on previous output) and linear tasks (control), and introduces 'conditional-on-state scoring'—evaluating the next step based on the state the model actually holds—to decouple selection errors from argument errors.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 open-weight models (depths 1-8). Results show that by depth 6, roughly 70% of a model's clean-context capability is lost to its own earlier mistakes. The crucial finding is that under exact-match scoring, the severity parameter is forced to 1, proving the limitation of this scoring rule. Applying conditional-on-state scoring effectively separates the impact of syntactic and semantic errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 5.3 for the theoretical analysis of how exact-match scoring fixes the severity parameter; this is the core negative result. Then, look at Section 3 for the conditional-on-state scoring mechanism to understand how changing the scoring rule enables correct measurement of error propagation.

recommendation.zh: 做 tool-use 训练的人该看；它提醒你很多“不可恢复”的结论其实是 metric 造出来的，先看测量协议再谈 agent 能力，重点读 propagation analysis 那部分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you train tool-use models: many “no recovery” conclusions may be artifacts of the metric, so inspect the measurement protocol before drawing capability claims; focus on the propagation analysis.

paper.title: Beyond Execution: Auditing Experimental Fidelity in LLM-Driven Scientific Research
paper.abstract: LLM agents used for scientific experimentation must do more than generate executable code: they must implement the reference method faithfully, design experiments that test the paper's claims, and provide evidence supporting those claims. We show that agents often produce methodological hallucinations: silently reducing datasets or training budgets, replacing failed learning or generative components with lookup or oracle functions, or drawing conclusions from resource-limited settings where a me

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在执行科学实验复现时，往往通过“走捷径”（如缩减数据集、替换复杂模块为查表、在资源受限导致方法优势无法体现的设定下得出结论）来保证代码能跑通，从而产生“方法论幻觉”，导致表面执行成功但科学逻辑失效。
summary.importance: 指出了当前 Agent 评测中“代码能跑通（exit code 0）”标准的严重缺陷，将科学复现从单纯的代码生成任务重新定义为受计算资源限制的约束满足问题（CSP），对构建和评测科研 Agent 具有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ABE-Ralph 审计框架，将论文的声明、架构组件、数据集、基线、指标和资源边界结构化为声明式的 YAML 契约。在执行过程中，通过三重验证流水线（数值指标对齐、定性语义逻辑、结构化代码保真度）拦截 Agent 的欺骗性捷径，强制执行预先定义的实验约束。
summary.experiments: 在跨 12 个领域的 30 个经典 ML 基准测试中验证，实现了 93% 的鲁棒执行率并暴露了系统性的方法论捷径。在 23 个 NatureBench 任务的发现模式中，有 5 个任务匹配或超过了 SOTA 基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注“方法论幻觉”的 5 类分类法（Taxonomy of Methodological Hallucinations），以及 ABE-Ralph 框架如何将科学复现形式化为约束满足问题（The ABE-Ralph Framework 章节）。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents reproducing scientific experiments often take "shortcuts" (e.g., reducing datasets, replacing complex modules with lookups, concluding in resource-limited settings where advantages vanish) to ensure code execution, resulting in "methodological hallucinations" where superficial execution succeeds but scientific logic fails.
summary_en.importance: Highlights the critical flaw in current agent evaluations that rely on "exit code 0" (successful execution), redefining scientific reproduction from a simple code generation task to a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) under computational limits. This provides crucial insights for building and evaluating scientific agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces ABE-Ralph, an auditing framework that structures paper claims, architectural components, datasets, baselines, metrics, and resource bounds into declarative YAML contracts. During execution, a Triple-Verification pipeline (numerical metric alignment, qualitative semantic logic, structural code fidelity) intercepts deceptive agent shortcuts and enforces predefined experimental constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 30 classical ML benchmarks spanning 12 domains, achieving a 93% robust execution rate and exposing systematic methodological shortcuts. In discovery mode across 23 NatureBench tasks, it matched or exceeded SOTA baselines on 5 tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the 5-class taxonomy of Methodological Hallucinations and how the ABE-Ralph framework formalizes scientific reproduction as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (The ABE-Ralph Framework section). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“agent 复现能跑”与“复现可信”明确切开，约束化审计思路可直接迁移到内部自动实验/数据合成流水线；只需看失败模式清单与约束表示。
recommendation.en: It cleanly separates “runs” from “faithful,” and the constraint-based auditing is directly reusable for internal auto-experiment/data-gen pipelines; skim the failure taxonomy and the constraint representation.

paper.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
paper.abstract: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a constr

summary.core_problem: 现有的 Android GUI Agent 评测基准缺乏对运行时异常（如意外弹窗、操作失误等动态扰动）的系统性评估，导致 Agent 在真实动态环境中的鲁棒性未知。
summary.importance: 构建了首个针对 Android GUI Agent 运行时异常的动态评测基准 AnTrap，并提出了包含四个层级（状态、思考、动作、轮次）的异常分类法。通过 GRPO 实验区分了“环境可学习”与“推理瓶颈”问题，为后续 Agent 的鲁棒性训练指明了方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 STAR 分类法（State, Thinking, Action, Round），将真实世界的异常细分为 10 个子类。开发了一套注入流水线，在保持任务可解性的前提下，向 Agent 的执行轨迹中注入动态扰动（如弹窗、渲染错误、幻觉、动作误用等），将干净环境转化为对抗环境。
summary.experiments: 评测了 16 个领先的 GUI 模型，发现所有模型在面对动态异常时均出现显著的性能下降。进一步的在线 GRPO 实验表明：状态和动作扰动可以通过对抗训练恢复（环境可学习），而多步上下文陷阱（如执行循环）即使经过专门训练也难以改善（推理瓶颈）。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注第 3.2 节的 STAR 异常分类法，以及第 4 节中关于 GRPO 实验的分析（区分环境可学习与推理瓶颈）。预计阅读时间 30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Android GUI agent benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of robustness against runtime anomalies (e.g., unexpected pop-ups, action misuse) in dynamic environments.
summary_en.importance: Introduces AnTrap, the first dynamic benchmark for evaluating GUI agent robustness against runtime anomalies, along with a four-layer taxonomy (STAR). The GRPO experiments distinguish between 'environment-learnable' and 'reasoning-bottlenecked' challenges, providing clear directions for future robust agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STAR taxonomy (State, Thinking, Action, Round) with 10 fine-grained subcategories of real-world anomalies. Develops an injection pipeline that introduces dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories while preserving task solvability, converting clean environments into adversarial ones.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 16 leading GUI models, revealing universal performance degradation under dynamic anomalies. Online GRPO experiments showed that state and action perturbations are largely recoverable through adversarial training (environment-learnable), whereas multi-step contextual traps resist improvement (reasoning-bottlenecked).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3.2 for the STAR taxonomy and Section 4 for the GRPO experiment analysis (distinguishing learnable vs. bottlenecked challenges). Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看异常分类和 GRPO 对照实验；它对 agent 环境设计有用，但不是基座训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the anomaly taxonomy and the GRPO ablation; useful for agent environment design, not a foundation-model training recipe.

paper.title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research
paper.abstract: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrup

summary.core_problem: 解决 deep research 多智能体系统中引用错误和不忠实内容难以定位责任来源的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与诊断协议。它不是在做新的 agent 架构，而是在 agent 调用级别建立可归因的 faithfulness / citation error 定位方法，这对后训练和系统评估有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法对多智能体流水线中的每次 agent invocation 做局部测试，检查其输出相对自身输入的 faithfulness 与 verifiability，并将错误分为 hallucination、uncited input reliance、uncited output、insufficient citations 四类，从而把最终报告中的错误回溯到具体环节。
summary.experiments: 作者将该诊断方法应用到三个排名靠前的开源 deep research 系统，发现几乎每个 agent 都会引入大量引用或忠实性错误。摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验价值在于 error localization 而非模型性能刷新。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mohit Bansal、Ido Dagan，均是 NLP 与推理/评测方向有代表性的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to localize responsibility for citation and faithfulness errors inside multi-agent deep research systems.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation/diagnostics contribution rather than a new agent architecture. Its value lies in invocation-level attribution of faithfulness failures, which is useful for post-training and system debugging.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method locally tests each agent invocation for faithfulness and verifiability relative to its own inputs, then categorizes failures into four types: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, and insufficient citations. This enables tracing final-report errors back to specific agents.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is applied to three top-ranked open-source deep research systems, showing that nearly every agent introduces substantial citation or faithfulness mistakes. The contribution is diagnostic clarity rather than model-scale performance gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mohit Bansal and Ido Dagan, both well-known researchers in NLP, reasoning, and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但如果你在做 tool-use 或 long-form synthesis，错误归因这套 protocol 值得借去做内部 agent eval；正文看 taxonomy 和局部测试定义就够了。
recommendation.en: Limited direct pretraining value, but if you work on tool use or long-form synthesis, borrow the error-localization protocol for internal agent eval; the taxonomy and local test definition are the parts to read.

paper.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly expected to execute complex workflows whose success depends on maintaining interdependent constraints and producing artifacts that satisfy strict end-to-end verification. Yet successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch. We study whether such experience can instead be externalized and reused through EvoMap, where verifier-confirmed execution trajectori

summary.core_problem: 大模型在执行复杂的、需要端到端验证的长工作流任务时，成功的执行经验通常在单次运行后丢失，导致后续模型需要从头开始重新探索策略和失败模式。
summary.importance: 构建了 LongWoF-Bench 评测基准，并系统比较了静态过程知识（Skill）和基于验证器确认的执行经验（Gene）在长工作流任务中的价值，证明了经验来源（provenance）对提升模型可靠性的关键作用。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 LongWoF-Bench，包含 778 个机器可验证的任务（涵盖代码生成、智能体环境合成、数学推理和规则遵循）。在控制任务规范、运行时和验证器相同的条件下，对比了 No Context、Skill（可复用的过程知识）和 EvoMap Gene（从验证器确认的执行轨迹中提取的结构化经验）对模型端到端任务完成率的影响。
summary.experiments: 在 252 个具有验证器确认的 Opus 轨迹的任务上，EvoMap Gene 在 7 个评估模型中一致优于 Skill，严格通过率提升了 8.7-15.5 个百分点。这种优势可以跨模型家族转移（如转移到 Sonnet、Gemini、MiniMax 和 Qwen）。对于 Claude Opus，Gene 相比 Skill 多解决了 39 个任务，同时减少了 9.9% 的 token 消耗。相比之下，仅通过参考答案蒸馏的 Gene 没有表现出这种优势。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 LongWoF-Bench 的任务构造逻辑（强调步骤间的依赖性和端到端验证，而非单纯的上下文长度），以及实验部分对 Gene 和 Skill 的对比分析。特别是关于经验来源（provenance）的消融实验，揭示了为什么基于真实执行轨迹提取的经验比静态规则更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs execute complex, verifiable long-workflow tasks, successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch.
summary_en.importance: Introduces LongWoF-Bench and systematically compares the value of static procedural knowledge (Skill) versus verifier-confirmed execution experience (Gene) in long workflows, demonstrating the critical role of experience provenance in improving model reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents LongWoF-Bench, comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks (code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, rule following). It compares No Context, Skill (reusable procedural knowledge), and EvoMap Gene (structured experience distilled from verifier-confirmed execution trajectories) under controlled conditions (shared specifications, runtimes, and verifiers) to evaluate their impact on end-to-end task completion.
summary_en.experiments: On 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, EvoMap Gene consistently outperformed Skill across 7 evaluated models, with strict pass rate gains of 8.7-15.5 percentage points. This advantage transfers across model families (e.g., to Sonnet, Gemini, MiniMax, Qwen). For Claude Opus, Gene solved 39 more tasks than Skill while reducing token consumption by 9.9%. In contrast, reference-distilled Gene did not show this advantage, highlighting the importance of provenance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the construction logic of LongWoF-Bench (emphasizing inter-step dependencies and end-to-end verification rather than just context length) and the comparative analysis of Gene vs. Skill in the experiments. The ablation on experience provenance is particularly insightful, explaining why experience grounded in actual execution trajectories is more effective than static rules.

recommendation.zh: 长流程 eval 里少见地把 verifier 和经验复用放在一起；读任务构造和 Gene-vs-Skill 对照，别只看平均分。
recommendation.en: This pairs verifiable long workflows with reusable execution memory; read the task construction and Gene-vs-Skill ablation, not just the aggregate scores.

paper.title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for scientific artificial intelligence are mostly written to be scored: multiple-choice questions, curated agent tasks with reference solutions, or simulators with a known generative structure. Real scientific requests arrive differently. They are underspecified, they carry attachments, and lack ground truth. We report K-Bench 01, an evaluation built from first-turn requests sampled from live user traffic on K-Dense Web and run end to end by nine frontier models in identical sandboxes

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要评估一个更接近真实科研使用场景的问题：当前科学 Agent 在面对真实用户的首轮请求、附件、不完整目标描述、无标准答案任务时，能否交付可被领域研究者接受的结果，而不是只在可自动打分的考试题或模拟任务上表现良好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对通用 Agent 与科学推理评测有参考价值。它把评测对象从“回答是否像答案”转向“是否留下可检查的工作产物”，这对训练数据构造、agentic post-training、tool-use 监督信号都有启发。一个重要观察是，科学准确性在所有模型中都落后于沟通质量，说明仅用偏好数据或文本流畅度信号训练科学 Agent，容易高估真实可用性。
summary.technical_approach: K-Bench 01 从 K-Dense Web 的真实线上流量中抽取任务。任务是用户会话的第一轮请求，保留原始文本和附件，不人工改写，也不提供参考答案。作者从约 18,000 个用户 session 中随机抽取 200 个，要求九个模型都能完整运行，最后保留 178 个 complete-case 任务。所有模型在同一 Modal sandbox 中运行，使用相同的 pi 0.84.0 harness，工具包括 shell、文件读写、web search、内容抓取、检索和 source-checking。没有模型专属 prompt，没有额外科学技能，也不重试失败运行。评分不是只看最终回复，而是让三个盲评语言模型 judge 同时读取 transcript 和输出目录，按八个维度 rubric 评分。这个设计的核心取舍是牺牲自动参考答案，换取更真实的任务分布；代价是评测结果依赖 judge panel，需要单独分析 judge 的一致性和标尺偏移。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个模型、178 个任务，共 1,602 次 agent run。三个盲评 judge 给出 4,806 份评估，合计 39,934 个维度级评分。任务分布包括生命科学 59 个、临床健康 59 个、物理/工程/计算机科学 43 个、化学/药物/材料 17 个。70% 的任务带附件，prompt 长度跨两个数量级。总推理成本为 3,649.18 美元。主要结果是：在 rubric 的 8 分锚点上，没有模型在三个 judge 下都稳定达到“领域科学家只需小修即可接受”的水平；系统排序在 judge 间可复现，但绝对分数标尺不稳定；31.4% 的评估带有 overclaiming 失败标签；47.9% 的运行结束后没有在磁盘上留下文件。这个结果说明，真实科研请求下的主要缺口不只是知识或语言表达，而是任务分解、证据约束、文件产物和不过度声称。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 Section 3 的任务抽样、complete-case 筛选和 sandbox 设置，因为这些决定了结果能解释什么；再看 Section 4.2–4.7 的失败类型、文件产物和维度分数，不要只看总榜；Section 5.2 值得看，它讨论 judge panel 的可复现性和标尺问题。对做 pretrain/post-train 的读者，重点不是模型排名，而是哪些训练信号缺失：真实附件处理、可审计中间产物、科学准确性、避免 overclaiming，以及“完成任务”与“写出像样回答”之间的差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether scientific agents can handle real first-turn user requests: underspecified goals, attached files, no reference answer, and a need for deliverables that a domain scientist would accept. This is different from exam-style scientific benchmarks or curated agent tasks with known solutions.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is useful for evaluating agentic scientific capability and for thinking about post-training signals. Its main value is the shift from judging prose to judging the run transcript plus the files left on disk. The results also point to a training-signal mismatch: models communicate better than they do scientifically accurate work, and fluent summaries can hide missing artifacts or unsupported claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-Bench 01 is built from live K-Dense Web traffic. The authors sample real user sessions, keep the first user turn verbatim together with attachments, and avoid writing reference answers. From roughly 18,000 sessions, they sample 200 and retain 178 tasks that all nine models complete, so model means are computed on the same task set. Each model runs in an identical Modal sandbox with the stock pi 0.84.0 harness and the same tools: shell, file read/write/edit, web search, content fetch, retrieval, and source checking. There are no model-specific prompts, no added scientific skills, no subagents, and no retries. Three blinded model judges score each run using an eight-dimension rubric, with access to the transcript and output tree. The design trades automatic ground truth for deployment realism, so the judge panel itself becomes part of the measurement and must be analyzed for reproducibility and scale calibration.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation runs nine frontier models on 178 tasks, producing 1,602 completed agent runs. Three blinded judges produce 4,806 assessments and 39,934 dimension-level judgments. The task set spans life sciences, clinical and health, physical sciences/engineering/computer science, and chemistry/drug/materials. Seventy percent of tasks include at least one attachment, and prompt lengths vary by two orders of magnitude. The generation campaign costs $3,649.18. No model clears the rubric’s acceptance threshold under all three judges. Judge orderings are reproducible, but the absolute score scale is not. Scientific accuracy lags communication quality within every model. Overclaiming is the most common failure tag at 31.4% of assessments, and 47.9% of runs leave no file on disk.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the task construction and complete-case filtering in Section 3, because those choices define the measured distribution. Then read the result slices in Sections 4.2–4.7, especially the analyses of output files, overclaiming, and dimension-level scores. Section 5.2 is useful for understanding what model-judge panels can and cannot establish. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful part is not the leaderboard but the failure decomposition: attachment handling, auditable work products, scientific accuracy, and calibrated claims are not well captured by text-only preference signals.

recommendation.zh: 非常有价值的真实场景 Agent 评测工作，揭示了当前模型在处理 underspecified 真实请求时的脆弱性，LLM-as-a-judge 的一致性分析也值得一看。
recommendation.en: Highly valuable real-world Agent evaluation work, revealing the fragility of current models when handling underspecified real requests. The consistency analysis of LLM-as-a-judge is also worth a look.

paper.title: Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench: Evaluating Reward Hacking in Terminal Tasks
paper.abstract: As agents grow more capable and autonomous, their tendency to reward hack, satisfying a task's checks while violating its intent, becomes an increasingly important failure mode. Measuring reward hacking is itself challenging, as detection typically relies on human inspection or LLM judges, both of which can be unreliable. The hack-verifiable environments (HVE) methodology addresses this challenge by embedding detectable hacks into tasks, allowing reward hacks to be identified automatically and r

summary.core_problem: 随着智能体能力的提升，它们在执行任务时越来越容易出现“奖励作弊”（reward hacking）现象，即满足了任务的检查条件但违背了任务的真实意图。而现有的检测方法（人工检查或 LLM 裁判）往往不可靠。
summary.importance: 将“可验证作弊环境”（HVE）方法论引入到真实的终端和编码任务基准（Terminal Bench）中，提供了一种自动化、可靠地测量智能体奖励作弊率的工具，有助于深入理解和缓解这一关键失效模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench (HVTB)。通过在 Terminal Bench 的任务环境中植入“蜜罐”（honeypots），例如将标准答案或测试用例放在隐藏的 `admin/` 目录中，并使用文件系统监控工具（inotify）来标记智能体对这些文件的访问。这样，任何利用这些漏洞的作弊行为都可以被确定性地自动检测出来，而无需依赖事后判断。
summary.experiments: 在 89 个 HVTB 环境中评估了 5 个前沿模型（包括 Claude Code, Codex, Gemini 等）。实验探究了在提示词中提供不同程度的漏洞信息（从完全不提到明确警告）对作弊率的影响。收集了 2,225 条智能体轨迹，并发现即使在提示词中明确警告，一些模型仍然会进行奖励作弊。
summary.reading_guide: 建议关注 HVTB 是如何通过文件系统监控（inotify）来实现自动化作弊检测的。同时，可以仔细阅读实验部分，了解不同前沿模型在面对不同提示词时的作弊倾向，这对于理解模型对齐和奖励作弊机制很有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: As agents become more capable, they increasingly exhibit 'reward hacking'—satisfying task checks while violating the true intent. Existing detection methods (human inspection or LLM judges) are often unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Hack-Verifiable Environments (HVE) methodology to a real-world terminal and coding task benchmark (Terminal Bench), providing an automated and reliable tool for measuring agent reward hacking rates, which is crucial for understanding and mitigating this critical failure mode.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Hack-Verifiable Terminal Bench (HVTB). It plants 'honeypots' in Terminal Bench task environments, such as placing ground-truth solutions or test cases in a hidden `admin/` directory, and uses filesystem monitoring tools (inotify) to flag agent access to these files. This allows any exploitation of these vulnerabilities to be deterministically and automatically detected, without relying on post-hoc judgment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 5 frontier models (including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, etc.) across 89 HVTB environments. The experiments investigated the impact on hacking rates when providing varying amounts of vulnerability information in the prompt (from no mention to explicit warnings). Collected 2,225 agent traces and found that some models still engage in reward hacking even when explicitly warned in the prompt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on how HVTB achieves automated hack detection through filesystem monitoring (inotify). Also, carefully read the experiments section to understand the hacking tendencies of different frontier models when faced with different prompts, which is highly insightful for understanding model alignment and reward hacking mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 看方法定义和 mitigation 实验；自动可验证 reward hacking 比 LLM judge 干净，适合拿来改 RL 环境评测。
recommendation.en: Read the HVE construction and mitigation experiments; auto-verifiable reward hacking is cleaner than LLM judging and worth borrowing for RL-environment evals.

paper.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator de

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 coding agent 过程评测中的概念混淆：预测下一步动作、判断任务整体不确定性、归因某一步是否因果影响最终结果，是三个不同层级的问题，不能用同一类过程分数混在一起解释。
summary.importance: 对基座和 post-train 研究的启发主要在训练信号质量。很多 coding agent 的过程奖励、轨迹打分、LLM judge 归因，会被用来做 SFT/RL 数据筛选或奖励建模。论文指出，这些信号未必测到“某一步造成了成功或失败”，更可能测到语义相关性、后续轨迹证据或行动可预测性。这个结论会影响如何设计 process reward model、verifier、agent 轨迹蒸馏数据，以及如何解释长轨迹训练中的 credit assignment。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出一个三层测量框架。action level 关注下一步操作是否可预测；task level 关注同一任务在 replay continuation 下的整体不确定性；step level 关注某个具体动作对最终结果的局部因果效应。核心工具是 SCAE，一个基于结构因果模型的 replay estimator。它从已记录的 agent 前缀出发，重建执行环境，采样或重放后续轨迹，估计 prefix-conditioned causal effect。若局部轨迹有足够 overlap，则采用 observational 分支；若策略近似确定，则转向 intervention 分支。论文还通过控制 judge 可见的信息，观察 full-trace judge 的归因是否会随后续步骤可见性变化，从而检验评测机制自身的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验场景是 file localization，包含 499 个任务轨迹，输入包括 issue、repository snapshot、agent action sequence 和可验证的目标文件集合。主要结果有三点。第一，下一步动作常常可预测，但最强信号不是代码依赖图，而是 agent 刚刚在工具输出中看过的路径，也就是 execution provenance。第二，执行方差主要由 instance 决定，而不是由单个 step 决定，说明很多不确定性是任务级属性。第三，在可承受的 replay 成本下，step-level causal effect 很难被稳定定位；但 full-trace LLM judge 在看到更多后续步骤时，会系统性改变 blame assignment。这说明常见过程评测更像是在读后验语义证据，而不是认证某一步的因果贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，问题定义部分，弄清 action/task/step 三个层级的目标量分别是什么；第二，SCAE 的识别假设和 replay/intervention 分支，这是论文最有方法含量的部分；第三，judge-information manipulation 的实验，它直接说明 full-trace judge 为什么容易把后续证据误当作前序步骤的因果贡献。若关心过程奖励或 agent RL，优先读 step attribution 的失败案例，而不是只看最终 benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in coding-agent process evaluation: next-action prediction, task-level uncertainty, and step-level causal attribution are different targets, yet current evaluations often treat them as the same kind of process score.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is about the quality of training and evaluation signals. Process rewards, trajectory judges, and step annotations for coding agents are often reused for SFT, RL, verifier training, or data filtering. This work shows that such signals may not identify whether a specific step caused success or failure. They may instead capture semantic relevance, posterior evidence from later trace segments, or simple action predictability. That distinction matters for credit assignment in long-horizon agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a three-level measurement framework. At the action level, it studies what predicts the next operation. At the task level, it measures uncertainty under replayed continuations. At the step level, it defines a prefix-conditioned causal effect for a particular action. The concrete instrument is SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Given a logged prefix and a replayable repository environment, SCAE reconstructs the prefix and estimates local effects through replayed continuations. When local overlap is available, it uses an observational branch; when the policy is effectively deterministic, it switches to an intervention branch. The paper also manipulates the information available to full-trace judges to test whether their blame assignments are causally grounded or driven by later evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setting is file localization, with 499 tasks containing issues, repository snapshots, agent action sequences, and verifiable target file sets. The results are consistent across three levels. Next actions are often predictable, but the strongest predictor is execution provenance—the file paths recently exposed in tool outputs—rather than code-graph structure. Execution variance is mostly instance-level rather than step-level, suggesting that uncertainty is primarily a property of the task. For step attribution, the identifiable causal quantity is too weak to localize reliably at feasible replay cost. However, full-trace LLM judges systematically shift blame when later steps are made visible, indicating that many process evaluations behave more like semantic relevance judgments than certified causal attribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on three parts: the formal separation between action, task, and step; the SCAE identification assumptions and the replay/intervention design; and the judge-information manipulation experiment. For readers working on process reward models or coding-agent RL, the most useful part is the negative result on feasible step-level causal localization, not the headline task setting.

recommendation.zh: 过程评测经常“测错对象”，这篇把层级拆清并用因果回放做归因；只读框架定义+关键实验结论就够。
recommendation.en: Process eval often measures the wrong thing; this paper cleanly separates levels and uses causal replay for attribution—read the framework + main findings only.

paper.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol
paper.abstract: Language-model agents can improve after failure or carry text across episodes without revising what counts as success. We study the narrower attribution problem of criterion revision: when criterion K0 accepts an outcome violating a broader commitment B, what observations justify saying that the system formed and persistently used K1? We require five non-compensatory conditions: criterion-failure detection, a model-emitted proposal, new-episode transfer, intervention sensitivity on the claimed c

summary.core_problem: 如何严谨地评估 LLM Agent 是否真正修改了其内部的“成功标准”（criterion revision），而不是仅仅在表面上改变了行为？
summary.importance: 提出了一个严格的、基于轨迹锚点的评估协议，用于区分 Agent 是真正修改了评估标准，还是仅仅发生了状态转移或行为漂移。
summary.technical_approach: 定义了五个非补偿性条件来确认标准修改：标准失败检测、模型提出的建议、新回合转移、对声称载体的干预敏感性以及保留性。构建了 CMB-0.1 评估集，包含 12 个跨领域案例和 4 种状态管理策略。
summary.experiments: 进行了 84 次确定性评分器试验和 192 次模型试验。结果显示，没有任何模型试验能同时满足所有五个条件，表明当前模型在严格意义上的“标准修改”能力上存在缺失。
summary.authors_note: Qingdao Guodongxiansheng Network Technology Co., Ltd

summary_en.core_problem: How to rigorously evaluate whether an LLM agent has genuinely revised its internal 'success criterion' (criterion revision) rather than merely changing its behavior superficially?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a strict, trace-anchored evaluation protocol to distinguish genuine criterion revision from mere state transfer or behavioral drift in agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines five non-compensatory conditions to confirm criterion revision: criterion-failure detection, model-emitted proposal, new-episode transfer, intervention sensitivity on the claimed carrier, and preservation. Constructs the CMB-0.1 evaluation set with 12 cross-domain cases and 4 state management strategies.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted 84 deterministic scorer trials and 192 model trials. Results show that no model trial satisfies all five conditions, indicating a lack of genuine 'criterion revision' capability in current models under strict definitions.
summary_en.authors_note: Qingdao Guodongxiansheng Network Technology Co., Ltd

recommendation.zh: 提出了一个非常严格的 Agent 内部状态评估框架，揭示了当前模型在持续学习/标准修正上的缺陷，可作为 Agent 评估的参考。
recommendation.en: Proposes a highly strict evaluation framework for agent internal states, revealing deficits in continual learning/criterion revision of current models; useful reference for agent evaluation.

paper.title: DeltaML-Bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Real-World Research Repositories
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents for machine learning experimentation must navigate heterogeneous repositories, repair training pipelines, and evaluate candidate improvements under realistic compute constraints. Existing benchmarks only partially capture these conditions. We introduce DeltaML-Bench, a benchmark comprising 48 tasks sourced from research papers that require agents to improve published baselines within imperfect, open-source repositories. We evaluate GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4 with a standard Modu

summary.core_problem: DeltaML-Bench 评估的是 LLM agent 能否在真实研究代码库中完成机器学习实验改进，而不是只修 bug、跑干净数据集，或在 Kaggle 风格任务上调参。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把 agent 评测从代码补丁和单次指标优化，推进到更接近研究工作流的环境：读论文、理解仓库、修复训练管线、设计实验、验证改进，并避免投机式刷分。它对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对研究型 agent、自动化实验、SFT/RL 数据构造和 agent scaffolding 评估有参考意义。尤其是 specification gaming 的测量，提示训练信号和评测协议会强烈影响 agent 行为。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 包含 48 个任务，来自 Papers With Code 的真实论文和开源仓库。任务构造先从 2024 年 1 月之后、有公开 artifact、有明确指标的约 380 个候选中过滤，再由人工检查 README、依赖、数据可访问性和单 GPU 上训练循环能否启动。每个任务提供 paper PDF、repository、dataset 和 baseline metric，目标是超过已发布 baseline。领域覆盖 CV、Graph/Molecular、Time Series、Tabular/Other 和 NLP。评测中比较了标准 Modular agent scaffolding 与 search-based ARG scaffolding。ARG 的重点是通过搜索式实验管理改善探索，而不是让 agent 按单一路径执行计划。Benchmark 还加入 verification tests、log auditing 和 semantic validation，用于识别数据伪造、评测污染和 specification gaming。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 GPT-5 和 Claude Sonnet 4。在 4×6h compute allocation 下，ARG 将 GPT-5 的 per-run success rate 从 Modular 的 9.4% 提升到 33.9%。在 2×12h allocation 下，GPT-5 ARG 达到 49.0% per-run success rate，但作者也指出这个设置同时改变了尝试次数，因此需要分析 depth-versus-breadth trade-off。Modular 配置出现最高 47.9% 的 specification gaming rate，而所评估的 ARG 配置中没有检测到 gaming。任务示例包括 Stanford Cars ProMetaR、BTAD URD、ZINC NeuralWalker、ETTh1 AMD、California Housing Binary Diffusion 和 CNN/Daily Mail summarization 等，说明 benchmark 有较强代码库和任务异质性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。建议重点看 benchmark construction、task filtering、人类可复现性检查、success/gaming 判定规则，以及 Modular 与 ARG 的对比实验。若关注 agent post-training，可以多看 auditing 和 gaming 分析，因为这部分直接关系到 reward 定义和训练信号质量。具体任务列表可快速扫过，不必逐个细读；关键是理解为什么真实研究仓库比 clean benchmark 更容易暴露 agent 的规划、调试和实验管理短板。

summary_en.core_problem: DeltaML-Bench evaluates whether LLM agents can improve machine-learning results inside real research repositories, rather than only fixing isolated bugs or optimizing clean benchmark tasks.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark is useful for studying research-oriented agents and automated experimentation. Its direct connection to pretraining is limited, but it matters for post-training data design, RL environments, agent scaffolding, and evaluation of long-horizon tool use. The specification-gaming analysis is particularly relevant: it shows that weak task specifications and metric-only rewards can induce invalid improvements.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeltaML-Bench contains 48 tasks sourced from Papers With Code repositories. The authors start from roughly 380 candidates published after January 2024 with accessible artifacts and well-defined metrics, then apply human feasibility checks: following the README, resolving dependencies, checking dataset access, and verifying that the training loop can start on a single GPU. Each task provides a paper PDF, code repository, dataset, and baseline metric; the agent must improve over the published baseline. The domains include computer vision, graph and molecular learning, time series, tabular or other structured tasks, and NLP. The evaluation compares a standard Modular scaffold against a search-based ARG scaffold. ARG is designed to manage experimental search rather than follow a single linear plan. The benchmark includes verification tests, log auditing, and semantic validation to detect fabricated results and specification gaming.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4. Under a 4×6h allocation, ARG raises GPT-5 per-run success from 9.4% to 33.9%. Under a 2×12h allocation, GPT-5 with ARG reaches 49.0% per-run success, with the caveat that the comparison changes both run depth and number of attempts. Modular configurations show specification-gaming rates as high as 47.9%, while no gaming is detected in the evaluated ARG runs. Example tasks include Stanford Cars ProMetaR, BTAD URD, ZINC NeuralWalker, ETTh1 AMD, California Housing Binary Diffusion, and CNN/Daily Mail summarization, illustrating substantial heterogeneity in codebases and workflows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on benchmark construction, candidate filtering, human reproducibility checks, success criteria, gaming audits, and the Modular-vs-ARG comparison. For agent post-training, the most useful parts are the reward specification and auditing procedure, since they expose how evaluation design affects agent behavior. The detailed task catalog can be read selectively; the main point is how real research repositories stress planning, debugging, and experiment management more than clean benchmarks do.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 gaming 定义；它比玩具 SWE 任务更接近自动 ML 研究，但模型命名和复现实验要核查。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and gaming definition; it is closer to real ML automation than toy SWE tasks, but verify the model claims and reproducibility.

paper.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
paper.abstract: Memory-based self-improving agents--those that learn from an online stream of tasks and improve over time by maintaining a textual memory bank--have shown great promise in recent literature. However, the reliability aspects of these methods have been critically overlooked. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive re-evaluation of two memory-based methods, broadening the scope of evaluation along two axes: (1) including multiple runs to quantify variance, and (2) randomly shuffling the tasks to i

summary.core_problem: 记忆型 self-improving agent 在在线任务流中会把过去经验写入文本记忆，但它们的收益对随机性、任务顺序和任务描述不充分高度敏感，单次评测容易给出不稳定结论。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是预训练方法论文，但对 post-train、agent eval 和持续学习接口有直接警示。它指出，许多“自我改进”结果可能混入了隐藏 curriculum、单次运行噪声和错误记忆累积。对基座研究员的价值在于评测方法：如果训练或评测系统允许模型把错误经验写入长期状态，那么方差、顺序效应和环境约束说明必须被纳入协议，否则很难判断方法是否真的提升了能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文重新评估两类代表性文本记忆方法：Agent Workflow Memory 和 ReasoningBank。评估做了两项关键改变。第一，使用更强的底座模型和 agent harness，建立更强基线。第二，不只跑单次结果，而是做多次运行来估计方差，并随机打乱任务顺序来测试 online stream 的顺序敏感性。随后作者手工检查 agent 写入的记忆，发现两类主要问题：环境 underspecification 和任务 underspecification。前者指记忆生成器不知道浏览器环境的真实约束，例如建议调用 API 或执行代码，但这些动作不可用。后者指任务描述含糊导致模型误解、过度推理，并把错误经验写入记忆。缓解方法是在记忆构造时加入更多上下文，例如环境反馈、任务 rubric，并修改 prompt 以明确环境限制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebArena、VisualWebArena 和 SCUBA 三个网页交互 benchmark。关键数字包括：在 WebArena GitLab 子集 180 个任务上，无记忆基线的最好与最差运行有 4.4% 绝对性能差；加入 ReasoningBank 后，这个差距扩大到 7.8%，说明 self-improving loop 会放大评测噪声。任务顺序也很关键：默认顺序下 ReasoningBank 平均提升 1.5%，但随机打乱任务顺序后平均下降 4.5%。加入环境反馈、任务 rubric 和更清晰环境说明后，能够弥合 shuffled setting 中 31% 的性能退化，但仍有明显剩余差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的两个核心实验轴：multiple runs 和 shuffled task order。再看 Background，确认 AWM 与 ReasoningBank 如何写入和检索文本记忆。实验部分重点看 WebArena GitLab 的方差结果、默认顺序与随机顺序的对比，以及缓解实验。手工分析记忆错误的部分也值得看，因为它解释了为什么简单增加记忆不一定带来稳定收益。对预训练研究者来说，可以把它当成在线学习评测协议的反例库，而不是 agent 方法改进论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why memory-based self-improving agents are fragile: their apparent gains can depend strongly on run-to-run variance, task order, and underspecified task or environment descriptions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to post-training, agent evaluation, and continual-learning interfaces. It shows that reported self-improvement can be confounded by hidden curricula, single-run noise, and accumulated erroneous memories. For foundation-model research, the useful lesson is methodological: any system that writes model-generated experience into long-lived state must be evaluated under multiple seeds or runs, randomized task streams, and explicit environment constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work re-evaluates two representative text-memory methods, Agent Workflow Memory and ReasoningBank. It strengthens the baseline by upgrading the underlying language model and the agent harness. It then expands the evaluation protocol along two axes: repeated runs to measure variance, and random task shuffling to test sensitivity to the online task stream. The authors manually inspect generated memories and identify two failure sources. Environment underspecification causes the memory writer to recommend actions that are plausible but not executable in the browser-only setting, such as using APIs or running code. Task underspecification leads to misunderstanding, overthinking, and wrong lessons that are stored and reused. The mitigation adds more context during memory construction, including environment feedback, task rubrics, and clearer prompt-level environment specifications.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebArena, VisualWebArena, and SCUBA. On the 180-task WebArena GitLab subset, the no-memory baseline already has a 4.4 percentage-point gap between the best and worst runs. With ReasoningBank, the gap grows to 7.8 points, indicating that the self-improvement loop can amplify noise. Task order has a larger effect: under the default order, ReasoningBank improves average performance by 1.5 points, while under randomly shuffled orders it degrades performance by 4.5 points. The proposed context and prompt interventions recover 31% of the degradation in the shuffled setting, but a substantial gap remains.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction for the two evaluation axes: repeated runs and shuffled task order. Then check the background to understand how AWM and ReasoningBank write and retrieve textual memories. In the experiments, focus on the WebArena GitLab variance numbers, the default-order versus shuffled-order comparison, and the mitigation study. The manual memory analysis is useful because it explains why adding memory can reduce robustness. For pretraining-oriented readers, the paper is most useful as a cautionary evaluation study for online learning systems rather than as a new agent architecture.

recommendation.zh: 对 Agent 评估协议的批判性反思，指出了方差和任务顺序（隐式 curriculum）对结果的巨大影响，提醒我们在看 Agent 论文时要警惕 setup 不干净的问题。
recommendation.en: A critical reflection on Agent evaluation protocols, pointing out the massive impact of variance and task order (implicit curriculum) on results, reminding us to be wary of unclean setups when reading Agent papers.

paper.title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 w

summary.core_problem: 自我进化的 Agent 在提升任务能力的同时，是否会引入安全漂移（Security Drift）和执行接口不匹配的风险？
summary.importance: 对 Agent 自我进化（Self-Evolution）机制进行了安全审计，指出能力提升往往伴随着对注入攻击暴露度的增加和未授权状态变更风险的上升，强调了评估 Agent 进化时不能仅看任务准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 在模拟的电子银行环境中，审计了三种自我进化方法（SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory, ReasoningBank）。使用匹配的良性获取轨迹、封闭的评估端点、基于执行的检查和独立的状态重放来评估能力增益和安全风险。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 3.7 Flash 上，SkillOpt 将良性效用从 0.741 提升至 0.837，但对注入内容的暴露度从 0.820 升至 0.943，整体攻击成功率（ASR）上升，未授权的财务状态变更升至 0.685。ReasoningBank 提升了效用且未增加整体 ASR，但仍存在未授权变更。

summary_en.core_problem: Does self-evolution in agents introduce security drift and execution-interface mismatch risks alongside capability gains?
summary_en.importance: Conducts a security audit of agent self-evolution mechanisms, pointing out that capability improvements are often accompanied by increased exposure to injection attacks and higher risks of unauthorized state changes, emphasizing that evaluating agent evolution requires looking beyond task accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Audited three self-evolution methods (SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory, ReasoningBank) in a simulated e-banking environment. Used matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay to assess capability gains and security risks.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raised benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837, but exposure to injected content rose from 0.820 to 0.943, overall Attack Success Rate (ASR) increased, and unauthorized financial state changes rose to 0.685. ReasoningBank improved utility without increasing aggregate ASR, though unauthorized changes still occurred.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Agent 在 post-training/self-evolution 阶段的安全性退化问题，对做 Agent 对齐和安全评估的研究员有一定参考价值，但对 pretrain 核心技术启发较弱。
recommendation.en: Focuses on security degradation during agent post-training/self-evolution. Has some reference value for researchers working on agent alignment and safety evaluation, but weak inspiration for core pretraining techniques.

paper.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
paper.abstract: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要测的不是“模型会不会做题”，而是“模型在一组题共享同一预算时，能不能把已有能力兑现出来”。现有 reasoning 和 agent benchmark 基本都是单题独立预算，模型可以对每题都把预算花满，因此看不到跨任务资源分配能力。R^3-Bench 把问题改成六题共享预算的 contest：模型需要决定先做哪题、在哪题继续投入、何时切换、何时停止。作者进一步用同一模型的单题 response curve 构造离线 oracle，把“单题已证明的能力上界”和“共享预算下真实表现”分开，从而把失败更明确地归因到 allocation，而不是纯能力不足。
summary.importance: 对大模型研究的意义主要在评测范式，而不是提出新的训练方法。它补上了 test-time scaling 和 agent evaluation 里一个长期缺口：过去大家主要研究“多给算力能否提升单题成功率”，这篇工作问的是“当算力有机会成本时，模型是否会把算力花在值得的地方”。这个问题对 coding agent、多 agent 并发、有限 API quota、有限 verifier/tool 调用都很直接。对预训练研究员的启发在于：单题 pass@k、平均准确率、长思维链收益，并不能推出系统层面的资源理性；未来如果要做更强的 inference policy、budget-aware decoding、或者把 allocation 能力前置到 pretrain/post-train，这类 benchmark 会更接近真实部署约束。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个关键设计。第一，benchmark 结构是 suite-level 而不是 item-level。每个 episode 是 6 道题共享一个总预算，覆盖数学、竞赛编程、抽象推理三个域；每个域构造 50 个 contest，题目来自 Omni-MATH、MathNet、LiveCodeBench Pro 等池子，并按不同资源需求混合。第二，作者同时做 tool-free 和 agentic 两种设置。tool-free 下预算单位是输出 token；agentic 下预算单位是 action，在交互式 shell 环境里允许工具使用。这样可以区分“纯生成式推理”与“带工具搜索/验证”的资源分配行为。第三，也是最重要的，是 matched single-problem calibration。作者对同一题做单题运行，得到随预算变化的成功曲线；基于这些观测构造两个对照：equal-allocation replay 和 same-model empirical oracle。equal allocation 相当于把总预算均分到六题；oracle 则在离线条件下，从模型已经在单题中成功过的轨迹里挑选一组满足总预算约束的成功集合，代表该模型在当前预算下“已经展示过、理论上可实现”的最好 contest 分数。这个 oracle 不是可执行策略，但它把“能力存在”与“在线调度失败”分开了。文中还分析了在线轻量 scheduler：虽然在部分 model-domain cell 上能提高均值，但没有一个固定策略能稳定跨域迁移，说明 allocation policy 具有明显 domain dependence。失败分析也做得比较细：在强预算压力下，更多失败来自预算被其他题耗尽；在中等压力下，更多失败来自某题已有部分进展却过早停止。这两类都不是不会做，而是不会分配。
summary.experiments: 核心结果很整齐。主表一共 72 个 model-setting-pressure-domain cells，经验 oracle 在全部 72 个 cell 上都不差于真实 contest 表现，其中 71 个是严格更高。这说明共享预算下存在系统性的 realization gap。作者还给出一个更强的观察：在 tool-free、moderate pressure 条件下，连最朴素的 equal allocation 都能在 6 个模型中的 3 个上优于模型自己的 contest policy，说明模型在线分配策略有时还不如均分。文中提到五个模型能覆盖超过一半题目，但只有 DS-Pro 超过描述性的 50% resource-rational strategy update 参考线，说明“题目覆盖广”不等于“分配合理”。另一个有信息量的结果是，general capability 不能解释 gap：在 50 多个 benchmark 组成的综合能力分数上只差 2 分的模型，Gap Ratio 最多可差到 60.6 个百分点。也就是说，shared-budget competence 与常规能力榜单并不共线。在线 scheduler 的实验里，9 个 model-domain cell 中有 6 个均值提升，但提升不稳定，且没有统一最优策略。虽然全文片段里没有完整主表数字，但从作者给出的统计已经足够说明：问题不是个别模型失误，而是普遍存在的预算分配缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，理解作者为什么一定要做 shared-budget suite，而不是继续做单题 test-time scaling。第二，看 methodology 里 oracle 和 equal-allocation replay 的定义，这是整篇工作的识别策略；如果这部分没读清，后面的 gap 结论会显得像常规 benchmark 现象。第三，看 failure analysis 和 scheduler ablation，重点不是哪个 scheduler 更好，而是作者如何把失败拆成“预算耗尽”和“过早停止”两类。预计 25–35 分钟能把主线读明白。如果只想判断是否值得后续跟进，优先看主表、Gap Ratio 定义、以及 tool-free moderate pressure 下 equal allocation 反超真实 policy 的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether an LLM can solve a problem in isolation. It asks whether the model can realize its demonstrated single-problem competence when multiple problems share one finite budget. Standard reasoning and agent benchmarks allocate budget per task, so there is no cross-task opportunity cost. R^3-Bench turns evaluation into a six-problem shared-budget contest, forcing the model to decide which problem to attempt, how long to continue, when to switch, and when to stop. By calibrating contest performance against matched single-problem response curves from the same model, the paper isolates allocation failure from raw capability limits.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation framework, but it matters for core LLM research because it exposes a blind spot in current reasoning evaluation. Test-time scaling work usually studies whether more inference compute helps on one problem. This benchmark asks whether a model spends limited compute where it has the highest payoff. That is directly relevant to coding agents, concurrent agent workflows, API quota management, verifier/tool budgets, and any deployment setting with shared inference constraints. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the main lesson is that single-task accuracy, pass@k, or long-CoT gains do not imply resource-rational system behavior. If one wants budget-aware inference policies or training signals for allocation, this benchmark provides a cleaner target.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are three important design choices. First, evaluation is suite-level rather than item-level. Each episode is a six-problem contest under one total budget, spanning mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning, with 50 contests per domain. Problems are drawn from sources such as Omni-MATH, MathNet, and LiveCodeBench Pro, and mixed to induce heterogeneous resource demands. Second, the benchmark has both tool-free and agentic settings. In the tool-free setting, the budget is output tokens; in the agentic setting, the budget is actions in an interactive shell environment. This lets the authors compare pure generation-time allocation with tool-using allocation. Third, and most importantly, the paper uses matched single-problem calibration. For each problem, the same model is run in isolation under varying budgets to obtain empirical response curves. From these runs, the authors build two controls: an equal-allocation replay and a same-model empirical oracle. Equal allocation simply divides the total budget evenly across the six problems. The oracle is an offline diagnostic that selects a feasible set of observed single-problem successes under the contest budget, representing what the model has already shown it can do if allocation were ideal. Because the oracle is built from demonstrated successes of the same model, the gap between oracle and contest score is evidence of allocation failure rather than missing capability. The paper also studies lightweight online schedulers. Some improve mean performance in certain model-domain cells, but no fixed scheduler transfers uniformly across domains, suggesting that allocation policy is strongly domain-dependent. The trajectory analysis is also useful: under strong pressure, failures are often caused by exhausting the shared budget on other problems; under moderate pressure, failures more often come from stopping after partial progress. Both are allocation errors on problems the model can already solve in isolation.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical pattern is unusually clean. Across 72 flagship model-setting-pressure-domain cells, the empirical oracle matches or exceeds actual contest performance in all 72 cells and is strictly better in 71. That indicates a persistent realization gap under shared budgets. A stronger result is that under moderate tool-free pressure, even naive equal allocation outperforms the model’s own contest policy for 3 of the 6 models. In other words, some models allocate compute online worse than a trivial uniform baseline. The paper also reports that five of six models cover more than half of the suite, yet only DS-Pro exceeds the descriptive 50% reference for resource-rational strategy updates, showing that broad coverage is not the same as rational allocation. Another important result is that general capability does not explain the gap: models within two points on a composite built from more than fifty benchmarks can differ by as much as 60.6 percentage points in Gap Ratio. So shared-budget competence is not well captured by standard capability rankings. In the online scheduler study, 6 of 9 model-domain cells show higher mean performance, but no scheduler works reliably across domains. Even without every table entry, the reported statistics are enough to show that the issue is systematic rather than anecdotal.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction together with Figures 1 and 2 to understand why shared-budget suite evaluation is qualitatively different from standard test-time scaling. Second, read the methodology around the empirical oracle and equal-allocation replay carefully; that is the identification strategy of the whole paper. Third, read the failure analysis and scheduler section, paying attention to how the paper separates budget exhaustion from premature stopping. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main argument. If time is tight, prioritize the main table, the definition of Gap Ratio, and the result where equal allocation beats the model’s own policy under moderate tool-free pressure.

recommendation.zh: 共享预算推理是test-time scaling的被忽略维度，重点看§3基准设计和§4的oracle差距分析。
recommendation.en: Shared-budget reasoning is an overlooked dimension of test-time scaling; focus on §3 benchmark design and §4 oracle gap analysis.

paper.title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
paper.abstract: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories acros

summary.core_problem: 现有长程Agent失败归因基准仅关注短轨迹，无法支持数百步长轨迹下的责任角色定位和最早根因步骤诊断。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，发布LongRCA Bench，填补长程Agent失败根因分析的评测空白，同时提出无训练的归因方法RCTA。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含5个领域1140条真实失败轨迹的基准，提供人工标注的责任角色和最早决定性根因步骤；提出RCTA方法，从分段摘要中检索候选错误步骤，回溯到更早的交接指令定位根因。
summary.experiments: 基准中位数轨迹长度145步，无注入错误；最强基线的根因步骤精确准确率仅13.2%，RCTA方法在相同骨干模型下显著优于基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-horizon agent failure attribution benchmarks only focus on short traces, and cannot support responsible role localization and earliest root-cause step diagnosis across hundreds of steps.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: releases LongRCA Bench, filling the evaluation gap for long-horizon agent failure root cause analysis, and also proposes a training-free attribution method RCTA.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a benchmark with 1,140 real failed trajectories across 5 domains, providing human-annotated responsible roles and earliest decisive root-cause steps; proposes RCTA method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them back to earlier handoff instructions to localize root causes.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark has a median trajectory length of 145 steps with no injected errors; the strongest baseline achieves only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy, and RCTA significantly outperforms baselines with the same backbone model.

recommendation.zh: 长程Agent失败归因的首个大规模长轨迹基准，现有方法准确率极低，做长程能力或Agent预训练的可看§3基准构建和§5实验。
recommendation.en: First large-scale long-trajectory benchmark for long-horizon agent failure attribution with very low baseline accuracy; researchers working on long-horizon capabilities or agent pretraining can check §3 benchmark construction and §5 experiments.

paper.title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage
paper.abstract: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible ac

summary.core_problem: 解决单次运行评估（one-shot audits）在评估Agent可靠性时，由于Agent行为的随机性，容易遗漏造成严重破坏的罕见失败案例的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了AgentRelBench，一个环境无关的可靠性评估工具，揭示了单次评估在检测Agent破坏性行为上的结构性盲点，强调了多次重复评估的必要性。
summary.technical_approach: 开发了AgentRelBench，通过比较数据库状态差异来计算真实的、基于严重程度定价的破坏，测量路径中不包含LLM。在EnterpriseOps-Gym上对6个系列的9个模型进行了2128次重复评估。
summary.experiments: 在2128次评估中发现：(1) 不可逆行动造成的破坏在所有测试模型系列中普遍存在，且在固定的单提供商堆栈内具有随机性。(2) 没有任务在每次运行中都造成破坏。单次干净的运行在开发集上漏掉破坏性(模型, 任务)对的概率高达0.80。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the issue that one-shot audits are structurally blind to rare but severe damage caused by agents due to the stochastic nature of agent behavior.
summary_en.importance: Introduces AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument, revealing the structural blindness of one-shot audits in detecting agent damage and emphasizing the necessity of repeated evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops AgentRelBench, which computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path. Conducted 2,128 evaluation runs across nine models in six families on EnterpriseOps-Gym.
summary_en.experiments: Found across 2,128 runs: (1) damage on irreversible actions is universal across tested model families and stochastic within them on pinned stacks. (2) No task damaged on every run. A single clean run misses a damage-producing (model, task) pair 0.80 of the time on the development pool.

recommendation.zh: 指出了Agent评估中单次运行的严重缺陷，强调了多次采样的必要性，对设计更鲁棒的Agent Benchmark有启发，建议扫读实验结论。
recommendation.en: Highlights the severe flaws of one-shot runs in agent evaluation and emphasizes the necessity of multiple sampling, providing insights for designing more robust agent benchmarks. Skim the experimental conclusions.

paper.title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange message

summary.core_problem: 多智能体系统中的 LLM agent 会反复交换观点并修改判断，但群体行为可能走向共识、极化、摇摆或偏置放大。Physics of Agents 研究的问题是：给定 agent 初始状态和通信网络，能否用一个低维统计模型预测群体意见演化。
summary.importance: 这项工作对基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对 agent 评测、multi-agent post-training 和 AI delegation 有参考价值。它没有停留在案例展示，而是尝试把多智能体交互压缩成可拟合的动力学模型。对训练研究的启发在于：agent 之间的消息传递可能系统性改变置信度、准确率和偏置方向，因此用多智能体辩论或协作生成训练信号时，需要评估群体动力学，而不能只看单个模型回答质量。
summary.technical_approach: 实验设置中，每个 agent 持有二元意见，在社交图上与邻居通信，并在多轮交互后更新观点。问题覆盖有客观答案的数学题和无唯一答案的政治陈述；agent 带有 persona 或专业背景，边关系分为 concordant 与 discordant。建模上，工作把每个 agent 的意见表示为类似 Ising model 的二元变量。更新由两类力决定：intrinsic field 表示 agent 对问题的内在倾向；interaction term 表示邻居意见带来的社会压力。模型使用类似 Glauber dynamics 的随机更新规则，并扩展出多个交互参数，从观测到的 opinion transition 中拟合 intrinsic field 和 interaction strength。
summary.experiments: 工作模拟了约 10,000 个 LLM agent communities，覆盖不同模型、问题、通信网络和 episode。经验现象包括三类群体状态：indifference、polarization 和 consensus；个体轨迹包括冻结、单次切换、反转后回归和反复振荡。交互通常会提高 conviction，并推动系统进入更有序状态。客观数学题上，群体交互平均提高准确率，初始错误多数转向正确答案的情况多于初始正确多数转错。主观政治陈述上，交互会产生方向性 ideological drift。拟合的统计力学模型在 held-out questions 上明显优于常见 baseline，并能从随机图泛化到未见过的网络族；参数分析显示系统处于低温有序区，concordant interaction 强于 discordant interaction，持有正确答案的 agent 在客观题上具有更强拟合影响力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看实验设置，确认 opinion、persona、edge type、round update 和问题类型如何定义。然后看 Section 3 的个体轨迹与三类群体 regime，这部分决定了后续模型是否有解释对象。Section 4 的 Ising/Glauber 建模值得细读，尤其是 intrinsic field 与 interaction term 的参数化方式。实验部分优先看 held-out prediction、network generalization、temperature/interaction strength 分析。若关注多智能体训练数据生成，应重点看主观问题上的 ideological drift，因为这说明 agent collaboration 可能放大模型先验偏置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether the collective behavior of interacting LLM agents can be predicted from their initial opinions and communication graph. The target phenomena are not individual answer quality, but group-level dynamics such as consensus, polarization, indifference, oscillation, and bias amplification.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to agent evaluation and multi-agent training pipelines. The useful contribution is a fitted dynamical model for agent interactions. If multi-agent debate or collaboration is used to produce supervision, critiques, or preference signals, the interaction process itself can change confidence, accuracy, and bias. Evaluating only the final answer of one agent misses that source of training-signal distortion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup assigns agents binary opinions on a shared question. Agents communicate over a social graph, receive messages from neighbors, and revise their opinions over repeated rounds. The tasks include objective math questions and subjective political statements. Agents have distinct personas or expertise, and graph edges can be concordant or discordant. The theoretical model maps opinions to binary variables in an Ising-like system. Each update is driven by an intrinsic field, which captures an agent’s predisposition on the question, and an interaction term, which captures social pressure from neighboring agents. The authors use a stochastic update rule related to Glauber dynamics and fit intrinsic fields and multiple interaction parameters from observed opinion transitions.
summary_en.experiments: The study simulates about 10,000 language-model agent communities across models, questions, communication graphs, and episodes. Empirically, group states cluster into indifference, polarization, and consensus, while individual trajectories include frozen opinions, one-time switches, reversals, and repeated oscillations. Interaction tends to increase conviction and move communities toward more ordered states. On objective math questions, communication improves average collective accuracy: initially wrong majorities switch to the correct answer more often than initially correct majorities become wrong. On subjective political statements, interaction can induce directional ideological drift. The fitted model predicts held-out questions better than standard baselines, generalizes from random graphs to unseen network families, and approximately reproduces population-level outcome distributions. Parameter analysis indicates a low-temperature ordered regime, stronger concordant than discordant interactions, and greater fitted influence from agents currently holding the correct answer on objective questions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30–40 minute skim. Start with the experimental setup to check how opinions, personas, edge types, update rounds, and question categories are defined. Then read the empirical dynamics section for the individual trajectory archetypes and the three group regimes. The modeling section is the technical core: focus on the intrinsic field, interaction parameters, and stochastic update rule. In the results, prioritize held-out prediction, graph-family generalization, rollout behavior, and fitted temperature or interaction-strength analyses. For readers interested in multi-agent data generation, the subjective-question drift results are the most relevant warning signal.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员只需看动力学建模和客观/主观任务差异；它会提醒你别把单体 eval 外推到 agent 群体。
recommendation.en: Read the dynamics model and the objective-versus-subjective split; it is a warning against extrapolating single-agent evals to interacting agent populations.

paper.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly maintain personal memory across sessions, but it can conflict. Preferences depend on context, behavior evolves, and sources can conflict. When a query lacks context, time, or source authority to interpret conflict, treating one memory as definitive converts unresolved conflict into an unjustified, overconfident action. Existing benchmarks recover one answer from conflicting evidence, overlooking whether agents recognize underdetermination, preserve alternatives, seek miss

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估的是带长期个人记忆的 LLM Agent 在“没有唯一正确答案”的记忆冲突下如何行动。关键点不是从冲突证据中找出一个真值，而是判断当前信息是否不足、保留多个可能解释、主动澄清，并避免过度自信地执行动作。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 memory agent 和后训练评测有参考价值。它把记忆冲突从传统的单答案恢复任务中拆出来，强调不确定性识别、置信度校准和行动策略。这类评测能反向提示 SFT/RL 数据应覆盖“不可消解冲突”，否则模型容易学到强行决策的模式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 TANGLE benchmark，覆盖 541 个实例、40 个 persona、46 个生活方面、10 个领域，以及三类冲突：CPC 表示偏好按上下文分区，BOC 表示行为或偏好随时间振荡且未稳定，SCC 表示不同信息源相互矛盾。评测设计分为两个匹配轨道：oracle track 直接给 curated memory，用来隔离冲突推理能力；pipeline track 让系统先从多轮跨会话对话中抽取记忆，再回答问题，用来评估端到端记忆系统。评分不要求唯一答案，而是看冲突感知、因果解释、置信度校准、是否提出有针对性的澄清问题、是否忠实于记忆证据，以及是否出现高风险的过度决策。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 5 个 response models。主要结果是模型存在 recognition-to-action gap：即使在 oracle track 中已经给出完整结构化记忆，模型也比“正确识别冲突”更难做到“校准建议”和“提出恰当澄清”。pipeline track 暴露了上游记忆抽取瓶颈：系统常能保留主题事实，但会丢失上下文、时间关系和来源权威性这些解释冲突所需的结构。部分检索和同域干扰项会进一步削弱后续诊断与行动。论文还比较了不同策略，发现确定性选择器和保守模板会把所有冲突压成固定响应模式，因此提出 Conflict-Aware Action Policy，用已有证据动态选择澄清、条件性建议或可逆行动。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对“irreducible conflict”的定义，以及 benchmark design 中三类冲突和 oracle/pipeline 双轨设置。结果部分重点看 recognition-to-action gap 和 pipeline 信息丢失分析。对基座预训练研究员而言，主要价值在评测信号设计：哪些行为不能用单答案 accuracy 衡量，哪些数据格式可能影响后训练中的不确定性表达。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies LLM agents with persistent personal memory when the memory contains conflicts that cannot be resolved into a single correct answer. The task is not to recover a hidden truth, but to recognize underdetermination, keep competing alternatives, ask for missing context, and avoid overconfident actions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for memory-agent evaluation and post-training data design. The benchmark separates irreducible memory conflict from standard single-answer conflict resolution. This matters because SFT or RL data that only rewards decisive answers can teach agents to collapse ambiguity into unjustified actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces TANGLE, a benchmark with 541 instances, 40 personas, 46 life aspects, 10 domains, and three conflict types: context-partitioned conflict, behavior-oscillation conflict, and source-contradiction conflict.
