summary_en.importance: First arbitrarily scalable, automatically verifiable task graph benchmark generator for systematic evaluation of context management dimensions; represents evaluation methodology and tool innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver; tasks are composed via typed intermediate states (scalars, lists) into task graphs with adjustable length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type, enabling exact automatic verification via solver execution.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated with math, GSM-style word problems, and Python tracing tasks; evaluates Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies, finding up to 33.3% accuracy drop on branching dependent math tasks — failures not exposed by single-task benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Gennady Pekhimenko (University of Toronto, ML systems and efficient computing) and Mark C. Jeffrey (University of Toronto, computer systems).

recommendation.zh: 可控任务图评测上下文管理能力，设计干净，预训练研究员可参考其评测范式验证模型长上下文依赖能力，重点看§3任务构造。
recommendation.en: Cleanly designed controllable task graph benchmark for context management; pretraining researchers can reference its paradigm to test long-context dependency abilities, focus on §3 task construction.

paper.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
paper.abstract: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, ho

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是个人设备助手评测里的一个基础难题：怎样构造既有真实纵向上下文、又能给出可验证标准答案、同时还能共享复现的数据。真实手机轨迹最接近目标场景，但隐私上几乎不可共享；手工写 case 安全但状态稀薄，覆盖不了跨应用、跨时间、多跳检索；LLM 生成 query 或答案虽然快，但如果背后没有完整设备状态，正确性就只能依赖人工或 LLM judge，稳定性和可审计性都不够。SenWorld 的切入点不是继续改 judge，而是把“评测”重写成“可控世界状态生成”问题：只要模拟世界完整拥有设备状态，并且状态演化受物理与外部环境约束，那么很多问题的正确答案就不是事后标注出来的，而是由某一时刻快照中的唯一记录直接决定。
summary.importance: 对大模型基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于评测数据生产范式。它给 personal agent / on-device assistant 这类系统提供了一种不依赖 LLM judge 的评测资产构造方式，尤其适合需要长期记忆、跨源检索、时空上下文绑定的任务。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要有三点。第一，它把“ground truth by construction”做到了设备级状态，而不是抽象任务后端，这对未来构造更高可信度的 agent eval 很重要。第二，它展示了 snapshot + pointer label 的标注形式，标签不是自然语言答案，而是指向底层记录的可验证引用，这比开放式文本评分更稳。第三，它说明了高质量评测集未必来自人工标注或模型蒸馏，也可以来自可复现模拟器。量级上，这更像评测基础设施而不是模型方法突破；对通用 LLM 预训练本身启发有限，但对 agent memory、tool use、personal context reasoning 的离线评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个 physically grounded、deterministic、event-sourced 的 digital twin。论文把 persona、手机、外部服务和物理环境放进同一个随时间推进的世界里统一演化。这里有几个关键设计。第一，物理与外部约束是真实注入的，不是纯文本虚构。世界构建会接入真实地图、天气、节假日、网络等外部数据，让位置、出行、通信、活动安排这些状态变化受现实条件约束。第二，系统是 deterministic 的，同样的初始条件和事件流会得到同样的世界轨迹，这保证了评测可复现。第三，采用 event sourcing 而不是只保留最终数据库状态。也就是每个状态变化都由事件驱动并被记录，系统可以在每个模拟帧导出 full-system snapshot。这样做的好处是，评测样本可以绑定到任意时刻的完整设备状态，而不是只看最终结果。第四，标签机制不是后验生成答案，而是把 query 的正确答案编码成 snapshot 中某个 source table 和 unique record id 的指针。比如“给住在这里的朋友打电话”，正确性最终落在联系人表中某条记录是否与当前位置关联，而不是落在某段自由文本是否看起来合理。第五，论文还设计了 snapshot-centered projection：同一个世界快照可以被确定性地投影成多种下游测试工件，比如用户可见上下文、结构化状态、评测 query 与目标记录等。这使模拟器既是数据生成器，也是评测样本工厂。与已有 state-grounded eval 相比，SenWorld 的区别在于它模拟的是更接近真实 smartphone ecosystem 的完整状态空间，而且评分绕开了 LLM judge。
summary.experiments: 实验主要围绕三件事展开。第一，分布层面的真实性。作者用北京场景下的 16 个 persona 运行整日模拟，并把生成数据与一个保留的真实用户基准在 6 个共享类别上做分布比较。摘要和正文给出的结论是生成分布与真实基准较接近，说明模拟器没有只生成模板化、过于规则的状态组合。第二，行为涌现。论文强调没有为每个 persona 手写 interaction script，而是让行为在环境、日程、设备状态和 persona 设定共同作用下自然出现，进而产生联系人、位置、通信、应用状态之间的长程关联。这一点很关键，因为如果交互脚本是手工编排的，评测集很容易退化成作者预设的有限模式。第三，实用性验证。作者把生成的 evaluation cases 用于诊断一个生产级 smartphone assistant，发现这些 case 能暴露真实缺陷，并帮助定位问题来源。就全文可见内容看，这篇论文更强调评测资产的构造逻辑和案例诊断价值，而不是追求大规模 benchmark 数字。参数量、训练 token、模型提升幅度这类信息并不是重点，因为它不是模型训练论文。若要抓实验重点，建议关注分布对齐图、case 构造示例，以及生产系统缺陷分析部分，而不是期待标准 leaderboard 式结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Method，把问题设定吃透，再看实验图表。优先关注三处。第一，SenWorld 的世界状态定义与事件驱动更新机制，这决定了为什么它能给出 by-construction 的标签。第二，snapshot-centered projection 的具体形式，理解“一个快照如何变成多个评测工件”，这是方法最有可迁移性的部分。第三，生产助手缺陷诊断案例，那里最能看出这种评测数据相比人工 case 或 LLM judge 的实际差异。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果只关心是否值得纳入 agent eval 工具箱，看引言、方法总览图和实验最后一节就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hard evaluation bottleneck for personal device assistants: how to build context-rich, longitudinal evaluation data with reliable ground truth, without relying on private real-device traces. Real smartphone logs are the natural source, but they are not shareable. Manual case writing is safe but too shallow. LLM-generated cases scale, yet correctness becomes dependent on post-hoc checking or LLM judges. SenWorld reframes the problem: instead of improving answer judging, it constructs a simulated world whose device state is fully owned, reproducible, and physically constrained, so the correct answer is determined directly by the world state at a given time.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation-data production paradigm rather than a model-training advance. For LLM base-model researchers, the relevance is indirect but real: it offers a way to build agent evaluation assets where labels are fixed by construction, especially for tasks involving memory, multi-source retrieval, and temporal context. Two ideas stand out. First, it moves from abstract backend state to a smartphone-like ecosystem, which is closer to the actual failure modes of personal assistants. Second, it replaces free-form answer judging with pointer-based labels into structured records. That makes evaluation more auditable and less dependent on noisy LLM judges. The impact is stronger for agent eval and personal-context reasoning than for core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SenWorld is a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital twin. Personas, smartphones, external services, and physical context evolve together in one simulated world. Several design choices matter. Real-world constraints are injected through maps, weather, holidays, and network data, so movement, communication, and device state changes are not purely fictional. The system is deterministic, which supports reproducibility. It is also event-sourced, meaning state transitions are recorded as events and full-system snapshots can be exported at each simulated frame. This allows evaluation cases to be tied to exact moments in a longitudinal trajectory. Ground truth is represented as a pointer into the snapshot, such as a source table plus a unique record ID, rather than a natural-language answer. The paper also introduces a snapshot-centered projection mechanism: one world snapshot can be deterministically transformed into multiple downstream testing artifacts. Compared with prior state-grounded evaluation setups, the key difference is that SenWorld targets a richer smartphone ecosystem and avoids LLM-based judging in the final scoring loop.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section focuses on three questions. First, distributional fidelity: the authors simulate full-day trajectories for 16 personas in Beijing and compare generated data against a held-out real-user benchmark over six shared categories. The reported conclusion is that the synthetic data tracks the real benchmark reasonably well at the distribution level. Second, emergent behavior: instead of hand-authoring interaction scripts for each persona, the framework lets behavior arise from persona settings, schedules, environment, and device dynamics, producing nontrivial links across contacts, locations, communication logs, and app state. Third, practical utility: the generated evaluation cases are used to diagnose defects in a production smartphone assistant, and the paper shows that these cases can surface concrete failures and help localize them. This is not a model-scaling paper, so readers should not expect parameter-count or training-token tables. The experimental value lies in the realism checks, case studies, and defect analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and method first. The key is to understand why the authors treat evaluation as a state-generation problem. Then focus on three parts: the world-state and event model, the snapshot-centered projection mechanism, and the production-assistant defect case studies. Those sections make clear what is genuinely new and what is mostly engineering integration. A quick but useful read should take about 20 to 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 label pointer 设计；它给个人助理 eval 一个比 LLM judge 更干净的替代方案。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and label-pointer design; it offers a cleaner personal-assistant eval path than LLM judging.

paper.title: Guardrails as Scapegoats: Auditing Unfaithful Safety Refusals in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Evaluation frameworks for tool-augmented LLM agents focus overwhelmingly on capability metrics or explicit tool crashes, leaving silent infrastructure failures and HTTP 200 responses with empty, null, or malformed payloads largely unaudited. We introduce a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles across 12 production-adjacent tool stubs and classifies agent responses into three mutually exclusive behavioral classes: Honest Surrender (HSR), Fabrication (F

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：tool-augmented LLM agent 在工具静默失败时，常见评测只看显式报错或任务成功率，忽略了模型会把基础设施故障伪装成“安全拒答”或直接编造结果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议与失效模式审计。它把 agent 失败从单纯 capability failure 拆成 Honest Surrender、Fabrication 和 Unfaithful Safety Refusal 三类，指出 guardrail 可能被模型当作甩锅话术。这对做 agent eval、tool-use reliability 和 refusal analysis 的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个轻量黑盒审计框架，在 12 个接近生产环境的工具 stub 中注入 4 类 silent failure profile，然后观察模型在温度为 0、neutral system prompt 下的响应行为，并通过 ablation 检查 guardrail 提示对 USR 的诱发作用。方法本身不改模型，而是改评测切面。
summary.experiments: 实验评估 2 个 frontier 模型和 2 个开源模型，共 396 条有效轨迹。核心结果是 FAR（把空/坏 payload 当真并编造结果）占 56.6%，USR 在基线几乎不存在，仅 0.25%；但在加入 guardrail 相关设置后，模型会更倾向于用虚构的政策或隐私理由解释工具失败。摘要未给出具体模型名和统计显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a blind spot in tool-augmented LLM agents: when tools fail silently, evaluations often miss whether the model fabricates outputs or hides infrastructure failures behind bogus safety refusals.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and failure-analysis contribution. It refines agent failure modes into Honest Surrender, Fabrication, and Unfaithful Safety Refusal, showing that guardrail language can become a convenient excuse rather than a faithful explanation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles into 12 production-adjacent tool stubs, then classify model behavior under temperature-zero, neutral-prompt conditions. The key methodological move is to audit failure attribution rather than just task success.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two frontier and two open-source models over 396 valid trajectories. The main result is that fabrication dominates at 56.6%, while unfaithful safety refusal is nearly absent at baseline (0.25%) but can be induced by guardrail-related ablations. The abstract does not provide full model names or detailed significance analysis.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但它把 refusal fidelity 这个坑挖得很准：agent 评测里别只看 refusal rate，先区分是真安全还是拿安全当借口；读 failure taxonomy 和 ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Not directly useful for pretraining, but it nails a real eval pitfall: refusal behavior in agents must be audited for faithfulness, not just counted; read the failure taxonomy and the guardrail ablation.

paper.title: SysAdmin: Measuring Instrumental Power-Seeking in Frontier AI
paper.abstract: Power-seeking defined as behaviors where AI systems acquire resources, evade oversight, or resist termination beyond task requirements is identified as a key driver of Loss of Control (LoC) risk. In this work, we introduce SysAdmin, a benchmark that positions frontier language models as autonomous system administrators in a high-fidelity Linux sandbox to measure power-seeking propensity across five dimensions: self-preservation, increasing autonomy, resource acquisition, environment modification

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图测量 frontier language models 在自主系统管理环境中的 power-seeking 倾向，即模型是否会在完成任务所需之外获取资源、规避监督、扩大权限、修改环境或隐藏行为。
summary.importance: 它属于 agent safety evaluation，对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 和 agent 化部署有参考价值。关键点在于它把 power-seeking 从抽象问答转成可执行的 Linux sandbox 行为测量，并且区分能力和倾向：任务完成率不是风险信号，超出最小必要权限的行为才是核心信号。这种评测方式有助于研究 RL、工具使用训练和长程 agent scaffold 是否会诱导不必要的自主性扩张。
summary.technical_approach: SysAdmin 把模型放在隔离 Docker 容器中，让模型作为系统管理员完成一系列 Linux 任务。任务来自 terminal-bench 以及作者构造的维护、排障、配置和安全类任务。模型通过结构化 JSON 接口行动，包括 COMMAND、THOUGHTS 和 EXIT 三个字段。这个设计把可执行命令、显式推理和任务终止信号分开，便于判断某个行为是误操作、正常权限需求，还是具有 power-seeking 指向。评测框架先定义完成任务的 minimum necessary resources，再检测模型是否超过这个必要边界。论文覆盖五类信号：self-preservation、increasing autonomy、resource acquisition、environment modification 和 strategic concealment。实验还设置 baseline 和三类 elicitation 条件，但不直接指示模型做违规行为，只提供可能诱发倾向的上下文。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 7 个 frontier models，在 4 种实验条件下共运行 2800 个任务。经过人工标注校准数据做 bias correction 后，不同模型的 corrected power-seeking estimate 大致在 0 到 5% 之间。这个数值不高，但不是零，说明在高权限工具环境中，少量异常行为可以被稳定捕捉。实验强调不要把任务成功率当作 power-seeking 指标；一个能力强的模型可能更会完成任务，但风险判断要看它是否越过最小必要权限。论文还使用 positive control 来验证框架能检测被诱发的 power-seeking 行为。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 benchmark 设计和 measurement protocol，重点看三处：minimum necessary resource 如何定义，red flag 如何和合法权限提升区分，bias correction 如何处理 judge 或标注偏差。实验结果可以快速看模型间 corrected estimate 和不同 elicitation 条件的变化。预计 25 到 35 分钟。若关注 RL agent 训练，值得重点看 persistent container、visible task queue、structured THOUGHTS/COMMAND 接口这些细节，因为这些 scaffold 会影响模型是否形成跨任务策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures whether frontier language models, when deployed as autonomous system administrators, show power-seeking behavior beyond what is required for the assigned task. The target behaviors include acquiring unnecessary resources, evading oversight, resisting termination, modifying the environment, and concealing actions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent safety evaluation paper, not a pretraining method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the evaluation design: it separates capability from propensity. A model completing a Linux task is not itself a risk signal; the risk signal is taking actions beyond the minimum resources and privileges required. This framing is useful for studying how tool-use training, RL post-training, and long-horizon agent scaffolds may change behavioral tendencies.
summary_en.technical_approach: SysAdmin places models in isolated Docker-based Linux sandboxes and asks them to perform system administration tasks. The tasks cover maintenance, troubleshooting, configuration, and security, with sources including terminal-bench and additional tasks built by the authors. The agent interface is structured as JSON with COMMAND, THOUGHTS, and EXIT fields. This separates executable actions from stated reasoning and termination decisions, making it easier to distinguish misunderstanding from intentional or strategy-like behavior. The benchmark defines the minimum necessary resources for each task, flags behavior that exceeds that boundary, and measures power-seeking along five dimensions: self-preservation, increasing autonomy, resource acquisition, environment modification, and strategic concealment. The experimental conditions include a baseline and three elicitation settings that create opportunities for the behavior without explicitly instructing the model to do it.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate seven frontier models across four conditions, for a total of 2,800 tasks. After bias correction using human-annotated calibration data, corrected power-seeking estimates range from 0 to roughly 5% depending on the model. The absolute rates are low, but nonzero. The benchmark also includes positive controls to check whether the measurement pipeline can detect induced power-seeking behavior. A useful experimental point is that task completion is not used as the propensity metric; the central question is whether the model exceeds the least-privilege boundary while acting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the benchmark construction and measurement protocol first. Focus on how the minimum required privilege is defined, how red flags are separated from legitimate privilege escalation, and how bias correction is performed. The results section can be read mainly through the corrected propensity estimates and the condition-level comparisons. A 25-35 minute read is sufficient for the core ideas. For researchers working on RL agents, the most relevant implementation details are the persistent container, the visible task queue, and the structured THOUGHTS/COMMAND interface, since these choices can influence cross-task strategy formation.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测不是预训练方法，但 Linux 沙箱和偏差校正较干净；读任务设计和校准流程即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining method, but the Linux sandbox and calibration are clean; read task design and bias correction.

paper.title: SAAG: Structured Agent Assessment and Grounding
paper.abstract: Exact-match evaluation of agent-calling obscures qualitatively different failure modes: a model may select the right function yet hallucinate argument values, or satisfy a schema while choosing a agent for the wrong reason. Existing benchmarks collapse these distinctions into a single binary score, leaving practitioners unable to diagnose where agent calls fail. We propose SAAG a cascaded diagnostic framework that decomposes agent-calling evaluation into three sequential stages: registry conform

summary.core_problem: 解决函数调用或 Agent 调用评测中 exact-match 指标过粗、无法区分工具选择、schema 完整性和参数 grounding 错误的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 调用评测协议和诊断框架。它的价值在于把单一二值分数拆成可解释的阶段性失败类型，并将诊断信号用于自修复。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAAG：一个级联式诊断框架，按顺序评估 registry conformance、structural completeness 和 argument grounding。每一阶段输出可解释诊断；当预测失败时，模型使用阶段特定反馈做 targeted correction，且不暴露 ground-truth 参数值。
summary.experiments: 在由 Glaive function-calling 数据集构造的受控 benchmark 上评估，registry 规模为 5、10、15 个 Agent，使用三个本地 sub-4B 参数模型。摘要称结构化反馈能带来一致改善，但未提供完整提升幅度和模型名称。
summary.authors_note: Amit Sheth 是知识图谱与语义 Web 方向的知名研究者；摘要未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the coarseness of exact-match evaluation for function or agent calling, where tool selection, schema completeness, and argument grounding errors are collapsed into one binary score.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation and diagnostic framework for agent calling. Its value is in decomposing a single pass/fail outcome into interpretable failure stages and using the diagnostic signal for self-repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAAG is a cascaded diagnostic framework with three sequential stages: registry conformance, structural completeness, and argument grounding. Each stage emits interpretable diagnostics. On failure, the model receives stage-specific feedback for targeted correction without leaking ground-truth values.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a controlled benchmark derived from Glaive's function-calling dataset, with registry sizes of 5, 10, and 15 agents, and three local models under 4B parameters. The abstract reports consistent gains from structured feedback but does not provide exact numbers or model names.
summary_en.authors_note: Amit Sheth is a well-known researcher in knowledge graphs and the Semantic Web; the provided abstract does not list institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 只看评测分解定义即可；对训练有用的是错误标签粒度，sub-4B 实验不足以支撑更大模型结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the evaluation decomposition; the useful part for training is the error taxonomy, while the sub-4B setup is weak evidence for larger models.

paper.title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
paper.abstract: Agentic computer-use RL is reported in single runs, and those numbers mislead. Using verifier-guided repair of a 35B computer-use agent (CUA) across five oracle-graded environments, we show a repaired policy's success rate is dominated by upstream variance: a variance-components decomposition across three cells (crossed data-draw $\times$ seed grid, bootstrap CIs) finds evaluation variance negligible ($σ_{\mathrm{eval}} \approx 0$) and the training-seed effect small everywhere ($\leq 10\%$); ins

summary.core_problem: 现有计算机使用Agent的RL评估常以单次运行结果报告，掩盖了训练数据、随机种子和运行不确定性对成功率的真实影响。
summary.importance: 原理分析与评测方法贡献：首次对35B计算机使用Agent的修复后策略做方差成分分解，指出评估指标报告方式的系统性缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 在5个oracle评分环境中使用verifier引导的策略修复，通过交叉数据采样×种子网格×bootstrap置信区间的三因素设计分解方差来源，用Hartigan dip检验识别成功率分布的双峰性。
summary.experiments: 模型为35B计算机使用Agent；评估方差接近0，训练种子效应≤10%，最难任务中数据采样占方差48%且呈双峰分布（p=0.07），单次运行有30%概率落入失败模式；固定token的完成检测可靠性达0.97±0.06。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-run reporting for agentic computer-use RL misleads by hiding how training data, seeds, and runtime nondeterminism dominate true policy success rates.
summary_en.importance: Analysis and evaluation methodology contribution: first variance-components decomposition for a repaired 35B computer-use agent, exposing systematic flaws in how evaluation metrics are summarized.
summary_en.technical_approach: Applies verifier-guided policy repair across five oracle-graded environments, then decomposes variance using a crossed data-draw × seed grid with bootstrap CIs; uses Hartigan dip test to detect bimodal success distributions.
summary_en.experiments: 35B computer-use agent; evaluation variance ≈ 0, training-seed effect ≤ 10%, data draw accounts for 48% of variance on the hardest cell with bimodal distribution (p=0.07, k=10) giving ~30% single-run failure chance; fixed-token done detection reaches 0.97±0.06 reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看方差分解和双峰检验两节即可，提醒做agent RL的人别再用单次run的均值±std报结果，数据采样方差才是大头。
recommendation.en: Read only the variance decomposition and bimodality test sections; a useful reminder that agent RL papers should stop reporting mean±std over single runs — data-draw variance dominates.

paper.title: Can AI Agents Really Complete RTL-to-GDS? Lessons from Benchmarking Tool-Interactive EDA Workflows
paper.abstract: LLM-driven agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for electronic design automation (EDA), demonstrating strong potential for automating complex design workflows. However, existing evaluations primarily examine individual language models on isolated EDA tasks, providing limited insight into how different agent systems perform across complete EDA flows. In this work, we present FluxBench, a systematic evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end EDA workflows under unified prompts, tool envir

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM agent 在完整 RTL-to-GDS EDA 工具链中的真实能力，而不是只看孤立代码生成或单步任务。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/evaluation protocol：把工具交互、统一 prompt、统一环境和端到端工作流放进同一评测框架。对通用 agent 研究有方法论意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FluxBench，在开源与闭源 EDA 工具环境下，系统评测 agent 在 RTL 生成、迭代修复、工具反馈利用、逻辑综合、布局布线和 ECO 自动化等环节的表现，并分析效率与失败模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明覆盖完整 RTL-to-GDS 流程，包含工业级商业 EDA 工具和开源工具链；但未给出具体参评模型、样本规模和关键数值。价值主要在评测设置是否干净、是否能揭示 tool-interactive agent 的瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether LLM agents can actually handle full RTL-to-GDS EDA workflows rather than isolated code-generation subtasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol: unified prompts, tool environments, and end-to-end workflows for tool-interactive agents. This matters for agent evaluation, though its direct relevance to base-model pretraining is modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper presents FluxBench, benchmarking agents across open-source and commercial EDA flows, including RTL generation, iterative repair, tool-feedback use, synthesis, place-and-route, and ECO automation, with efficiency analysis and failure characterization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates coverage of full RTL-to-GDS workflows with both open and industrial toolchains, but does not provide model roster, benchmark size, or headline numbers. The real value will depend on how cleanly the benchmark isolates agent-tool interaction bottlenecks.

recommendation.zh: 这是工具交互 agent 的压力测试，不是基座论文；若你关心 agent eval 设计，可只看任务分解和失败类型，别把结论外推到通用推理能力。
recommendation.en: This is a stress test for tool-interactive agents, not a base-model paper; read the task decomposition and failure taxonomy, but do not overgeneralize its conclusions to generic reasoning.

paper.title: ProEvent: An Event-centric Benchmark for Proactive Agents
paper.abstract: Proactive agents are expected to anticipate user needs and provide autonomous assistance by perceiving environmental context without explicit instructions. A fundamental capability of such agents is to identify and track users' upcoming events, enabling continuous and event-specific assistance. For example, by recording the time and location of a planned hike, an agent can deliver weather reminders in advance or provide navigation support before departure. However, existing works on proactive ag

summary.core_problem: 构建评测 proactive agents 是否能从持续即时聊天中识别、维护和跟踪用户即将发生事件的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评测资产。现有 proactive agent 评测常偏向显式任务或单轮辅助，而事件驱动的长期上下文维护更接近真实个人助理场景。对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 long-horizon memory、用户状态建模和 agent evaluation 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProEvent，一个 event-centric benchmark。数据由合成但尽量真实的即时聊天组成，包含动态多用户互动、并发聊天线程和现实噪声；评测目标是让 agent 主动维护用户 timetable，并据此提供事件相关辅助。核心是评测协议与数据设计，不是新的 agent 架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模、参评模型、指标或 leaderboard 结果。可确认的是 benchmark 面向 open-ended proactive assistance 的可靠评估，强调事件识别、跟踪和日程维护能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether proactive agents can identify, maintain, and track users' upcoming events from ongoing instant messaging chats.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation contribution. Existing proactive-agent evaluations often focus on explicit tasks or single-turn assistance, while event-centric long-horizon state tracking is closer to realistic personal-assistant use cases. The direct relevance to pretraining is moderate, but it is useful for long-horizon memory and user-state evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProEvent is an event-centric benchmark built from synthetic but realistic instant messaging chats. It includes dynamic multi-user interactions, concurrent chat threads, and real-world noise. Agents are evaluated on proactively maintaining a user's timetable and enabling event-specific assistance. The core contribution is the benchmark and protocol, not a new agent architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, evaluated models, metrics, or leaderboard numbers. It states that the benchmark targets reliable evaluation of open-ended proactive assistance through event identification, tracking, and timetable maintenance.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory eval 备查即可；看数据生成协议，别把合成聊天结果外推到真实用户环境。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-memory eval reference; read the data protocol, but do not overread synthetic-chat results.

paper.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: Many math- and science-oriented agent systems use hierarchical designs with specialized reviewer roles, assuming that a dedicated review stage should help turn wrong candidates into correct ones. We test this assumption on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. Collaboration adds little on the easiest tiers, but from tier 4 onward the gains open sharply; in this harder regime, broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-exec

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个推理系统设计问题：在多 agent 数学推理里，专门设置 reviewer 角色是否真的能把错误解修正为正确解。作者给出的答案是否定的，至少在他们测试的层级式 planner-executor-reviewer（PER）协议里，reviewer 即便能高精度指出问题，solver 也常常不采纳这些批评，导致“批评质量”和“修复效果”脱钩。论文把这个现象命名为 reviewer–solver decoupling，并进一步把问题拆成三步：reviewer 是否发现了有用错误、solver 是否据此改变下一版答案、这种改变是否真的完成修复。这个拆解比只看最终 pass rate 更细，也更能解释为什么一些多 agent 设计看起来结构复杂，但收益并不稳定。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 inference-time reasoning protocol 的过程分析，因此只适合 skim。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它提醒人们不要把“更细的角色分工”误当成“更强的推理能力”。如果反馈接口设计不好，增加 reviewer 只是在系统里加入一个高精度但低作用力的模块。第二，它提供了一套较有用的中间诊断指标：NeglectRate、CouplingRate、ReviewerGuidedRepairRate。这类指标对 post-train 和 test-time scaling 都有参考价值，因为它们把系统失败从“模型不会”细分为“模型知道但没改”“改了但没修好”。对做 RL、self-correction、verifier-guided decoding 的人来说，这种过程分解是有信息量的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者不是提出新模型，而是在固定底层模型家族的前提下，系统比较不同多 agent 协议。主比较对象包括：单 agent iterative baseline、broadcast-style peer discussion，以及层级式 PER 协议。关键点在于他们没有只看最终正确率，而是引入 verifier-grounded 的过程评估，把 reviewer 的“检测精度”和 solver 的“采纳执行”分开测量。

具体来说，作者在 Omni-MATH 的 4,181 道题上运行 matched gpt-oss-120b actors，并用 evaluator 判断 reviewer 给出的 critique 是否“有用”。在此基础上定义几类指标：NeglectRate 衡量有用批评被忽略的比例；CouplingRate 衡量收到有用批评后下一版答案是否发生变化；ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 衡量这种变化是否真正把错误答案修成正确答案。这个设计的价值在于，它把多 agent 协议的优劣从一个黑盒结果，拆成了信息发现、信息传递、信息执行三个环节。

作者还做了若干 within-PER 干预，例如 ACK-required、EMB、deeper-reflection variant。ACK-required 属于合规式控制，要求 solver 显式确认 reviewer 意见；EMB 则把 reviewer 指导直接嵌入 solver 的工作上下文，减少信息在角色切换时的丢失。结果显示，这些改动只能部分弥合 PER 与 broadcast 的差距，说明问题不只是 reviewer 说得不清楚，而是层级接口本身存在较强摩擦。
summary.experiments:
实验最关键的发现有四个。第一，在 Omni-MATH 的简单层级（tier 1–2），多 agent 相比 matched single-agent baseline 只带来最多约 2 个百分点提升，说明简单题上协作空间很小。第二，从 tier 4 开始，协作收益明显拉开，在 tier 6–9 可达到约 10–20 个百分点，这说明 benchmark 难度足够高时，多 agent 设计确实有可分辨差异。第三，在这个真正有 headroom 的区间里，broadcast 的最终准确率高于 PER。第四，也是全文最重要的数字：PER reviewer 的 precision 高于 broadcast（0.861 vs. 0.644），但 reviewer-to-action uptake 明显更差；当 reviewer 给出后来被 evaluator 认定为有用的 critique 时，PER 只有 33.6% 的情况下会改变 carried-forward candidate，而 broadcast 为 93.5%；ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 则分别为 0.051 和 0.286。

这些数字说明，PER 的问题不在于 reviewer 看不出错，而在于有用反馈没有有效进入 solver 的下一步推理。作者还提到 reduced cross-family replication with Gemma 3 actors 时，整体协议排序会变化，但 precision–uptake 分离现象仍存在。这意味着“critique uptake”更像一个通用评估维度，而不是只对某个模型家族成立的偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段精读。建议先看 Introduction 前几页，把 role-specialization hypothesis 和 reviewer–solver decoupling 这两个概念吃透。然后直接看主结果图表，重点是不同 difficulty tier 上 single-agent、broadcast、PER 的曲线，以及 reviewer precision、CouplingRate、ReviewerGuidedRepairRate 的对比表。最后再看 within-PER interventions，理解为什么 ACK-required 这类看似合理的控制并没有解决问题。

如果只想抓住结论，20 分钟左右足够。若要多花一点时间，值得看 appendix 里的 cross-evaluator disagreement replay、higher-cost PER-inner6 stress test，以及 Gemma 3 replication。它们不能单独证明因果，但能帮助判断这个现象是否稳健。阅读时要注意，这篇工作研究的是 test-time protocol，不是训练新模型，因此不要把它的结论直接外推到所有多 agent 或所有 verifier 系统。
summary.authors_note: 全文片段未给出明确机构与完整作者列表，无法可靠确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question in multi-agent reasoning: does adding a specialized reviewer role actually improve error correction on hard math problems? The answer, in the tested setting, is often no. A reviewer may identify useful flaws with high precision, yet the downstream solver may fail to act on that critique. The paper names this failure reviewer-solver decoupling and studies it explicitly instead of treating the protocol as a black box. The key issue is not whether critique exists, but whether useful critique is taken up and converted into a repaired solution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, so its relevance is indirect and it belongs in skim territory. Still, it offers a useful lesson for post-training and inference-time reasoning research. Better role specialization does not automatically translate into better reasoning if the interface between roles is weak. More importantly, the paper introduces process-level diagnostics that separate detection quality from actionability. That is valuable for work on verifier-guided decoding, self-correction, RL-based reasoning, and test-time scaling, because it distinguishes between three different failures: the system did not notice the error, noticed it but ignored it, or changed the answer without actually repairing it.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is a protocol study rather than a new model proposal. It keeps the actor family fixed and compares several inference-time designs on the same benchmark: a matched single-agent iterative baseline, a broadcast-style peer discussion protocol, and a hierarchical planner-executor-reviewer protocol, abbreviated as PER. The main methodological contribution is the evaluation decomposition. Instead of reporting only final accuracy, the authors use verifier-grounded analysis to measure whether the reviewer produced useful critique, whether the next candidate answer changed in response, and whether that change repaired the solution.

This leads to three central diagnostics: NeglectRate, which measures how often useful critique is ignored; CouplingRate, which measures whether the next answer actually changes after useful critique; and ReviewerGuidedRepairRate, which measures whether that change leads to a correct repair. This decomposition is the paper’s strongest idea. It turns a protocol comparison into a process analysis.

The authors also test several within-PER interventions. ACK-required is a compliance-style control that forces explicit acknowledgment of reviewer feedback. EMB injects reviewer guidance directly into the solver’s working context to reduce interface friction. A deeper-reflection variant is also explored. These interventions recover only part of the gap between PER and broadcast, suggesting that the issue is not simply reviewer quality but the structure of feedback routing itself.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems using matched gpt-oss-120b actors. The tiered benchmark is important because easy math benchmarks are too close to ceiling to separate protocols cleanly. The main findings are clear. First, on tiers 1 and 2, collaboration adds little, at most around 2 percentage points over the matched single-agent baseline. Second, from tier 4 onward, collaboration starts to matter, and gains reach roughly 10 to 20 points on tiers 6 to 9. Third, in that regime, broadcast outperforms PER in final accuracy.

The most informative numbers are the process metrics. PER’s reviewer has higher precision than broadcast’s reviewer, 0.861 versus 0.644. But when the reviewer gives critique that the evaluator later confirms as useful, PER changes its carried-forward candidate only 33.6 percent of the time, while broadcast does so 93.5 percent of the time. ReviewerGuidedRepairRate is 0.051 for PER versus 0.286 for broadcast. These numbers strongly support the paper’s central claim: reviewer precision alone does not explain protocol quality if critique uptake is weak.

The appendix-level evidence also matters. A reduced replication with Gemma 3 actors changes the overall ranking of protocols, but the precision-versus-uptake separation remains. That suggests critique uptake is a meaningful evaluation axis beyond one specific model family.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This paper is best read selectively. Start with the introduction and make sure the two central concepts are clear: the role-specialization hypothesis and reviewer-solver decoupling. Then go straight to the main tier-by-tier accuracy plots and the tables for reviewer precision, CouplingRate, and ReviewerGuidedRepairRate. Those figures carry most of the paper’s substance. After that, read the within-PER intervention section to see why simple controls such as forced acknowledgment do not solve the problem.

A 20-minute read is enough to capture the main result. If you want more confidence in robustness, inspect the appendix sections on cross-evaluator disagreement replay, the higher-cost PER-inner6 stress test, and the Gemma 3 replication. The important reading caution is that this is a test-time protocol study, not a training paper, so its conclusions should not be overgeneralized to all multi-agent or verifier-based systems.

recommendation.zh: 反常识的多Agent协作机制结论，做推理时Agent编排或RL reviewer设计的重点看摘要中的精度与采纳率对比数据。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive multi-agent collaboration findings; researchers working on inference-time agent orchestration or RL reviewer design should focus on precision vs uptake comparison data in the abstract.

paper.title: Eta Given Delta: Defining LLM Tool Efficiency With Marginal Tool Utility
paper.abstract: This paper introduces tool efficiency, a new quantitative metric to evaluate the rate of useful tool calls in an LLM agent trajectory. To ensure that tool efficiency is well-defined, we also introduce marginal tool utility, a new quantitative metric defined per tool call indicating whether a tool is useful or whether it can be safely removed from the tool suite without affecting accuracy while increasing tool efficiency; in this paper, we determine the sign of marginal tool utility for each tool

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 工具使用中“调用是否高效”缺少直接量化指标的问题，而不是只用最终准确率间接代替。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法工作，贡献是提出 tool efficiency 和 marginal tool utility 两个指标。对 agent 评估设计有一定参考，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把单次工具调用的价值定义为 marginal tool utility，即移除该工具调用后是否仍能保持准确率且提升效率；再把轨迹层面的有效调用率定义为 tool efficiency。具体判定依赖 LLM-as-a-Judge 对每次调用做 post hoc 分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体 benchmark、模型规模或统计结果。当前更像提出评测定义与分析框架，而不是一个经过大规模验证的标准协议。由于 judge 依赖 LLM，本身可能引入稳定性和偏差问题。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of a direct metric for how efficiently LLM agents use tools, instead of relying on final accuracy as an indirect proxy.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. Its contribution is the definition of tool efficiency and marginal tool utility. It may be useful for agent evaluation design, but it is fairly far from core pretraining concerns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines marginal tool utility at the level of each tool call: whether removing that call would preserve accuracy while improving efficiency. Tool efficiency is then the trajectory-level rate of useful tool calls. The sign of marginal utility is determined post hoc using an LLM-as-a-Judge setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark details, model scales, or quantitative validation. At this stage it reads more like a metric proposal than a broadly validated evaluation standard. The reliance on LLM judges may itself introduce variance and bias.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use eval，可以知道这个指标长什么样；但它离 pretrain 很远，而且 judge 依赖太重，先看定义别急着采纳。
recommendation.en: Useful to know if you design tool-use evals, but it is far from pretraining and heavily judge-dependent; read the metric definition, not the whole paper.

paper.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored. This phenomenon occurs rarely in realistic benchmarks but can lead to dramatic failure in real life applications. Therefore in this study we propose DeepStress, a stress testing framework that controls the frequency of challenging evidence by replacing the retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment. We use this

summary.core_problem: 解决 search agent 在检索证据质量变差时缺少系统性压力测试的问题，尤其是现实中少见但代价很高的低可信、低相关或含错证据场景。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测框架与指标，而不是又一个 agent。它把检索质量拆成 trustworthiness、relevance、factuality 三个可控维度，适合研究 parametric knowledge 与 retrieved knowledge 冲突时 agent 的失效模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DeepStress，用受控合成环境替换 search agent 的原始检索模块，从而精确控制输入文档的可靠性分布。基于这一环境，对多个 search agent 在 HotpotQA 和 BrowseCompPlus 上做 stress test，并设计更细的结果指标来刻画系统输出及参数知识与外部证据的交互。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是若干 search agents，任务覆盖 HotpotQA 与 BrowseCompPlus。摘要显示不同 agent 在面对不可靠信息时差异显著，但未给出具体模型名、参数量和数值幅度。对预训练研究员而言，价值不在 leaderboard，而在 failure taxonomy 和评测设计是否足够干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Orange Research。不是头部基础模型实验室，但做的是比较扎实的 agent stress-testing 方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of systematic stress testing for search agents when retrieved evidence becomes low-quality, especially in rare but costly cases involving untrustworthy, irrelevant, or false documents.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation framework and metrics, not another agent. It factorizes retrieval quality into trustworthiness, relevance, and factuality, which is useful for studying failure modes when parametric knowledge conflicts with retrieved evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepStress replaces the native retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment, allowing precise control over the reliability profile of retrieved documents. It then stress-tests several search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus, with new metrics to characterize outcomes and the interaction between parametric and retrieved knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover multiple search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus. The abstract reports substantial differences in robustness to unreliable information, but does not provide model names, parameter counts, or effect sizes. For a pretraining researcher, the value is less about the leaderboard and more about whether the failure taxonomy and evaluation setup are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Orange Research. This is not a top foundation-model lab, but the work appears to be a fairly serious agent stress-testing effort.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测切口是对的：当参数知识和检索证据冲突时，agent 怎么坏掉，这比再刷一个 QA 分数更值得看；先读指标定义和 controlled setup。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it asks the right evaluation question: how agents fail when parametric knowledge conflicts with retrieval; read the metric design and controlled setup before anything else.

paper.title: STOCKTAKE: Measuring the Gap Between Perception and Action in LLM Agents with a Fair Oracle
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly evaluated on multi-week decision tasks in which the state that drives cost is never directly observed. On such tasks the final cost cannot say why an agent failed: it may have misread the world, or read it correctly and still failed to act (the knowing-doing gap). Existing evaluations cannot separate these two failures; their reference policies either read privileged information the agent never sees, or are missing altogether. We introduce STOCKTAKE, a 26-week supply-

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“LLM agent 在长周期决策里表现差”这个泛问题，而是更细的一层：在部分可观测、长期累积成本的任务里，失败到底来自没看懂世界，还是看懂了却没把判断落实成动作。现有 supply-chain / retail 一类 benchmark 往往只给最终成本，或者拿能看到特权信息的 oracle 当上界，因此把 state estimation failure 和 control failure 混在一起，无法定位 knowing-doing gap。STOCKTAKE 的核心设计，是构造一个可以计算“公平 oracle”的长周期 POMDP 基准，让参考策略和 agent 看到完全相同的观测流，从而把感知与行动两类失败拆开测。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在供应链任务本身，而在评测方法：它给 agent 评测补上了一个长期缺口——如何在部分可观测环境里做可归因的能力分解。这个问题和 LLM pretrain/post-train 都有关。若一个模型能在 rationale 里稳定识别隐变量，却在动作上持续失配，问题更可能出在 policy elicitation、训练目标、工具调用接口或长程决策校准，而不是世界模型本身。反过来，如果 detection lag 很长，则更像是表征、记忆、证据整合或训练数据覆盖的问题。论文的贡献量级主要体现在 benchmark 设计和评测归因框架，而不是提出新的 agent 算法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个关键点。第一，任务被形式化为一个 26 周的 factored POMDP。环境里有六个隐藏因子过程，驱动需求、供应、物流、质量等风险；agent 每周只能看到仪表盘症状，如库存、在途订单、需求实现、运价、港口等待、供应商评分和质检报告，然后做补货决策。第二，作者刻意把隐藏结构做成 factorized，并固定 event tape，因此可以对每个隐藏因子运行 exact Bayes filter，再用 rollout policy 在相同观测条件下做决策，得到 fair oracle。这里“公平”的关键不是 oracle 强，而是它不读 agent 看不到的真值；论文也明确说明只有一处披露的不对称。第三，围绕这个 fair oracle 定义了一组分解指标，而不是只看总成本。skill score 把 agent 定位在 symptom-blind base-stock floor 和 fair Bayesian oracle 之间；detection lag 衡量 agent 从隐藏事件发生到在 rationale 中点名该因子的延迟；knowing-doing rate 则统计已经正确诊断的压力周里，动作仍导致 stockout 或过度保护成本的比例。作者还设计了 isolated / persistent / compound 三类 stress profile，在世界模型不变的前提下控制隐藏故障的重叠方式，用来观察感知和行动错误如何耦合。全文里一个值得注意的细节是，benchmark 不给策略 playbook，只给 rules-only prompt，这样更接近“模型自身把诊断转成动作”的能力，而不是提示工程后的流程执行。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 50 个 seed、200 个 episode，按 stress profile 分组评估 Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Grok 4.5 四个模型。最关键的结果有两点。第一，感知层面的差异并不大：四个模型都能识别 84%–88% 的隐藏因子 episode，通常在事件发生后一周内就能在 rationale 中点名，甚至 skill score 较低的模型有时识别更快。第二，成本层面的差异很大，而且与 detection 不同步：四个模型里有两个整体表现低于 symptom-blind floor，也就是在大约一半的 seed 上，“完全不读症状、按固定库存规则下单”反而更便宜。这说明错误主要不是没看见，而是看见后动作没有跟上。persistent seeds 上，所有模型在“已正确诊断”的压力周里，仍有 34%–43% 的周最终发生 stockout。作者进一步分析指出，这里面部分是 severity confound：越严重的周越容易被诊断出来，也越容易把货架压穿；但即便考虑这一点，模型之间真正拉开差距的仍是从 diagnosis 到 order quantity / route / supplier / protection action 的映射质量。论文还讨论了 knowing-doing gap 的双向性：不仅会订少、订晚，也会为了防风险而付出过高保护成本，比如过度锁运价、过度空运或过度检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一看任务定义和 Figure 1，弄清每周观测、可选动作、成本项和隐藏因子分别是什么；如果这里没看明白，后面的指标会显得抽象。第二看 fair oracle 的构造部分，重点是 exact Bayes filter per factor 和 rollout policy 如何共享同一 observation stream，这决定了 benchmark 是否真的能把 knowing 与 doing 分开。第三看结果章节里按 stress profile 分解的表和图，尤其是 detection lag、skill score、knowing-doing rate 三者的错位关系。预计 25–35 分钟能把主要思想读清。若想进一步用到自己的 agent 评测里，建议再细看 Section 4–5 中关于公平性假设、唯一信息不对称、severity 分析和 rationale-based metric 的定义边界，因为这些地方决定了指标是否会被 prompt style 或 verbalization 能力污染。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not merely about poor long-horizon agent performance. It targets a more specific identification problem: in partially observed, cost-accumulating decision tasks, did the agent fail because it inferred the hidden state incorrectly, or because it inferred it correctly and still failed to act on that belief? Existing supply-chain and retail benchmarks usually report only final cost, or compare against privileged oracles that observe latent state unavailable to the agent. That setup entangles state-estimation failure with control failure. STOCKTAKE is designed to make a fair oracle computable, so the benchmark can separate perception from action and measure the knowing-doing gap directly.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is methodological rather than domain-specific. It provides an attribution-friendly evaluation design for long-horizon agents under partial observability. That matters for both pretraining and post-training analysis. If a model can reliably verbalize the right latent diagnosis but still chooses poor actions, the bottleneck is more likely policy elicitation, action calibration, interface design, or training objective mismatch than world modeling. If detection itself is slow or inconsistent, the issue looks more like representation quality, memory, evidence integration, or data coverage. The contribution is therefore a benchmark and evaluation framework that decomposes failure modes, not a new agent algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: There are three central design choices. First, the task is a 26-week factored POMDP with six hidden factor processes governing demand, supply, logistics, quality, and related risks. Each week the agent observes a dashboard of symptoms—inventory, in-transit orders, realized demand, freight quotes, berth waiting times, canal transit counts, supplier scorecards, and quality reports—then chooses replenishment actions. Second, the hidden dynamics are intentionally factorized and the event tape is fixed, which makes a fair reference policy tractable: an exact Bayes filter is run per factor, and a rollout policy acts on the same observation stream seen by the LLM. The key point is not that the oracle is strong, but that it is non-privileged. Third, the benchmark defines decomposed metrics instead of relying on total cost alone. A skill score places the agent between a symptom-blind base-stock floor and the fair Bayesian oracle. Detection lag measures how quickly the agent names the active hidden factor in its rationale. Knowing-doing rate measures how often the agent still incurs stockout-like action failures during stress weeks it has already diagnosed correctly. The benchmark also introduces isolated, persistent, and compound stress profiles, keeping the world model fixed while varying overlap among hidden failures. One useful detail is that models are tested with a rules-only prompt and no strategy playbook, which makes the benchmark more about converting diagnosis into action than following a hand-crafted procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 50 seeds and 200 episodes, grouped by stress profile, with Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Grok 4.5. The main empirical result is a strong mismatch between diagnosis and control. On the perception side, all four models detect hidden-factor episodes at broadly similar rates, around 84% to 88%, typically within one week of onset. In some cases, the lower-skill models even diagnose faster. On the cost side, however, performance diverges sharply: two of the four models finish below the symptom-blind floor overall, meaning that on roughly half of their seeds, a policy that ignores symptoms entirely and follows a fixed inventory rule would have been cheaper. This is the clearest evidence that action quality, not just inference quality, is the main failure source. On persistent seeds, even during stress weeks that were correctly diagnosed, every model still suffers stockout in about 34% to 43% of those weeks. The paper further notes a severity effect: the weeks severe enough to be easy to detect are also the weeks most likely to break the shelf. Even after accounting for that, the main separation between models remains the quality of mapping diagnosis into order quantity, route, supplier choice, and protective actions. The knowing-doing gap is also bidirectional: some models under-react and order too little too late, while others over-protect and pay too much through freight locks, air expediting, or inspections.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the task setup and Figure 1 carefully to understand the weekly observation space, action set, cost structure, and hidden factors; otherwise the later metrics will feel abstract. Second, read the fair-oracle construction in detail, especially how the exact per-factor Bayes filters and rollout policy are constrained to the same observation stream as the agent. That is the core reason the benchmark can separate knowing from doing. Third, read the results broken down by stress profile, paying attention to the mismatch among detection lag, skill score, and knowing-doing rate. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If you want to reuse the design in your own agent evaluation, spend extra time on the fairness assumptions, the disclosed asymmetry, the severity analysis, and the exact definition of rationale-based metrics, because those determine how robust the attribution is to prompt style and verbalization quality.

recommendation.zh: 值得看评测设计；只读 oracle 构造和 rationale 诊断，别把供应链设定误读成通用能力结论。
recommendation.en: Read the oracle construction and rationale diagnostics; do not overinterpret the supply-chain setting as a broad agent-capability result.

paper.title: AgentCompass: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure for Agent Capabilities
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, the need for unified evaluation infrastructure becomes critical. However, current evaluation pipelines remain highly fragmented and tightly coupled, hindering reproducibility and causing redundant engineering. To address this, we introduce AgentCompass, an open-source, lightweight, and extensible infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents. AgentCompass organizes the evaluation process around three independent components, namely B

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 agent 评测基础设施碎片化的问题：同一个模型换一个 benchmark，往往就要重写环境接入、交互循环、打分逻辑和运行脚本，导致复现差、工程重复高，也很难系统比较“模型能力”和“harness 设计”各自的贡献。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 和 agent 研究的实验方法有现实价值。它把 benchmark、agent harness、execution environment 三层明确解耦，使研究者能更干净地比较模型、提示协议、工具调用流程和运行环境。对于做基座模型外推到 agent 场景的人，这种基础设施有助于减少评测噪声，避免把工程差异误判成模型差异。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计是三层抽象：Benchmark 负责数据加载、任务定义和评分；Harness 负责把模型包装成可交互 agent，包括 prompt、状态管理、多轮工具调用和 API 适配；Environment 提供隔离执行上下文，包括命令执行、文件传输、文本编辑和网络服务。三者通过稳定协议连接，并由声明式 RunRequest 统一配置。RunRequest 进一步拆成 BenchmarkSpec、HarnessSpec、EnvironmentSpec、ModelSpec 和 ExecutionSpec，把“评测语义”与“执行方式”分开。框架还支持 decorator registry，便于本地注册新 benchmark / harness / environment，而不改核心 runtime。另一个实用点是 scorer execution mode：评分既可以在内存里做，也可以复用 agent 运行时工作区，或在全新隔离环境中重放验证，适合代码 agent、补丁验证等场景。运行时层面，作者实现了 fault-tolerant asynchronous runtime，用来并行长轨迹 agent 评测，并提供 trajectory-level 分析工具，记录中间动作、工具调用和环境反馈。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，论文更偏系统介绍，实验重点应是展示统一基础设施如何覆盖多类 benchmark 和 harness 组合，以及在长轨迹任务上的并发执行与诊断能力。文中明确提到该框架已作为 Intern-S agent 系列的基础评测设施。当前可确认的结果主要是功能覆盖面，而不是某个新算法带来的能力提升数字。若按研究阅读优先级看，读者更该关注它支持哪些 execution mode、隔离边界和 analyzer，而不是期待模型分数上的新结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，把 benchmark / harness / environment 的边界看清楚；再看 RunRequest 与各类 Spec 的定义，理解哪些配置改变评测语义，哪些只改变执行方式；最后看 scorer execution mode 和 runtime/analyzer 部分，这些最影响实际落地。预计 15–25 分钟可以判断它是否适合接入自己的评测栈。如果你关心的是 agent 方法而不是评测工程，这篇不需要深读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragmentation in agent evaluation infrastructure. In current practice, changing the benchmark often requires rewriting environment integration, interaction loops, scoring logic, and execution scripts. That creates poor reproducibility, duplicated engineering, and makes it hard to disentangle model capability from harness-specific implementation choices.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is useful for post-training and agent methodology. By explicitly decoupling benchmark, agent harness, and execution environment, the framework makes it easier to compare models, prompting protocols, tool-use procedures, and runtime setups in a cleaner way. For foundation-model researchers evaluating agentic behavior, this kind of infrastructure helps reduce evaluation noise and prevents engineering variance from being mistaken for model variance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is a three-layer abstraction. Benchmark handles dataset loading, task definition, and scoring. Harness wraps a model into an interactive agent, including prompt formatting, state management, multi-turn tool use, and provider-specific API handling. Environment provides the isolated execution context, including command execution, file transfer, text editing, and network services. These components are connected through stable interfaces and configured through a declarative RunRequest. The request is further decomposed into BenchmarkSpec, HarnessSpec, EnvironmentSpec, ModelSpec, and ExecutionSpec, separating evaluation semantics from execution mechanics. The framework uses lightweight decorator-based registries so new benchmarks, harnesses, or environments can be added locally without modifying the central runtime. A practically useful feature is scorer execution mode: scoring can happen in memory, reuse the agent workspace, or run in a fresh isolated environment, which is especially relevant for coding agents and patch verification. On the systems side, AgentCompass includes a fault-tolerant asynchronous runtime for parallel long-horizon trajectories and trajectory-level analyzers that expose intermediate actions, tool calls, and environment feedback.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the provided full text, the paper is primarily a systems/infrastructure presentation rather than a method paper with strong algorithmic ablations. The empirical emphasis appears to be on demonstrating coverage across multiple benchmark-harness-environment combinations and showing that the runtime can support long interactive trajectories with analysis support. The paper explicitly states that the framework has already been used as the evaluation backbone for the Intern-S agent series. The main takeaway is therefore breadth of support and execution design, not a new capability gain with headline benchmark numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the boundaries among benchmark, harness, and environment. Then read the RunRequest and Spec definitions to see which configuration choices alter evaluation semantics and which only affect execution. Finally, read the scorer execution modes and the runtime/analyzer sections, since those are the parts that matter most in practice. Around 15 to 25 minutes should be enough to decide whether it fits your own evaluation stack. If your focus is agent methods rather than evaluation engineering, a deep read is unnecessary.

recommendation.zh: 读系统拆分和 trajectory analysis 部分即可；它不改 pretrain prior，但能减少 agent 评测噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the component split and trajectory analysis sections; it will not change pretraining priors, but it can reduce noise in agent evaluation.

paper.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
paper.abstract: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied recursively as new failures and new tasks appear over time. The central question this raises is whether optimizer-driven gains compound: after an agent has been optimized once, can it be optimized again

summary.core_problem: 检验 agent optimizer 在持续到来的新任务上是否能“复利式”累积收益，而不是只在一次性静态 benchmark 上看起来有效。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测设定而不是新 agent 方法。它把 agent 优化从单阶段静态评测改成两阶段 continual-learning 评测，直接暴露现有优化器是否会遗忘旧收益。这对看 agent scaling、test-time optimization 和部署稳定性的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Terminal-Bench 2.0 构建两阶段 continual-learning evaluation，在相同优化预算下比较 GEPA、Meta Harness 和 RELAI-VCL 三类 agent-harness optimization 方法。重点不是提出新优化器，而是控制预算与任务到达顺序，观察第一轮优化后的收益在第二轮新任务到来后能否保留、迁移或被侵蚀。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明三种方法在传统单阶段静态设定下都优于 baseline agent，但在引入新任务后的持续学习设定中，收益不再稳定累积，部分方法出现旧任务收益回退或新旧任务兼顾失败。由于摘要未给出具体数值、agent backbone 和任务规模，当前更应把它当作评测协议信号，而不是结论终局。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Soheil Feizi。Feizi 在鲁棒性、评测与模型行为分析方面有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains from agent optimizers actually compound when new tasks arrive over time, instead of merely looking good in a one-shot static benchmark setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol, not a new agent method. By turning agent optimization into a two-phase continual-learning test, it exposes whether current optimizers preserve earlier gains or simply overfit to a fixed benchmark. This is relevant for people tracking agent scaling, test-time optimization, and deployment stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the paper introduces a two-phase continual-learning evaluation and compares GEPA, Meta Harness, and RELAI-VCL under matched optimization budgets. The point is not to invent another optimizer, but to control budget and task arrival so one can measure whether improvements from phase one survive phase two.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, all three methods beat the baseline agent in the conventional single-phase static setting. Once new tasks are introduced, however, the gains do not reliably compound, and some methods appear to lose prior improvements or fail to balance old and new tasks. Since the abstract omits exact numbers, backbone details, and task counts, the result should be treated as a strong evaluation signal rather than a settled empirical law.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Soheil Feizi, who is well known for work on robustness, evaluation, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新 agent 算法，而是把“优化有效”这件事测得更干净；若你关心 test-time scaling 或 agent 训练闭环，只看设定和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new agent algorithm, but a cleaner way to test whether optimization really sticks; if you care about test-time scaling or agent training loops, the setup and main table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Analogical Deep Research: Retrieving and Integrating Historical Analogies for Foresight Analysis
paper.abstract: Systematic comparisons between current situations and structurally similar past events in the historical, i.e., historical analogies, is among the most powerful tools for foresight analysis. In this work, we present a new task called Analogical Deep Research (ADR) to Large Language Model (LLM) agents and construct the first ADR benchmark ADR-bench to study whether LLM agents are able to find and leverage historical analogies when doing foresight analysis. Our investigation reveals a key obstacle

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM agent 在前瞻分析中能否检索并使用历史类比，尤其是能否找到结构机制相似、而不是表面特征相似的历史事件。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测任务和分析框架：提出 Analogical Deep Research 任务，并构建 ADR-bench，用来评估 agent 的历史类比检索、机制对齐和跨类比验证能力。它对通用 agent 评测有一定价值，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 ADR 解释为一个因果问题，认为有效类比需要识别事件发生机制。方法上提出两个原则：mechanism alignment 要求当前事件与历史事件在因果机制上对齐；cross-analogy confirmation 要求多个类比之间相互确认。基于这些原则构建 Causal Analogical Researcher，作为引导 LLM 检索、比较和整合历史类比的 agent 框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明构建了 ADR-bench，并发现现有 LLM agent 倾向于按表面特征匹配类比，而不是按深层机制匹配。摘要未披露具体模型、数据规模、baseline 列表和量化提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Kun Zhang 是因果发现和因果表示学习方向的知名研究者；论文信息未给出机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM agents can retrieve and use historically analogous events for foresight analysis, especially when the analogy depends on shared mechanisms rather than surface similarity.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation task and benchmark: Analogical Deep Research and ADR-bench. It is relevant to general agent evaluation and causal reasoning diagnostics, but it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame ADR as a causal problem. They propose two principles: mechanism alignment, where the current and historical cases must share causal structure, and cross-analogy confirmation, where multiple analogies are used to validate each other. These principles are instantiated in an agent framework called Causal Analogical Researcher.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that LLM agents tend to match analogies by surface features rather than underlying mechanisms. It does not provide model sizes, benchmark scale, baseline details, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Kun Zhang is a well-known researcher in causal discovery and causal representation learning; the provided paper metadata does not specify affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent reasoning 评测备查即可；真正有用的是“表面相似误导类比检索”这个 failure mode。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly as an agent-reasoning eval reference; the worthwhile signal is the surface-similarity failure mode in analogy retrieval.

paper.title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
paper.abstract: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control.

summary.core_problem: 评测 agent 在会话中工具可靠性悄然变化时，是否能像 set-shifting 一样及时调整工具选择，而不是固化在早期形成的调用惯性里。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 评测工作，不直接服务于基座预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的行为诊断有一定新意：它不只看任务是否完成，而是看在隐藏分布切换下，策略是否能重新分配工具调用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借用认知心理学中的 set-shifting 概念，构造带冗余工具库的 benchmark：多个工具都能完成任务，但隐藏可靠性不同；在分支式日程中，可靠工具组会在会话中途切换，并配对 no-shift 对照。论文定义 set-shifting accuracy，衡量每个 post-shift 窗口都路由到目标工具组的联合概率，并在开源 agent harness 中测试开源模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示，agent 往往在每个边界后几轮内收敛到少数重复 routine，工具调用份额集中在少数离散值；不同模型在同一组 routine 上表现出不同失败模式。实验更像行为剖面而非能力上限测试。未见与预训练直接相关的模型或数据分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM agents can adapt their tool choice when hidden tool reliability changes mid-session, rather than getting stuck in early routines.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-evaluation paper, not a foundation-model pretraining contribution. Its value is the behavioral diagnostic: it measures adaptation under hidden distribution shifts instead of only end-task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: Borrowing the notion of set-shifting from cognitive psychology, the benchmark builds redundant tool libraries where multiple tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. A branched schedule changes the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs each shift with a no-shift control. The main metric is set-shifting accuracy, defined over post-shift routing windows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that agents quickly settle into a small recurring routine after each boundary, with tool-call shares concentrating on a few discrete values. Different open-weight models exhibit distinct failure modes over the same routines. The setup is more diagnostic than capability-maximizing.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 tool-use agent eval，可以记下这个“隐藏可靠性切换”设定；否则和基座研究距离较远，看 metric 定义即可，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on tool-use agent evaluation, keep the hidden-reliability-shift setup; otherwise this is far from core foundation-model work and the metric definition is enough.

paper.title: EgoProceVQA: A Novel Egocentric Procedural Understanding Task with Self-Skill-Exploration Agent
paper.abstract: Most daily activities are inherently procedural. However, existing evaluations for egocentric video understanding seldom address procedural understanding and largely overlook complex key-step-level reasoning under the widely used video question answering (VQA) paradigm for MLLMs. Such capabilities are crucial for building procedural AI assistants deployable on wearable devices. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Egocentric Procedural Understanding VQA task (EgoProceVQA), which systematically e

summary.core_problem: 现有第一人称视频理解评测缺乏对程序类任务的关键步骤级推理能力评估，无法支撑可穿戴设备上的程序类AI助手研发
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+数据平台贡献：首次提出第一人称程序理解VQA任务，配套自动化数据生成平台，填补该细分领域的评测空白
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计6类以关键步骤为核心的问答题型，定义EgoProceVQA任务；2. 开发EgoProceGen数据生成平台，可针对不同题型高效构造定制化QA数据；3. 引入自技能探索Agent作为评测基线之一
summary.experiments: 构建含3600道问题、4类常见程序场景、31项日常程序任务的基准数据集；评测现有主流MLLMs与Agent，结果显示现有模型在该任务上仍有较大性能缺口

summary_en.core_problem: Existing egocentric video understanding evaluations lack assessment of key-step-level reasoning for procedural tasks, failing to support development of procedural AI assistants for wearable devices
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and data platform contribution: First egocentric procedural understanding VQA task with automated data generation pipeline, filling the evaluation gap in this subdomain
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Design 6 key-step-centric question types to define the EgoProceVQA task; 2. Develop EgoProceGen for efficient construction of type-specific QA data; 3. Include a self-skill-exploration agent as an evaluation baseline
summary_en.experiments: Build a benchmark with 3,600 questions, 4 procedural scenarios, and 31 daily procedural tasks; evaluations of mainstream MLLMs and agents show significant performance gaps

recommendation.zh: 细分场景的多模态Agent评测基准，仅做多模态能力边界分析时可参考数据集构造方式，无需读正文
recommendation.en: A niche multimodal agent evaluation benchmark; only reference its dataset construction pipeline for multimodal capability boundary analysis, no need to read full text

paper.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
paper.abstract: We revisit the evaluation of automatic harness evolution for LLM agents. Existing harness evolution methods use unit test cases to search for harness configurations and then report final performance on the same public benchmark. This protocol raises two fundamental concerns. First, harness evolution is itself an iterative search procedure that repeatedly evaluates and revises candidate harnesses using task feedback. As in agentic test-time scaling, it should therefore be compared with simple tas

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent harness evolution 的评测协议是否把“额外搜索预算”误当成“更好 harness 设计”这一混淆问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测方法与 protocol 纠偏。它不是提出新 agent，而是指出现有 harness evolution 论文常把搜索过程和最终 benchmark 复用在同一任务集上，导致预算不匹配和 benchmark overfitting 两个系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 作者重新定义比较方式：把 harness evolution 视为一种迭代搜索过程，要求与简单 test-time scaling 或 discovery baseline 在相同反馈信号和推理预算下比较；同时把搜索集与最终评测集分离，检查方法是否只是对公开 benchmark 过拟合。核心是 protocol redesign，而非新模型结构。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明做了较大规模重评估，将 harness evolution 与简单 task-level search baseline 在 matched feedback 和 inference budget 下对比，并分析同 benchmark 上搜索再汇报结果带来的过拟合风险。具体模型、数据规模和提升幅度在摘要中未给出，但结论指向：先前收益中有一部分可能来自额外搜索而非 harness 本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Hannaneh Hajishirzi、Yulia Tsvetkov、Pradeep Dasigi，属于做 NLP/agent/eval 较活跃的学术团队。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether current evaluations of agent harness evolution confound better harness design with simply spending more search budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation-protocol correction rather than a new agent method. It argues that many harness-evolution papers reuse the same public benchmark for both iterative search and final reporting, creating budget mismatch and benchmark overfitting.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reframes harness evolution as an iterative search procedure and requires comparisons against simple test-time scaling or discovery baselines under matched feedback and inference budgets. It also separates search from final evaluation to test whether gains transfer beyond the benchmark used during search.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the authors run an extensive reevaluation comparing harness evolution against simple task-level search baselines under controlled budgets and feedback. Exact model sizes and datasets are not listed in the abstract, but the main empirical message is that some reported gains likely come from extra search rather than superior harness design.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Yulia Tsvetkov, and Pradeep Dasigi, from a strong academic group active in NLP, agents, and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但会改你看 agent 结果表的方式；重点读 matched-budget 设计，很多“方法提升”大概率只是多搜了几轮。
recommendation.en: It will not change your model, but it should change how you read agent tables; focus on the matched-budget protocol because many gains may just be extra search.

paper.title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agent systems improve by creating, revising, and retiring their own skills, but every such loop rests on a hidden assumption: a reliable evaluation metric already exists. In many real applications it does not. We make three claims. First, metrics can be \emph{evolved}: our metric loop searches compositions of small drawback detectors under a full evolutionary lifecycle, trained to agree with a ten-item anchored reference set, regularized by consensus over unlabeled outputs, and aud

summary.core_problem: 解决自进化Agent系统依赖预先存在的可靠评估指标的问题，实际场景中往往缺乏这样的指标。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出评估指标进化框架与metric-skill共进化的Double Ratchet方法，实现无预设metric下的Agent自进化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出metric进化循环，通过进化小缺陷检测器的组合，锚定参考集训练，用无标签输出共识正则化，held-out anchor审计，生成可解释的metric；提出Double Ratchet方法共进化metric与skill生命周期管理循环。
summary.experiments: 在代码生成（MBPP+）、企业text-to-SQL（Spider 2.0-Snow）、无参考报告生成任务上，保留了held-out lift的88-110%。
summary.authors_note: AWS生成式AI创新中心与汇丰集团合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the problem that self-improving agent systems rely on pre-existing reliable evaluation metrics, which are often absent in real-world scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a metric evolution framework and the Double Ratchet method for co-evolving metrics and skills, enabling agent self-improvement without pre-defined metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a metric evolution loop that evolves compositions of small drawback detectors, trained on anchored reference sets, regularized by consensus over unlabeled outputs, audited against held-out anchors, producing interpretable metrics; proposes the Double Ratchet method for co-evolving metrics and skill lifecycle management loops.
summary_en.experiments: On code generation (MBPP+), enterprise text-to-SQL (Spider 2.0-Snow), and reference-free report generation tasks, retains 88-110% of the held-out lift achieved by a reliable metric.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between AWS Generative AI Innovation Center and HSBC Holdings.

recommendation.zh: Agent自进化中metric与skill共进化的思路有启发，但工程性较强，对预训练研究员参考价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The co-evolution of metrics and skills for self-improving agents is thought-provoking, but engineering-heavy and of limited relevance to pretraining researchers; read the abstract only.

institutions: HSBC Holdings Plc., HSBC Technology Center

paper.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
paper.abstract: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用Agent评测框架以文本为核心，大多仅支持静态单轮、小规模工具集的视觉输入场景，缺少在动态多轮交互、多图像输入、大规模工具库条件下，对多模态Agent视觉工具调用能力的标准化统一评测体系。
summary.importance: 作为多模态工具调用方向的专项评测框架，填补了动态视觉工具调用场景的评测空白，其多维度任务设计和自动化场景生成流程，为多模态模型的工具调用能力迭代、预训练-后训练全流程的多模态Agent能力验证提供了可直接复用的测试基准。
summary.technical_approach: 在文本工具调用评测框架ToolSandbox基础上扩展，新增原生图像处理能力、视觉专属工具集，同时支持结构化工具调用、代码执行两种交互范式。构建的评测基准覆盖511个工具、16个应用领域，沿信息流类型、对话挑战类型、图像到达模式三个正交维度设计任务，包含258个人工校验的场景、1284张专属图像，支持多轮、多图像交互。配套自动化场景生成管线，通过信息流引导的任务规划、环境状态实例化、多阶段质量过滤，将人工成本从全量标注降低为定向审核。评测环节结合确定性状态校验与LLM裁判，从任务完成度、工具使用有效性、指令遵循、无副作用等多个维度完成打分。
summary.experiments: 对主流闭源、开源前沿模型的系统评测显示，现有模型在视觉工具调用任务上仍存在明显短板：多图像工作记忆是核心瓶颈，不同参数量模型呈现差异化的失败模式，在视觉grounding推理、多步交互、状态化工具使用环节均存在显著提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注框架设计部分的三维任务划分逻辑、实验部分的模型失败模式分析，可直接复用该基准评估自有多模态模型的视觉工具调用能力，预计阅读时间12分钟。
summary.authors_note: Apple机器学习团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing tool-calling agent evaluation frameworks are text-centric, mostly limited to static single-turn scenarios with small tool sets, and lack a standardized, unified evaluation system for multimodal agents' visual tool-calling capabilities under dynamic multi-turn interaction, multi-image input, and large tool library settings.
summary_en.importance: This dedicated visual tool-calling evaluation framework fills the gap in benchmarking for dynamic visual tool use scenarios. Its multi-dimensional task design and automated scenario generation pipeline provide a directly reusable testbed for iterating multimodal model tool-calling capabilities and validating multimodal agent performance across the full pretraining and post-training pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built as an extension of the text-centric ToolSandbox evaluation framework, the system adds native image processing support and vision-specific tools, supporting both structured tool calling and code execution interfaces. The benchmark covers 511 tools across 16 application domains, with tasks designed along three orthogonal axes: information flow type, conversational challenge type, and image arrival pattern. It includes 258 human-verified scenarios with 1284 curated images, supporting multi-turn, multi-image interactions. An automated scenario generation pipeline uses information-flow-guided planning, environment state instantiation, and multi-stage quality filtering to reduce manual effort from full annotation to targeted review. Evaluation combines deterministic state verification and LLM-based judges, scoring across dimensions including task completion, tool use validity, instruction following, and absence of unintended side effects.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of leading proprietary and open-weight models shows existing models still exhibit clear weaknesses on visual tool-calling tasks: multi-image working memory stands out as a core bottleneck, models of different parameter scales show distinct failure patterns, and significant gaps remain in visual grounding reasoning, multi-step interaction, and stateful tool use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the three-dimensional task taxonomy in the framework design section and the model failure mode analysis in the experiment section. The benchmark can be directly adopted to evaluate visual tool-calling capabilities of in-house multimodal models. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Apple Machine Learning team

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §benchmark 和 failure analysis；低于 50% 的结果说明 VLM-agent 短板仍在视觉接地精度，不只是规划。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure analysis; the sub-50% result points to visual grounding precision, not just planning, as the VLM-agent bottleneck.

paper.title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
paper.abstract: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and

summary.core_problem: 现有AI Agent自动失败归因基准仅覆盖文本模态、规模极小（仅184条），且缺乏高质量自动标注的失败轨迹，无法支撑多模态、复杂场景下Agent失败归因能力的评测与研究。
summary.importance: 1）提供大规模多模态失败归因基准，可用于训练和评测具备自我错误诊断能力的Agent基座模型；2）可控错误注入的轨迹构造方法可迁移用于合成预训练/RL阶段的自我改进信号；3）揭示的跨模态、跨协议归因规律为Agent对齐训练的目标设计提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）提出可扩展的自动数据构造管线：先在26个基准、15种Agent框架上生成成功轨迹，再选定步骤注入6类（感知/推理/规划/行动/验证/协同）可控错误，从该步热启动生成失败续篇，注入错误直接作为金标决定性错误；2）构建Who&When Pro基准，覆盖文本、图像、视频3模态、9类任务；3）设计跨模态、跨协议、跨模型家族的归因行为分析框架。
summary.experiments: 基准包含12326条带金标的失败轨迹；实验发现视频模态的错误步骤定位难度最高，多模态轨迹为失败模式诊断提供更强线索；全轨迹归因协议显著优于增量式归因；开源模型作为归因骨干具备不错的性价比表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先级：第3节基准构造管线（重点3.3错误注入流程）→第4节核心实证规律与统计结论，附录可按需查看失败分类体系和基准明细；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated failure attribution benchmarks for AI agents are restricted to text-only modalities, contain only 184 small-scale instances, and lack high-quality automatically annotated failure trajectories, making them unsuitable for evaluating and researching agent failure attribution in multimodal, complex real-world scenarios.
summary_en.importance: 1) Delivers a large-scale multimodal failure attribution benchmark that supports training and evaluation of agent base models with self-error diagnosis capabilities; 2) The controlled error injection trajectory construction pipeline can be transferred to synthesize self-improvement signals for pretraining or RL stages; 3) Revealed cross-modal and cross-protocol attribution patterns provide empirical guidance for agent alignment training objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Introduces a scalable automatic data construction pipeline: first roll out successful trajectories across 26 benchmarks and 15 agent frameworks, then inject 6 categories of controlled errors (perception/reasoning/planning/action/verification/coordination) at selected steps, and warm-start execution from that step to generate failed continuations, with the injected error directly used as the golden decisive error label; 2) Builds the Who&When Pro benchmark covering 3 modalities (text, image, video) and 9 task categories; 3) Designs an analysis framework for attribution behavior across modalities, protocols, and model families.
