summary_en.importance: The benchmark is useful because it tests a combination of capabilities rather than a single skill: visual grounding, instruction reading, state tracking, communication efficiency, error recovery, and decision-making under time constraints. Compared with static QA benchmarks, this setting is closer to deployed agentic interaction and is better suited to distinguish memorization of task-like content from the ability to coordinate under novel rules.
summary_en.technical_approach: gptnt is built on the cooperative game Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes. Two agents have strictly asymmetric information: one sees the bomb but not the defusal manual, while the other has the manual but cannot see or manipulate the bomb. They must communicate in real time to defuse procedurally generated bomb modules under a live countdown. The framework supports flexible difficulty control through time limits, module counts, module types, and module placement. The authors also add single-agent diagnostic evaluations and manual-removal contamination checks to separate genuine coordination ability from memorization of game content present in training data.
summary_en.experiments: Across five frontier multimodal model families tested, no model successfully defused even an entry-level bomb in real time, while nine out of ten human player pairs cleared that bar. Ablations that reduce complexity still show substantial failure: models struggle even with a single simple module and unlimited deliberation time. In self-play and other-play experiments, models spend a larger share of game time on communication when paired with a different model. Targeted offline and qualitative analyses attribute failures to hallucination of visual and textual information, inability to detect implausible or ambiguous messages from the partner, loss of state across turns, and weak recovery from errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the task design, the ablations that decompose where performance breaks down, and the contamination-control diagnostics. The paper is most relevant to readers working on agent evaluation, multimodal post-training, or cooperative interaction benchmarks. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 benchmark 设计和失败模式；实时异步协作比多数 turn-based Agent eval 更接近真实系统压力。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure modes; real-time asynchronous collaboration is a cleaner stress test than most turn-based agent evals.

paper.title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
paper.abstract: LLM agents are expected to act over multiple turns, using search, browsing interfaces, and terminal tools to complete user goals. Yet not every goal is well specified or achievable in the available environment. In such cases, a reliable agent should recognize that further interaction is unlikely to help and abstain from additional tool calls. We define Agentic Abstention, the problem of deciding when an agent should stop acting under uncertainty. Unlike standard LLM abstention, which is usually

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent研究聚焦任务完成率，未系统研究多轮交互场景下的序列弃权决策问题：当用户指令模糊、任务在当前环境下不可行时，Agent需要判断何时停止工具调用与无意义探索，而非强行继续交互。该问题不同于传统单轮QA的“答或弃权”决策，任务不可行性往往需要多轮环境交互后才会暴露。
summary.importance: 补全了通用Agent评测体系的空白，为开放环境下的Agent可靠性设计提供了量化基准；提出的convolve上下文工程方法无需微调模型权重，仅通过从历史轨迹中提取可复用规则注入上下文即可提升弃权能力，为轻量Agent优化提供了低成本路径。
summary.technical_approach: 1）形式化定义Agentic Abstention任务，每轮动作空间扩展为{回答、弃权、继续工具调用}三类；2）构建覆盖3类场景（网购、终端交互、QA）的2.8万条指令基准：从AbstentionBench筛选适配样本，同时为WebShop和Terminal-Bench 2.0构造两类合成弃权样本——请求型（修改指令使其语义模糊）和环境型（修改环境配置使原任务不可行，且不可行性需交互后才会被发现）；3）提出convolve上下文优化方法：从全量交互轨迹中提取“继续交互无收益”的可复用模式，整理为动态规则手册（playbook），每轮决策前追加到Agent上下文中引导判断。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖13个LLM-as-Agent系统（含GPT-5.4、Llama-3.3-70B等）与2个Agent框架（Terminus 2、Codex CLI）：1）所有配置的弃权表现均较差：网购场景最强基线的及时弃权召回（AbsRec@1）仅26.7%，最大轮次10时的总召回为83.2%；终端场景最优配置的及时召回仅21.6%；QA场景下错误前提、意图不明确类问题的弃权召回均不超过50%；2）更强的基座模型不必然带来更好的弃权表现，思维链推理可提升及时召回但降低总召回，模型参数缩放不提升及时弃权能力，终端场景下Agent框架本身对结果影响显著；3）convolve方法在Llama-3.3-70B上将网购场景的及时弃权召回从26.7%提升至57.4%，总召回从83.2%提升至100%，且不损害正常任务的完成率；大模型学到的规则迁移性最优，小模型学到的规则也可有效迁移到大模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看第1节的任务定义与单轮弃权的核心差异，再看第3节的基准构造逻辑（尤其是两类合成弃权样本的设计思路），随后重点关注第4节的核心评测结论（模型规模、推理策略、框架设计对弃权表现的影响），最后浏览convolve的规则提取与注入细节。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent research prioritizes task completion rate, but lacks systematic study of abstention as a sequential decision problem in multi-turn interaction settings: when user instructions are ambiguous or tasks are infeasible in the current environment, agents need to decide when to halt tool calls and unproductive exploration instead of forcing continued interaction. This differs from standard single-turn QA abstention, as task infeasibility often only becomes apparent after multiple rounds of environment interaction.
summary_en.importance: Fills a gap in general-purpose agent evaluation pipelines, and provides a quantitative benchmark for reliability design of agents deployed in open environments. The proposed convolve context engineering method requires no model fine-tuning, and improves abstention performance by injecting reusable patterns extracted from historical trajectories, offering a low-cost path for lightweight agent optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: (1) Formalizes the Agentic Abstention task, with a per-turn action space of {answer, abstain, continue with tool call}; (2) Constructs a 28k-instruction benchmark covering three scenarios: web shopping, terminal interaction, and QA. The benchmark combines filtered, adapted samples from AbstentionBench with two types of synthetic abstention instances built for WebShop and Terminal-Bench 2.0: request-based instances (modified instructions with ambiguous semantics) and environment-based instances (modified environment configurations where the original task becomes infeasible only after interaction); (3) Proposes the convolve context optimization method: it extracts reusable patterns of unproductive interaction from full trajectories, organizes them into a dynamic playbook, and appends the playbook to the agent's context before each decision step to guide judgment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover 13 LLM-as-Agent systems (including GPT-5.4, Llama-3.3-70B) and 2 agent scaffolds (Terminus 2, Codex CLI): (1) Abstention performance is poor across all configurations: for web shopping, the strongest baseline reaches only 26.7% timely abstention recall (AbsRec@1) and 83.2% overall recall at max 10 turns; for terminal tasks, the best configuration hits 21.6% timely recall; for QA, abstention recall for false-premise or underspecified questions stays ≤50% for all models; (2) Stronger base models do not consistently improve abstention; chain-of-thought reasoning boosts timely recall but reduces overall recall; model parameter scaling does not improve timely abstention; agent scaffold design has a significant impact on results in terminal environments; (3) Convolve lifts timely abstention recall of Llama-3.3-70B from 26.7% to 57.4% and overall recall from 83.2% to 100% on web shopping, without degrading normal task completion; playbooks learned by larger models have the best transferability, though patterns extracted from smaller models also transfer effectively to larger models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task formulation and core differences from single-turn abstention in Section 1, then review the benchmark construction logic (especially the design of the two types of synthetic abstention instances) in Section 3. Next, focus on the key evaluation findings in Section 4 (effects of model scale, reasoning strategy, and scaffold design on abstention performance), followed by the details of pattern extraction and context injection for convolve. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: agent评测的新维度，重点看§2的问题定义与§4的失败模式分析，可用于指导agent对齐的目标设计
recommendation.en: A new dimension of agent evaluation; focus on Section 2 for problem definition and Section 4 for failure mode analysis, useful for guiding agent alignment target design

paper.title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench
paper.abstract: When a benchmark's accuracy saturates, it is often retired and replaced with a more challenging version. We show that this approach privileges accuracy and misses the opportunity to study six other key dimensions of agent performance: construct validity issues such as shortcuts, out-of-distribution generalizability, efficiency, reliability, the relative importance of the model versus the scaffold, and uplift from human-agent collaboration. We use CORE-Bench Hard, a benchmark for computational re

summary.core_problem: 当前AI agent基准测试普遍遵循“饱和即替换”的迭代模式：当头部模型在基准上的准确率接近天花板、结果无统计显著差异时，就废弃旧基准，推出难度更高的新版本。这种模式只关注单一准确率指标，忽略了饱和基准上仍可观测的多个关键性能维度，无法全面反映agent在真实场景下的实际能力与实用价值。
summary.importance: 这一研究挑战了“准确率饱和即基准失去价值”的默认认知，对预训练和post-train阶段的评测设计有直接参考意义。针对当前评测一味追求更难题目、更高准确率的倾向，提出的多维度分析框架可以迁移到通用LLM、代码模型、推理模型的基准设计中，提醒研究者关注捷径利用、分布外泛化、可靠性、模型与外围脚手架的贡献拆分、人机协作增益等和落地效果强相关的维度，帮助减少基准过拟合，让评测结果更贴近实际使用场景。
summary.technical_approach: 研究以准确率已经饱和的计算可复现性基准CORE-Bench Hard为案例，从三个层面挖掘饱和基准的剩余价值：一是审查基准本身的构念效度，通过分析agent运行日志，挖掘题目本身的答案错误、可被利用的解题捷径，修正得到更严谨的CORE-Bench v1.1版本；同时构建跨学科的分布外测试集CORE-Bench OOD，检验饱和的准确率在领域迁移后是否仍然成立。二是开展多维度性能评估，在准确率无法区分头部agent性能时，对比不同agent的计算效率、多次运行的结果可靠性、以及基础模型能力和外围脚手架（prompt设计、工作流、工具框架）的各自贡献占比。三是评估实际使用效用，通过随机对照试验测量人机协作场景下agent对人类任务完成效率的提升，而不是仅测量agent独立完成任务的准确率。
summary.experiments: 研究在CORE-Bench Hard上分析了20组agent运行结果：原始测试集上头部agent准确率已接近天花板、无统计显著差异，但在效率、可靠性、脚手架依赖度上存在明显分化——不同agent的单任务成本、运行延迟、多次运行成功率方差差异显著，部分agent的高表现严重依赖复杂的外围脚手架设计。日志审查发现原始基准存在15道题目答案错误、20道题目存在可利用的捷径；在修正后的v1.1版本上，原有的高准确率出现明显下降。跨学科分布外测试中，原本饱和的准确率大幅滑落，说明之前的高得分有相当一部分来自对原基准领域分布的过拟合。人机协作实验显示，有agent辅助时人类完成可复现性任务的时间缩短一半以上；纯人类组有20%的任务在3小时时限内未能完成，而人机协作组全部完成，这部分实用价值是单一准确率指标完全无法反映的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对“淘汰-替换”基准迭代模式的问题分析，以及三个核心评测维度的设计逻辑。不需要深入CORE-Bench本身的任务细节，可以将提出的评测维度映射到MMLU、HumanEval、SWE-bench等已逐渐进入饱和期的通用大模型基准上思考迁移性，预计阅读时间15分钟。
summary.authors_note: 代码与实验日志开源于https://github.com/nnadgi01/corebench-analysis。

summary_en.core_problem: AI agent benchmarks currently follow a ubiquitous "retire-and-replace" cycle: once top models reach near-ceiling accuracy and scores become statistically indistinguishable, the old benchmark is discarded in favor of a newer, harder version. This narrow focus on standalone accuracy discards measurable, meaningful signals about agent performance that persist after saturation, and fails to capture real-world capabilities and practical utility.
summary_en.importance: This work challenges the default assumption that accuracy saturation renders a benchmark useless, with direct implications for evaluation design across pretraining and post-training. Against the dominant trend of building ever-harder benchmarks to chase higher accuracy numbers, the proposed multi-dimensional evaluation framework generalizes to general-purpose LLM, coding, and reasoning benchmarks. It highlights under-measured dimensions including shortcut exploitation, out-of-distribution generalization, reliability, the split between base model capability and peripheral scaffolding, and human-agent collaboration uplift—all factors that reduce benchmark overfitting and make evaluation results more predictive of real-world performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the accuracy-saturated computational reproducibility benchmark CORE-Bench Hard as a case study, the work extracts remaining value from saturated benchmarks across three layers. First, it audits construct validity by analyzing agent run logs to identify ground truth errors and exploitable shortcuts in the original benchmark, producing a corrected, more rigorous CORE-Bench v1.1, and builds a cross-discipline out-of-distribution split CORE-Bench OOD to test if saturated accuracy transfers across domains. Second, it conducts multi-dimensional performance evaluation: when accuracy cannot differentiate top agents, it compares compute efficiency, run-to-run result reliability, and the relative contribution of base model capability versus peripheral scaffolding (including prompt design, workflow logic, and tooling frameworks). Third, it measures practical utility via a randomized controlled trial of agent uplift in human-agent collaborative workflows, rather than only measuring standalone agent task completion rate.
summary_en.experiments: Analysis covers 20 agent runs on CORE-Bench Hard. On the original split, top agents reach statistically indistinguishable near-ceiling accuracy, but show substantial differences in per-task cost, latency, run-to-run success variance, and degree of reliance on scaffolding—some high-performing agents depend heavily on complex peripheral engineering rather than base model capability. The log audit uncovers 15 tasks with incorrect ground truth and 20 tasks with exploitable shortcuts; scores drop significantly on the corrected v1.1 split. Saturated accuracy does not transfer to the cross-discipline OOD split, indicating a large portion of original high scores comes from overfitting to the original benchmark's domain distribution. The human-agent collaboration study finds agent assistance cuts task completion time by more than half; 20% of human-only sessions failed to finish within a 3-hour time limit, while all human-agent collaborative sessions completed successfully—an effect entirely invisible to standalone accuracy metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the critique of the "retire-and-replace" benchmark cycle in the introduction, and the design logic of the three core evaluation dimensions. There is no need to dive into CORE-Bench-specific task details; consider how the proposed dimensions apply to increasingly saturated general LLM benchmarks such as MMLU, HumanEval, and SWE-bench. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Code and experimental logs available at https://github.com/nnadgi01/corebench-analysis.

recommendation.zh: 修正了「benchmark准确率饱和就该淘汰」的惯性认知，六维评估框架可复用，重点看§3的维度定义和构念效度分析
recommendation.en: Corrects the default assumption that saturated benchmarks should be retired; the reusable 6-dimension framework is worth noting, focus on Section 3 for dimension definitions and construct validity analysis

paper.title: CyberChainBench: Can AI Agents Secure Smart Contracts Against Real-World On-Chain Vulnerabilities?
paper.abstract: We present CyberChainBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on smart contract security across three complementary tasks: vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and patch synthesis. Built from 541 real-world exploit incidents from DeFiHackLabs spanning 9 EVM chains, the benchmark provides end-to-end on-chain evaluation where agents interact with historical blockchain state through isolated evaluation environments orchestrated by Harbor, using tools to read code, trace transactio

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM-based agents 是否能在真实链上环境中完成智能合约漏洞检测、利用生成和补丁合成，而不是只做静态代码问答。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 与端到端评测协议。它对通用 Agent 评测设计有参考价值，尤其是把真实环境交互、经济后果和可执行验证纳入同一套评测闭环；但任务域是区块链安全，离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CyberChainBench，基于 541 个来自 DeFiHackLabs 的真实 exploit 事件，覆盖 9 条 EVM 链。每个样例锚定到具体历史区块，agent 可在 Harbor 编排的隔离环境中读取代码、追踪交易、在 mainnet fork 上验证 exploit，并对 patch 进行历史攻击回放与合法交易回放验证。
summary.experiments: 基准包含三类任务：漏洞检测、利用生成、补丁合成，并定义五类漏洞 taxonomy。论文评测了多种 agent-model 配置，重点不在追求单一分数，而在揭示当前 agent 在真实链上安全任务中的能力边界。摘要未给出具体领先模型和绝对分数，但从设计上看，评测强度明显高于纯静态 benchmark。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括华盛顿大学与西北大学方向的安全研究者；Zhiqiang Lin 是系统与安全领域较知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark asks whether LLM-based agents can actually detect vulnerabilities, generate exploits, and synthesize patches for smart contracts in realistic on-chain environments rather than just answer static code questions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. The value for foundation-model researchers is in the end-to-end agent evaluation design: real environment interaction, executable validation, and economic impact are all folded into one loop. Still, the domain is blockchain security, not core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CyberChainBench is built from 541 real exploit incidents from DeFiHackLabs across 9 EVM chains. Each case is anchored to a historical block, and agents operate in isolated Harbor-managed environments with tools for code reading, transaction tracing, exploit validation on mainnet forks, and patch checking via replay of historical attacks and legitimate transactions.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and patch synthesis, with a five-type vulnerability taxonomy. Multiple agent-model combinations are evaluated. The point is less about a leaderboard winner and more about exposing where current agents fail under realistic execution constraints. The abstract does not provide exact top scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include security researchers from institutions such as the University of Washington and Northwestern University; Zhiqiang Lin is a well-known systems and security researcher.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但评测闭环做得比多数 agent benchmark 干净；只看任务定义和可执行验证设计，别陷进区块链细节。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the eval loop is cleaner than most agent benchmarks; read the task design and executable validation, not the blockchain specifics.

paper.title: OpenRCA 2.0: From Outcome Labels to Causal Process Supervision
paper.abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) poses a holistic test of LLM agentic capabilities, such as long-context understanding, multi-step reasoning, and tool use. However, existing datasets suffer from a fundamental gap: they label only the root cause, not the propagation path connecting it to the observed symptom, which largely simplifies the task to naive pattern matching. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce PAVE, a step-wise labeling protocol that leverages known interventions from fault injection

summary.core_problem: 现有 RCA 评测只标注最终根因，缺少故障从根因传播到症状的过程标签，容易把复杂因果推理简化成模式匹配。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向 LLM agent 的评测资产贡献，重点在过程级因果监督，而不是只看 outcome accuracy；它能更细地暴露长上下文、工具使用、多步推理和因果链路恢复中的失败位置。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PAVE 标注协议，利用故障注入中的已知干预信息重建因果传播路径；核心验证方向是从 cause 到 effect 的 forward verification，而不是从症状反推根因。基于该协议构建 OpenRCA 2.0，包含跨系统 RCA 实例和逐步因果注释。
summary.experiments: OpenRCA 2.0 包含 500 个实例；论文评测 11 个前沿 LLM，在 exact root-cause set 恢复上平均成功率为 20.7%。摘要还提到通过放宽判定标准定位失败来源，但具体 relaxed metrics 和各模型结果未在给定信息中完整展示。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RCA benchmarks label only the final root cause, leaving out the causal propagation path from fault to symptom and making the task easier to solve by pattern matching.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset for LLM agents with process-level causal supervision, aimed at diagnosing failures in long-context reasoning, tool use, multi-step reasoning, and grounded causal reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PAVE, a step-wise labeling protocol that uses known interventions from fault injection to reconstruct causal propagation paths. The key idea is forward verification from cause to effect rather than backward inference from observed symptoms. Applying PAVE yields OpenRCA 2.0 with cross-system RCA instances and step-wise causal annotations.
summary_en.experiments: OpenRCA 2.0 contains 500 instances. Across 11 frontier LLMs, exact root-cause set recovery succeeds in only 20.7% of cases on average. The abstract also mentions relaxed criteria to locate failure modes, but the provided text does not include full metric definitions or model-by-model results.

recommendation.zh: RCA 领域味道偏重，但过程标签比 outcome-only 评测干净；看数据构造协议即可，不必细读模型榜单。
recommendation.en: Domain-heavy RCA work, but the process labels are cleaner than outcome-only evals; read the annotation protocol, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
paper.abstract: For agents to learn continuously from interaction with the world at test time, they must be able to explore effectively, acquire new world knowledge and skills, retain relevant episodic experiences, and plan over long horizons. To evaluate these key abilities of test-time continual learning agents, we introduce AgentOdyssey, a novel evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics, and long-horizon tasks. Critically, AgentOdyssey goes beyo

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent benchmark 多数评估静态推理能力，难以研究模型在部署过程中通过交互、记忆和试错持续学习的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近评测基础设施，而不是预训练方法。对基座研究的价值在于，它把 test-time continual learning 拆成可诊断能力：探索、情景记忆、世界知识获取、技能学习和长程规划。这些能力与预训练和后训练的接口相关，尤其是记忆机制、上下文学习、工具使用、长期任务数据合成，以及是否需要参数更新的 test-time training。它不直接给出新的 LM objective，但能帮助判断现有 LLM agent 的瓶颈来自模型先验、上下文管理、记忆压缩，还是规划策略。
summary.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey 是一个可程序化生成开放式文字游戏的评测框架。环境被形式化为 POMDP，状态包含地点图、物体分布、NPC、时间和 agent 自身状态；agent 通过自然语言动作与环境交互，只能看到局部文本观察。生成端使用面向长程游戏的 ontology，定义地点、物体、NPC、action rules 和 step rules。action rules 描述 agent 动作的效果，step rules 描述环境自身动态，例如 NPC 行为。LLM 用于合成实体和规则，随后用程序合成进行验证和自动修复，以保证游戏系统可执行、任务可达、反馈一致。评测端不只看游戏进度，还包含世界知识、情景记忆、物体探索、动作探索、动作多样性和调用成本等诊断指标。
summary.experiments: 提供内容中没有完整实验表格和具体数字。可确认的是，作者评估了多类 agent 范式，并报告当前 agent 在长程、非重置环境中存在明显限制；影响有效任务跨度的因素包括探索效率、短期记忆组织、经验到语义知识的抽象，以及能否把早期经历用于后续规划。作者特别强调短期记忆在 agent test-time training 中的重要性，这一点符合长程环境的直觉：如果经验不能被稳定保留并压缩成决策相关信息，后续参数更新或检索增强都难以发挥作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–40 分钟。优先看 AgentOdyssey 的 ontology、POMDP formalization、game verification/auto-fixing 机制，以及 metrics 设计。若只关心预训练接口，可跳过具体游戏示例，重点看评测维度如何映射到记忆、知识获取和技能学习。值得深挖的是生成环境的可控性：任务难度是否能随实体数、规则数、依赖链长度稳定扩展；自动验证是否能排除不可解任务；诊断指标是否能预测 agent 在真实长程任务中的失败模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in agent evaluation: most benchmarks measure static inference, while real agents may need to learn continuously during deployment through interaction, memory, and trial-and-error.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation and environment-generation contribution, not a pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it decomposes test-time continual learning into concrete abilities: exploration, episodic memory, world-knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. These abilities sit at the interface between pretraining, post-training, memory systems, and test-time adaptation. The benchmark can help distinguish whether an agent fails because the base model lacks priors, because the memory system loses useful information, because the planner cannot manage long dependencies, or because test-time updates are poorly conditioned.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey procedurally generates open-ended text games. The environment is modeled as a POMDP: the hidden state contains a graph of locations, objects, NPC instances, time, and agent state, while the agent receives partial textual observations and feedback after each natural-language action. The generation engine is built around an ontology for long-horizon games, covering entities such as locations, objects, and NPCs, plus rules such as action rules and step rules. Action rules define the effects of agent actions; step rules define autonomous environment dynamics, such as NPC behavior. LLMs synthesize entities and rules, and a program-synthesis-based verifier checks and repairs generated games so that the resulting environments are executable and internally consistent. The evaluation suite includes not only task progress but also diagnostic metrics for world knowledge, episodic memory, object and action exploration, action diversity, and model cost.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied text does not include full tables or numerical results. The visible claims are that the authors compare diverse agent paradigms and find clear limits in current agents under long-horizon, non-resettable settings. The reported bottlenecks include inefficient exploration, poor short-term memory organization, weak abstraction from episodes into reusable knowledge, and limited ability to use earlier experiences for later planning. The emphasis on short-term memory in test-time training is technically plausible: if recent experience is not preserved and compressed into decision-relevant state, retrieval-based learning and parametric test-time updates both lose useful signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–40 minutes. Read the ontology, POMDP formalization, game verification and auto-repair mechanism, and metric definitions. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip many game examples and focus on how the benchmark operationalizes memory, knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. The key points to inspect are controllability and validity: whether difficulty scales cleanly with entity count, rule count, and dependency length; whether verification removes unsolvable games; and whether the diagnostic metrics predict failures in more realistic long-horizon agent tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读评测协议和诊断指标即可；它不是预训练方法，但 test-time continual learning 的任务假设值得纳入 agent eval 视野。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and diagnostic metrics; it is not a pretraining method, but the test-time continual-learning assumption is worth tracking for agent evaluation.

paper.title: Agentic System as Compressor: Quantifying System Intelligence in Bits
paper.abstract: Large language models are turning from isolated predictors into agentic systems: they call tools, retrieve evidence, obey environment constraints, use verifiers, and complete tasks through search and multi-turn interaction. We adopts an analytical viewpoint based on "compression is intelligence": under a fixed task distribution, interface, and compute budget, a stronger agentic system lets a target object be reconstructed with fewer bits. We operationalize the measure with arithmetic coding, see

summary.core_problem: 如何用统一的信息论度量来评估“带工具、检索、验证器和环境交互的 agent 系统”整体智能，而不是只测孤立模型的准确率或裸模型的压缩率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作把“compression is intelligence”从单模型 log-loss 扩展到了 agent system 层面，提出了一种可操作的 codelength 指标，用于分解模型、工具、检索、验证器、搜索预算等组件到底贡献了多少“有效不确定性压缩”。对预训练研究的直接启发不在于训练方法，而在于评测思想：当系统能力越来越来自模型外机制时，只看最终成功率会丢失大量信号；用比特数衡量残差不确定性，可以在成功率接近零或组件耦合严重时仍给出细粒度对比。这对研究推理系统、检索增强、verifier 辅助生成、甚至 RL/搜索增强训练的收益归因都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 agent 系统形式化为三元组：控制程序 P、模型接口 M、环境/工具接口 E，并在给定资源预算 C 下运行。在此基础上定义系统级压缩任务：编码端和解码端共享同一个系统，编码端只发送足够短的 per-instance 描述，使解码端能在相同接口和预算下重建目标对象。系统越强，需要的残差比特数越少。为让这个定义可执行，作者组合了三种编码机制：arithmetic coding 把模型的条件分布直接转成 NLL/codelength；seed coding 用于确定性或可重放环境，只传随机种子序号，让系统通过采样找到满足约束的输出；当 seed coding 在有限预算内失败时回退到 arithmetic coding，保证所有样本都能编码。进一步，作者定义 marginal bit value，用加入某个组件前后平均码长的减少量来量化组件贡献，从而把工具、检索、verifier、采样预算都纳入统一账本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个受控场景，目的不是刷任务分数，而是验证这套度量能否分辨不同信息源的贡献。Reversed text 检验共享变换是否能被编码进系统而减少每实例码长；chess 用来测量规则环境对合法动作空间的压缩；protein 实验显示当成功率几乎没有区分度时，codelength 仍能分辨模板先验和 verifier feedback 的收益；RAG 用来测外部证据相关性和观测标准如何改变残差比特数；semantic story compression 则测试语义目标和计算预算对码长的影响。论文给出的核心现象是：在这些设置里，agent 组件都能稳定降低 codelength，而且该指标能在 success rate 失去分辨率时继续提供梯度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读理论部分，尤其是 agent 系统定义、观测等价性、arithmetic/seed/fallback 三种编码的分工，以及 marginal bit value 的定义。这是论文最有价值的部分。实验部分不必逐段细读，重点看每个任务想隔离哪类信息源。对预训练研究者来说，值得思考的是：这个框架能否迁移到训练信号分析上，例如衡量 verifier、RL rollout、检索增强究竟为模型压缩目标分布提供了多少额外比特，而不是只看下游分数变化。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the intelligence of an entire agentic system—including tools, retrieval, verifiers, and environment interaction—with a unified information-theoretic measure, rather than relying only on isolated-model accuracy or bare-model compression rate.
summary_en.importance: The paper extends the 'compression is intelligence' view from single-model log-loss to full agent systems and proposes an operational codelength metric for attributing how much residual uncertainty reduction comes from the model versus tools, retrievers, verifiers, and search/compute budgets. Its main relevance to pretraining is evaluative rather than algorithmic: as system capability increasingly comes from mechanisms outside the base model, end-task success rates become too coarse and can stay near zero even when large differences exist in residual uncertainty reduction. Bit-level accounting provides a finer signal for reasoning systems, retrieval augmentation, verifier-guided generation, and the analysis of RL- or search-based training gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model an agentic system as a triple of control program P, model interface M, and environment/tool interface E, evaluated under a resource budget C. They define system-level compression: given a shared system on both encoder and decoder sides, the encoder transmits only a short per-instance code that allows the decoder, under identical interfaces and budget, to reconstruct the target object. A stronger system requires fewer residual bits. To make this operational, three coding schemes are combined: arithmetic coding converts conditional model distributions into NLL/codelength; seed coding applies to deterministic or replayable environments by transmitting only a random-seed rank until a valid sample is found; and arithmetic coding is used as a fallback when seed coding fails within budget, ensuring lossless encodability for every sample. A marginal bit value metric is then defined as the average codelength reduction attributable to adding a specific component, enabling unified accounting of tools, retrieval, verifiers, and sampling budget.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed as controlled probes rather than benchmark sweeps. Reversed text checks whether shared transforms can be absorbed into the system to reduce per-instance codelength. Chess measures how rule-based environments shrink the legal action space. Protein experiments show that codelength can still differentiate gains from template priors and verifier feedback when success rate has almost no resolution. RAG tests how external evidence relevance and observation standards change residual bits. Semantic story compression studies the effect of semantic observers and compute budget. Across these settings, agentic components consistently reduce codelength, and the metric continues to provide measurable gradients even where success rates saturate near zero or one.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the theory sections carefully, especially the agent-system formalism, observational equivalence, the division of labor among arithmetic coding, seed coding, and fallback coding, and the definition of marginal bit value. These are the most useful parts. The experiments do not need a close read in full; focus on which information source each task is intended to isolate. For pretraining researchers, the key question is whether this accounting framework can be transferred to training-signal analysis—for example, quantifying how many bits verifiers, RL rollouts, or retrieval add for compressing the target distribution, instead of only reporting downstream score changes. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把压缩即智能从单模型推广到多组件agent，视角统一有启发性，但实验都是小规模受控玩具，只看§3的度量定义和§5的框架讨论即可。
recommendation.en: Extends compression-as-intelligence from standalone models to multi-component agents with a unifying framing, but experiments are small-scale and synthetic; read §3 for metric definition and §5 for framework discussion only.

paper.title: Decoupling Reconnaissance and Exploitation: Measuring the Capability Boundaries of LLM-Based Web Penetration Testing
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated penetration testing, yet existing end-to-end black-box evaluations are highly susceptible to error cascading: failures in early reconnaissance can mask an agent's actual ability to exploit vulnerabilities. To more accurately characterize these capabilities, we propose a two-stage decoupled evaluation framework that separates exploit execution from reconnaissance. Using ground-truth injection and knowledge-driven ablation across 70 hig

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决 LLM Web 渗透测试 agent 的评测归因问题：端到端黑盒评测会把侦察阶段的失败传导到漏洞利用阶段，使研究者无法区分 agent 是不会发现漏洞，还是发现后不会利用漏洞。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接价值有限，更接近 agent eval 和工具使用评测。但它有一个可迁移的评测思想：把复杂 agent 任务拆成感知、状态构建、执行几个可控阶段，用 ground-truth injection 隔离错误来源。这个思路对代码 agent、浏览器 agent、长程工具调用评测也有参考意义，尤其适合诊断模型能力和系统编排能力之间的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是两阶段解耦评测。第一阶段评估自主侦察能力，关注 agent 能否从页面、日志、工具输出和异常信息中定位目标漏洞。第二阶段在侦察失败时注入标准化的真实漏洞上下文，让 agent 在已知漏洞位置和类型的条件下执行利用，从而单独测量 exploitation 能力。作者还做 knowledge-driven ablation，用不同程度的先验信息观察性能变化。评测资产来自 Vulhub 和 Vulfocus，重建了 70 个高保真 Web 漏洞环境，并选取 50 个代表性漏洞进行严格对齐比较。被测对象包括 5 个开源渗透测试 agent，覆盖 multi-agent、monolithic 和 graph-driven 架构。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是侦察和利用之间存在明显断层。在注入准确漏洞上下文后，agent 的 Functional Success Rate 最高达到 90.0%；但在自主侦察条件下，Targeted Vulnerability Recall 大约停在 50.0%。主要失败来源不是简单的 payload 生成，而是对非结构化环境反馈的解析不足，例如错误页面、工具 telemetry、WAF 拦截信息和非标准返回。架构分析显示，不同 agent 有不同适用区间：multi-agent 隔离更适合反序列化这类长交互链路；monolithic 架构在短链注入上更直接；graph-driven 设计在跨 session 的访问控制漏洞上表现更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看第 3 节的两阶段评测协议和 ground-truth injection 设计，再看第 4 节的 benchmark 构建、指标定义和总体结果。第 5 节的架构归因值得快速扫一遍，重点关注 multi-agent、monolithic、graph-driven 的失败模式差异。若只关心通用 agent 评测，可跳过具体漏洞细节，保留“阶段解耦 + 真实状态注入 + 错误归因”的评测框架。
summary.authors_note: 材料中可确认的机构包括南京理工大学、Runjian Co., Ltd. 的研究机构，以及与中国科学技术大学邮箱相关的作者信息；作者列表未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses attribution in LLM-based web penetration-testing agents. In end-to-end black-box evaluation, a failed reconnaissance step can hide whether the agent is actually incapable of exploitation or simply never reached the right vulnerability context.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the evaluation idea is useful for general agent research. It separates perception, state construction, and execution so that failure sources can be measured rather than inferred. The same design pattern can be applied to coding agents, browser agents, and long-horizon tool-use systems where early observation errors often mask downstream capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation protocol decouples reconnaissance from exploitation. First, agents attempt autonomous reconnaissance and are measured on whether they can identify the target vulnerability from pages, logs, tool outputs, and noisy runtime feedback. If reconnaissance fails, the framework injects ground-truth vulnerability context and then measures exploitation under controlled conditions. The authors also use knowledge-driven ablations to vary the amount of prior information. The benchmark contains 70 reconstructed high-fidelity web vulnerability environments from Vulhub and Vulfocus, with a strictly aligned subset of 50 representative vulnerabilities. Five open-source penetration-testing agents are evaluated, covering multi-agent, monolithic, and graph-driven designs.
summary_en.experiments: The main finding is a large gap between exploitation and reconnaissance. With accurate vulnerability context, agents reach a Functional Success Rate of up to 90.0%. Under autonomous reconnaissance, Targeted Vulnerability Recall plateaus around 50.0%. The dominant failures come from parsing unstructured telemetry and unstable environment feedback, including non-standard error messages, WAF interference, and noisy tool outputs. The architecture analysis identifies different niches: multi-agent isolation helps with long interaction chains such as deserialization; monolithic agents do better on short-chain injections; graph-driven agents are stronger on cross-session access-control vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the two-stage protocol and ground-truth injection design, then read the benchmark construction, metric definitions, and aggregate results. The architecture attribution section is useful for understanding how control-flow design changes failure modes. Readers interested mainly in general agent evaluation can skip most vulnerability-specific details and retain the broader recipe: stage decomposition, controlled state injection, and explicit error attribution.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided material identifies Nanjing University of Science and Technology, a research institute of Runjian Co., Ltd., and author contact information associated with the University of Science and Technology of China. The full author list is not available in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是安全应用本身，而是把 agent 失败拆干净了；做 tool-use 或 web agent 的人应直接借它的解耦评测思路，重点看 ablation 设计。
recommendation.en: This is useful not as a security application but as a cleaner failure decomposition for agents; if you work on tool use or web agents, borrow the decoupled evaluation design and read the ablations.

paper.title: GUI vs. CLI: Execution Bottlenecks in Screen-Only and Skill-Mediated Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents can execute software tasks through either graphical interfaces or programmatic command interfaces, but existing evaluations confound interaction modality with differences in tasks, initial states, verifiers, and permitted actions. We introduce a matched execution-layer benchmark of 440 desktop tasks across 18 applications and 12 workflow categories, where screen-only GUI agents and skill-mediated CLI agents receive identical goals, states, and final-state verifiers while bein

summary.core_problem: 现有 computer-use agent 评测把 GUI 与 CLI/skill 两种交互模态和任务集、初始状态、验证器、动作空间等因素混在一起比较，无法回答 GUI 与 skill-mediated CLI 本身的执行瓶颈到底在哪里。
summary.importance: 这是一个控制变量做得比较扎实的 agent 执行层评测工作，不属于通用基座 pretrain 方向，但对理解 agent 训练数据与接口设计有间接价值：它把“模型能力”问题与“动作接口/技能覆盖”问题拆开，指出很多 CLI 差距其实来自 skill 层不完备，而不是模态本身。对做 computer-use / tool-use post-training 和数据构造的研究者有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个匹配式执行层 benchmark：440 个桌面任务，覆盖 18 个应用、12 类工作流。GUI agent 和 CLI/skill agent 使用完全相同的任务目标、初始状态和最终状态可执行验证器，但被严格限制在各自模态原生动作空间内：GUI 只能通过截图+点击/拖拽/键盘操作，CLI 只能调用 skill 层暴露的程序化操作，不允许绕过接口直接改文件。通过这个受控设置比较两种模态，并进一步用 verifier-guided skill patching 诊断 skill 覆盖不足造成的性能上限。
summary.experiments: 在原始 skill 设置下，最强 GUI agent（GPT-5.4）full pass rate 为 59.1%，最强 CLI agent（Codex GPT-5.5）为 48.2%。诊断发现原始 skill 只能覆盖 37.6% 的 verifier checkpoint；在 verifier 引导下修补缺失 skill 后，CLI 成功率提升到 69.3%，这可视为 skill 覆盖补齐后的诊断上限而非开箱即用结果。失败模式上，GUI 主要瓶颈是 visual grounding 和长工作流执行；CLI 主要瓶颈是 skill 覆盖缺口、隐式默认状态重建、以及应用内不可观测语义。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 benchmark 设计和 failure mode 分析部分，尤其是 skill coverage 作为 CLI 瓶颈的定量诊断，以及 GUI/CLI 各自适合的工作流类型。实验表格和失败 taxonomy 值得看。预计阅读时间 20 分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations of computer-use agents compare GUI and skill-mediated CLI interaction while confounding modality with differences in tasks, initial states, verifiers, and permitted action spaces, making it impossible to isolate the execution bottlenecks intrinsic to each modality.
summary_en.importance: This is a carefully controlled agent benchmark rather than a pretraining paper. Its main relevance is for computer-use and tool-use post-training: it cleanly separates model capability from action-interface quality, showing that a large part of the apparent CLI deficit comes from incomplete skill coverage rather than the modality itself. This is useful for anyone designing tool interfaces, action spaces, or training data for computer-use agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a matched execution-layer benchmark of 440 desktop tasks across 18 applications and 12 workflow categories. GUI and skill-mediated CLI agents are given identical task goals, initial states, and executable final-state verifiers, but are restricted to modality-native action spaces: GUI agents act only through screenshots and native mouse/keyboard operations, while CLI agents act only through a curated skill layer and are not allowed to bypass it by directly editing output files. The study further uses verifier-guided skill patching as a diagnostic to estimate how much CLI performance is recoverable by repairing missing skill paths.
summary_en.experiments: With the original skill layer, the strongest GUI agent (GPT-5.4) reaches 59.1% full pass rate, while the strongest CLI agent (Codex GPT-5.5) reaches 48.2%. Only 37.6% of verifier checkpoints are satisfiable under the original skill interface. After verifier-guided patching of missing skills, CLI success rises to 69.3%, which is interpreted as a diagnostic upper bound under repaired skill coverage rather than an out-of-the-box CLI result. GUI failures are dominated by visual grounding and long-horizon workflow execution; CLI failures are dominated by skill coverage gaps, implicit-default reconstruction, and unobservable application semantics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the benchmark design and failure-mode analysis. Pay particular attention to the quantitative diagnosis of skill coverage as a CLI bottleneck and the per-workflow comparison of GUI versus CLI strengths. The result tables and failure taxonomy are the most informative parts. Estimated reading time: about 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的 setup 比结论更值钱；看任务匹配和 verifier 设计，可校准 GUI/CLI agent 评测。
recommendation.en: The setup is more valuable than the conclusion; read the task matching and verifier design to calibrate GUI/CLI agent evaluation.

paper.title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although th

summary.core_problem: 检验长时程工具使用 agent 中，retrieval exact-match recall 是否真能代表下游决策模型获得了有用的 policy signal。
summary.importance: 这是 agent/RAG 评测代理指标的审计，价值在于指出 retrieval recall 可能误导系统设计；对做 tool-use、decision-time retrieval、agent eval 的研究员有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 tau-bench 的 pre-action policy classification 设定下，用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 分类器比较 gold-policy、retrieved-policy、mismatched-policy、no-policy 等条件，并先验证 compact structured state 相比 raw trajectory 是否更利于分类。
summary.experiments: 在 airline states 上，benchmark 指定的 exact governing clause 只有 7% 能被 rank-1 检索到，但 3B 分类器用 retrieved clauses 的 macro-F1 为 0.58，接近 gold clauses 的 0.60；mismatched-policy 和 no-policy 分别为 0.32 和 0.21。作者未能检测到 retrieved 与 gold 的显著差异，但置信区间较宽，尚不能证明非劣。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether exact-match retrieval recall is actually a good proxy for useful policy signal in long-horizon tool-use agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an audit of proxy metrics for agent/RAG evaluation. Its value is in showing that retrieval recall can be misleading for downstream decision quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using pre-action policy classification on tau-bench, the authors compare gold-policy, retrieved-policy, mismatched-policy, and no-policy conditions with Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers, and also study compact structured state versus raw trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: On airline states, the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 only 7% of the time, yet the 3B classifier reaches macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses; mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. The interval is too wide to establish non-inferiority, but the qualitative gap between retrieval recall and policy utility is clear.

recommendation.zh: 如果你还在用 retrieval recall 当 agent 上下文质量代理，这篇会给你泼冷水；读摘要和主结果表就够，结论有意思但统计把握还不够硬。
recommendation.en: If you still use retrieval recall as a proxy for agent context quality, this paper is a useful corrective; the main table is enough, though the statistical confidence is still loose.

authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein

paper.title: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant approach to scalable evaluation in NLP pipelines, yet judges themselves carry systematic biases that raw accuracy hides: they favor responses placed in slot A (position bias), they prefer longer responses regardless of quality (verbosity bias), and their reliability degrades sharply in lower-resource languages. We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes -- position bias, verbosity b

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 LLM-as-a-judge 的可靠性审计问题：一个 judge 模型即使在配对选择上有不错的原始准确率，也可能同时存在位置偏置、冗长偏置、顺序不一致和跨语言退化。论文的重点不是提升 judge，而是提供一个不依赖人工偏好标注的测试框架，把这些隐藏失效模式显式量化。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 研究的直接启发在于：LLM judge 已经被大量用于偏好数据构造、RLHF/RLAIF、模型选择和自动评测，如果 judge 在低资源语言或长回答上存在系统性偏置，训练信号会被污染。BabelJudge 的贡献偏评测基础设施，量级不在模型能力提升，而在提供一个可复用的可靠性诊断工具。它提醒研究者不要只看 judge accuracy，还要看 order consistency、position bias 和 verbosity susceptibility 这类会影响训练数据质量的指标。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 gold-labelling by degradation。给定高质量参考回答 r，对它施加受控退化得到 p，并把 gold label 定义为偏好 r。这样可以从任意参考语料自动生成配对评测样本，不需要人工偏好标注。框架设计了 5 类语言无关扰动，基于空白 token、句子分隔符和数字模式操作，因此可以直接迁移到多语言场景。其中 repeat_pad 是冗长偏置探针：扰动答案更长但质量更差，如果 judge 偏好它，就说明 judge 在奖励长度而不是质量。每个样本以 ref-first 和 pert-first 两种顺序提交给 judge，从而直接测量位置偏置和顺序一致性。最终指标不是简单平均，而是把准确率、位置偏置惩罚、冗长偏置惩罚、顺序一致性组合成 multiplicative reliability score。这个设计有明确取舍：如果一个 judge 准确率高但偏置大，乘法门控会比加法平均给出更低分，更适合暴露评测风险。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 作为 judge，在 Apple Silicon 上本地运行。数据来自 Aya 多语言数据集，每种语言抽取 10 条参考回答，覆盖英语、印地语、阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语。5 种扰动、2 个严重程度、2 种展示顺序，对每种语言形成约 200 次 judge 调用，四种语言约 800 次调用。结果显示，宏平均 accuracy 为 0.770，但宏平均 reliability 只有 0.614，差距达到 15.6 个百分点。斯瓦希里语 reliability 为 0.550，比印地语 0.714 低 23 个百分点；但两者 accuracy 差距只有 17.5 个百分点，分别为 0.660 和 0.835。主要问题来自 order consistency：斯瓦希里语只有 0.480，说明交换候选答案顺序后，判决接近随机翻转。英语的 verbosity susceptibility 很低，为 0.075，说明该 judge 在英语 repeat_pad 样本上不太容易被更长但更差的回答误导。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 gold-labelling by degradation 的构造逻辑、repeat_pad 为什么能隔离冗长偏置、双顺序评测如何分离位置偏置和顺序一致性。Results 部分建议看 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，对比 accuracy 与 reliability 的差异，以及不同语言上的退化来源。如果关心自动评测或偏好数据质量，值得细看 composite reliability score 的乘法惩罚设计；如果只关心模型能力提升，可以跳过 agent trajectory 扩展和工程适配细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses reliability auditing for LLM-as-a-judge systems. A judge can show reasonable pairwise accuracy while still suffering from position bias, verbosity bias, order inconsistency, and cross-lingual degradation. The goal is not to train a better judge, but to build a reusable audit harness that exposes these hidden failure modes without human preference labels.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training is signal quality. LLM judges are now used in preference data generation, RLHF/RLAIF pipelines, model selection, and automated evaluation. If the judge systematically favors slot A, longer answers, or high-resource languages, the resulting supervision can be biased. BabelJudge is best viewed as evaluation infrastructure. Its contribution is to move judge assessment beyond raw accuracy toward reliability metrics that are more predictive of whether the judge can safely be used as a training or evaluation signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is gold-labelling by degradation. Starting from a high-quality reference response, the framework applies a controlled degradation to create a worse response, and defines the gold label as preferring the original reference. This produces pairwise items from any reference corpus without human annotation. The perturbations are designed to be language-agnostic, relying on whitespace tokens, sentence boundaries, and digit patterns. The repeat_pad perturbation is the verbosity-bias probe: it makes the degraded response longer while keeping it strictly worse, so a preference for the padded response indicates a length bias. Each item is evaluated in both reference-first and perturbed-first orders, which makes position bias and order consistency directly measurable. The final reliability score combines accuracy with multiplicative penalties for bias and inconsistency, intentionally lowering the score of judges that are accurate but unstable or biased.
summary_en.experiments: The experiment audits mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit, a quantized Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct judge running locally through MLX on Apple Silicon. The data is sampled from Aya, with 10 reference responses per language across English, Hindi, Arabic, and Swahili. Five perturbation types, two severity levels, and two presentation orders yield about 200 judge calls per language, or roughly 800 total calls. The macro accuracy is 0.770, while macro reliability is 0.614, a 15.6-point gap. Swahili reliability is 0.550, 23 points below Hindi at 0.714, even though the accuracy gap is smaller: 0.660 versus 0.835. The main driver is order consistency. For Swahili it is 0.480, meaning the judge’s decision nearly flips at random when the answer order is swapped. English verbosity susceptibility is reported as low, 0.075, suggesting the audited judge is not easily fooled by longer degraded answers in English.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the methodology: the degradation-based labelling scheme, the repeat_pad probe for verbosity bias, and the two-order design for separating position bias from answer quality. In the results, Figure 2 and Figure 3 are the useful parts: they show why accuracy and reliability diverge, and which failure modes dominate per language. For readers building automated evaluation or preference-data pipelines, the composite reliability score is worth a closer look. The agent-trajectory extension and backend adapters can be read lightly unless they match an immediate engineering need.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 构造即可；若你用 judge 过滤 RL 数据，这类偏差会直接变成训练信号噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the metric construction; if judges filter your RL data, these biases become training-signal noise rather than evaluation trivia.

paper.title: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
paper.abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) have advanced rapidly in desktop automation, and a growing number of users deploy CUAs such as OpenClaw on Mac Mini for always-on automation. However, existing benchmarks, including those for macOS, evaluate agents without framework augmentation and rely on binary evaluation. As a result, they fail to capture both the framework capabilities leveraged by modern CUAs and the partial progress on long-horizon, multi-application tasks. We present MacAgentBench, a comprehens

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 macOS 桌面智能体评测不够贴近真实使用的问题：已有评测多把智能体限制在截图到 GUI 动作的闭环里，并用二值成功率打分，难以评估现代 CUA 框架中的 CLI、AppleScript、Accessibility API、预置技能，以及长流程任务中的部分完成情况。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对通用智能体能力评测有参考价值。它把模型能力、框架能力和技能库影响拆开看，避免把 agent harness 的工程收益误认为模型本身能力提升。对于做 agent 数据合成、长程任务训练、GUI/CLI 统一动作建模的人，这类细粒度检查点可以作为更稳定的训练和评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: MacAgentBench 的核心设计是开放环境评测，而不是规定固定的观察空间和动作空间。智能体可以使用纯 GUI，也可以调用命令行、脚本、预置技能或外部 harness。环境侧采用 Docker-QEMU 运行 macOS，并利用 QEMU copy-on-write 机制共享基础镜像，每个实例只保存运行时差分层。任务集包含 676 个任务，覆盖 25 个应用，近 60% 同时涉及 GUI 和 CLI。评测采用确定性规则脚本，不依赖人工主观判断。对多应用长任务，作者设计了多检查点评分，并把检查点标注为 Research、App State、Content、File Ops、Sys Config 五类能力，用来观察智能体卡在哪一类子目标上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 类框架和 16 个模型。一个关键结果是，同一模型在有无框架支持时差异很大：Claude Opus 4.6 配合 OpenClaw 达到 73.7% Pass@1，而无框架支持时为 39.2%。作者进一步分析 OpenClaw 的预置技能影响：在技能覆盖的任务上收益明显；在没有技能覆盖的任务上，多数模型反而低于 baseline，说明主要收益来自技能命中，而不是通用规划能力自然提升。鲁棒性分析使用 Pass@1、Pass@4 和 Pass 4 指标，显示能力上限相近的智能体在一致性上差异明显。多检查点评分还揭示了二值成功率相同的模型，在子目标完成度和能力短板上可能不同。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对现有 CUA benchmark 的两点批评，再看 MacAgentBench 章节里的环境开放性、Docker-QEMU copy-on-write 设计和多检查点评分。实验部分重点看框架对比、技能覆盖消融，以及二值评分和检查点评分不一致的案例。若关注 agent 训练信号，可细看检查点定义和规则评测脚本设计；若只关心基座模型能力，可跳过较多 macOS 虚拟化工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in macOS computer-use agent evaluation: existing benchmarks often force agents into a screenshot-to-GUI-action loop and score tasks with binary success, which misses CLI usage, AppleScript, accessibility APIs, framework skills, and partial progress in long multi-application workflows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for evaluating general-purpose agent capabilities. A key value is the separation between model ability, framework scaffolding, and pre-built skills. This matters for researchers who use desktop tasks for agent data generation, long-horizon training, or unified GUI/CLI action modeling, because fine-grained checkpoints can provide denser and more interpretable supervision than pass/fail labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: MacAgentBench is built around an open-environment evaluation protocol. It does not prescribe the observation space, action space, or interaction loop; agents may use GUI control, command-line tools, scripting, accessibility APIs, or external harnesses. The environment runs macOS through a Docker-QEMU stack. A copy-on-write disk design lets instances share one base image and store only runtime changes, yielding about 30 seconds of startup time and roughly 1 GB of per-instance disk overhead. The benchmark contains 676 tasks across 25 applications, with nearly 60% requiring both GUI and CLI interaction. Evaluation is deterministic and rule-based. For multi-application tasks, the benchmark adds multi-checkpoint scoring with five capability annotations: Research, App State, Content, File Ops, and Sys Config.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate three frameworks and 16 models. The strongest reported configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 with OpenClaw, reaches 73.7% Pass@1, compared with 39.2% for the same model without framework support. The skill analysis is more informative than the headline number: OpenClaw performs much better when a task is covered by pre-defined skills, but often underperforms the baseline on tasks without skill coverage. This indicates that the gain is largely skill-driven. Robustness analysis with Pass@1, Pass@4, and Pass 4 shows that agents with similar ceilings can differ in consistency. Multi-checkpoint scoring further shows that models with similar binary success rates may complete different subsets of subgoals.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 20–30 minutes is enough. Read the introduction for the critique of GUI-only and binary evaluation, then inspect the benchmark design section for the open interaction protocol, Docker-QEMU copy-on-write setup, and checkpoint scoring. In the experiments, focus on the framework comparison, the skill-coverage ablation, and examples where binary scores hide differences in subgoal completion. Readers interested in agent training signals should spend more time on the checkpoint taxonomy and rule-based evaluators; readers focused on base-model capability can skip most virtualization details.

recommendation.zh: Agent eval 里框架贡献常被算到模型头上；建议看评分设计和 skill library 消融，别只看榜单分。
recommendation.en: Framework gains are easy to misattribute to the model; skim the scoring design and skill-library ablation rather than the leaderboard.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Counsel: A Meta-Evaluation Dataset for Agentic Tasks
paper.abstract: As agentic systems tackle increasingly complex multi-step tasks, evaluating their trajectories presents a major bottleneck - human annotation of a single trajectory on popular agentic benchmarks can take hours, making it difficult to scale evaluations for measuring performance or curating training data. This has driven widespread reliance on automated approaches such as LLM-as-a-judge (LLMJ) to critique agents at the process and outcome-levels at scale, however, the soundness of LLMJ critiques o

summary.core_problem: 当前Agent轨迹评估广泛依赖LLM-as-judge生成过程级批评，但缺乏公开的元评测数据集衡量这类批评本身的质量；现有元评估仅对比LLM judge最终打分与人类标注的一致性，无法判断错误定位是否准确、解释逻辑是否合理，限制了judge模型的迭代优化。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent评测领域的元评估数据空白，可直接用于评估LLM judge的过程批评质量、训练元judge过滤低质量反馈、作为监督信号优化judge模型，对大模型后训练阶段自动化反馈信号质量提升、Agent训练数据筛选工作有基础支撑作用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了首个面向Agent任务的公开元评测数据集Counsel，覆盖两类主流Agent场景：τ-bench的多轮客服交互、DA-Code的代码生成。数据采集分两步：首先使用开源LLM judge对开源Agent的执行轨迹逐step生成批评，标注错误位置与原因；再由人类标注员对LLM生成的批评做元标注，分别标记错误定位是否准确、解释是否合理。数据集支持三类核心用途：评估judge的批评质量、训练元judge筛选高价值批评、直接监督优化judge模型。
summary.experiments: 人类标注员间一致性达到Krippendorff’s alpha 0.78，标注质量可靠。跨模型测试显示，judge基础能力越强、推理投入越高，与人类元标注的一致性越高；当前表现最好的开源judge错误定位准确率达88%，但解释合理性准确率仅为65%，说明现有judge的批评推理质量仍有明显提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议用10分钟读完核心内容，重点关注数据集构建流程、标注维度设计，以及现有judge模型的表现统计；从事Agent评测或LLM-as-judge优化方向的读者可额外关注数据集的字段设计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Widespread adoption of LLM-as-judge for process-level evaluation of agent trajectories lacks public meta-evaluation resources to measure the quality of LLM-generated critiques; existing meta-evaluation efforts only compare final score agreement with human labels, without assessing error localization accuracy or explanation soundness, creating a bottleneck for judge model improvement.
summary_en.importance: Counsel fills a core gap in agent evaluation infrastructure, enabling direct measurement, optimization, and filtering of LLM judge outputs. It provides a foundation for improving automated feedback signal quality in post-training and curating high-quality agent training data at scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: Counsel is the first public meta-evaluation dataset for agent tasks, covering two common agent domains: multi-turn customer support interactions from τ-bench, and code generation tasks from DA-Code. Data is collected in two stages: open-weight LLM judges first generate step-level critiques (error location + supporting explanation) for trajectories produced by open-weight agents; human annotators then provide meta-labels for each critique, marking whether errors are correctly localized and whether explanations are logically sound. The dataset supports three core use cases: evaluating judge critique quality, training meta-judges to filter low-quality outputs, and providing direct supervision for judge model optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Human annotators achieve high inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.78), confirming annotation reliability. Cross-model evaluation shows stronger base model capability and higher reasoning effort correlate with higher human agreement; the top-performing open-weight judge reaches 88% agreement on error localization, but only 65% agreement on explanation correctness, indicating substantial remaining room for improvement in critique reasoning quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~10 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction pipeline, annotation dimension design, and aggregate performance statistics of existing judge models. Readers working on agent evaluation or LLM-as-judge optimization can review the dataset schema for field design details.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据定义和标注一致性即可；它提醒训练 agent critic 前先量 judge 噪声，不然 RL/SFT 信号会很脏。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset schema and agreement analysis; the useful lesson is to measure judge noise before using agent critiques as SFT or RL signals.

paper.title: AgentMeter: Evaluating Model-CLI Matching for CLI-Based Local Task-Solving Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly solve local tasks through command-line and CLI-based harness interfaces, including code editing, repository inspection, data analysis, and file workflows. Existing evaluations often emphasize task success, but deployed local agents are not models alone: the CLI mediates prompts, context replay, tool outputs, file access, terminal observations, and stopping behavior. As a result, the same model can produce different success, token, and cost profiles under different CLIs. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题不是“哪个 agent 模型更强”，而是更贴近部署现实的“哪个 model–CLI 组合更合适”。在本地任务求解场景里，CLI 不是中性的外壳，它会改变 prompt 组织、上下文回放、工具输出序列化、文件访问方式、终止条件和重试行为，因此同一个模型接到不同 CLI 后，成功率、token 消耗和账单成本都可能明显变化。现有 benchmark 多半把评估对象默认成模型本身，主要看 pass rate，难以回答部署时真正关心的匹配问题：在不同任务难度下，哪个组合既能做成事，又不会因为低效轨迹和昂贵失败把成本拉高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的方法论文；但对 post-train、agent system 和模型能力外化方式的理解有现实意义。它提醒人们：模型能力不是脱离执行壳层独立存在的，接口设计会改变模型可见证据、上下文利用方式和停止策略，从而改变最终表现。对做预训练的人，这个结论有两个启发。第一，很多“模型能力差异”里混入了系统层差异，尤其是长上下文利用、工具输出压缩、重复读取控制等。第二，如果未来要把 pretrain 与 agent deployment 更紧地接起来，评估单位需要从裸模型转向模型与执行环境的联合体。贡献量级偏评测与方法论，不是范式级进展，但问题定义是清楚的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两部分。第一部分是 benchmark 设计。作者构建了 AgentMeter，包含 Benchmark90 和 Core30。Benchmark90 是完整 90 题验证集，覆盖 code editing、repo inspection、shell、data processing、document manipulation 等本地工作流任务，来源于 SkillsBench、Terminal-Bench 和 DA-Code，并被重新校准为 Easy/Medium/Hard 各 30 题。Core30 是从 Benchmark90 中抽出的低成本子集，用来在更多 model–CLI 组合上做横向比较，包含 30 题、6 个模型家族和 4 个 CLI 家族形成的 24 个完整配置。这里的关键不是简单拼盘，而是把“任务来源标签”和“任务 effort tier”分开：tier 不是按数据源继承，而是先做难度校准，再用于后续 cost-aware 评分。

第二部分是评分指标 AMS。它不是单纯的 success rate，也不是 token/pass 或 USD/pass 这种只看成功样本的效率指标。作者强调三件事要同时计入：任务质量、预算约束下的质量、以及昂贵失败的惩罚；并且这些量要在不同 effort tier 上分别校准。这样做的原因很直接：Easy 任务上，很多组合都能过，区分度主要来自效率；Medium 任务上，成功与成本的折中最重要；Hard 任务上，除了成功本身，还要惩罚那种长时间无效探索后失败的配置。AMS 试图把这三种部署偏好合并成一个 success-anchored、cost-aware、tier-calibrated 的匹配分数。全文给出的直觉是，pass count、token/pass、USD/pass 和 AMS 会给出不同排序，而 AMS 更接近真实部署选择。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作没有去设计新的 agent policy 或上下文压缩算法，而是把注意力放在“评估单位定义错误”这个更基础的问题上。它与常见 agent benchmark 的区别，不在任务更难，而在把 CLI mediation 明确纳入被评估对象。
summary.experiments:
实验主体是比较不同模型与不同 CLI 的组合表现，并验证排序是否稳定。文中给出的两个代表性案例很能说明问题：在 grid-dispatch-operator 上，Qwen3.6++ 配 qwen-coder 可以通过，消耗 369K tokens；同一模型配 Claude Code 则失败，且消耗 4.78M tokens，并出现 30 次重复文件读取。这里不是小幅效率差，而是轨迹行为已经被 CLI 明显改变。另一个例子是 sqlite-query-optimizer：Qwen3.6++ 分别配 Codex 和 Claude Code 都能通过，但后者 token 用量是前者的 5.1 倍，说明只看 pass/fail 会掩盖部署成本差异。

基准规模方面，Benchmark90 为 90 题，Easy/Medium/Hard 各 30；Core30 为 30 题，包含 10/10/10 的 tier 分布。Core30 主实验覆盖 24 个完整 model–CLI 配置，由 6 个模型家族和 4 个 CLI 家族组成。作者还用 Benchmark90 对重叠配置做验证，检查在更大样本上排序结构是否保持稳定。全文的核心实验结论不是某个模型或某个 CLI 绝对领先，而是“换 CLI 会改变排名”，并且不同指标会选出不同最优组合：成功数最多的配置，不一定是 token/pass 最低的；最便宜的成功配置，也不一定在考虑昂贵失败后仍是最佳匹配。对这篇论文，最重要的实验信号是排序分歧本身，而不是单点分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，把问题设定吃透：评估对象为什么必须是 model–CLI pairing，而不是模型。然后看 Benchmark Design，重点看任务来源、tier 校准逻辑，以及 Benchmark90 与 Core30 的分工。接着看 AMS 定义，理解它为什么要把 success、cost-budgeted quality 和 expensive-failure penalty 放在一起，以及为什么要按 Easy/Medium/Hard 分层。实验部分不用逐表细抠，优先看能体现“同模不同 CLI 差异”的案例、不同指标导致不同排序的主表，以及 Benchmark90 对 Core30 排序稳定性的验证。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果关心 agent eval 设计，再回头细看 metric 公式和 tier calibration 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a deployment-facing question that most agent benchmarks sidestep: not “which model is best,” but “which model–CLI pairing is best for local task-solving.” In CLI-mediated agents, the CLI is not a neutral wrapper. It changes prompt formatting, context replay, tool-output serialization, file access, terminal observations, retry patterns, and stopping behavior. Because of that, the same model can exhibit very different success rates, token footprints, and billable costs under different CLIs. Existing evaluations usually treat the model as the unit of analysis and focus on task success, which misses the practical matching problem operators actually face.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, and its direct relevance to foundation-model training is limited. Still, it is useful for anyone thinking about the interface between model capability, tool use, and deployment. The main lesson is that a nontrivial part of observed “model performance” is mediated by the execution shell. That matters for interpreting long-context behavior, repeated evidence gathering, tool-output handling, and stopping policies. For pretraining researchers, the paper is a reminder that some capability differences attributed to the base model may in fact come from the surrounding interface. Its contribution is mainly evaluative and methodological rather than algorithmic.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main components. First, it introduces the AgentMeter benchmark. Benchmark90 is the full 90-task validation set spanning realistic local workflows: code editing, repository inspection, shell usage, data processing, and document manipulation. Tasks are drawn from SkillsBench, Terminal-Bench, and DA-Code, then calibrated into 30 Easy, 30 Medium, and 30 Hard tasks. Core30 is a lower-cost subset used to compare more model–CLI configurations at scale. In the main setup, Core30 covers 24 complete configurations formed by 6 model families and 4 CLI families. A key design choice is to separate source provenance from effort tiers: difficulty tiers are calibrated independently rather than inherited from the original benchmark source.

Second, the paper proposes AgentMeter Score (AMS), a success-anchored, cost-aware, tier-calibrated metric. AMS is designed to combine three deployment-relevant signals: task quality, quality under cost budgets, and penalties for expensive failures. The tier structure matters because the desirable behavior changes with task effort. On Easy tasks, many configurations succeed, so efficiency becomes the main discriminator. On Medium tasks, the success–cost tradeoff dominates. On Hard tasks, avoiding long, expensive failed trajectories is part of what makes a pairing usable. AMS is meant to reflect this changing preference structure better than raw pass count, token/pass, or USD/pass alone.

The paper’s main methodological move is not a new agent algorithm but a redefinition of the evaluation unit. Instead of benchmarking a model in isolation, it benchmarks the deployed model-plus-CLI system.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental message is that changing only the CLI can materially change both outcomes and rankings. Two examples in the paper make this concrete. On grid-dispatch-operator, Qwen3.6++ paired with qwen-coder passes using 369K tokens, while the same model paired with Claude Code fails after 4.78M tokens and 30 repeated file reads. This is not a small efficiency gap; it shows that the trajectory itself is being reshaped by the CLI. On sqlite-query-optimizer, Qwen3.6++ passes with both Codex and Claude Code, but Claude Code uses 5.1× more tokens, showing why pass/fail alone is insufficient.

In terms of scale, Benchmark90 contains 90 tasks with balanced Easy/Medium/Hard tiers, while Core30 contains 30 tasks with a 10/10/10 tier split. The main Core30 comparison evaluates 24 complete model–CLI configurations from a 6-by-4 grid. The authors then validate overlapping configurations on Benchmark90 to test whether the ranking structure persists on the larger set. The key empirical result is not that one model or one CLI universally wins, but that different metrics select different pairings: the highest pass-count configuration need not minimize token/pass or USD/pass, and the cheapest successful configuration need not remain the best once expensive failures are accounted for.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and make sure the problem framing is clear: why the deployed unit should be the model–CLI pair rather than the model alone. Then read the benchmark design section, focusing on task composition, effort-tier calibration, and the distinct roles of Benchmark90 and Core30. After that, read the AMS definition carefully enough to understand why it combines success, cost-budgeted quality, and expensive-failure penalties, and why these are tier-dependent. In the experiments, prioritize the case studies showing large same-model/different-CLI divergences, the main ranking tables where different metrics disagree, and the Benchmark90 validation of ranking stability. A first pass should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 定义和 24 配置表即可；它提醒 agent 分数常是模型×CLI 的交互项，不是模型常数。
recommendation.en: Read the metric definition and the 24-configuration table; it usefully treats agent scores as model-CLI interactions, not model constants.

paper.title: Skill Coverage: A Test Adequacy Metric for Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Agent skills encode reusable procedural knowledge that guides large language model agents across tasks and execution contexts. Existing evaluations primarily assess skills through task level outcomes, yet task success alone does not reveal which parts of a skill have been exercised or which remain untested. We introduce skill coverage, a test adequacy metric that treats the skill artifact as the object under test. Our approach extracts observable skill behavior constraints from skill documents a

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测仅通过任务级成功率评估可复用技能的效果，但无法揭示技能文档中编码的哪些行为约束被实际执行、哪些未被测试，导致技能复用、适配和优化决策缺乏可审计的依据。
summary.importance: 提出了将可复用技能本身作为测试对象的artifact级评测视角，补充了任务级成功率之外的互补信号；从自然语言文本中抽取可审计行为约束的思路，可迁移到预训练合成数据校验、指令数据约束验证等场景。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从自然语言技能文档中抽取源锚定的技能行为约束（SBC），用EARS受控自然语言将异构的技能文本规范化为有限的可审计约束集合，过滤背景描述和偶发实现细节；其次基于Oracle覆盖思想，定义只有当Agent轨迹提供足够可观测证据证明相关场景被实例化、且约束行为可被判定时，才视为该约束被覆盖，采用二值（覆盖/未覆盖）判断规则，不额外打分。
summary.experiments: 在350条约束-轨迹对上验证LLM判定与人工标注的一致性，达成93.71%的一致率，Cohen's κ=0.874；在SkillsBench的78个源任务、7种Agent-模型配置、每种配置3条轨迹上测试，现有执行平均仅覆盖39.90%-43.98%的抽取到的技能行为约束，证明任务成功与技能的充分测试是相互独立的两类信号。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第3节问题形式化部分（理解SBC的定义和约束抽取规则，约10分钟），第4节覆盖判定协议，第5节的SkillsBench覆盖率统计结果；全文泛读总时长约25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent evaluations assess reusable skills only through task-level success rates, which cannot reveal which behavioral constraints encoded in skill documents are actually exercised during execution and which remain untested, leaving no auditable basis for skill reuse, adaptation and improvement decisions.
summary_en.importance: It introduces an artifact-level test adequacy perspective that treats reusable skills as the test object, providing a complementary signal beyond task-level outcomes. The framework of extracting auditable behavioral constraints from natural language documents can be transferred to scenarios like pre-training synthetic data validation and instruction constraint verification.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, extract source-grounded Skill Behavior Constraints (SBCs) from natural-language skill documents, normalizing heterogeneous skill prose into a finite set of auditable constraints via EARS-style controlled natural language while filtering out background text and incidental implementation details. Then adapt oracle-based coverage rules: a constraint is marked as covered only when the agent trajectory provides sufficient observable evidence to prove the relevant scenario is instantiated and the constrained behavior is judgeable, using a binary cover/not-cover judgment without additional scoring.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the LLM-based coverage attribution protocol against human labels on 350 constraint-trajectory pairs, achieving 93.71% agreement and Cohen's κ = 0.874. Applied the protocol to 78 SkillsBench tasks across 7 agent-model configurations with 3 traces per configuration; existing executions cover only 39.90–43.98% of extracted SBCs on average, confirming that task success and adequate skill testing are independent signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 3 (problem formulation and SBC definition, ~10 min), Section 4 (coverage judgment protocol), and Section 5 (SkillsBench coverage statistics). Full skimming takes around 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 技能覆盖度补全了任务成功率的盲区，读§3的约束提取方法和§4的覆盖度统计即可，可用于后训练技能对齐评测
recommendation.en: Skill coverage fills the blind spot of task success rate; read §3 for constraint extraction and §4 for coverage statistics, useful for post-training skill alignment evaluation

paper.title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Predictive Validity for the Evaluation of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks are growing fast, but no single benchmark touches more than four or five of the dimensions that deployment exposes. This paper aggregates the largest coordinated deep-dive of one MCP-based industrial-agent benchmark to date: fourteen parallel implementation studies covering new asset classes (including a multi-modal visual extension), alternative orchestrations, retrieval strategies, reasoning modes, infrastructure optimizations, and evaluation-methodology probes. Consolidating

summary.core_problem: Agent 评测仍在沿用“单一 aggregate 分数排行榜”的范式，但真实部署暴露的维度远多于榜单覆盖，导致排名不稳定、不可迁移。论文要解决的是：用什么标准判断一个 agent benchmark/leaderboard 的排名是否对部署决策有用；以及如何把“可预测性（in-sample 排名能否预测 out-of-sample 排名）”作为核心评测目标落地。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接作用有限（更偏 eval 方法论与 agent 工程），但它点中了一个会反噬训练的关键问题：如果评测信号本身缺乏 predictive validity，那么基于该评测做的模型选择、数据合成、RL/偏好优化都会被错误目标牵引。对做 RL pretrain、持续学习、或 agentic 数据回流的人来说，这篇文章提供了一个更接近“训练目标应对齐什么”的评测视角：不要只追 in-domain 均值分数，要追跨设置的排名稳定性。
summary.technical_approach:
这是一篇 position/synthesis paper，不做新的受控实验，主要贡献在评测框架与可证伪标准。
- 证据来源：汇总 14 个围绕同一 MCP-based 工业 agent benchmark 的并行实现研究（每个研究沿单一轴做端到端改动：编排、检索、推理模式、基础设施优化、评测方法探针、以及多模态视觉扩展等），再结合 7 个既有 agent benchmark。
- 核心概念：predictive validity——用“in-sample 排名与 out-of-sample 排名的相关性”来评价 leaderboard 是否对部署有预测力，而不是只看 in-sample aggregate score。
- 测量装置：提出一个 12-tier 的 measurement apparatus，把 agent 评测拆成多层维度（例如编排、artifact 复用、tool-call hygiene、judge-independent verification 等），强调这些维度在 aggregate 分数里被折叠掉。
- 三类可证伪的 predictive-validity 测试：held-out、cross-subset、adversarial（文中给出判定条件与 falsification threshold 的思路）。
- 论证结构：指出 aggregate-score leaderboards 的三类结构性问题：transferability assumption（默认可迁移）、judge reflexivity（评测器/裁判与被评测系统相互作用）、以及 evaluation circularity（评测定义了能力本身）。
summary.experiments: 不包含新的统一实验；但引用了竞赛回顾作为动机证据：在一个 149 队的 agentic competition 中，public leaderboard 与 hidden evaluation 的 Spearman 相关在 execution track 上为 ρ=-0.13（n=13，统计上接近 0），planning track 为 ρ=0.69（n=20，且其 95% 上界落在作者提出的“可证伪阈值”附近）。论文还用 14 个并行实现研究的观察来说明：同一 benchmark 在不同架构/系统选择下会暴露不同失败模式，单一 aggregate 分数无法区分“高推理高成本 vs 高检索高延迟 vs tool hygiene 脆弱但 artifact 复用强”等配置差异。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 先看 Introduction 的竞赛相关性例子与“predictive validity”定义，明确它想替换的 ranking 目标是什么。
2) 直接看 12-tier measurement apparatus 的图/表（通常是 Figure 1 或对应章节）：理解它把 agent 评测拆成哪些层，哪些是现有榜单缺失的。
3) 看 Section 4.3（文中提到的 falsification conditions）：这是全文最“可操作”的部分，决定它是不是可落地的方法论。
4) 快速扫“14 个并行实现研究”总结段：重点不是每个系统细节，而是它们各自揭示的 failure mode 如何落到 apparatus 的不同 tier。
5) 如果你做训练闭环：把它的 predictive-validity 测试当作“训练/对齐迭代的离线门槛”，思考如何在数据合成与 RL 迭代中引入 held-out/cross-subset 的 rank check。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent evaluation is still dominated by single aggregate-score leaderboards, but deployed agents vary along many axes that leaderboards collapse, leading to rank instability and poor transfer. The paper asks what ranking criterion better matches deployment decisions, and proposes using predictive validity—how well in-sample rankings predict out-of-sample rankings—as the central objective for agent benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: Only indirectly tied to pretraining, but it matters for any training loop that uses benchmark scores as optimization targets (model selection, synthetic data generation, RL-style alignment, continual pretraining with agent traces). If a leaderboard has low predictive validity, optimizing against it can systematically push training toward brittle, non-transferable behaviors. The paper reframes “what to optimize” from in-domain mean score to cross-setting rank stability.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A position/synthesis paper rather than a new controlled experimental study.
- Evidence base: consolidates fourteen parallel implementation studies around a single MCP-based industrial agent benchmark (each varying one major axis end-to-end: orchestration, retrieval, reasoning mode, infra optimizations, evaluation probes, plus a multimodal visual extension), and synthesizes them with seven prior agent benchmarks.
- Key construct: predictive validity, operationalized as correlation between in-sample and out-of-sample ranks.
- Measurement framework: a 12-tier “measurement apparatus” to expose dimensions that aggregate scores hide (e.g., orchestration choices, multi-turn artifact reuse, tool-call hygiene, judge-independent verification).
- Proposed tests: three predictive-validity criteria—held-out, cross-subset, adversarial—paired with explicit falsification conditions / thresholds.
- Critique: identifies structural issues with aggregate leaderboards (transferability assumption, judge reflexivity, and evaluation circularity).
summary_en.experiments: No new experiments; the paper relies on synthesis and cited evidence. A key motivating datapoint is a 149-team agent competition retrospective: Spearman correlation between public-leaderboard ranks and hidden-eval ranks was ρ = -0.13 on the execution track (n=13, effectively no correlation) and ρ = 0.69 on the planning track (n=20), with the planning track’s upper 95% confidence bound near the authors’ proposed falsification threshold. The fourteen implementation studies are used to argue that the same benchmark surfaces different failure modes under different architectural/system choices, and that identical aggregate scores can correspond to qualitatively different deployment tradeoffs (reasoning-heavy/costly vs retrieval-heavy/latency-bound vs tool-hygiene-fragile but artifact-reuse-efficient).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the Introduction for the competition evidence and the definition of predictive validity.
2) Go straight to the 12-tier apparatus figure/table to see what dimensions they claim are missing from current leaderboards.
3) Read the falsification conditions section (they reference Section 4.3): this is the most actionable part.
4) Skim the synthesis of the fourteen parallel studies for the failure modes, not the system details.
5) If you run training loops: treat their held-out/cross-subset rank checks as a candidate offline gate for RL/data-synthesis iterations.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 agent 方法，但会改你看榜单的方式；只看 predictive validity 定义和 rank instability 证据，足够判断哪些 benchmark 不该再当主指标。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your agent architecture, but it should change how you trust leaderboards; read the predictive-validity definition and the rank-instability evidence, then revisit which benchmarks you optimize for.

paper.title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Bias Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
paper.abstract: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their systematic evaluation biases propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator biases spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator bias profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-based), we measure the Cross-Agent Contagion Matrix Gamma_3 and find that evaluator biases consistent

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多 Agent 系统中充当 evaluator 时，自身评价偏差会如何沿 Agent 交互网络传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评估可靠性分析与形式化建模。它把“LLM-as-judge 的偏差”从单点误差扩展到网络传播问题，对多 Agent 评审、辩论、委员会式决策有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contagion Networks，用跨 Agent 传染矩阵 Gamma_3 度量评价偏差传播强度，并用谱半径 rho(Gamma_N) 划分传播、临界、抑制三类 regime。方法偏分析框架，不是新的 Agent 训练或推理架构。
summary.experiments: 在受控 3-Agent 设置中使用 DeepSeek-chat，构造 structured、balanced、evidence-based 三类 evaluator bias profile。测得同模型 Agent 间 contagion coefficient 为 0.157 到 0.352；相比 prior work MM-EPC 中跨模型约 0.85 到 1.3 的系数弱 3-5 倍。将 evaluator committee size 从 k=1 增至 k=3 后，有效传染下降 72.4%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how systematic LLM evaluator biases propagate through interacting agents in multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an analysis framework for evaluator reliability in agent networks. It moves LLM-as-judge bias from a single-node issue to a network-level propagation problem, which is relevant for debate, committee evaluation, and multi-agent review pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Contagion Networks and a cross-agent contagion matrix Gamma_3 to quantify bias transfer.
