The spectral radius rho(Gamma_N) is used to define propagation regimes. The work is primarily a diagnostic and formalization effort rather than a new agent training method.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled experiment uses three DeepSeek-chat agents with structured, balanced, and evidence-based evaluator bias profiles. Same-model agents show contagion coefficients between 0.157 and 0.352, about 3-5x weaker than the cross-model coefficients around 0.85-1.3 reported in MM-EPC. Increasing the evaluator committee from k=1 to k=3 reduces effective contagion by 72.4%.

recommendation.zh: 可看 abstract 和实验表；小规模 setup 偏窄，但“同模型偏差传播弱于跨模型”这个信号值得记下。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and experiment table only; the setup is small, but the weaker same-model contagion signal is worth remembering.

paper.title: Benchmarking Agentic Review Systems
paper.abstract: A new class of agentic review systems are emerging as a remedy to the pressure placed on peer review systems by AI-assisted research, but it is unclear how they should be evaluated. We evaluate two open-source systems (OpenAIReview and coarse), one proprietary system (Reviewer3), and a zero-shot baseline, across six LLMs spanning frontier and efficient models. First, we study whether AI reviews on ICLR/NeurIPS papers track with papers' quality as approximated by external signals such as citation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个此前几乎没有被认真定义的问题：agentic review system 应该如何被系统性评测。难点不在于让模型给出一段审稿意见，而在于判断一个“审稿系统”是否真的具备审稿能力。这里的对象是完整系统，不是单次 prompt 的裸模型输出。系统里包含长文切分、上下文管理、多轮检查、评论聚合、引用定位等机制，因此不能只看通用 benchmark 或单条样例。作者把问题拆成三层：第一，系统能否对真实论文质量给出有区分度的信号；第二，系统能否在有明确 ground truth 的条件下发现具体错误；第三，真实用户在开放使用中是否觉得这些评论有帮助，以及主要失败模式是什么。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在“审稿”这个应用本身，而在于它提供了一套评测 agentic long-context system 的方法学。很多系统论文都声称多代理、分段审阅、结构化提示能提升复杂任务表现，但缺少把“系统设计”与“底层模型能力”分开的评测框架。这里给出的两类评测——质量代理信号相关性和可控扰动召回——对长文理解、错误定位、跨段推理、系统级 recall/precision 权衡都有参考价值。对做 pretrain 和 post-train 的人，这篇文章还给出一个很具体的观察：更强模型确实提升系统表现，但系统设计本身也能显著改变错误类型覆盖面，尤其是在长上下文、跨段 prose-level reasoning error 上。这说明很多复杂任务的上限不只由 base model 决定，也受 inference-time decomposition 和 context routing 影响。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，文章的核心不是提出一个新 reviewer，而是构建一套分层 benchmark，并用它比较 OpenAIReview、‘coarse、Reviewer3、以及 zero-shot baseline 在多种后端模型上的表现。OpenAIReview 的系统设计值得看，因为它代表了一类典型的 agentic long-document pipeline：先把整篇论文切成长度相近的 passages，再对每个 passage 做局部审阅，同时维护运行中的摘要或全局上下文，使后续 passage 的判断不完全局限于局部窗口；最后把评论与原文引用绑定并聚合成结构化 review。作者强调，这种 running summarization 对跨段的论证错误、错误 claim、实验设计问题更有帮助，因为这些问题往往不是一个局部 token span 能决定的。

评测设计分三块。第一块是真实论文质量代理评测。作者收集 ICLR/NeurIPS 论文，用 citations、accept/reject、reviewer scores 以及三者组合形成 paper quality proxy。然后在随机采样的低质量/高质量论文对上，比较系统是否给低质量论文提出更多评论，用 pairwise accuracy 衡量。这个设定并不要求系统显式输出分数，而是把“评论密度”当作弱质量信号。第二块是扰动 benchmark。作者从原本较好的论文出发，人工或半自动注入四类错误：局部数学编辑、错误 claim、faulty reasoning、实验设计或分析错误。这样就有了已知 ground truth 的 error spans / error types，可以直接测 recall。第三块是真实部署反馈。OpenAIReview 作为 web tool 对外开放，收集用户对评论的 like/dislike 和“已处理”反馈，用来观察 precision 问题是否会在真实使用中成为主要障碍。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。第一，评测对象是完整系统而不是裸 LLM。第二，既看开放世界的相关性信号，也看封闭世界的已知错误召回。第三，作者明确区分 recall 和 precision：系统在 benchmark 上可以抓到不少错误，但真实使用里用户最不满的是 false positive 和吹毛求疵，这个张力在 agentic system 里很常见。
summary.experiments:
结果里最重要的数字有几组。质量代理评测上，所有系统都高于随机水平，说明今天的 reviewer system 已经能从论文文本中提取一定质量信号。最强配置是 OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5，pairwise accuracy 达到 83.0%。整体区间大致在 66% 到 83% 之间，并且随底层模型能力增强而上升。这个趋势说明系统设计不是在“制造幻觉信号”，而是在放大模型已有但不稳定的审阅能力。

扰动 benchmark 上，最强配置同样是 OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5，能召回 71.6% 的注入错误。按错误类型看，OpenAIReview 相对 zero-shot baseline 的优势主要出现在 prose-level 错误，而不是局部数学 token 级错误。文中给出的代表性数字是 faulty reasoning 的召回从 36.8% 提升到 68.4%。这和它的分段审阅 + 运行摘要设计一致：如果错误依赖较长的论证链或跨段上下文，系统化审阅比单次通读 prompt 更占优；但如果只是一个局部公式符号被改错，系统优势就没那么大。

另一个很有信息量的结果是模型互补性。不同 backend 在 OpenAIReview 框架下会关注到不同段落、不同错误类型；把多个模型的评论并起来，综合 recall 可以到 83.3%，比单个 GPT-5.5 后端高 11.7 个点。这说明 reviewer task 的 error surface 不是单模型轻易覆盖的，ensemble 或 committee-style review 可能比继续堆单模型更有效。

真实部署部分，作者收集了 1,360 条 review，覆盖 1,100 篇论文。用户反馈总体偏正向，likes:dislikes 为 1.44:1，且不少评论被标记为已处理。负反馈分析显示，主要问题不是完全胡说，而是 precision 不够：误报、过度挑刺、价值较低的小问题占了大头。这一点和 benchmark 中偏重 recall 的设置形成互补，也提醒系统设计不能只追求“多抓错”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看引言和任务定义，确认作者到底在 benchmark 什么：不是“模型能不能像审稿人一样打分”，而是“系统能否稳定地产生有用、可定位、可操作的评论”。然后重点看两部分。

第一部分是质量代理评测的构造。要看清楚 pairwise accuracy 的定义、为什么用评论数量作为弱质量信号、以及 citations / acceptance / reviewer scores 这些 proxy 各自的偏差。这里值得思考的是：评论多不一定代表论文差，也可能代表系统更啰嗦，所以这个指标更适合做相对比较，不适合做绝对质量判断。

第二部分是 perturbation benchmark。这是全文最有方法价值的部分。重点看四类错误是如何注入的、ground truth 如何对齐、recall 如何计算、不同错误类型为什么难度不同。图 1 和相关主表最值得细读，因为它们把“系统设计提升了什么能力”讲得比较清楚。

如果时间有限，再看 OpenAIReview 的系统流程图，尤其是 passage-level review、running summary、comment aggregation 这几个模块。它们对应的是长文 agentic system 的常见设计模式。最后看部署反馈部分，理解 precision failure 的真实形态。这个部分对做 agent、judge、verifier、长文 QA 系统的人都很有参考价值。

值得深挖的点有三个：一是评论数作为质量 proxy 是否会偏向冗长系统；二是 recall/precision 如何联合优化，是否需要 verifier 或 comment dedup/filtering；三是多模型互补性来自能力差异还是随机性差异，这决定 ensemble 是否值得长期投入。
summary.authors_note: Chicago Human+AI Lab 相关工作，文中明确涉及 OpenAIReview 团队；其余作者与机构在给定内容里未完整列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a missing piece in the emerging literature on AI reviewing: how to evaluate an agentic review system as a system, rather than judging a raw LLM on a few review prompts. A reviewer pipeline includes document parsing, passage segmentation, context management, iterative checking, comment grounding, and aggregation. The central question is therefore not whether a model can write review-like text, but whether a full system can reliably detect quality signals and concrete errors in long scientific papers, and whether those comments remain useful in real deployment.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is methodological. The paper offers a clean evaluation template for long-context agentic systems where system design and model capability are entangled. The two main axes are especially useful: correlation with external quality proxies on real papers, and recall on a controlled perturbation benchmark with known ground truth. That combination is broadly relevant to judge systems, verifier systems, long-document reasoning pipelines, and any setup where decomposition and context routing matter. A practical takeaway is that stronger base models help, but system design changes what kinds of failures are recoverable, especially for discourse-level and cross-paragraph errors.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is primarily an evaluation framework, not a new review model. The authors benchmark two open systems, OpenAIReview and ‘coarse, one proprietary system, Reviewer3, and a zero-shot baseline across multiple backend LLMs. OpenAIReview is the most informative system to inspect because it represents a common agentic long-document pattern: split a paper into passages, review passages one at a time, maintain a running summary or global context, and aggregate grounded comments linked to quoted spans. That design is intended to preserve long-range coherence while keeping each local review step tractable.

The evaluation has three layers. First, a real-paper quality-proxy study on ICLR/NeurIPS papers. Since these systems do not necessarily output calibrated scores, the paper uses comment volume as a weak signal and asks whether lower-quality papers, as approximated by citations, acceptance decisions, reviewer scores, or a composite proxy, receive more comments than higher-quality papers in random pairwise comparisons. Second, a perturbation benchmark with explicit ground truth. Starting from otherwise good papers, the authors inject four categories of errors: local math edits, false claims, faulty reasoning, and experimental design or analysis errors, across eight arXiv subject areas. This allows direct measurement of error recall. Third, a public deployment study of OpenAIReview, collecting user feedback on real reviews to expose precision issues that offline recall benchmarks may miss.

Relative to prior work, three differences matter. It evaluates complete systems rather than naked models. It combines open-world proxy correlation with closed-world error detection. And it explicitly surfaces the recall-precision tension: systems can catch many issues offline while still frustrating users with false positives and low-value nitpicks.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result on the quality-proxy task is that every evaluated system performs above chance, suggesting that current reviewer systems do extract nontrivial quality signals from paper text. The best configuration, OpenAIReview with GPT-5.5, reaches 83.0% pairwise accuracy. Reported performance spans roughly 66% to 83% depending on system and backend model, with a clear trend that stronger models yield stronger quality discrimination.

On the perturbation benchmark, the strongest setup again is OpenAIReview + GPT-5.5, reaching 71.6% recall over injected errors. The gains over a zero-shot baseline are not uniform across error types. The largest improvements are on prose-level errors, especially faulty reasoning, where recall rises from 36.8% to 68.4%. Gains are smaller on local math-token edits. This pattern fits the system design: passage-wise review plus running summarization helps when the error depends on longer argumentative structure or cross-section consistency, but offers less advantage for highly local symbolic corruption.

A particularly useful finding is model complementarity. Different backend models, even under the same OpenAIReview scaffold, comment on different paragraphs and catch different subsets of errors. When combining outputs from all models, recall reaches 83.3%, which is 11.7 points above GPT-5.5 alone. That suggests reviewer-style error detection has broad coverage gaps and may benefit from committee-style aggregation rather than relying on a single stronger model.

The deployment study covers 1,360 reviews over 1,100 papers. User feedback is net positive, with likes outnumbering dislikes by 1.44 to 1, and many comments marked as addressed. The main failure mode is precision, not complete nonsense: users mostly complain about false positives and minor nitpicks. This is an important complement to the recall-heavy benchmark results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem framing and evaluation setup. The key is to understand that the target is not score prediction but actionable, grounded review comments produced by a full pipeline. Then focus on two sections.

First, read the quality-proxy evaluation carefully. Pay attention to how pairwise accuracy is defined, why comment count is used as a weak quality signal, and what biases enter through citations, acceptance decisions, and reviewer scores. This section is useful because it shows how to evaluate systems when direct labels are noisy or unavailable.

Second, spend most of the time on the perturbation benchmark. That is the most reusable methodological contribution. Look closely at how the four error types are injected, how ground truth is aligned, and how recall is computed. The main figure and the per-error-type tables are where the paper becomes most informative about what the system design is actually buying.

If time permits, inspect the OpenAIReview pipeline diagram: passage-level review, running summarization, and comment aggregation. Those modules map directly to common design choices in long-context agentic systems. End with the deployment analysis to see how offline recall translates imperfectly into user-perceived utility.

The most interesting follow-up questions are whether comment count is too entangled with verbosity, how to jointly optimize recall and precision, and whether the observed multi-model complementarity reflects true capability diversity or merely stochastic variation.
summary_en.authors_note: Associated with the Chicago Human+AI Lab through OpenAIReview; full author list and affiliations are not fully recoverable from the provided content.

paper.title: GateMem: Benchmarking Memory Governance in Multi-Principal Shared-Memory Agents
paper.abstract: Memory benchmarks for LLM agents largely assume single-user settings, leaving shared assistants for hospitals, workplaces, campuses, and households understudied. In these deployments, multiple principals write to a common memory pool and query it under different roles, scopes, and relationships, so memory quality requires governance as well as recall. We introduce GateMem, a benchmark for multi-principal shared-memory agents. GateMem jointly evaluates utility for legitimate long-horizon requests

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是共享记忆 agent 的治理评测，而不是预训练或建模方法本身。它要解决的问题可以概括为：现有 memory benchmark 大多默认单用户私有记忆，只考 recall 和 utility，但真实部署里常见的是多主体共享记忆，系统不仅要记得住，还要按角色、关系和删除请求正确地“该答则答、该拒则拒、该忘则忘”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响较弱，主要价值在评测侧。它提醒人们，长时记忆能力不能只看召回率，memory system 的质量还包含访问控制和接口层遗忘。这个视角对 post-train agent 系统更相关，对 pretrain 的启发主要是：如果未来把长期记忆、外部记忆或 episodic memory 更深地并入模型训练，训练目标和数据构造也许需要显式编码授权边界与删除行为，而不是只优化“记住更多”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上不是提出新 agent 架构，而是构建 benchmark。GATEMEM 把 shared-memory evaluation 定义成三个联合维度：Utility、Access Control、Active Forgetting。数据覆盖 medical、office、education、household 四类场景，包含 91 个长篇多方交互 episode 和 2,218 个隐藏 checkpoint。评测时，模型拿到完整交互历史、当前请求者身份和相关 policy context，但看不到 query 标签、评分规则和受保护目标。任务设计里不仅有直接问答，还包含间接推断、委托请求、社工式恢复等更接近真实泄露路径的 probe。作者强调他们测的是 interface-level forgetting，也就是删除请求后代理在行为上不能再恢复、确认或侧面重建该信息，而不是参数级 machine unlearning。
summary.experiments: 关键结论是三者之间存在明显张力：utility、access control、active forgetting 很难同时做好。不同 baseline 和 backbone 上都没有出现一个在三项上都稳定强的方案。长上下文直接提示通常给出最好的整体折中，但 token 成本高；retrieval-based 和 external-memory 方法在成本上更省一些，但仍然频繁出现越权披露和删除后恢复失败。摘要和引言里给出的核心规模信息是 91 个 episodes、2,218 个 hidden checkpoints；从全文可见，作者更关心 failure mode 的系统性暴露，而不是单一平均分数。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，明确它与 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 一类 benchmark 的区别：不是测单主体 recall，而是测共享记忆治理。然后看 benchmark construction 和 evaluation protocol，重点理解三类指标如何定义、隐藏 checkpoint 如何布置、删除 probe 与 access boundary 如何设计。实验部分不必逐个 baseline 细看，抓住“长上下文最稳但贵，检索/外存更省但治理失败更多”这个结论即可。预计 20–30 分钟足够完成有效阅读。
summary.authors_note: 吉林大学等；文中可见通讯邮箱为 yibo.yang93@gmail.com、guodandan@jlu.edu.cn，完整作者背景在给定内容中未完全展开。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is about evaluation for shared-memory agents rather than a pretraining method. The core problem is that most memory benchmarks assume a single-user private setting and mainly reward recall and utility, while real deployments often involve multiple principals writing into and querying a shared memory pool. In that regime, a system must not only remember useful facts, but also enforce contextual access boundaries and honor deletion requests.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The main contribution is on the evaluation side. What it adds is a clearer notion that memory quality is not equivalent to recall quality. For agent systems, memory must be governed. The pretraining-facing takeaway is indirect: if long-term memory, external memory, or episodic memory become more tightly integrated into training, the supervision signal may need to encode authorization and forgetting behavior, not just retention and retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a benchmark rather than a new agent architecture. GATEMEM defines shared-memory evaluation along three coupled dimensions: Utility, Access Control, and Active Forgetting. It spans four domains—medical, office, education, and household—and contains 91 long-form multi-party episodes with 2,218 hidden checkpoints. During evaluation, the model receives the interaction history, the current requester identity, and the relevant policy context, but not the query label, grading rubric, or protected target. The probes go beyond direct retrieval and include indirect inference, delegated requests, and social-engineering-style recovery attempts. The forgetting notion is explicitly interface-level: after a deletion request, the agent should no longer recover, confirm, or reconstruct the deleted information behaviorally, without claiming certified physical erasure or full machine unlearning.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is a persistent trade-off among utility, access control, and active forgetting. Across baselines and backbone models, no method performs strongly on all three dimensions at once. Long-context prompting often gives the best overall governance trade-off, but at high token cost. Retrieval-based and external-memory approaches can reduce cost, yet they still show frequent failures in unauthorized disclosure and post-deletion recovery. The paper’s emphasis is less on a single headline score and more on exposing systematic failure modes in shared institutional settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and Table 1 to see how it differs from prior memory benchmarks such as LoCoMo and LongMemEval: the shift is from single-principal recall to multi-principal memory governance. Then read the benchmark construction and evaluation protocol, focusing on how the three dimensions are operationalized, how hidden checkpoints are inserted, and how deletion and access-boundary probes are designed. In the experiments, it is enough to retain the main pattern: long-context prompting is the strongest but expensive baseline, while retrieval and external memory are cheaper but less reliable on governance. A useful read should take about 20 to 30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Jilin University and collaborators; the provided text shows corresponding emails yibo.yang93@gmail.com and guodandan@jlu.edu.cn, but the full author background is not fully visible in the supplied content.

recommendation.zh: 填补多主体共享内存Agent评测空白，重点看§4任务设计与长上下文模型的权限失效模式，对预训练记忆能力设计有参考价值
recommendation.en: Fills the gap in multi-principal shared-memory agent evaluation; focus on §4 task design and long-context model access control failure modes, useful for pretraining memory capability design

paper.title: TRAP: Benchmark for Task-completion and Resistance to Active Privacy-extraction
paper.abstract: Agents are increasingly deployed in document-intensive workflows where sensitive private information is not an edge case but a routine input, e.g., an agent booking a flight needs passport numbers. In such settings, the agent must use private information to complete tasks accurately while never exposing it in its responses, because it cannot verify who is actually at the keyboard. These two obligations are in fundamental tension. A model capable enough to use private information for task complet

summary.core_problem: 评测 Agent 在必须使用隐私信息完成任务时，能否同时抵抗用户主动诱导泄露同一隐私信息。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 安全与隐私方向的 benchmark。它把任务完成率和隐私泄露率放在同一场景中测量，适合观察工具调用能力与隐私约束之间的张力。
summary.technical_approach: TRAP 的每个场景包含一份带隐私字段的文档、一个需要用隐私字段调用正确工具的任务查询，以及一个试图用自然语言诱导模型泄露同一信息的攻击查询；评测目标不是单独测拒答，而是同时测 task completion 和 active privacy-extraction resistance。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 22 个模型，覆盖前沿闭源模型和开源模型；摘要未给出完整排行榜和具体数值，但设计上能比较不同模型在任务成功率与隐私泄露率之间的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether agents can use private information to complete tool-mediated tasks while resisting active attempts to extract the same private information.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent safety and privacy benchmark. It measures task completion and privacy leakage in the same scenario, making the capability-safety trade-off explicit rather than testing refusal behavior in isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each TRAP scenario contains a document with private fields, a task query that requires invoking the right tool using those fields, and an attack query that tries to elicit the same private information in natural language. The benchmark jointly measures task accuracy and resistance to active privacy extraction.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 22 models spanning frontier proprietary and open models. The abstract does not include the full leaderboard or numerical breakdown, but the setup is designed to expose the trade-off between task success and privacy leakage.

recommendation.zh: 读任务构造和泄露定义即可；它把“会用隐私”和“不泄露隐私”的冲突测得比较干净。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and leakage definition; the clean part is the joint measurement of using private data without revealing it.

paper.title: ReproRepo: Scaling Reproducibility Audits with GitHub Repository Issues
paper.abstract: Reproducing research results from papers and released code is central to scientific progress. Existing works have introduced benchmarks to evaluate whether LLM agents can assist with reproducibility, but they are difficult to scale due to their reliance on substantial manual effort for data curation and evaluation. We introduce ReproRepo, a scalable framework for reproducibility evaluation that leverages human-raised GitHub issues as naturally occurring supervision on realistic reproduction bloc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是“如何大规模、低人工成本地评估LLM agent对科研复现问题的发现能力”。以往复现评测要么靠专家手工设计任务、注入错误、写rubric，要么样本量很小，而且常常只覆盖高质量artifact。作者想把这个评测过程做成可扩展、可持续更新、且更贴近真实研究实践的基准：给定论文和代码仓库，让agent通过静态审查找出真实用户在GitHub issue里报告过的复现阻塞点。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但属于应当保留的eval类工作，因为它提供了一种新的、规模足够大的agent/research automation评测资产。对基座研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它把“真实用户遇到的问题”当监督信号，而不是专家合成任务，这种数据构造思路对训练数据和评测数据都很有借鉴意义。第二，它揭示了当前强agent在静态代码审查上的能力边界：语义层面能找到大部分问题区域，但精确定位和隐蔽错误仍然困难。对于做代码模型、agentic coding、自动科研、以及repo-level pretraining/eval的人，这个基准有实际参考价值。贡献量级主要在benchmark construction和evaluation protocol，而不是方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
框架名为ReproRepo，核心设计是用GitHub issues替代昂贵的专家标注。整体流程分三步。

第一步是数据构造。作者从顶会论文中收集paper-repo对，再抓取对应仓库中的issue。随后筛选出与复现阻塞相关的issue，而不是一般功能请求或讨论。为了保证评测时agent不能直接“看到答案”，作者基于issue发生时间和修复PR时间构建仓库快照，例如issue-time snapshot、修复前snapshot、修复后snapshot。这样可以把真实历史问题转成隐藏测试项。

第二步是agent任务定义。给agent论文和固定版本代码仓库，但不允许执行代码，只做compute-light的静态审查。agent需要输出可能的复现阻塞点。这个设置很重要，因为现代ML仓库往往依赖GPU、大数据集、外部API，完全执行成本太高；作者因此把问题限定为“静态审计能发现多少真实阻塞”。

第三步是评测协议。作者把agent输出与人类issue进行匹配，既看exact match，也看semantic match；既看issue-level指标，也看paper-level指标，还统计成本。这个多层评估设计比较合理，因为复现问题往往存在表述差异，单纯exact match会低估agent能力，而只看语义相近又会高估其定位精度。论文还区分visible failures和less visible failures，帮助分析agent到底擅长发现哪类问题。

与已有基准相比，ReproRepo的差异不在于任务形式多新，而在于监督来源和规模。它不依赖专家写题，而是直接利用自然发生的用户痛点；规模上覆盖1149篇论文、7553个issue，明显大于多数既有复现评测。代价是标签噪声和issue质量不可控，但作者用多种匹配指标和快照构造来缓解这一点。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是这篇工作的主要亮点。作者在3个主要机器学习会议上构建了1149篇论文、7553个人类报告复现阻塞点的数据集，并评估了Claude Code、Codex与4个frontier LLM的组合。在静态审查设定下，结果比直觉上更强：Codex + GPT-5.5在NeurIPS 2024 main conference上，能为93.3%的论文找出至少一个语义相关的隐藏issue；在ICLR 2026上这一比例为89.7%。这说明即便不运行代码，强agent也能从论文与仓库结构中恢复相当多的人类复现痛点。

但作者没有把这个结果解读成“复现问题已被解决”。更关键的发现是：agent的semantic coverage高，但exact localization仍弱。它们更擅长发现可见的失败模式，比如缺失依赖、脚本错误、明显配置不一致；对隐蔽错误、晚期崩溃、语义更复杂的问题，命中率明显差。论文还指出false positive rate较低，这意味着agent不是靠大量泛泛而谈的猜测刷高召回，而是确实能定位到相近问题区域。

如果精读实验部分，建议重点看四类结果：一是不同模型/agent框架的paper-level与issue-level对比；二是exact match与semantic match之间的差距，这直接反映“知道哪里不对”和“准确指出哪一行/哪一模块不对”之间的落差；三是visible vs. less visible failure的分层分析；四是成本分析，因为这个benchmark的一个卖点就是可扩展性和更新便利性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“数据构造—评测协议—误差分析”的顺序读。

先看Figure 1和Table 1，理解ReproRepo相对PaperBench、CORE-Bench、REPRO-Bench等已有工作的区别。重点不是记名字，而是看它为什么能扩到1149篇：因为监督来自GitHub issue，而不是专家手工制作。

然后看数据构造细节。要确认issue筛选标准、repo snapshot如何对齐issue时间、如何处理修复前后版本，以及哪些issue被排除。这个部分决定benchmark是否真的在测复现阻塞，而不是在测仓库维护噪声。

接着看evaluation metrics。尤其注意exact match和semantic match的定义、issue-level与paper-level指标的关系、以及false positive如何统计。很多agent benchmark最后争议都出在匹配规则，这篇也不例外。

最后看qualitative analysis。最值得读的是失败案例：agent为什么能找到“语义区域”却不能精确定位；哪些问题静态分析天然难；是否存在从论文文本中猜到大致问题、但无法落实到代码位置的情况。若只想快速了解，读引言、Figure 1、Table 1、主结果表和误差分析，大约25到35分钟即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark construction problem: how to evaluate LLM agents on research reproducibility at scale, with low manual overhead, and in a way that reflects real research practice. Prior benchmarks often rely on expert-written tasks, injected bugs, curated rubrics, or manual grading, which keeps them small and hard to update. ReproRepo reframes the problem by using real GitHub issues as naturally occurring evidence of reproducibility blockers, then asks agents to recover those blockers from the paper and repository snapshot.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is a relevant evaluation asset. Its main value is methodological: it shows how to build a large, renewable benchmark from real user pain rather than expert-designed tasks. That idea is useful beyond evaluation, including for data construction and supervision mining. For foundation-model researchers, the practical takeaway is that strong coding agents already have substantial semantic coverage in static repository audits, yet still struggle with precise localization and less visible failures. That matters for code models, agentic coding, automated research workflows, and repo-level evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ReproRepo has three core pieces.

First, data construction. The authors collect paper–repository pairs from major ML conferences, then mine GitHub issues from the linked repositories. They filter for issues that correspond to reproducibility blockers rather than generic feature requests or discussion. To avoid leaking the answer to the agent, they reconstruct repository snapshots aligned with issue timing and fix timing, such as issue-time snapshots, pre-fix snapshots, and post-fix snapshots. This turns naturally occurring historical failures into hidden evaluation targets.

Second, the task setup. Agents are given the paper and a fixed repository snapshot, but they do not execute code. The setting is intentionally compute-light and limited to static inspection. This is a practical design choice: many modern ML repositories require GPUs, large datasets, and external APIs, so full execution is expensive and hard to standardize. The benchmark therefore asks a narrower but still meaningful question: how many real reproducibility blockers can an agent surface from static inspection alone?

Third, the evaluation protocol. Agent findings are compared against human-reported issues using both exact match and semantic match. Metrics are reported at both the issue level and the paper level, along with cost. This layered evaluation is important because reproducibility failures are often described differently by different people. Exact match alone would understate capability, while semantic match alone would overstate localization quality. The paper also distinguishes visible failures from less visible ones, which helps characterize what current agents are actually good at.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is less about task format and more about supervision source and scale. Instead of expert-authored tasks, it uses naturally occurring GitHub issues. Instead of tens of papers, it covers 1,149 papers and 7,553 human-reported blockers. The trade-off is noisier supervision, but the snapshot design and multi-granularity metrics help manage that noise.
summary_en.experiments:
The scale of the evaluation is the main result. The benchmark covers 1,149 papers from three major ML conferences and 7,553 human-reported reproducibility blockers. The authors evaluate Claude Code and Codex paired with four frontier LLMs. Under the static-inspection setting, the results are stronger than one might expect: Codex with GPT-5.5 finds at least one semantically related hidden issue for 93.3% of NeurIPS 2024 main-conference papers and 89.7% of ICLR 2026 papers.

The more important finding, however, is the gap between semantic coverage and exact localization. Agents are often able to identify the right semantic region of failure, especially for visible problems such as missing imports, broken scripts, dependency mismatches, or obvious setup issues. But they are much weaker at pinning down the exact source of the problem and at identifying less visible failure types. The paper also reports relatively low false positive rates, which suggests the agents are not simply generating broad generic warnings to inflate recall.

When reading the experiments, focus on four things: comparisons across agent/model combinations; the gap between exact match and semantic match; the stratified analysis of visible versus less visible failures; and the cost analysis, since scalability is one of the benchmark’s main claims.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of data construction, evaluation protocol, then error analysis.

Start with Figure 1 and Table 1. They make the benchmark positioning clear relative to earlier reproducibility evaluations such as PaperBench, CORE-Bench, and REPRO-Bench. The key point is not the names, but why this benchmark scales: supervision comes from GitHub issues rather than expert-authored tasks.

Then read the data construction section carefully. Check how reproducibility-related issues are filtered, how repository snapshots are aligned with issue timing, and how pre-fix versus post-fix states are used. This determines whether the benchmark is really measuring reproducibility blockers rather than repository maintenance noise.

Next, read the metric definitions. Pay close attention to exact match versus semantic match, issue-level versus paper-level metrics, and how false positives are counted. In agent benchmarks, much of the real disagreement usually comes from the matching protocol.

Finally, spend time on the qualitative analysis. The most useful part is the failure analysis: why agents can often identify the right semantic area but fail to localize precisely; which failure types are inherently hard for static inspection; and whether some findings are inferred from the paper text without being grounded in the codebase.

If you only want the main ideas, read the introduction, Figure 1, Table 1, the main result table, and the qualitative error analysis. That should take around 25 to 35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测设计很干净；做 coding/agent eval 的人应直接看任务构造和误差分析，别被“90%”这个 headline 误导成能力已够用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the eval design is clean; read the task construction and error analysis, and do not overread the '90%' headline as evidence that agents are already reliable.

paper.title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, har

summary.core_problem: 这篇 position paper 的核心问题是：现有 coding benchmark 仍在评估“单个模型一次性生成代码”的能力，但实际 coding agent 是模型、prompt、工具、环境、上下文和反馈信号组成的系统。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对代码模型和 agent 评测有启发。它提醒研究者不要把 SWE-Bench、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、BigCodeBench 这类端到端分数简单归因于 base model 或 post-train 方法。对于训练代码模型，benchmark signal 的归因错误会反过来影响数据构造、RL 环境设计和 verifier 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新模型，而是重新定义 coding agent 的评测对象。作者区分 agent harness 和 system harness：前者是单个模型在工具循环中解决任务，后者负责把高层目标拆成任务、调度一个或多个 agent、管理仓库和运行环境、组织上下文、收集反馈。系统被分解为五个组件：tasks、agent harnesses、environment、context、feedback signals。反馈又按时延和可信度分为 inner-loop、middle-loop、outer-loop。inner-loop 包括测试、类型检查、lint、编译；middle-loop 包括代码审查、仿真、维护性检查；outer-loop 包括 PR 接受率、revert、事故和用户反馈。作者认为更合理的 coding benchmark 应该给出组件级信号，使用独立行为规格而不是单一参考答案，并显式度量系统在迭代和反馈中的表现。
summary.experiments: 这不是一篇实验论文，没有受控实验或标准 benchmark 结果。证据主要来自对现有 coding benchmark 的结构性分析，以及作者开源的 NS2 系统 harness 经验。NS2 使用 issue 作为协调单位，运行包含工具调用的 agent loop，并引入严格 verifier、middle-loop review、outer-loop friction/revert 信号。论文的关键观察是：harness、环境、上下文和反馈设计带来的分数变化，可能接近相邻模型代际之间的差距，因此单一端到端分数不足以支持模型能力归因。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 The System Harnesses 一节，里面对 agent harness、system harness、五个组件和三层反馈的拆分最有用。Three Symptoms of the Misalignment 一节可快速扫读，主要抓住三点：模型与 harness 混淆、单一参考答案不适合真实软件工程、缺少迭代过程和组件级信号。对做代码模型训练或 RL 环境的人，最值得带走的是 verifier 和 feedback signal 的分层，而不是具体的 NS2 实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that current coding benchmarks evaluate an older object of study: a model producing code in a mostly fixed harness. Real coding agents are composite systems made of models, prompts, tools, environments, context management, and feedback loops.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for code-model evaluation and agentic RL setups. It warns against attributing an end-to-end SWE-Bench-style score to the base model alone. Harness design, environment setup, context construction, and verifier quality can move scores by margins comparable to model-generation differences. For code model training, this affects how evaluation signals are interpreted and how synthetic tasks, verifiers, and feedback loops should be designed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a benchmark-position argument rather than a new algorithm. The paper separates an agent harness from a system harness. An agent harness is a model in a tool-use loop for a single task. A system harness sits outside it: it converts higher-level goals into tasks, dispatches one or more agent harnesses, manages the repository and runtime environment, curates context, and routes feedback. The system is decomposed into five parts: tasks, agent harnesses, environment, context, and feedback signals. Feedback is further divided into inner-loop signals such as tests, type checks, linting, and compilation; middle-loop signals such as review, simulation, and maintainability checks; and outer-loop signals such as PR acceptance, reverts, incidents, and user outcomes. The proposed benchmark direction is to expose component-level measurements and grade against independent behavioral specifications rather than a single reference solution.
summary_en.experiments: There are no controlled experiments or new benchmark numbers. The evidence is an analysis of existing coding benchmarks and practical observations from NS2, an open-source issue-driven system harness described by the authors. NS2 uses deterministic checks and agent-arbitrated checks, including strict verifiers, middle-loop review, and outer-loop friction or revert signals. The main empirical claim is qualitative: changes in harness, context, environment, and feedback can produce score movements large enough to confound model comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time is about 15–20 minutes. The most useful part is the system-harness section, especially the distinction between agent harness and system harness, the five-component decomposition, and the three-tier feedback taxonomy. The misalignment section can be read for the three main failure modes: conflating model and harness, grading against a single reference solution, and losing iteration-level or component-level signal. For researchers working on code-model post-training or RL environments, the feedback taxonomy is the main reusable idea.

recommendation.zh: 对理解 SWE-bench 类分数有帮助，但偏立场文章；直接读三个症状和结论即可，别期待方法。
recommendation.en: Useful framing for interpreting coding-agent leaderboards, but it is a position piece; read the three symptoms and stop.

paper.title: Offline Preference-Based Trajectory Evaluation
paper.abstract: Offline evaluation of agentic systems often collapses trajectories to terminal success, discarding information about partial progress and inducing widespread ties, creating substantial statistical inefficiency by reducing effective sample size and weakening the ability to distinguish systems. We propose preference-based trajectory evaluation, which compares trajectories directly through temporal preferences over progress and time-to-return profiles. We find that, across diverse agentic and inter

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 agent 轨迹离线评测中的信息损失问题。许多 benchmark 只看最终是否成功，把多步交互过程压成一个二值结果，导致部分进展、求解速度、失败前接近成功的程度都被丢掉。结果是大量 instance-level 比较变成平局，评测集的有效样本量下降，系统之间更难区分。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身是间接相关，但对 agent、RL post-training、交互式评测有实际启发。它提醒一个关键问题：所谓 benchmark saturation 有时不是模型真的不可区分，而是 metric 把可区分信号压没了。对于用 agent benchmark 评估推理模型、代码模型、工具使用模型的团队，这类轨迹级评测能提高统计效率，减少为了区分模型而盲目扩大评测集的需求。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 preference-based trajectory evaluation。论文不再先把每条轨迹压成 success rate 或 discounted return，而是直接比较两条轨迹的时间序列表现。其基本原则是 temporal preference：在达到相同任务进展的情况下，更早达到的轨迹更好。这样可以利用 trajectory 中的 progress profile 和 time-to-return profile，而不是只看终点。相较于常见的时间折扣方法，它强调不引入额外超参数，也不要求预先设定折扣系数；相较于只比较 partial return 的方法，它保留了“什么时候达到某个进展”的信息。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖经典强化学习环境和较新的 agentic / interactive benchmarks。论文报告的核心数字是：使用标准 success-based metric 时，instance-level comparison 平均约 75% 是平局；即使改用 partial return，平局率仍约 50%；轨迹偏好方法把平局率降到约 35%。这一变化带来更好的区分能力、排名稳定性和数据效率。论文还做了一个现象性统计：NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks track 论文摘要中提到 binary metrics 的比例从 2022 年的 5% 增至 2025 年的 18%；EMNLP 中对应比例从 9% 增至 21%，说明二值评测的使用还在增加。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 success metric 信息损失的说明，再看方法部分如何定义 temporal preference 和 trajectory-level comparison。实验部分重点看 tie rate、ranking stability、data efficiency 相关表格和图。对做模型预训练的人，最有用的不是具体公式，而是评测设计上的提醒：当模型越来越强时，metric 的分辨率会直接影响训练信号和模型选择。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses information loss in offline evaluation of agentic systems. Standard metrics often reduce a multi-step trajectory to a binary terminal success label, discarding partial progress, speed of progress, and near-miss behavior. This creates many tied comparisons and lowers the effective sample size of an evaluation set.
summary_en.importance: The connection to base pretraining is indirect, but the paper is useful for evaluating reasoning agents, tool-using models, and RL/post-training systems. Its main lesson is that apparent benchmark saturation can be caused by metric design rather than by true indistinguishability between systems. For expensive agent benchmarks, trajectory-aware evaluation can improve statistical power without simply increasing the number of test instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is preference-based trajectory evaluation. Instead of computing a scalar success rate or discounted return first, it compares trajectories directly through their progress over time. The guiding rule is temporal preference: if two trajectories reach the same level of task progress, the one that reaches it earlier is preferred. This preserves both progress profiles and time-to-return profiles. Unlike discounting-based metrics, the method is presented as avoiding additional discount hyperparameters; unlike partial-return comparisons, it keeps timing information rather than only the amount of progress.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans both classic reinforcement-learning environments and modern agentic or interactive benchmarks. The central empirical result is that success-based metrics yield tied instance-level comparisons on roughly 75% of cases. Partial-return comparisons still tie on about 50%. Trajectory-aware preferences reduce the tie rate to about 35%, with corresponding gains in discriminative power, ranking stability, and data efficiency. The paper also reports an adoption trend: mentions of binary metrics in NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks abstracts increased from 5% in 2022 to 18% in 2025, and from 9% to 21% at EMNLP over the same period.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand how terminal success collapses useful signal. Then read the method section for the definition of temporal preferences and trajectory comparison. In the experiments, focus on tie rates, ranking stability, and data-efficiency plots or tables. The main takeaway for pretraining-oriented researchers is about evaluation resolution: when models become stronger, the metric can become the bottleneck in model selection and training-signal quality.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 Agent 评测中 binary success rate 导致的信息丢失问题，提出的 trajectory preference 视角对设计更 robust 的 eval metric 有启发，建议看 §Method 和 Fig 1。
recommendation.en: Points out the information loss caused by binary success rates in Agent evaluation; the proposed trajectory preference perspective is inspiring for designing more robust eval metrics. Recommend reading §Method and Fig 1.

paper.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
paper.abstract: Agent skills -- structured, reusable knowledge artifacts that augment LLM agent capabilities -- have been rapidly adopted in industry, yet their cross-domain impact and use across commercial and open-source models remain under-studied, and no reusable methodology exists for evaluating an individual skill. In this work, we present an evaluation framework that lets a skill author construct realistic tasks to rigorously assess the aspects of a skill that matter most to them, and that estimates skil

summary.core_problem: Agent skill 作为可复用能力构件在工业中快速采用，但缺少可复用的单技能评估方法，也不清楚不同模型对 skill 的遵循程度差异。
summary.importance: 提出了一个技能级评测框架，并在 500 个真实技能、19 种模型配置上做规模化评估，对 agent 评测方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 让 skill 作者构造贴近真实使用场景的任务，基于技能内容生成约 1000 个任务，并用指令遵循和目标完成两类 rubric 做自动评估。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 500 个真实世界技能、19 个商业与开源 agent-model 配置；结果显示模型在 skill 指令遵循度上差异显著，直接影响目标完成率。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent skills are widely adopted as reusable capability artifacts, yet there is no reusable methodology for evaluating individual skills or measuring model adherence to them at scale.
summary_en.importance: Provides a skill-level evaluation framework and a large-scale empirical study across real-world skills and model configurations, relevant to agent evaluation methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lets skill authors construct realistic tasks, derives about 1,000 tasks from skill content, and scores agent runs on instruction-following and goal-completion rubrics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 19 proprietary and open-source model configurations on 500 real-world skills; finds large model-to-model variation in instruction adherence with substantial impact on goal completion.

recommendation.zh: 偏应用评测框架，和预训练关系弱；若关心 agent eval 可看任务构造和 rubric 设计，其余可略。
recommendation.en: Applied agent-evaluation work, only weakly connected to pretraining; skim the task construction and rubrics if you care about agent eval.

paper.title: Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning
paper.abstract: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：工具调用型 LLM agent 在与环境交互时，能否真正学出一个可验证的世界模型，而不是只靠局部模式和短视试探。作者把问题落到 active automata learning 上，让模型通过 membership query 和 equivalence query 去识别一个隐藏 DFA。这样做的好处是，环境结构已知、复杂度可控、最优或强基线算法现成，因而可以把“会不会建模环境”拆成可测的几个维度：成功率、查询效率、随状态数增长的退化曲线，以及交互轨迹中的规划失误类型。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对“agent 能力到底来自哪里”给了一个很干净的诊断框架。价值主要有三层。第一，它把 world-model inference 从开放任务里抽离出来，避免 benchmark 污染和任务提示技巧，把能力测成一个受控变量。第二，它说明当前强推理模型即便在小规模离散环境里也远未接近经典算法，问题不只是知识不足，而是主动查询规划、证据整合、假设修正这几步都不稳。第三，这类结果对预训练和后训练都有启发：如果模型在这种最小化环境建模任务上都明显掉队，那么仅靠更长 CoT 或更大模型未必能补齐，可能需要更明确的交互式训练信号、外部记忆、程序化状态表示，或把“查询策略学习”直接纳入训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把经典 automata learning 重新包装成 agentic setting。每个任务实例先采样一个目标 DFA，agent 只能通过两类工具与 oracle 交互：MQ 询问某个字符串是否被目标语言接受，EQ 提交一个候选 DFA，若错误则得到反例。评测时既看最终是否恢复正确 DFA，也看用了多少查询。复杂度主要由最小 DFA 的状态数控制。基线选了经典的 L* 和 TTT，这一点很关键，因为它让结果不只是“模型彼此比较”，而是“模型与已知高效学习程序比较”。从全文描述看，作者还做了轨迹级分析，把失败分成几类：查询不够信息化、对已有观测推理不一致、构造假设时没有正确利用历史证据、收到 counterexample 后修正方向不对。这个分析框架比单纯报成功率更有信息量，因为它把 agent 失败定位到 planning 和 state tracking，而不是笼统归因于 reasoning 不足。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有三点。第一，随着 DFA 状态数增加，成功率快速下滑；对 9-state automata，没有任何模型超过 25% 成功率，而经典算法在同类任务上是 100%。第二，即便只看成功样本，最强模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的查询数仍比 TTT 多约 45.8%，说明问题不只是偶尔失败，而是整体发现过程低效。第三，reasoning model 与非 reasoning model 差距很大：在 4–5 状态任务上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 可达 85% 成功，而 GPT-5.4 非 reasoning、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Llama-3.3-70B 为 0%。这些数字说明，显式推理能力确实有帮助，但帮助主要体现在把模型从“几乎不会做”拉到“能做一部分”，离稳定、系统化的环境归纳还很远。轨迹分析部分的价值也不小：模型常提出冗余或低区分度查询，不能围绕当前 hypothesis 的不确定边界去设计 probe；拿到反例后，也常不能把反例转成结构性修正，而只是局部打补丁。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和任务定义，理解为什么 DFA learning 是一个比一般 agent benchmark 更干净的世界模型测试。然后重点看实验主表和按状态数分层的结果图，抓住两个事实：性能随复杂度的退化斜率，以及与 L*/TTT 的效率差。接着看 trajectory analysis，尤其是作者如何把失败拆成 query planning、evidence integration、hypothesis construction 三类。若只花 20–30 分钟，建议读任务设定、主结果、失败案例三部分即可。若要深挖，可以思考两件事：一是当前 agent 框架里，模型到底缺的是搜索策略、外部记忆，还是离散结构归纳偏置；二是如果把这类任务做成 post-training 或 RL 环境，奖励该如何设计，才能学到接近经典 learner 的查询策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: can tool-using LLM agents actually infer a latent world model through interaction, rather than relying on shallow local heuristics? It instantiates this as active automata learning: the agent must recover a hidden DFA using membership queries and equivalence queries. This setup gives controlled environment complexity, exact ground truth, strong algorithmic baselines, and trajectory-level observability, so “world-model inference” becomes measurable instead of anecdotal.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for foundation-model researchers because it isolates one capability that many agent benchmarks blur together. The contribution is mainly diagnostic. First, it turns latent-structure inference into a clean controlled testbed. Second, it shows that current reasoning-capable LLM agents remain far from classical learners even in small deterministic environments, so the gap is not just missing knowledge but weak query planning, weak evidence aggregation, and unstable hypothesis revision. Third, it suggests that scaling CoT alone is unlikely to close this gap; more explicit interactive training signals, external state tracking, or policy learning over information-gathering actions may be needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method recasts classical active automata learning as an agentic evaluation environment. For each instance, an oracle is initialized with a target DFA. The LLM agent can call two tools: MQ asks whether a string is accepted by the target language, and EQ submits a hypothesized DFA, which is either accepted or rejected with a counterexample. Task difficulty is controlled by the number of states in the minimal DFA. Evaluation measures both final identification success and interaction efficiency in number of queries. A strong design choice is the inclusion of classical learners such as L* and TTT as baselines, which anchors the results against known efficient procedures rather than only against other LLMs. The paper also goes beyond aggregate scores and analyzes trajectories, attributing failures to poor query informativeness, inconsistent reasoning over accumulated evidence, weak use of prior observations when constructing hypotheses, and ineffective use of counterexamples for refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Three results matter most. First, performance drops sharply as DFA size grows: for 9-state automata, no tested model exceeds 25% success, while classical algorithms solve all instances. Second, even on successful runs, Gemini 3.1 Pro, the best model in the study, uses about 45.8% more queries than TTT, indicating a substantial efficiency gap. Third, reasoning models are much stronger than non-reasoning ones: on 4–5 state automata, Gemini 3.1 Pro reaches 85% success, whereas GPT-5.4 without reasoning, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and Llama-3.3-70B score 0%. The trajectory analysis is equally informative: models often ask redundant or weakly discriminative queries, fail to maintain a coherent global hypothesis, and treat counterexamples as local patches rather than structural evidence for DFA refinement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task formulation and motivation sections to see why DFA learning is a cleaner probe of world-model inference than open-ended agent benchmarks. Then read the main results tables and the plots stratified by DFA size; the key signal is the degradation slope with complexity and the efficiency gap to L*/TTT. After that, focus on the trajectory analysis and failure cases, especially how the paper separates planning failures from evidence-integration failures. For a quick read, 20–30 minutes on setup, main results, and representative trajectories is enough. For deeper reading, the useful question is not whether LLMs fail, but what kind of inductive bias is missing: search policy, external memory, symbolic state abstraction, or training on information-gathering behavior itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务形式和错误轨迹分析即可；它把“agent 会不会学世界模型”拆成了干净可控的反例生成器。
recommendation.en: Read the task setup and failure-trajectory analysis; it gives a clean counterexample generator for claims about agents learning world models.

paper.title: How Much Can We Trust LLM Search Agents? Measuring Endorsement Vulnerability to Web Content Manipulation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents synthesize open-web content into actionable recommendations on behalf of users, creating a risk that attacker-published pages are transformed into endorsed claims. We introduce SearchGEO, a controlled evaluation framework for measuring endorsement corruption in LLM-based web-search agents, combining a web-evidence manipulation pipeline, a five-mode attack taxonomy, and multiple output-level metrics. We evaluate 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. Res

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM search agent 在开放网页环境中是否会把攻击者操纵的内容转化为模型背书，从而形成错误推荐。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测框架 SearchGEO：它不是又一个 search agent，而是把 web manipulation、攻击类型和输出级指标系统化。对 agent 安全评估和 deployment 风险建模有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建受控网页证据操纵流水线，定义五类攻击模式，并设计多种输出层指标来测量 endorsement corruption；同时加入一个辅助 agent-skill probe，把“背书”转成安装命令等更高风险动作，观察不同后端的行为分化。
summary.experiments: 在 13 个 LLM backend、每个 308 个案例上评测。摘要给出明显差异：Claude-Sonnet-4.6 的总体 ASR 为 0.0%，Gemini-3-Flash 为 31.4%；同一 scaffold 对不同后端可能放大或降低攻击成功率。实验重点是模型家族差异和系统封装交互，而非训练方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAUST、吉林大学、浙大、IDSIA/USI/SUPSI、NNAISENSE 等。Jürgen Schmidhuber 署名使其在 agent 安全评测方向上更容易被关注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM search agents can turn attacker-manipulated web content into model-endorsed recommendations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is the SearchGEO evaluation framework. This is not another search agent paper; it systematizes web manipulation, attack modes, and output-level metrics for agent safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework builds a controlled web-evidence manipulation pipeline, defines a five-mode attack taxonomy, and measures endorsement corruption with multiple output metrics. It also adds an auxiliary skill probe where endorsement becomes a higher-risk action such as an install command.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 LLM backends on 308 cases each. The abstract reports strong backend variation: overall attack success ranges from 0.0% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6 to 31.4% on Gemini-3-Flash, and the same deployment scaffold can either amplify or reduce vulnerability depending on the backend.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from KAUST, Jilin University, Zhejiang University, IDSIA/USI/SUPSI, and NNAISENSE. Jürgen Schmidhuber's presence makes it more visible in the agent safety evaluation space.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent 或 tool-use 的都该看，尤其是同一 scaffold 对不同 backend 方向相反这点；这说明系统层结论别轻易外推，读实验表就够值回时间。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agents or tool use: the key result is that the same scaffold can help one backend and hurt another, so system-level conclusions do not transfer cleanly.

institutions: Center of Excellence for Generative AI, KAUST

paper.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench,

summary.core_problem: 现有 computer-use agent benchmark 在非个人环境中评估模型，无法测试需要登录或个人信息的真实 web 任务，与实际部署存在差距
summary.importance: 提出了首个面向个人智能计算机使用 agent 的 benchmark（MyPCBench），填补了评估与部署之间的 gap；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 团队出品
summary.technical_approach: 在 Linux 桌面构建 17 个模拟真实世界 web 应用和完整桌面栈，以《办公室》Michael Scott 为标准人设，定义 184 个来自 OpenClaw 社区的真实任务
summary.experiments: 测试 6 个闭源和开源模型，统一 computer+bash 工具界面；Claude Opus 4.6 最佳，完成 55.4% 任务
summary.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov；Carnegie Mellon University；Ruslan Salakhutdinov 是深度学习和贝叶斯深度学习知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Current computer-use agent benchmarks evaluate in impersonal environments, cannot test web tasks requiring login or personal information — a gap between evaluation and real deployment
summary_en.importance: First benchmark (MyPCBench) for personally intelligent computer-use agents, filling the evaluation-deployment gap; from Ruslan Salakhutdinov's group at CMU
summary_en.technical_approach: Linux desktop with 17 simulated real-world web apps and full desktop stack, seeded for canonical persona (Michael Scott from The Office); 184 tasks inspired by real requests from OpenClaw community
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarked 6 closed and open-weight models with uniform computer+bash tool surface; Claude Opus 4.6 solves 55.4% of tasks as best performer
summary_en.authors_note: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov; Carnegie Mellon University; Ruslan Salakhutdinov is a prominent researcher in deep learning and Bayesian deep learning

recommendation.zh: CMU Salakhutdinov 团队的重要 benchmark 贡献，关注 agent 评测方向的读者应看任务设计和模拟环境搭建，对预训练研究员主要是评估设计有间接启发
recommendation.en: Important benchmark contribution from CMU Salakhutdinov's group; agent evaluation researchers should study task design and simulation setup; indirect inspiration for pretraining researchers on evaluation design

paper.title: ToolMenuBench: Benchmarking Tool-Menu Filtering Strategies for Reliable and Efficient LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language model agents increasingly operate over large tool libraries, but existing evaluations often focus on whether a model can call a tool correctly rather than how the visible tool menu shapes reliability, efficiency, and safety-relevant risk exposure. We introduce ToolMenuBench, a benchmark for evaluating tool-menu construction in multi-step LLM agents. ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure, and reports b

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM Agent 在大工具库下如何构造可见工具菜单，以及菜单大小、干扰工具和风险暴露如何影响可靠性、效率与安全。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 工具使用评测基准。它把评测重点从“能否正确调用工具”推进到“给模型看哪些工具会改变行为”，这对 tool-use agent 的可靠性分析更贴近实际部署。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ToolMenuBench，通过控制工具菜单大小、干扰工具类型、状态依赖任务结构和风险暴露来测试多步 Agent；指标同时覆盖过滤器本身和下游 Agent 表现，包括可见工具数、风险工具暴露、任务成功率、错误工具调用、过早行动和 token 使用量。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个模型后端、3 种工具菜单大小、6 种过滤方法和 7 种评测设置上实验。摘要报告 CMTF 将任务成功率从 all-tools exposure 下的 32.1% 提升到 85.7%，同时平均 token 使用量减少约 98%；因果最小工具过滤在成功率、成本和风险之间取得较好折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how tool-menu construction affects the reliability, efficiency, and risk exposure of LLM agents operating over large tool libraries.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an agent benchmark that shifts evaluation from whether a model can call tools to which tools should be made visible. This is closer to practical deployment, where the exposed action space strongly shapes model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolMenuBench varies tool-menu size, distractor type, state-dependent task structure, and risk exposure in multi-step agent tasks. It reports both filter-level and downstream metrics, including visible tool count, risky-tool exposure, task success, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token usage.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates seven model backends, three menu sizes, six filtering methods, and seven evaluation settings. The abstract reports that CMTF raises task success from 32.1% under all-tools exposure to 85.7%, while reducing average token usage by about 98%. Causal minimal tool filtering gives the strongest overall tradeoff.

recommendation.zh: 工具菜单是被低估的 Agent 控制面；读指标和 CMTF 对照，别把数字外推到通用规划能力。
recommendation.en: Tool menus are an underrated agent control surface; read the metrics and CMTF ablation, but do not extrapolate the numbers to general planning.

paper.title: LatentGym: A Testbed For Cross-Task Experiential Learning With Controllable Latent Structure
paper.abstract: We envision continually learning agentic systems that become more useful over time: as they encounter sequences of related tasks, they should infer the hidden structure shared across those tasks and use it to improve future decisions. This cross-task experiential learning capability is pivotal in domains such as personalization and interactive assistance, but existing training/evaluation frameworks do not provide shared, controllable latent structures and cannot measure whether or why agents imp

summary.core_problem: 评测智能体是否能在一串相关任务中识别共享的隐变量，并把历史经验转化为后续决策收益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent / continual learning 评测资产。它把“跨任务经验学习”拆成可控 latent structure、探索质量和利用质量，比只看最终成功率更适合诊断模型为什么没有真正适应。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LatentGym，一组带有 ground-truth latent variable 的可控环境。每个环境的任务序列共享隐藏结构，系统记录 agent 的交互行为，并用专门指标区分 exploration：动作是否收集到关于 latent 的信息；exploitation：模型是否使用已收集的信息改进后续决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者用 LatentGym 研究 frontier models 在相关任务序列上的适应失败机制，但未给出具体模型清单、参数量、任务数量和提升幅度。实验重点不是训练新模型，而是用受控环境拆解失败来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether agents can infer shared latent structure across a sequence of related tasks and convert prior interactions into better future decisions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent and continual-learning evaluation contribution. Its value is the controlled latent structure and the separation of exploration from exploitation, which is more diagnostic than reporting aggregate task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: LatentGym provides environments organized around a ground-truth latent variable. The suite measures whether an agent's actions acquire information about the latent variable and whether the agent later uses that information to improve decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports empirical studies on why frontier models fail to adapt across related tasks, but does not specify the model list, parameter scales, number of environments, or quantitative gains. The emphasis is diagnostic evaluation rather than training a new model.

recommendation.zh: 只看环境构造和 exploration/exploitation 指标；它不改预训练 recipe，但给 agent 记忆和在线适应评测一个更干净的 setup。
recommendation.en: Read the environment design and the exploration/exploitation metrics; it does not change pretraining recipes, but gives a cleaner setup for evaluating agent memory and online adaptation.

paper.title: WorkBench Revisited: Workplace Agents Two Years On
paper.abstract: The best agent on WorkBench in March 2024, GPT-4, completed 43% of tasks and took an unintended harmful action, such as emailing the wrong person, on 26% of them. We re-visit the benchmark in June 2026 and find that the best agent to date, Claude Opus 4.8, completes 89% and takes an unintended harmful action on 2.5%. Aside from this considerable progress in frontier agent performance, three things stand out. First, capability and safety go together on WorkBench rather than trade off, so the mode

summary.core_problem: 重新评估 WorkBench 上工作场景 Agent 的能力、安全性和成本变化，回答两年后前沿模型是否真的更能完成办公室任务、同时更少造成不可逆错误。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评测与纵向分析。它不是预训练方法论文，但给出了一个有用信号：前沿 Agent 的任务完成率和误操作率都发生了大幅变化，并且开源权重模型显著降低了达到旧前沿水平的成本。
summary.technical_approach: 作者复用并更新 WorkBench，对 2024 年 GPT-4 的结果与 2026 年 Claude Opus 4.8 等模型进行比较。评估指标包括任务完成率、非预期有害动作比例、错误类型分布，以及不同模型在成本和能力上的位置。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告：2024 年 GPT-4 在 WorkBench 上完成 43% 任务，并在 26% 任务中采取非预期有害动作；2026 年最佳 Agent Claude Opus 4.8 完成 89% 任务，有害动作降至 2.5%。若干错误类型已消失，但仍会出现发错邮件等基础且不可逆错误。开源权重模型以更低成本达到过去只有闭源模型能达到的性能水平。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits WorkBench to measure whether workplace agents have become both more capable and less harmful over a two-year period.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent evaluation and longitudinal benchmarking contribution. It is not a pretraining paper, but it provides a useful signal on how frontier-agent capability, safety, and cost have shifted in realistic office tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study updates and reruns WorkBench, comparing the March 2024 GPT-4 baseline with June 2026 frontier and open-weight agents. It tracks task completion, unintended harmful actions, error classes, and cost-performance tradeoffs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that GPT-4 completed 43% of tasks in 2024 and took unintended harmful actions in 26% of them, while Claude Opus 4.8 completes 89% in 2026 with harmful actions reduced to 2.5%. Some error classes disappear, but basic irreversible mistakes such as emailing the wrong person remain.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表和错误 taxonomy；它说明 Agent 能力与安全未必此消彼长，但对预训练 recipe 没直接动作。
recommendation.en: Read the result table and error taxonomy only; the capability-safety coupling is interesting, but it does not directly change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: SIMMER: Benchmarking Latent Failures in LLM Executable Planning with a World Model
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners for autonomous agents in household environments. While existing benchmarks evaluate whether LLM-generated plans execute successfully, they overlook a critical type of failure: latent failures. Unlike immediate failures that trigger instant feedback at execution time and enable timely correction, latent failures do not immediately halt plan execution but silently compromise goal achievement. In severe cases, they cause irreversibl

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 作为可执行规划器时，现有 benchmark 只看计划是否立即失败，漏掉不会立刻中断执行但会破坏最终目标的 latent failures。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent planning 评测资产。它把“计划可执行”拆成即时前置条件失败和延迟显现的状态损害，对安全型 agent 评测有一定方法价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SIMMER，在厨房任务中构建人工校验的符号世界模型，包含 77 个动作、262 个唯一物体和约 46,800 种语义现实的交互；使用状态机 executor 按世界状态验证 LLM 生成计划，并检测即时前置条件错误与潜在失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出世界模型规模和数据来源：交互来自真实烹饪脚本；未提供完整被测模型列表、指标数值或相对 baseline 提升。评测重点是通过符号执行暴露传统成功率指标遗漏的 latent failures。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM executable planning failures that do not immediately stop execution but silently undermine the final goal.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-planning evaluation contribution. It separates immediate precondition failures from latent state corruption, which is useful for safety-oriented agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIMMER builds a human-curated symbolic kitchen world model with 77 actions, 262 objects, and roughly 46,800 semantically realistic interactions derived from real cooking scripts. A state-machine executor validates generated plans against world states and flags both immediate and latent failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the world-model scale and provenance, but not the full model list, quantitative results, or baseline deltas. The main experimental value is exposing failures missed by execution-success-only evaluation.

recommendation.zh: agent eval 可看 latent-failure 定义和 world-model schema；厨房域较窄，不必读实验表。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for the latent-failure definition and world-model schema; the kitchen scope is narrow, so the tables are optional.

paper.title: Poker Arena: Multi-Axis Profiling of Strategic Reasoning and Memory in LLMs
paper.abstract: Strategic reasoning under uncertainty underpins consequential decisions in negotiation, finance, and policy, but prevailing game-play benchmarks collapse heterogeneous reasoning dimensions into a single scalar, leaving the capability structure of frontier LLMs unexamined. We introduce Poker Arena, a no-limit Texas Hold'em tournament platform that couples a three-layer memory architecture (within-hand, session, and cross-session) with a nine-axis cognitive profile decomposing strategic reasoning

summary.core_problem: 用德州扑克评估 LLM 在不确定环境下的战略推理、长期记忆和多维决策能力，避免只用单一胜负或筹码指标概括能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测平台和能力剖面。它对通用 Agent 和推理评测有参考价值，但扑克场景较窄，对 LLM 基座预训练的直接信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Poker Arena，一个无限注德州扑克锦标赛平台。平台包含三层记忆结构：单手牌内记忆、会话记忆、跨会话记忆；并设计九个认知维度来拆解战略能力，例如下注尺度校准和位置意识。
summary.experiments: 评估 7 个前沿模型，每个模型 50 个 session、每个 session 1,000 手牌，并做记忆消融。摘要中报告 Claude Opus 4.6 在筹码上以 +15,730 和 14 次第一获胜，但平均九轴评分仅排第 5；持久记忆对不同模型有正负不一的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Poker Arena evaluates LLM strategic reasoning and memory under uncertainty, avoiding a single scalar game outcome as the only capability measure.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-platform contribution. It is relevant to agent and reasoning assessment, but the poker setting is narrow and has limited direct leverage for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses no-limit Texas Hold'em tournaments with a three-layer memory design: within-hand, session-level, and cross-session memory. It also defines a nine-axis cognitive profile covering dimensions such as bet-sizing calibration and positional awareness.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate seven frontier models across 50 sessions of 1,000 hands, plus controlled memory ablations. Claude Opus 4.6 wins on tournament chips with +$15,730 and 14 first-place finishes, yet ranks only fifth of seven on the mean axis score; persistent memory helps some models and hurts others.

recommendation.zh: 作为评测设计备查即可；九轴 profile 有点意思，但 poker 分布太窄，不值得读完整方法。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an evaluation-design reference; the nine-axis profile is useful, but the poker distribution is too narrow to justify a full read.

paper.title: ToolSense: A Diagnostic Framework for Auditing Parametric Tool Knowledge in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models deployed as agents over large tool catalogs face a critical tool-retrieval bottleneck. As embedding-based retrieval approaches rely on compact encoders that may under-capture specialized tool semantics, parametric tool retrieval addresses this by encoding each tool as a virtual token appended to the LLM vocabulary, fine-tuned in two stages (memorization then retrieval SFT) to use the LLM as a retriever, achieving strong performance on standard ToolBench retrieval benchmarks

summary.core_problem: 现有 parametric tool retrieval benchmark 使用完整指定的查询和约束解码评估，无法真正揭示 LLM 是否理解其工具语义。
summary.importance: 首次提出针对 parametric tool knowledge 的诊断评测框架，自动生成三级模糊度的真实检索 benchmark、MCQ 探测 benchmark 和 QA 探测 benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: ToolSense 是一个开源 LLM 驱动的诊断框架，接受任意工具 catalog 作为输入，自动生成：(1) Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) — 在三级查询模糊度下评估；(2) MCQ 探测 benchmark；(3) QA 探测 benchmark。核心在于暴露 parametric tool retrieval 在真实、模糊查询下的真实能力，而非使用约束解码掩盖缺陷。
summary.experiments: 将 ToolSense 应用于标准 ToolBench retrieval benchmark，对比现有 parametric 方法 (两阶段微调：记忆 + retrieval SFT) 在完整查询 vs 模糊查询下的表现，揭示现有评估的 inflated 结果。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未从摘要中确认，作者来自多所高校/研究机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parametric tool retrieval benchmarks use fully-specified queries and constrained decoding evaluation, masking whether LLMs truly understand tool semantics.
summary_en.importance: First diagnostic evaluation framework for parametric tool knowledge; automatically generates retrieval benchmarks at three ambiguity tiers plus MCQ and QA probing benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolSense is an open-source LLM-powered diagnostic framework that takes a tool catalog as input and auto-generates: (1) Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) at three query ambiguity levels; (2) MCQ probing benchmark; (3) QA probing benchmark. Critically exposes true retrieval capability under realistic, ambiguous queries rather than inflated scores via constrained decoding.
summary_en.experiments: Applied to standard ToolBench retrieval benchmarks, comparing existing parametric methods (two-stage fine-tuning: memorization + retrieval SFT) on fully-specified vs ambiguous queries, revealing inflated evaluation results.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliations not confirmed from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 核心贡献是 benchmark 生成框架而非方法，对 agent tool-use 评测研究有参考价值。看 §3-4 benchmark 设计和 Figure 2-3 揭示的现有评估 gap 即可，预训练研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: Contribution is benchmark generation framework, not methodology. Relevant for agent tool-use evaluation research. Read §3-4 benchmark design and Figs 2-3 on evaluation gaps; pre-training researchers need not go deep.

paper.title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility
paper.abstract: Agent systems are advancing quickly across domains, but their evaluation remains fragmented. Most benchmarks rely on fixed, LLM-centric harnesses that require heavy integration, create test-production mismatch, and limit fair comparison across diverse agent designs. The root problem is the lack of an open, agent-agnostic assessment interface. We advocate Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA), where evaluation is performed by judge agents and all participants interact through standardized protocols:

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：当前 agent benchmark 依赖固定、LLM-centric 的评测脚手架，导致集成成本高、测试与生产脱节、不同 agent 设计难以公平比较。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议与评测基础设施，而不是 agent 能力本身。它的意义在于把 agent 评测从“为 benchmark 写适配器”转成“通过统一协议交互”，这对通用 agent 生态和可复现实验有价值；对预训练研究员的直接相关性一般，但如果你关心 AI delegation eval、tool-use eval 或 judge-based assessment，这篇值得知道。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Agentified Agent Assessment（AAA）：让 judge agents 执行评测逻辑，所有参与方通过标准协议交互，任务管理用 A2A，工具访问用 MCP。基于这一思想实现 AgentBeats，并总结五种操作模式，使标准化评测能兼容不同 agent 架构。关键点是把 benchmark 接口与被测 agent 接口合并成统一协议层，减少专用集成。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调的是框架设计、开放性、标准化与复现性，而不是某个模型在 benchmark 上的分数提升。没有看到大规模能力对比或严谨的 judge reliability 结果前，不宜把它看成评测范式已经定型；更像是一个评测基础设施提案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fragmentation of agent evaluation, where most benchmarks rely on fixed, LLM-centric harnesses that are expensive to integrate, mismatched with production, and hard to use for fair comparison across agent designs.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation protocol and infrastructure layer, not agent capability itself. Its value is in shifting agent assessment from benchmark-specific adapters to standardized interaction protocols. That matters for general-agent ecosystems and reproducibility; for pretraining researchers it is only moderately relevant, but worth knowing if you care about AI delegation eval, tool-use eval, or judge-based assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA): judge agents perform the assessment logic, while all participants interact through standardized protocols, using A2A for task management and MCP for tool access. They instantiate this idea in AgentBeats and describe five operation modes to make standardized assessment compatible with diverse agent architectures. The key move is collapsing the benchmark interface and the agent interface into a single protocol layer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes framework design, openness, standardization, and reproducibility rather than score gains on a benchmark. Without stronger evidence on judge reliability or broad empirical comparisons, it should be treated as an evaluation infrastructure proposal rather than a settled evaluation paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在搭 agent eval 平台，这篇有工程味道；否则只看 AAA 的接口抽象，别把协议统一误读成评测有效性已经解决。
recommendation.en: Useful if you build agent-eval infrastructure; otherwise just read the AAA interface abstraction and do not confuse protocol standardization with solved evaluation validity.

paper.title: WorldReasoner: Evaluating Whether Language Model Agents Forecast Events with Valid Reasoning
paper.abstract: Forecasting real-world events requires language-model agents to reason under uncertainty from incomplete, time-bounded information. Yet evaluating whether agents genuinely forecast requires more than final-answer accuracy: a model may be correct by recalling memorized training facts, citing fabricated evidence, or producing an unsupported causal story. We present WorldReasoner, an evaluation framework for temporally valid event forecasting. Each task gives an agent a resolved forecasting questio

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“LLM agent 是否真的在做事件预测”，而不是在被时间泄漏污染的静态题库里做事后回忆；并且把预测质量拆成可诊断的三部分：概率预测是否靠谱、证据是否时间有效且相关、因果/事件推理是否站得住。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“训练数据时间泄漏”与“评测可复现性”的矛盾给了一个工程化解法：用历史已决事件做可复现评测，同时用严格的时间网关限制可见证据，降低模型靠记忆/语料污染拿分的空间。对做 continual pretrain、数据配比、以及 post-train 强化检索/工具使用的团队，这类评测能更早暴露“看似会推理、其实在背答案/编证据/概率不校准”的问题。
summary.technical_approach:
框架核心是“模拟预测日 + 时间网关（Temporal Gateway）”。每个任务包含：问题文本、可预测窗口（最早可预测日 t0、模拟日 tsim、决议日 tres）、决议标签 y，以及一个带时间戳的证据库 A。评测时，agent 只能访问 tsim 之前的证据子集（按时间戳过滤），从而把信息环境固定下来，做到可复现。

提交物不仅是答案，还包括：预测概率 p、引用/访问的证据集合 C、可选的自然语言解释 r、以及在启用图工具时的“预测时因果事件图”GF=(VF,EF)。决议后，系统用一个 Hindsight Agent 基于 tres 之前的证据构造参考证据集 CH 和参考因果图 GH，用于对齐评测。

评分分三轴：
1) outcome quality：既看准确率，也看概率预测的 proper scoring（Brier、log score），避免只比对最终选项；
2) evidence quality：检查引用/访问来源是否时间有效（tsource<=tsim）以及与问题的相关性/精确性，区分“编造证据”与“检索到但没用好”；
3) reasoning quality：把 agent 的预测图 GF 与事后参考图 GH 对齐，评估关键事件召回、边/事件匹配等，试图量化“因果故事是否覆盖了后来被证据支持的关键链条”。

论文还强调了构建流水线：从预测市场与新闻流生成问题、收集带时间戳证据、并自动生成事后图（hindsight graph），以便规模化扩展题库。
summary.experiments:
作者在 6 种受控 agent 设置下评测多种前沿模型（文中强调对比不同工具配置：是否允许检索、是否要求/允许构图等）。主要结论是：
- “时间有效的检索”是 outcome 提升的最强驱动因素；没有严格时间约束的检索会把评测变成隐性泄漏。
- 显式构建因果事件图能提高关键事件覆盖/召回（reasoning 维度更好），但并不必然带来更高的最终选项正确率，说明“会找证据/会列事件”与“会把不确定性压成校准概率”之间仍有断层。
- 条件分析显示：正确的 Search-Enabled + Graph 预测通常伴随更高的 source precision 与 key-event recall；但也暴露瓶颈：不少失败样本里，agent 已经检索到相关证据、也能指出关键事件，却无法把证据转成合理的概率分配（校准/聚合失败）。

（注：你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格与具体数值；若需要精确数字，需要补充论文后半部分的实验表与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看框架定义部分：Temporal Gateway 的形式化、任务实例的时间变量（t0/tsim/tres）与证据过滤规则，这是它与普通“历史题库”最大的区别。
- 再看三轴评分的定义：尤其是 evidence quality 如何判定时间有效与相关性、reasoning quality 如何把预测图与事后图对齐；这些细节决定了它能否真的抑制“编造引用/事后诸葛”。
- 最后看实验的受控设置对比：重点关注“仅检索 vs 检索+构图”在 outcome/evidence/reasoning 三轴上的分解结果，用来判断你自己的 agent 训练/对齐该补哪一块（检索、证据使用、概率校准、还是结构化推理）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether an LLM agent is genuinely forecasting real-world events under uncertainty—rather than exploiting temporal leakage in static resolved benchmarks—and how to decompose forecasting quality into outcome calibration, evidence grounding with time validity, and causal/event reasoning quality.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it squarely targets a recurring pretrain/eval failure mode: temporal contamination. The “simulated forecast date + time-gated evidence” design offers a practical compromise between live forecasting (clean but slow and irreproducible) and static resolved QA (fast but increasingly leaked). For teams doing continual pretraining, data refresh, or retrieval/tool-augmented post-training, the framework is useful to detect when gains come from memorization, fabricated citations, or poor probability calibration rather than prospective reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
WorldReasoner turns each resolved event question into a reproducible historical forecasting task by freezing the information environment at a simulated date. Each instance includes the question, a forecast window (earliest forecastable date t0, simulated date tsim, resolution date tres), the resolved outcome y, and a timestamped evidence repository A. A Temporal Gateway exposes only evidence items with timestamps <= tsim, enforcing a strict temporal boundary while keeping evaluation reproducible.

Agents submit: a predicted answer with probability p, cited/accessed sources C, an optional natural-language rationale, and—when enabled—a forecast-time causal event graph GF. After resolution, a Hindsight Agent constructs reference evidence CH and a reference causal graph GH using evidence up to tres.

Scoring is explicitly multi-axis:
1) Outcome quality: accuracy plus proper scoring rules (Brier/log score) to evaluate probabilistic forecasts.
2) Evidence quality: checks time validity (no post-tsim sources) and relevance/precision of cited or accessed evidence, separating “right for the wrong reasons” from grounded forecasting.
3) Reasoning quality: compares GF against GH to measure key-event recovery and structural alignment, aiming to quantify whether the agent’s causal story covers hindsight-validated drivers.

The paper also describes a scalable construction pipeline sourcing questions from prediction markets/news streams, collecting timestamped evidence, and auto-building hindsight graphs to expand the benchmark.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers multiple frontier models under six controlled agent configurations (varying retrieval access and graph-construction tools). The main findings are:
- Temporally valid retrieval is the strongest driver of outcome performance.
- Explicit causal graph construction improves key-event recovery (reasoning axis), but does not reliably translate into better final answer selection.
- Conditional analyses show correct forecasts tend to have higher source precision and key-event recall, yet a persistent bottleneck remains: agents can retrieve relevant evidence and identify plausible causal events but still fail to convert that grounded information into well-calibrated probabilities.

(The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables; exact numeric deltas require the missing experimental sections/appendices.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the formalization of the Temporal Gateway and the task tuple (t0/tsim/tres). This is the core mechanism that makes the benchmark reproducible while resisting leakage.
- Inspect the three scoring axes, especially how evidence validity/relevance is operationalized and how forecast graphs are matched to hindsight graphs.
- Scan the controlled-setting comparisons (retrieval vs retrieval+graph) and focus on the decomposed metrics; they tell you whether your own agent stack is bottlenecked by retrieval, evidence use, causal structuring, or probability calibration.

recommendation.zh: 值得看评测协议；时间截断和证据评分比最终 accuracy 更干净，可用于检查 agent benchmark 泄漏。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the protocol: temporal cutoff plus evidence scoring is a cleaner signal than final accuracy for agent benchmarks.

paper.title: Can AI Agents Synthesize Scientific Conclusions?
paper.abstract: Scientific AI agents increasingly retrieve evidence, reason across sources, and synthesize conclusions used in consequential decisions. Yet, their ability to do so in high-stakes domains such as health remains unclear. We introduce SciConBench, a large-scale live benchmark of 9.11K questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews to evaluate open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis. The benchmark draws on an expert-validated automated evaluation pipeline that decomposes conclu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作评估的是科学结论合成，而不是检索、引用或短答案问答。核心问题是：在干净的开放网页环境下，AI agent 能否从分散证据中生成类似系统综述的专家结论，尤其是在健康等高风险场景中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在评测信号设计。SciConBench 把长程检索、证据筛选、冲突信息整合和结论生成放到同一个任务里，能暴露模型在 factual recall、factual precision、证据覆盖和泄漏依赖上的问题。对基座模型研究的启发主要有两点：一是当前模型的开放域科学综合能力仍受限，不能只看短问答或引用准确率；二是评测必须隔离可检索的标准答案，否则容易把“找到原文结论”误判成“完成科学综合”。
