- Taxonomy/coverage mapping figure(s) to understand how “industry coverage” is quantified.
- Baseline results and any error breakdowns by task type/difficulty.
If reading with a pretraining lens, focus on failure attribution: which errors stem from visual grounding, toolchain execution, long-horizon planning/memory, or verification-target mismatch—these map directly to data mixture and mid-training interventions.

recommendation.zh: 极具野心的真实世界长周期 Agent 评测，2.6% 的通过率说明现有模型在复杂 workflow 上依然很弱，值得关注其 task 构造方式。
recommendation.en: Highly ambitious real-world long-horizon agent benchmark; the 2.6% pass rate highlights current models' weakness on complex workflows, worth checking its task construction.

institutions: Leading institution: University of California, Berkeley
authors: et al. (208 additional authors not shown)

paper.title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
paper.abstract: Continual learning, the ability of AI systems to improve through sequential experience, has attracted substantial interest, but no high-quality benchmark exists to evaluate it. We introduce Continual Learning Bench (CL-Bench), the first difficult, expert-validated benchmark designed to measure whether LLM-based systems genuinely improve with experience. CL-Bench spans six diverse domains (software engineering, signal processing, disease outbreak forecasting, database querying, strategic game-pla

summary.core_problem: 现有持续学习评测仅使用记忆召回、离线准确率等代理指标，无法有效衡量LLM系统的在线持续学习能力，缺乏覆盖真实领域的高质量基准。
summary.importance: 为持续预训练、测试时自适应、LLM代理的持续学习能力评测提供了标准化基准，其隔离基础模型能力、引入概念漂移的任务设计思路，也能为持续预训练的评测体系构建提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构建CL-Bench基准，覆盖软件工程、信号处理、疫情预测等6个真实领域，所有任务经领域专家验证，设计为包含跨实例共享的可在线发现的潜在结构，部分任务引入概念漂移模拟真实环境变化；新增增益指标衡量在线经验带来的性能提升，隔离基础模型能力的干扰。
summary.experiments: 对前沿模型和多种代理架构的大规模评测显示，朴素上下文学习的效果优于专门设计的持续学习机制，当前系统普遍存在早期错误信念难以修正的问题，可靠的在线自适应能力仍未实现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的基准设计准则、第4章的任务说明，第5章的前沿模型评测结论值得关注，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continual learning evaluations rely on proxy metrics such as memory recall and offline accuracy, and cannot effectively measure the online continual learning capability of LLM systems, with a lack of high-quality benchmarks covering real-world domains.
summary_en.importance: It provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating continual learning capabilities of continual pretraining methods, test-time adaptation systems and LLM agents. Its task design principles of isolating base model capability and introducing concept drift also inform evaluation system construction for continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The CL-Bench benchmark covers 6 real-world domains including software engineering, signal processing and disease outbreak forecasting, with all tasks validated by domain experts. Tasks are designed to contain learnable latent structure shared across instances that can only be discovered online, and some variants introduce concept drift to simulate real-world environment changes. A gain metric is added to measure performance improvement from online experience, eliminating the interference of base model capability.
summary_en.experiments: Large-scale evaluation of frontier models and various agent architectures shows that naive in-context learning outperforms specially designed continual learning mechanisms. Current systems commonly fail to correct early incorrect beliefs, and reliable online adaptation remains an unsolved problem.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on benchmark design criteria in Section 3, task descriptions in Section 4, and frontier model evaluation conclusions in Section 5. Estimated reading time is 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 首个专家级持续学习benchmark，gain metric设计有参考价值；对pretrain的直接启示有限，读§3评测设计即可
recommendation.en: First expert-level continual learning benchmark; gain metric design is worth studying. Read §3 evaluation design only; limited direct pretraining insight.

paper.title: Do More Agents Help? Controlled and Protocol-Aligned Evaluation of LLM Agent Workflows
paper.abstract: Does adding more agents help an LLM workflow once compared systems share the same benchmark loader, tool access, answer contract, usage accounting, and trajectory logging? We introduce BenchAgent, an evaluation framework that places single-agent, fixed multi-agent (MAS), and evolving MAS workflows under one normalized execution and logging protocol. BenchAgent evaluates these substrate-internal workflows across ten reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks with GPT-4.1, and separately reports a

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体系统的评测未统一执行协议、工具权限、用量统计等边界条件，导致性能差距无法区分是来自多智能体架构本身的提升还是协议优势，无法回答“增加智能体数量是否真的能带来可靠的性能收益”这一核心问题。
summary.importance: 给出了标准化的多智能体工作流评测框架，首次在严格控制变量的条件下验证了多智能体架构的边际收益边界，对智能体系统的设计和对齐训练中的多智能体数据合成有明确的指导意义：单纯增加智能体数量或引入协调机制并不能保证性能提升，架构收益高度依赖具体设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BenchAgent评测框架，统一所有对比系统的基准测试加载、工具访问接口、答案格式约束、token/延迟用量统计、执行轨迹日志标准；将评测分为两类：基底内部评测（SI）要求所有工作流在同一沙箱内运行，暴露全部内部状态；协议对齐外部评测（PAE）适用于无法重写的成熟系统，仅对齐输入、评测器、工具能力、后端模型等外部边界，保留执行轨迹用于分析；核心评估指标为工作流提升度，即单智能体基准替换为多智能体工作流后的精度与成本变化。
summary.experiments: 基于GPT-4.1后端，在10个推理、代码、工具使用基准测试上对比1个单智能体基准和6个固定/演化多智能体系统；基底内部评测结果显示仅EvoAgent一个多智能体系统平均精度超过单智能体基准，且提升幅度仅1.44个百分点，处于单次运行的统计波动范围内，其余5个多智能体系统精度落后2.56-11.29个百分点；在GAIA基准上的协议对齐外部评测显示，Claude-Code风格的运行时生成工作流整体精度达到66.72%，在2-3级难度任务上领先，且token用量低于最强非Claude基线，但无法确定具体是哪项设计带来了收益。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读评测协议设计部分和基底内部评测的对比结果表，附录的工作流分类术语表可作为参考；预计阅读时间20-25分钟，不需要复现实验，核心关注多智能体收益的边界条件结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations of multi-agent systems do not unify boundary conditions such as execution protocols, tool permissions, and usage accounting, making it impossible to distinguish whether performance gaps come from improvements in the multi-agent architecture itself or protocol advantages, and thus unable to answer the core question of whether adding more agents actually delivers reliable performance gains.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a standardized evaluation framework for multi-agent workflows, and verifies the marginal gain boundary of multi-agent architectures under strictly controlled variables for the first time. It provides clear guidance for agent system design and multi-agent data synthesis in alignment training: simply increasing the number of agents or introducing coordination mechanisms does not guarantee performance improvements, and architectural gains are highly dependent on specific design choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The BenchAgent evaluation framework is proposed to unify benchmark loading, tool access interfaces, answer format constraints, token/latency usage accounting, and execution trace logging standards across all compared systems. Evaluations are divided into two categories: Substrate-Internal (SI) evaluation requires all workflows to run in the same sandbox and expose all internal states; Protocol-Aligned External (PAE) evaluation applies to mature systems that cannot be rewritten, only aligning external boundaries such as inputs, evaluators, tool capabilities, and backend models, while retaining execution traces for analysis. The core evaluation metric is workflow lift, defined as the change in accuracy and cost when a single-agent baseline is replaced by a multi-agent workflow.
summary_en.experiments: Using GPT-4.1 as the backend, 1 single-agent baseline and 6 fixed/evolving multi-agent systems are compared across 10 reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks. SI evaluation results show that only one multi-agent system (EvoAgent) exceeds the single-agent baseline in average accuracy, with a gain of only 1.44 percentage points which falls within the statistical fluctuation range of a single run, while the remaining 5 multi-agent systems lag by 2.56 to 11.29 percentage points. PAE evaluation on the GAIA benchmark shows that the Claude-Code-style runtime-generated workflow reaches 66.72% overall accuracy, leads on Level 2-3 tasks, and uses fewer tokens than the strongest non-Claude baseline, though it is not possible to isolate which specific design choice drives the gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the evaluation protocol design and the comparison result tables of SI evaluation. The workflow classification terminology table in the appendix can be used as a reference. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. There is no need to reproduce experiments; focus on the conclusion about the boundary conditions of multi-agent gains.

recommendation.zh: 协议对齐后发现多数多 agent 不如单 agent，对 agent scaling 有直接启示；只看 §3-§4 的核心对比表即可。
recommendation.en: Protocol-aligned comparison shows most multi-agent systems underperform single agents — directly relevant to agent scaling; only §3-§4 core comparison tables merit reading.

paper.title: Search-Time Contamination in Deep Research Agents: Measuring Performance Inflation in Public Benchmark Evaluation
paper.abstract: Public benchmarks enable fair and reproducible evaluation of LLM reasoning, but they become fragile for deep research agents that actively search the web during inference. Such agents may retrieve public benchmark metadata, question context, or even ground-truth answers via web search. This gives rise to Search-Time Contamination (STC), where external retrieval bypasses intended reasoning and inflates measured performance. We systematically study STC in deep research agent evaluation. We define

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 deep research agent 在公开 benchmark 上评测时的 search-time contamination：模型在推理过程中主动联网搜索，可能直接检索到 benchmark 元数据、题目上下文，甚至标准答案，从而绕过原本要测的推理能力，导致分数被系统性抬高。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train agent、联网推理系统和评测协议很重要。它提醒人们：一旦模型具备外部检索和多步搜索能力，传统“公开测试集 + 最终答案打分”的评测假设就不再成立。对于基座研究员，这个问题会反过来影响训练信号质量、RL 目标设计和 benchmark 可信度，因为如果评测被污染，后续基于这些分数做模型选择、数据合成或策略优化都会偏掉。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先把 STC 明确分成三个层级。第一类是 Benchmark Metadata Leakage，即 agent 的搜索行为已经被 benchmark 名称、数据集页面、题库镜像等元信息引导到测试集相关资源上；第二类是 Question-Context Leakage，即检索结果暴露了题目的来源、上下文或近似原题，虽然未必直接给出答案，但已经显著缩小了解题空间；第三类是 Explicit Answer Leakage，即网页中直接出现标准答案或足以唯一确定答案的内容。

在方法上，作者不是训练新 agent，而是做 contamination detection 与 impact quantification。核心做法是记录 agent 的完整搜索轨迹，包括 query、访问 URL、页面内容和回合级行为，然后用检测算法在 question-level 和 turn-level 标注泄漏类型。这样可以分析：某道题是否发生污染、污染发生在第几步、发生后 agent 的行为是否从原推理轨迹切换到检索到的答案。

论文的一个重要点是把 STC 从“数据污染”区分为“推理时污染”。这不是训练集记忆问题，而是 inference-time retrieval 直接把 benchmark artifact 带回上下文。对于 deep research agent，这种污染往往比传统 benchmark contamination 更隐蔽，因为它发生在工具调用链中，而不是静态参数里。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖六个公开 benchmark，并重点分析医学和临床场景，因为这类题目在公开题库、论坛、教育网站和代码仓库中暴露度高。作者发现所有评测集都存在不同程度的 STC。文中给出的几个数字比较关键：MedMCQA 上接近四分之一的问题可以从网络上检索到答案；在 HLE 的 biological 和 chemical 子集上，STC 带来的性能抬升最高可达 4%；一旦 agent 检索到泄漏答案，不论任务本身难度如何，准确率都会迅速升到 95% 以上，并且推理轨迹会明显偏离原先路径，转而采纳泄漏答案。

作者还检查了商业系统的行为。以 Gemini Deep Research 为例，在抽样的 100 道 MedQA 题目中，agent 有 60% 的情况访问到了同时包含原题和答案的网页。这说明问题不是某个学术原型特有，而是联网 research agent 的普遍评测风险。

实验最有价值的地方不只是报告污染比例，而是把“污染发生后性能如何变化”也量化了：答案泄漏会同时带来更高准确率和更快收敛，说明它确实在替代推理，而不是仅仅提供弱提示。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看 Introduction、STC 三分类定义、检测算法描述，以及案例分析图。预计 20 分钟左右可以抓住主要结论。

阅读时建议带着两个问题看。第一，作者如何区分 metadata leakage、context leakage 和 explicit answer leakage，边界是否清楚。第二，污染检测是基于页面内容匹配、答案显式出现，还是结合了 agent 行为转折来判定。后者更重要，因为它关系到“检索到了”与“真正利用了”之间的区别。

如果只看一组实验，优先看 MedMCQA、HLE 子集和商业 agent 案例。这几部分最能说明公开 benchmark 在联网 agent 时代的脆弱性。对做训练的人来说，最后关于 sandbox、透明搜索轨迹、私有测试集和动态生成测试实例的建议也值得看，因为这些会直接影响后续 RL 或 agent tuning 的评测闭环。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies search-time contamination (STC) in deep research agents evaluated on public benchmarks. When an agent can browse the web during inference, it may retrieve benchmark metadata, question context, or even the ground-truth answer, bypassing the intended reasoning process and inflating benchmark scores.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for agent evaluation, web-enabled reasoning systems, and the reliability of post-training signals. For foundation-model researchers, the practical implication is clear: once evaluation is contaminated, model selection, RL optimization, synthetic data generation, and claims about reasoning improvement can all be distorted. Public-benchmark evaluation assumptions that were acceptable for closed-book LLMs become fragile for search-enabled agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper introduces a three-level taxonomy of STC. Benchmark Metadata Leakage refers to cases where the agent’s search is steered toward benchmark-related artifacts such as dataset pages or mirrored repositories. Question-Context Leakage refers to retrieved content that reveals the source, framing, or near-duplicate context of the benchmark item without necessarily exposing the final answer. Explicit Answer Leakage is the strongest case, where the correct answer or uniquely identifying answer evidence is directly retrieved.

Methodologically, the work is about contamination detection and impact measurement rather than building a new agent. The authors log full search trajectories, including queries, visited URLs, page contents, and turn-level behavior, and then apply detection algorithms to identify leakage at both the question level and the turn level. This allows them to ask not only whether contamination occurred, but also when it occurred and whether the agent’s reasoning trajectory shifted after the leaked evidence was observed.

A useful conceptual distinction in the paper is between training-time contamination and inference-time contamination. STC is not primarily about memorized test data inside model parameters. It is about benchmark artifacts being pulled into the context window through tool use during evaluation. That makes it especially relevant for deep research agents built on ReAct-style iterative search.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers six public benchmarks, with a strong focus on medical and clinical settings because those questions are widely exposed across educational websites, forums, repositories, and exam-prep platforms. All evaluated benchmarks show some degree of STC. Several numbers stand out. On MedMCQA, nearly one quarter of the questions have answers retrievable from the web. On the biological and chemical subsets of Humanity’s Last Exam, STC-induced score inflation reaches up to 4%. Once an explicit leaked answer is retrieved, the agent’s accuracy rises above 95% regardless of task difficulty, and its trajectory rapidly shifts away from its earlier reasoning path toward the leaked answer.

The paper also inspects commercial systems. For Gemini Deep Research, in a sample of 100 MedQA questions, the agent visited pages containing both the original question and its answer in 60% of cases. This suggests the issue is not limited to academic prototypes.

The most informative part of the experiments is not just the contamination rate, but the behavioral effect after contamination. Answer leakage leads to both higher accuracy and faster convergence, which supports the claim that retrieval is replacing reasoning rather than merely providing weak auxiliary hints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the introduction, the three-way STC taxonomy, the detection procedure, and the case studies. Around 20 minutes should be enough to capture the main contribution.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, how cleanly does the paper separate metadata leakage, context leakage, and explicit answer leakage? Second, does the detection only check whether leaked content appeared on a page, or does it also examine whether the agent’s behavior changed after retrieval? The latter matters more because seeing leaked content and actually exploiting it are not the same thing.

If you only inspect one part of the experiments, prioritize MedMCQA, the HLE subsets, and the commercial-agent examples. Those sections make the evaluation fragility most concrete. The mitigation discussion at the end—sandboxed environments, transparent search traces, private test sets, and dynamically generated evaluation instances—is also worth reading because it directly affects future RL and agent-tuning loops.

recommendation.zh: 做agent评测、基座推理能力评估的研究员必须关注这一污染问题，可复用其检测方法修正内部评测结果，重点读§3的污染分类与检测算法
recommendation.en: Researchers working on agent evaluation and LLM reasoning capability assessment must address this contamination issue; reuse its detection methods to correct internal evaluation results, focus on §3 contamination taxonomy and detection algorithms

paper.title: Beyond Ideal Instruction: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating LLMs in Realistic Interactions
paper.abstract: Despite great advances in tool-use capabilities of large language models (LLMs), existing evaluation benchmarks struggle to fully align with real-world scenarios. Such benchmarks mostly rely on simulated idealized user assumptions and lacks experience-oriented evaluation. These limitations fail to account for the ambiguity, uncooperative behaviors, and shifting intentions characteristic of real-world users. To fill this gap, we propose RUT-Bench, a dedicated benchmark designed to assess LLMs und

summary.core_problem: 现有 tool-use/agent benchmark 多建立在“理想用户”与静态交互假设上，难以覆盖真实部署中常见的含糊指令、不配合、参数编造、目标中途切换等行为，从而导致评测结果与真实用户体验脱节。论文要解决的是：如何构建一个可执行、可多轮交互、能系统覆盖非理想用户行为的工具调用评测框架，并给出不仅看任务成功率、也能反映可靠性与体验的诊断指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（不涉及数据配比、tokenizer、scaling 或训练 recipe），但对“pretrain→posttrain→agent”闭环有现实价值：它把工具调用能力的失败模式从静态正确率，推进到更接近线上分布的交互鲁棒性与体验维度。对做 agentic 数据合成、tool-use SFT/RL、以及把评测信号反哺训练的人，RUT-Bench 提供了更难被投机的目标分布与更细的错误分型。论文给出的关键结论是：在非理想用户设定下，主流模型成功率显著下滑，说明当前训练信号（多为理想指令/干净轨迹）与真实交互存在系统性分布差。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计分三块：
1) 非理想用户行为 taxonomy：从语言行为学/会话准则相关工作出发，结合真实对话日志归纳为 7 类：Ideal Rational、Underspecification（信息不足/含糊）、Information Overload（信息过载）、Fabricated Parameters（编造参数/不一致事实）、Goal Switching（目标切换）、Contradictory Constraints（矛盾约束）、Impatience and Hostility（不耐烦/敌对）。并用 WildChat 的真实交互样本做统计验证（用 GPT-5.4 标注 1000 段英文对话）。
2) 可执行的 tool-use 环境与任务：RUT-Bench 不是纯文本问答，而是包含 59 个可执行、带状态的工具环境，支持单轮与多轮对话，在同一任务骨架上注入不同用户行为扰动，使评测覆盖“理想→非理想”的分布迁移。
3) 多维度评测：以 overall task success rate 为主指标，同时增加两类诊断指标，用于刻画 response reliability 与 user experience（论文在引言中明确提出，但你给的全文片段未包含指标的精确定义公式与计算细节；精读时需要回到方法/评测章节确认其可复现性与是否会被策略性优化）。
方法取舍上，它选择“高保真用户模拟器 + 可执行环境”而不是“静态题库 + 参考答案”，目的是让模型必须在不确定性下做信息收集与策略调整，而不是匹配固定模式。
summary.experiments:
规模与设置：RUT-Bench 含 1638 个高质量测试样本，覆盖 59 个可执行工具环境，包含单轮/多轮与理想/非理想用户行为。
关键结果（论文在你提供的正文中给出的数字有限）：
- 在 19 个开源与闭源主流 LLM 上评测，所有模型 overall success rate 均低于 40%。
- 从理想用户场景切换到非理想场景时，性能“显著/剧烈”下降（原文用 drastically），表明鲁棒性不足。
- 来自 WildChat 的统计：在抽样的 1000 段英文对话中，22.6% 落入非理想类别；最常见的是 underspecification，其次是 information overload 与 fabricated parameters；goal switching 与 impatience/hostility 更偏后期多轮出现。
消融与更细粒度对比（例如：不同非理想类型分别造成的成功率下降幅度、不同模型家族的差异、以及诊断指标与成功率的相关性）在你提供的片段中未出现；如果论文正文有这些表格，它们会是判断 benchmark“是否真的提供新信息”的关键。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：中等（偏 eval/agent 方向），预计 30–45 分钟。
建议阅读路径：
- 先看 taxonomy 定义与 Figure 1：7 类非理想行为的边界是否清晰、是否可操作化生成。
- 看 WildChat 统计与标注流程（Appendix E）：尤其是用 GPT-5.4 自动标注的可靠性、提示词、以及是否有人类复核；这决定 taxonomy 与分布结论的可信度。
- 精看 RUT-Bench 构建流程（Figure 2 + Section 4）：任务生成、环境可执行性、以及多轮用户模拟器如何驱动状态变化。
- 精看评测指标定义：两类诊断指标如何计算、是否与成功率独立提供信息、是否容易被“迎合指标”的策略钻空子。
- 最后看 19 模型对比表：重点不是排名，而是失败模式是否与 taxonomy 对齐、以及理想→非理想的 drop 是否一致。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-use/agent benchmarks largely assume ideal, cooperative users and static interactions, which misses common real deployment behaviors such as underspecified requests, uncooperative turns, fabricated parameters, and goal switching. The paper targets a concrete gap: building an executable, multi-turn benchmark that systematically injects realistic non-ideal user behaviors and evaluates not only task success but also reliability and user experience under distribution shift.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper (no scaling/data/tokenizer/optimizer contributions), but it matters for the pretrain→post-train→agent loop because it sharpens the target distribution for tool-use robustness. If you do tool-use SFT/RL, trajectory synthesis, or want evaluation signals that better reflect real user interactions, RUT-Bench provides a harder and more behaviorally grounded testbed. The headline finding—mainstream models staying below 40% success and dropping sharply from ideal to non-ideal settings—suggests current training data (often clean, ideal instructions) is misaligned with real interaction dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Three main components:
1) A taxonomy of non-ideal user behaviors (7 classes): Ideal Rational, Underspecification, Information Overload, Fabricated Parameters, Goal Switching, Contradictory Constraints, and Impatience/Hostility. The taxonomy is motivated by pragmatics/speech-act style prior work and empirically checked using real chat logs.
2) An executable benchmark: 1,638 test cases across 59 stateful, runnable tool-use environments, supporting both single-turn and multi-turn dialogues. The key design choice is to evaluate agents in interactive environments with controllable user simulators rather than static prompt-answer pairs.
3) Multi-dimensional evaluation: overall task success rate plus two diagnostic metrics intended to capture response reliability and user experience. (The provided excerpt does not include the exact metric definitions; verifying their computation and robustness is essential when reading the full paper.)
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 1,638 curated samples, 59 executable environments, ideal and non-ideal user simulations, single- and multi-turn.
Main reported numbers from the excerpt:
- Evaluated 19 popular open and proprietary LLMs; all achieve <40% overall success on RUT-Bench.
- Performance degrades drastically when moving from ideal-user scenarios to realistic non-ideal settings.
- WildChat analysis: 22.6% of 1,000 sampled English dialogues fall into non-ideal categories; underspecification is most frequent, followed by information overload and fabricated parameters; goal switching and impatience/hostility appear more in later turns.
More granular breakdowns (per behavior type, per model family, and how diagnostic metrics correlate with success) are not shown in the excerpt; those tables/figures are the most important parts to validate the benchmark’s added signal.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim-level recommendation (30–45 minutes).
Focus on:
- The behavior taxonomy (Figure 1): whether categories are operational and non-overlapping.
- The WildChat labeling pipeline (Appendix E): GPT-based labeling prompts, any human verification, and potential bias.
- Benchmark construction (Figure 2 + Section 4): how environments are made executable and how user simulators drive multi-turn dynamics.
- Metric definitions for reliability/experience: check for loopholes and whether they add information beyond success rate.
- The 19-model results table: look for consistent failure patterns aligned with the taxonomy rather than leaderboard ranking.

recommendation.zh: 对 tool-use posttrain 有直接信号；只看用户行为 taxonomy 和失败分解，别只盯总分。
recommendation.en: Directly useful for tool-use post-training; read the user-behavior taxonomy and failure breakdown rather than the aggregate score.
