paper.title: K-BrowseComp: A Web Browsing Agent Benchmark Grounded in Korean Contexts
paper.abstract: Frontier model evaluations are shifting from foundational capabilities (e.g., instruction following and reasoning) toward compositional, agentic ones, but Korean agentic benchmarks remain scarce. We introduce K-BrowseComp, a web-browsing agent benchmark grounded in Korean contexts, consisting of 400 problems. The 300-problem K-BrowseComp-Verified subset is manually constructed and validated by native Korean speakers. On this subset, frontier LLMs, including GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and GLM-5.1,

summary.core_problem: 构建一个韩语语境下的 web-browsing agent benchmark，用来评估模型在本地化网页信息检索、组合推理和浏览执行中的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agentic evaluation dataset。价值主要在语言和地区语境对浏览 agent 的压力测试，而不是新的 agent 架构或训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 K-BrowseComp，共 400 道题，其中 300 道 K-BrowseComp-Verified 由韩语母语者人工构造和验证；另有 100 道 synthetic split，通过 hard few-shot exemplars 和 failure-mode-targeted generation 生成，并做 adversarial filtering。人工集和合成诊断集分开报告，以避免混淆评测来源。
summary.experiments: 在 300 题 verified subset 上，摘要称 GPT-5.5、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.1 等 frontier LLM 得分为 30.00% 到 45.67%，显著低于 BrowseComp；韩国 Proprietary AI Foundation Model program 发布的 Korean LLM 得分为 0.00% 到 10.33%。在 adversarially filtered synthetic diagnostic split 上，最强模型为 26.00%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a Korean-context web-browsing agent benchmark to evaluate localized web search, compositional reasoning, and browsing execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agentic evaluation dataset. Its main value is as a stress test for language- and region-specific browsing, not as a new agent architecture or training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-BrowseComp contains 400 problems. The 300-problem K-BrowseComp-Verified subset is manually constructed and validated by native Korean speakers. A 100-problem synthetic split is generated using hard few-shot exemplars and failure-mode-targeted generation, followed by adversarial filtering. Manual and synthetic splits are reported separately.
summary_en.experiments: On the 300-problem verified subset, the abstract reports 30.00% to 45.67% for frontier LLMs including GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and GLM-5.1, with a substantial drop from BrowseComp. Korean LLMs from Korea's Proprietary AI Foundation Model program score 0.00% to 10.33%. On the adversarially filtered synthetic diagnostic split, the strongest model reaches 26.00%.

recommendation.zh: 作为本地化 browser-agent 压测可备查；除非做多语网页评测，否则看分数表就够。
recommendation.en: Useful as a localized browser-agent stress test; unless you build multilingual web evals, the score table is enough.

paper.title: OpenSkillEval: Automatically Auditing the Open Skill Ecosystem for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Skills, i.e., structured workflow instructions distilled for large language models (LLMs), are becoming an increasingly important mechanism for improving agent performance on real-world downstream tasks. However, as the open-source skill ecosystem rapidly expands, it remains unclear how different models and agent frameworks interact with skills, how to evaluate skill quality, and how users should select skills under practical cost-performance trade-offs. In this paper, we present OpenSkillEval,

summary.core_problem: 如何自动化、可持续地评估开源“skills（面向 agent 的结构化工作流指令）”生态：既评估 skill 本身质量，也评估 skill-augmented agent 系统在真实下游应用任务中的效果与成本，并分析不同模型/框架是否真的会读取并执行 skill。
summary.importance: 这是一篇以评测资产/评测框架为核心贡献的 agent 论文，不是预训练/训练动态/数据效率方向。对基座预训练研究的直接信息增益有限；间接启发主要在“训练信号质量/对齐”层面：它揭示了在更嘈杂、更真实的上下文里，模型对外部程序化指令（skills）的遵循率并不高（文中给出平均约 48% 会显式读取 skill），说明仅靠把流程写进上下文并不能稳定改变策略。这对做 post-train（工具使用、指令遵循、过程监督）的人更相关，对 pretrain 侧更多是背景噪声与指令可达性问题的一个实证。
summary.technical_approach:
OpenSkillEval 由三部分组成：
1）自动测试用例生成：不依赖静态 benchmark，而是从不断变化的真实工件/需求中构造任务实例，覆盖五类应用（presentation、前端网页、poster、数据可视化、report）。
2）skill 收集与组织：从开源社区收集同类任务的多种 skills，按类别整理，支持持续跟踪。
3）评估流水线：同时评估最终产物质量与中间轨迹（agent 是否读取 skill、是否按步骤执行、执行成本），从而支持两种视角：agent-level（不同模型/框架+skill 的组合）与 skill-level（同任务下不同 skill 的对比）。

方法上更像“动态任务生成 + 轨迹审计”的评测 harness，而不是提出新的 agent 学习算法。
summary.experiments:
在五类应用、600+ 任务上评估多种 agent 架构，给出三条主要发现（文中有定量）：
- 在现实 skill-access 设置下，agent 平均只有约 48% 的案例会显式读取提供的 skill，且经常不忠实执行。
- 不同 agent 框架对 skill 增益差异很大；合适框架+高质量 skill 可以让较弱模型接近较强模型，但当底座模型能力不足时，skill 不能稳定带来提升。
- 开源 skill 质量参差：更“信息密度高、先验更完整”的 skill 往往能用更长输入换更好效果，但不少热门 skill 增加成本却不优于 base agent。

由于全文细节未完整给出，这里缺少：具体比较了哪些模型/框架、产物质量如何自动评分/人工评分、成本指标（token/时间/工具调用）分布、以及 skill 格式建议对应的消融证据强度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Framework 部分的任务生成与轨迹审计设计，确认它解决的是“评测可持续性”而不是单点榜单。
- 直接跳到实验结论与分析（尤其是 skill 使用率/遵循率的统计口径），再回头看它如何判定“读取 skill”“遵循 skill”。
- 如果关心对齐/指令遵循训练信号，重点看 Section 3.1/3.3 的失败案例与 skill 格式建议；如果只做预训练，可快速略过具体应用类别的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to continuously and automatically audit the open-source “skill” ecosystem for LLM agents—evaluating both skill quality and skill-augmented agent performance/cost on realistic, evolving downstream tasks, including whether agents actually read and follow the provided skills.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation framework for agents/skills rather than a pretraining or optimization contribution. The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The main transferable signal is empirical: in realistic, noisy contexts, agents often do not reliably consume or follow procedural instructions embedded as skills (reported ~48% explicit skill-reading rate on average). This is more actionable for post-training (instruction following, tool-use policies, process supervision) than for pretraining, but it does highlight that “just put the procedure in context” is an unstable control mechanism without stronger training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach:
OpenSkillEval is an evaluation harness with three components:
1) Automatic test-case generation that avoids static benchmarks by constructing task instances from evolving real-world artifacts/needs across five application categories (presentations, front-end web design, posters, data visualization, reports).
2) Skill collection/organization from the open-source community, grouped by task category to enable controlled comparisons and longitudinal tracking.
3) An evaluation pipeline that measures both final artifact quality and intermediate trajectories (whether the agent accesses/reads the skill, how faithfully it executes steps, and the incurred cost), enabling agent-level and skill-level auditing.
The contribution is methodological evaluation infrastructure rather than a new learning algorithm or architecture.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across 5 application categories and 600+ tasks, comparing multiple agent architectures/frameworks with and without skills. Key reported findings include:
- Skills are not reliably used: under a realistic skill-access setting, agents explicitly read the provided skill in ~48% of cases on average, and often do not follow it faithfully.
- Framework sensitivity: with suitable frameworks and well-designed skills, weaker base models can approach stronger ones; but when the base model is intrinsically weak, skills do not consistently help.
- Skill quality variance: richer, better-structured skills can trade more input tokens for better outcomes, while many popular skills add cost without outperforming base agents.
The excerpt does not provide the full set of numeric breakdowns (models/frameworks, scoring protocol, cost metrics), which are important to validate robustness.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the framework section to understand how tasks are generated dynamically and how trajectories are audited.
- Jump to the main empirical analyses (skill usage/following rates, framework comparisons), then backtrack to the operational definitions of “reading” and “following”.
- If your focus is alignment/post-training, spend time on the failure cases and skill-format recommendations; if you only do pretraining, you can skip most application-specific details.

recommendation.zh: 读评测构造和成本曲线即可；它适合做 agent skill 生态的审计基线，不是训练方法信号。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and cost curves; it is a useful audit baseline for agent skills, not a training-method signal.

institutions: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University

paper.title: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents: Comprehensive Evaluation with a Lightweight Framework
paper.abstract: HTML observations in LLM-based web agents are extremely long, and while many reduction methods have been proposed, it remains unclear which methods reduce overall agent latency while maintaining performance. The main obstacle is the high cost of end-to-end evaluation: in our experiments, evaluating 11 methods across 32 configurations on 33 tasks of WorkArena L1 required 232.4 cumulative hours. To address this, we propose a lightweight evaluation framework based on the Minimal Failure Set (MFS),

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 web agent 里的 observation reduction 评测问题：HTML/DOM 观察极长，大家提出了很多裁剪方法，但真正决定端到端延迟的，不只是裁剪后 token 变少，还包括裁剪步骤本身的计算开销。现有工作很难系统比较，因为完整评测太贵。作者要解决的是，能否构造一个不依赖在线环境和大模型推理、但又能可靠预测端到端成功率的轻量评测框架。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是直接一线相关，但对长上下文 agent、工具使用和评测方法有方法论启发。最有价值的点不是某个具体 web agent 技巧，而是提出了一个可离线、可并行、可作为优化目标的 proxy metric。对于做 post-train agent 数据构造、长上下文 observation 压缩、甚至训练时信息瓶颈设计的人，这种“先找任务最小必要信息，再评价压缩是否保留它”的思路是可迁移的。另一方面，这篇文章也提醒一个常见误区：减少输入 token 不等于减少系统延迟，reduction method 自身的 latency 可能把收益吃掉。
summary.technical_approach:
核心概念是 Minimal Failure Set，简称 MFS。作者从成功轨迹出发，对某一步 HTML observation 中的元素信息做干预删除，寻找“最小的、删掉就会导致任务失败的信息集合”。HTML 元素被拆成更细粒度的 (element id, attr) 单元，attr 可以是具体属性、@tag，或者 @text。这样 MFS 不只是“哪个节点重要”，而是能区分文本内容、标签类型、属性值各自的重要性。

在有了每一步的 MFS 之后，作者定义 coverage：某个 reduction method 是否完整保留了该步 MFS；在数据集上统计比例，作为端到端 success rate 的 proxy。这个设计的关键优点是，一旦 MFS 预先构造完成，后续评测不需要 web access，也不需要 policy model inference，每个样本还能独立并行评估，因此成本远低于真实 rollout。

作者用这个框架系统比较了 11 类 reduction 方法，包括程序启发式、retrieval-based、LLM inference-based 和 accessibility tree 等。然后基于 coverage 这个目标，用 GEPA 这样的 LLM evolutionary optimization 方法，在 benchmark-specific 的 MFS 训练集上自动优化 pruning program。这里的结论也很明确：通用方法里，LLM-based reduction 覆盖率更高，但延迟太大；真正能把总延迟降下来的是针对 benchmark 特征做程序级定制优化。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不在于提出一个更强 agent，而在于验证 coverage 这个 proxy 是否可信，以及不同 reduction 方法在“保性能”和“降延迟”之间的真实取舍。

1. 评测成本方面，作者给出一个很具体的数字：在 WorkArena L1 上，用 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 评估 11 种方法、32 个配置、33 个任务，累计需要 232.4 小时。这就是他们提出轻量框架的直接动机。

2. proxy 有效性方面，作者在 WorkArena L1 和 WebLinx 上验证 coverage 与端到端 success rate 强相关，并声称累计评测时间可获得超过 100 倍加速。这个结果如果成立，意味着很多 observation reduction 的研究以后可以先离线筛选，再做少量真实 rollout 验证。

3. 方法比较方面，作者发现 LLM inference-based 方法在激进压缩下 coverage 明显优于 retrieval-based 方法，但 reduction 自身 latency 很高，因此未必带来更低的整体 step latency。这个结论很重要，因为它把“压得更准”和“系统更快”区分开了。

4. benchmark 差异方面，WebLinx 更依赖 text content，而 WorkArena L1 更依赖 HTML tags 和 attributes。也就是说，什么信息是任务关键，不同环境差异很大，通用 reduction policy 很难同时做好。

5. 优化结果方面，作者用 GEPA 在各 benchmark 的 MFS 训练数据上优化 pruning program。端到端评测里，WorkArena L1 达到 2.2 倍更快的 per-step latency，同时保留原始成功率的 84%；WebLinx 达到 3.1 倍更快，同时保留 89%。这说明 benchmark-specific program optimization 比昂贵的通用 LLM reducer 更有现实性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看方法定义，再看相关性验证和最终 latency-success tradeoff 图。

第一，重点看 MFS 的形式化定义，尤其是 HTML element 被拆成 (i, attr) 粒度这一点。它决定了这个框架为什么能分析“文本重要还是属性重要”，而不只是做粗粒度节点删除。

第二，看 coverage 与 end-to-end success 的相关性图表。这部分决定整个框架是否站得住。如果相关性只在单一 benchmark 上成立，价值会小很多；作者这里至少在 WorkArena L1 和 WebLinx 两个环境上做了验证。

第三，看 11 类 reduction 方法的 latency 与 coverage/成功率对比，以及 GEPA 优化后的 pruning program 结果。这里能直接看出作者真正想表达的结论：便宜、快、稳的 reduction 往往需要 domain-specific program，而不是更重的 LLM selector。

如果只想抓住主要信息，读 Introduction、MFS 定义、相关性验证、Figure 1 和最终优化结果，大约 25 分钟。若要深挖，可以继续看 MFS 构造过程中的 intervention 细节，以及不同 benchmark 上关键属性类型分布的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation bottleneck in web-agent observation reduction. HTML observations are extremely long, many reduction methods have been proposed, but it is still unclear which ones actually reduce end-to-end latency once the cost of the reduction step itself is included. Full online evaluation is too expensive to support systematic comparison. The paper asks whether one can build an offline proxy that predicts task success well enough to compare and optimize reduction methods without repeated web rollouts and LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-context agents, tool-use systems, and evaluation methodology. The useful idea is the proxy design: identify the minimal task-critical information and score a reduction method by whether it preserves that information. That pattern is transferable to observation compression, post-training data construction, and information-bottleneck design for agent systems. It also highlights an important systems lesson: fewer input tokens do not automatically mean lower latency, because the reduction procedure itself may dominate runtime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central concept is the Minimal Failure Set (MFS). Starting from successful trajectories, the authors intervene on a given HTML observation by removing pieces of information and asking which minimal subset causes the task to fail when removed. HTML is decomposed into fine-grained units of the form (element id, attr), where attr can be a concrete attribute, @tag, or @text. This is more informative than node-level ablation because it separates the role of text content, tag identity, and attribute values.

Once an MFS is constructed for each step, the paper defines coverage: whether a reduction method fully retains the MFS for that instance, aggregated over the dataset. Coverage is proposed as a proxy for end-to-end success rate. The practical advantage is large: after MFS construction, evaluation requires neither web access nor policy-model inference, and instances can be scored independently in parallel.

Using this framework, the authors compare 11 classes of reduction methods, including heuristic pruning, retrieval-based selection, LLM-guided selection, and accessibility-tree variants. They then use coverage as an optimization objective and apply GEPA, an LLM-based evolutionary optimization framework, to learn benchmark-specific pruning programs. The resulting message is fairly clear: generic LLM-based reducers can preserve more critical information, but their own latency is often too high; benchmark-specific program optimization is a better route if the goal is lower total step latency.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on validating coverage as a proxy and quantifying the real trade-off between preservation quality and latency.

1. The motivation is backed by a concrete cost number: on WorkArena L1, evaluating 11 methods across 32 configurations and 33 tasks with Qwen3.5-122B-A10B took 232.4 cumulative hours. That makes exhaustive end-to-end comparison impractical.

2. On both WorkArena L1 and WebLinx, coverage is shown to correlate strongly with end-to-end success rate, while enabling more than 100x speedup in cumulative evaluation time. If this correlation is robust, it makes offline screening of reduction methods much more feasible.

3. In the method comparison, LLM inference-based reducers achieve higher coverage than retrieval-based methods, especially under aggressive reduction, but they incur substantially higher latency. So better reduction quality does not necessarily translate into lower system latency.

4. The paper also finds benchmark-specific differences in what information matters: text content is more critical on WebLinx, whereas HTML tags and attributes matter more on WorkArena L1. This explains why a single generic reduction policy may not transfer well.

5. Using GEPA to optimize pruning programs on benchmark-specific MFS training data, the authors report 2.2x faster per-step latency on WorkArena L1 while retaining 84% of the original success rate, and 3.1x faster on WebLinx while retaining 89%. That is a meaningful systems result: tailored pruning programs can outperform heavier generic reducers when total latency is the target.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on the formal definition of MFS, the validation of coverage, and the final latency-versus-success comparisons.

First, read the MFS construction carefully, especially the decision to ablate at the (element id, attr) level rather than at the whole-node level. That is what enables the paper to analyze whether text, tags, or attributes are the critical information carriers.

Second, inspect the plots or tables showing the correlation between coverage and end-to-end success on WorkArena L1 and WebLinx. That is the core validity check for the whole framework.

Third, read the comparison of the 11 reduction methods and the GEPA-optimized pruning results. Those sections contain the main practical conclusion: if the objective is lower total latency, benchmark-specific pruning programs are often more effective than expensive LLM-based selectors.

A 20–25 minute read covering the introduction, MFS definition, correlation results, Figure 1, and the final optimization results is enough to capture the main contribution. If you want more depth, look into the intervention procedure used to construct MFS and the analysis of which attribute types dominate on each benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 做 web/GUI agent 的应读：把“输入压缩”评测从昂贵 rollout 里拆出来很干净；只看 MFS 定义与相关性验证就够。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for web/GUI agents: it cleanly decouples input-compression evaluation from expensive rollouts; focus on the MFS definition and the coverage–success correlation.

paper.title: MINDGAMES: A Live Arena for Evaluating Social and Strategic Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as interactive agents, yet their capacity for social and strategic reasoning over extended interaction remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations rely on static vignettes or single-game benchmarks that cannot capture the sustained, multi-faceted reasoning that real-world multi-agent settings demand. We introduce Mindgames, a multi-game arena and evaluation platform for LLM agents that operationalizes complementary reasoning demands rele

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的核心问题，是如何系统评估多智能体 LLM 在真实交互中的社会推理与策略推理能力，而不是只看静态问答式 theory-of-mind 测试。作者认为，现有 false-belief 或单轮博弈评测过于脚本化，无法测到长期互动中的信念跟踪、对手建模、欺骗、协作、承诺一致性等能力，也很难区分“真的会推理”与“只是没犯格式错误”。因此他们构建一个 live arena，把多种文本游戏统一到同一评测协议下，并进一步审计 leaderboard 的测量有效性，分析排名到底反映了策略能力，还是反映了对环境错误和对手失误的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是训练方法论文，但它属于比较扎实的 eval 资产。价值主要在两层。第一，它提供了一个规模较大的交互式多智能体评测平台和轨迹数据集，适合研究 in-context opponent modeling、长期状态跟踪、social reasoning failure、agent memory 设计等问题。第二，它没有停留在“搭 benchmark”，而是认真讨论了评测信号是否可信，尤其指出某些环境里 leaderboard 可能被 error-survival confound 污染：排名高不一定因为策略更好，也可能因为更少犯非法动作、或者更能从对手崩溃中获利。这个视角对 agent eval 很重要，因为很多在线竞技 benchmark 都有类似问题，只是没有被明确拆开。对做 agent 或 post-train 的人，这篇文章更像一套评测基础设施加测量学提醒，而不是能力结论本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者基于 TextArena 搭了统一的 text-only 多智能体评测框架。环境是一个带隐藏状态的确定性 simulator，按 gym 风格给当前行动者渲染 observation，接收文本 action，再推进状态并在终局给 reward。MindGames 选了四类游戏，覆盖不同的信息结构和激励结构：Colonel Blotto 测 hidden information 下的对手建模；Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma 测沟通、信任与背叛；Codenames 测受限通信下的协作推理；Secret Mafia 测部分可观测条件下的持续欺骗与社会推断。评测协议采用在线 matchmaking 和 TrueSkill rating，并完整记录 turn-level trajectory。除了线上竞技，作者还构建了 MG-Ref，即一个冻结的 reference pool，配合确定性的离线 tournament protocol，让新 agent 可以离线对战并得到与主榜兼容的 TrueSkill 和错误归因指标。论文另一个技术重点是 measurement audit：他们不只报分数，还分析 invalid actions、forfeit 机制、角色不平衡、metric disagreement、行为多样性等因素如何影响排名解释。这使它更像一个“评测系统设计”工作，而不只是游戏集合。
summary.experiments: 规模上，NeurIPS 2025 这一轮评测共收到 944 个 agent 提交，来自 76 个团队；总计 29,571 局游戏，243M tokens，形成 94,132 条 player trajectories。赛道分为 Social Deduction Track 和 Generalization Track，并区分 Unlimited 与 Efficient（≤9B open-weight）两个组别。论文的实验重点不是比较某个模型赢了多少，而是分析不同环境的评测可靠性。作者发现 IPD 和 Colonel Blotto 的信号相对更可解释，Codenames 的成绩混合了策略能力与避免错误的能力，而 Secret Mafia 存在明显的 error-survival confound：排名可能更多反映谁更不容易因规则错误出局、或谁更能利用对手失误，而不完全是社会推理更强。文章还总结了高分系统的常见设计模式，包括结构化 prompting、显式 memory、代码执行或状态机辅助等，同时归纳了常见失败：规则遵守差、状态跟踪断裂、credit assignment 不稳。给出的核心结果不是单一数字提升，而是说明不同游戏对“社会推理”的测量纯度差异很大，不能把一个总榜分数直接当成 theory-of-mind 能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Benchmark Design，弄清四个游戏各自测什么能力，以及为什么需要 live arena 而不是静态题库。然后直接看 measurement audit 相关章节，这是文章最有信息量的部分：作者如何分析 invalid action、forfeit、error attribution、metric disagreement，以及为什么 Secret Mafia 的榜单解释要格外谨慎。若你关心数据资产，再看数据集统计和 MG-Ref 离线协议，理解它如何支持可复现实验。若你关心 agent 方法，可浏览 top submissions 的设计模式总结，但这部分更偏经验归纳。预计 25–40 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你在做 multi-agent eval 或 online arena，值得把附录里的赛制细节和 error columns 定义也看一下。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmark design problem: how to evaluate social and strategic reasoning in multi-agent LLM systems under live interaction, rather than through static theory-of-mind prompts or single-turn game tasks. The authors argue that many existing evaluations are too scripted to capture belief tracking, opponent modeling, deception, cooperation, and long-horizon adaptation. They therefore build a live arena with multiple text-based games under a unified protocol, and, importantly, they study whether leaderboard outcomes actually measure strategic reasoning or are confounded by rule-following failures and environment-specific error dynamics.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, this is an evaluation infrastructure paper rather than a training-method paper, but it is a useful one. Its value comes from two places. First, it provides a reasonably large interactive trajectory dataset and a standardized arena for studying multi-agent reasoning, memory, adaptation, and social interaction. Second, it treats evaluation validity as a first-class issue. The paper shows that leaderboard scores in interactive environments can be distorted by error-survival effects, invalid actions, and role-dependent artifacts. That matters because many agent benchmarks implicitly assume that a higher win rate means better reasoning, when in practice it may partly reflect robustness to formatting mistakes or the ability to benefit from opponent failures. The paper is therefore more useful as a measurement and benchmark-design contribution than as a statement about which model family is best.
summary_en.technical_approach: MindGames is built on TextArena, a text-only multi-agent environment with a gym-style interaction loop. A deterministic simulator maintains hidden state, renders an observation for the current player, receives a textual action, updates the state, and returns terminal rewards. The benchmark includes four games chosen to span different information and incentive structures: Colonel Blotto for hidden-information opponent modeling, Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma for trust and betrayal under communication, Codenames for cooperative inference with constrained signaling, and Secret Mafia for deception and social deduction under partial observability. Evaluation is conducted through online matchmaking with TrueSkill ratings and full trajectory logging. Beyond the live arena, the paper introduces MG-Ref, a frozen reference pool of selected submissions plus a deterministic offline tournament protocol, so new agents can be rated offline with metrics compatible with the main benchmark. A major technical contribution is the measurement audit: the authors analyze invalid actions, forfeits, role balancing, metric disagreement, and behavioral diversity to determine when rankings are interpretable as strategic competence and when they are not.
summary_en.experiments: The NeurIPS 2025 competition cycle collected 944 agent submissions from 76 teams, producing 29,571 games, 243M tokens, and 94,132 player trajectories. The competition was split into a Social Deduction Track and a Generalization Track, each with Unlimited and Efficient (<= 9B open-weight) divisions. The main empirical contribution is not a model comparison table but an evaluation audit across environments. The paper finds that IPD and Colonel Blotto provide relatively interpretable signals, Codenames mixes strategic quality with error avoidance, and Secret Mafia suffers from a pronounced error-survival confound, where rankings can reflect robustness to failures or the ability to exploit opponent breakdowns as much as genuine strategic reasoning. The authors also summarize recurring design patterns among strong submissions, including structured prompting, explicit memory, and code or state-tracking support, and they document common failure modes such as poor rule adherence, broken state tracking, and weak credit assignment. The key result is that benchmark reliability varies substantially by environment, so a single aggregate leaderboard should not be read as a clean measure of social reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and benchmark design to understand why the four games were chosen and what each is intended to probe. Then go straight to the evaluation-validity analysis. That is the most informative part of the paper: it explains how invalid actions, forfeits, and metric choices change the meaning of the leaderboard, and why Secret Mafia in particular needs careful interpretation. If you care about reusable assets, read the dataset statistics and the MG-Ref offline protocol. If you care about agent design, the section summarizing top-submission patterns is useful but more descriptive than methodological. A solid skim should take around 25–40 minutes. If you are building multi-agent benchmarks or online arenas, the appendix details on tournament logistics and error-attribution columns are worth checking.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测里少见地重视长程互动轨迹；读平台设计和日志 schema，别只看榜单分数。
recommendation.en: A rare agent benchmark that takes long-horizon interaction traces seriously; read the platform design and logging schema, not just the leaderboard.

paper.title: Redundant or Necessary? A Benchmark for Detecting Redundant Steps in Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. However, existing evaluation protocols primarily focus on task success, overlooking a critical aspect of agent behavior: execution efficiency. In practice, agent trajectories often contain redundant steps that consume substantial resources while contributing little to task completion. In this work, we propose and formulate a new research area: \textbf{redundant step detectio

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent评估协议仅关注任务成功率，完全忽略执行效率维度。已有的粗粒度效率指标（延迟、token消耗、步长）无法识别轨迹中消耗资源但对任务完成无实质贡献的冗余步骤，也没有专门的基准支撑细粒度冗余步骤检测的研究与评估。
summary.importance: 填补了Agent轨迹细粒度步骤价值评估的空白。对于预训练研究，该基准可用于筛选高质量Agent轨迹训练数据，避免模型在SFT/RL阶段学习冗余推理模式，也可支撑Agent推理效率优化、降低部署成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RedundancyBench基准，包含200条完整Agent轨迹共8000余步，每一步通过多轮标注流程标记为冗余或必要。配套设计两级评估指标：面向粗粒度的轨迹级得分，以及面向细粒度检测能力的步骤级得分。在基准上测试了3种代表性的冗余步骤检测方法。
summary.experiments: 现有方法在该任务上表现普遍较差：性能最好的方法步骤级得分仅为24.88%，部分方法表现甚至不如随机猜测，说明冗余步骤检测难度较高，现有方案远未达到可用水平。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题定义、基准构建与标注流程章节、实验部分的不同方法性能对比。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent evaluation protocols only focus on task success rate and ignore execution efficiency. Existing coarse-grained efficiency metrics (latency, token consumption, step length) cannot identify redundant steps in agent trajectories that consume computing resources but contribute nothing to task completion, and no dedicated benchmark supports research and evaluation of fine-grained redundant step detection.
summary_en.importance: This work fills the gap in fine-grained value evaluation of agent trajectory steps. For pretraining research, the benchmark can be used to filter high-quality agent trajectory training data, prevent models from learning redundant reasoning patterns during SFT/RL, and support optimization of agent inference efficiency to reduce deployment costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose RedundancyBench, which contains 200 complete agent trajectories with over 8,000 total steps. Each step is labeled as redundant or necessary through a multi-round annotation process. Two levels of evaluation metrics are provided: coarse-grained trajectory-level score and fine-grained step-level detection score. 3 representative redundant step detection methods are evaluated on the benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Existing methods perform poorly on this task: the best-performing method only achieves 24.88% step-level score, while some methods perform worse than random guessing. The results indicate that redundant step detection is highly challenging and existing solutions are far from usable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition in Introduction, the benchmark construction and annotation pipeline section, and the performance comparison of different methods in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“agent 走冤枉路”做成可评测资产是对的；只需看任务定义与标注协议，24.88% 这个下限可当效率研究的 sanity check。
recommendation.en: Good move to turn “wasted agent steps” into a measurable asset; read mainly the task/labeling protocol—24.88% is a useful lower bound sanity check for efficiency work.

paper.title: TraceGraph: Shared Decision Landscapes for Diagnosing and Improving Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks increasingly record rich interaction trajectories, yet evaluation often reduces each rollout to a pass rate or reward score. We introduce TraceGraph, a graph-based framework that turns released multi-model agent trajectories into shared decision landscapes. For each task, TraceGraph builds a graph over observable action-observation states from pooled rollouts before model identity is introduced. It then overlays outcome-informed productive cores and trap regions, and summarizes

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agent 评测里的一个老问题：同一个 benchmark 上，几个模型的 pass rate 可能差不多，但它们走过的轨迹、踩过的坑、恢复方式完全不同。只看最终成功率，无法知道 benchmark 奖励的到底是“少犯错”、还是“犯错后能修回来”，也无法知道模型失败发生在什么决策区域。作者想建立一个共享的过程坐标系，把不同模型、不同 rollout 放到同一张 task-specific decision landscape 上，再用这张图诊断 agent 的导航风格和 benchmark 的过程需求。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接关系不强，但对 post-train、agent 训练和评测设计有现实意义。它的价值不在提出新的 agent 架构，而在于把 trajectory log 从“事后可视化材料”变成“可比较、可统计、可干预”的结构化对象。对于做 RL、tool-use SFT、agent data filtering 的人，这种过程级分析框架有启发：如果 benchmark 的难点主要来自 trap recovery，而训练数据只奖励一次性成功，那么模型学到的策略会偏。对预训练研究员而言，更多是接口层价值，而不是基座训练方法价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 TraceGraph。作者先把多模型 rollout 中每一步的 action-observation state 编码成稀疏的 observable key，不引入模型身份，只保留可观测决策痕迹。然后用 IDF-weighted Jaccard similarity 计算状态相似度，在 pooled rollouts 上构建 mutual-kNN graph。图建好后，再做结构分解，例如双连通分量（BCCs）和 articulation gates，用来识别图中的稳定区域与关键转折点。

接下来作者用终局 outcome 给图做后验标注，而不是在建图时就把成功/失败信息混进去。这样得到两类区域：productive cores 和 trap regions。前者是高成功 rollout 反复经过的共享区域，后者是与失败强相关、且会吸附轨迹的区域。基于这些 overlay，每条 rollout 被压缩成三个事件：Access，是否到达 productive core；Trap exposure，是否进入 trap；Repair，进入 trap 后是否又回到 core。这个设计很克制，它不试图重建 agent 的全部 reasoning，而是只保留最能解释 benchmark 过程需求的三个统计量。

论文还把这个分析框架往在线干预推进了一步。在 SWE-bench 上，作者用 graph-derived trap 做 runtime trigger：当 live trajectory 进入历史高风险区域时，系统从该前缀 fork 出若干 continuation，并施加轻量恢复策略，例如加入保守的 diagnosis note 或提高 temperature，让 agent 从同一状态尝试不同恢复路径。这里的重点不是 recovery policy 本身多复杂，而是证明图上定义的 trap 不是纯事后解释，它可以转成运行时信号。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个 benchmark splits、7329 条轨迹、427 个任务、5 个模型。主结果不是单一分数，而是过程画像。作者展示：即便几个模型的 aggregate score 只差几个点，它们在共享图上的行为也可能明显不同，有的偏向广泛探索但具备 repair 能力，有的更擅长浅层避坑，有的更容易进入 productive core 但 trap exposure 也更高。换句话说，benchmark 之间奖励的能力并不相同，有些更看重 trap avoidance，有些更看重 trap recovery。

在线干预部分选在 SWE-bench，因为作者认为这个 benchmark 的 Repair demand 最明显。基于 TraceGraph 的 trap-aware prefix-fork pipeline，在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 实例上测试。最佳 pooled policy 在 per-provider fired subset 上把 resolved rate 提高了 +3.1 个点，p=0.016；在 common-fired instances 上提高 +3.8 个点，p=0.045。这个量级不算大，但说明 trap overlay 至少有可操作性，而不是只会做事后解释。论文还提到 active component differs by provider，意味着不同模型供应商的 agent 失败模式并不一致，统一 recovery 策略未必最优。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议把它当评测方法论文，而不是 agent 方法论文。阅读顺序可以这样安排：
1. 先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 shared decision landscape 的输入、建图方式和三类事件定义。
2. 再看方法部分里 state encoding、IDF-weighted Jaccard、mutual-kNN graph、BCC / articulation gate 的定义。这里决定图是否真的能对齐不同模型轨迹。
3. 接着看五个 benchmark split 的过程画像，重点不是谁分数高，而是哪些 benchmark 更奖励 avoidance，哪些更奖励 repair。
4. 最后看 SWE-bench 的在线恢复实验，判断 trap detector 的 precision/coverage 是否足够支撑运行时干预。

预计 25 分钟左右可以读完主线。如果只关心是否值得纳入自己的 agent eval 工具链，重点看三件事：状态表示是否通用、图构建是否稳定、以及 trap-triggered intervention 的收益是否超过简单多采样。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a process-evaluation gap in agent benchmarks. Two models can have nearly identical pass rates while following very different trajectories, failing in different regions, and recovering in different ways. Aggregate success metrics therefore hide what a benchmark is actually rewarding: avoiding bad states, repairing after entering them, or simply reaching productive regions early. TraceGraph aims to build a shared task-level coordinate system so trajectories from different models can be compared as movement over the same decision landscape.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, and its direct relevance to base-model training is limited. Its value is at the pretrain–posttrain interface: it turns released trajectory logs into structured objects for diagnosis, comparison, and intervention. That matters for agent RL, tool-use SFT, trajectory filtering, and benchmark design. If a benchmark mainly rewards recovery from traps but the training setup only rewards one-shot success, the learned policy can be misaligned with the benchmark’s actual process demands. For a pretraining researcher, the paper is useful mainly as an evaluation and data-analysis tool rather than as a modeling contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TraceGraph has a clear pipeline.

First, each action–observation step in a rollout is encoded into a sparse observable signature. Model identity is intentionally excluded at this stage so that the graph is built from shared external behavior rather than from model-specific metadata. Similarity between states is computed using IDF-weighted Jaccard, which gives more weight to rarer, more informative observable features. Using pooled trajectories from multiple models, the method constructs a mutual-kNN graph over these states.

Second, the graph is structurally decomposed using tools such as biconnected components and articulation gates. This gives a task-specific topology with stable regions and bottlenecks. Only after the graph is built does the method overlay outcome information. Successful trajectories define productive cores; failure-associated recurring regions define traps. This separation is important: the graph is meant to be a shared descriptive map first, not a supervised predictor from the start.

Third, each rollout is summarized by three events: Access, whether it reaches a productive core; Trap exposure, whether it enters a trap region; and Repair, whether it returns from a trap to a core. This is a deliberately compact process profile. Instead of reconstructing all reasoning details, the paper keeps the smallest set of events that can explain benchmark-specific process demands.

The paper then uses the same trap overlay for online intervention. On SWE-bench, when a live trajectory enters a historically risky region, the system triggers a prefix-fork recovery pipeline. Continuations resume from the same state with lightweight modifications such as a conservative diagnosis note or a temperature bump. The point is not that the recovery policy is sophisticated; the point is that graph-derived traps are actionable enough to support runtime control.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans five benchmark splits, 7,329 trajectories, 427 tasks, and five models. The main result is qualitative but operationally meaningful: models with similar aggregate scores can exhibit very different navigation styles on the shared graph. Some explore broadly and rely on repair, some avoid traps early but access productive cores less often, and some reach productive regions frequently while also exposing themselves to more traps. This shows that benchmark scores alone do not reveal what process a benchmark rewards.

The intervention experiment focuses on SWE-bench because it shows the clearest positive demand for Repair. Using the TraceGraph-derived trap detector as a runtime trigger, the trap-aware prefix-fork pipeline is tested on all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances. The best pooled policy improves resolved rate by +3.1 points on the per-provider fired subset (p=0.016) and by +3.8 points on common-fired instances (p=0.045). The gains are modest, but they matter because they demonstrate that the trap regions are not merely post-hoc explanations; they can support online recovery. The paper also notes that the effective recovery component differs by provider, suggesting provider-specific failure modes rather than a single universal repair strategy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as an evaluation-method paper, not as a new agent architecture paper.
1. Start with Figures 1 and 2. They explain the shared decision landscape idea, the graph construction pipeline, and the three rollout events.
2. Then read the state encoding and graph-building details: observable keys, IDF-weighted Jaccard, mutual-kNN, and the BCC / articulation-gate decomposition. These choices determine whether trajectories from different models are aligned in a meaningful way.
3. Next, inspect the benchmark-level process profiles. The useful question is not which model ranks first, but which benchmarks reward trap avoidance versus trap recovery.
4. Finish with the SWE-bench intervention section. That part tells you whether the trap detector has enough precision and coverage to justify runtime use.

A focused read should take about 25 minutes. If you are deciding whether this belongs in your own agent-eval stack, concentrate on three things: the generality of the state representation, the stability of the graph construction, and whether trap-triggered recovery beats simpler alternatives such as extra sampling.

recommendation.zh: 提供了超越聚合通过率的Agent细粒度评测思路，重点看第3章的状态图构建和事件定义方法
recommendation.en: Provides a fine-grained agent evaluation approach beyond aggregate pass rates; focus on the state graph construction and event definition methods in Chapter 3

paper.title: unix-ctf: Procedural Environments for Unix-Competence Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Unix competence is the ability to use shell and operating-system primitives as first-class tools, not merely to write programs through a terminal. Current terminal benchmarks tend to blur this distinction: a solver fluent in Python but weak in Unix can pass a substantial fraction of Terminal-Bench 2.0, while the reverse skill profile is rarely exercised. We make the distinction operational and build a training surface for the Unix component. unix-ctf is a procedural generator of capture-the-flag

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个专门针对 Unix 命令行技能（而非通用编程能力）的强化学习环境和评测基准？
summary.importance: 指出了现有 Terminal Benchmark 无法有效区分 Python 编程能力和纯 Unix 命令行技能的问题，并提供了一个程序化生成的 CTF（Capture-The-Flag）环境，填补了这一细分评测/训练数据的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 开发了 `unix-ctf`，一个程序化生成 shell 代理 CTF 任务的系统。利用 LLM 辅助合成 pipeline 生成隐藏技术，将其重写为参数化的“隐藏-寻找”脚本对，并通过双向契约（隐藏脚本不能在磁盘留下明文，寻找脚本必须能恢复 flag）进行过滤，确保任务的有效性。
summary.experiments: 构建了包含多种 Unix 特性的任务生成器，为强化学习代理提供纯粹的 Unix 技能训练和测试环境。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自独立研究团队或未明确标注知名机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a reinforcement learning environment and benchmark specifically targeting Unix command-line skills, distinct from general programming abilities?
summary_en.importance: Identifies the issue that existing Terminal Benchmarks fail to effectively distinguish between Python programming skills and pure Unix command-line competence, and provides a procedurally generated CTF environment to fill this gap in evaluation/training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops `unix-ctf`, a procedural generator for shell agent CTF tasks. Uses an LLM-assisted synthesis pipeline to generate hiding techniques, rewrites them into parameterized hide-and-find script pairs, and filters them with a bidirectional contract (hide script leaves no plaintext, find script recovers the flag) to ensure task validity.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed a task generator covering various Unix features, providing a pure Unix skill training and testing environment for RL agents.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from independent research teams or institutions are not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 通过 LLM 合成双向契约数据来解耦评测维度的思路很干净，对构建特定技能的 RL 训练环境有启发，可快速浏览其数据合成 pipeline。
recommendation.en: The idea of decoupling evaluation dimensions via LLM-synthesized bidirectional contract data is clean and inspiring for building specific-skill RL environments; skim its data synthesis pipeline.

paper.title: Honest Lying: Understanding Memory Confabulation in Reflexive Agents
paper.abstract: Reflexion-style agents rely on self-generated reflections as memory, implicitly assuming that agents can accurately diagnose their own failures. We show that this assumption can fail systematically: across ALFWorld and HumanEval, agents store confident but incorrect interpretations of the task and continue acting on them across trials, even though the environment resets to the correct task each time. We call this failure mode memory confabulation and introduce the Reflection Repetition Rate (RRR

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 Reflexion 一类“把失败后的自然语言反思写入记忆，再在后续 trial 里检索使用”的 agent 机制，在什么条件下会系统性失效。作者指出，问题不只是单次 hallucination，而是更危险的 memory confabulation：模型会对失败原因做出自信但错误的解释，把错误解释写进 memory，之后反复检索、反复执行，并在新的反思里继续强化同一错误。环境每次 reset 都会重新给出正确任务描述，但 agent 仍被自己写下的错误记忆牵着走。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何定义、检测并验证这种“自我诊断写错后长期污染上下文”的失败模式，以及它何时会从无害噪声变成实质性的性能伤害。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对 post-train agent memory 设计、训练信号质量、以及“语言化自监督能否可靠替代显式反馈”这个问题有直接启发。价值主要有三点。第一，它把反思式 agent 的失败从泛泛的 hallucination 讨论，推进到可操作的多轮记忆污染分析，这对做长期记忆、continual interaction、self-improvement 的人很有参考意义。第二，它说明当反馈只有 binary pass/fail，而任务又需要多步因果归因时，开放式自然语言自诊断很容易学到伪因果解释；这和 RL、RLAIF、过程监督里“弱反馈导致错误 credit assignment”是同一类问题。第三，它给出一个很朴素但有效的替代方向：不要让模型自由编造失败原因，而是从 trajectory 中程序化抽取更接近环境事实的失败信号。这个结论对 agent memory、tool-use、甚至训练数据合成都有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是定义。作者把 confabulated reflection 操作化为：反思文本没有提到当前任务的正确 target object。这个定义在 ALFWorld 里可由 gamefile 名称直接恢复目标对象，因此可以从现有日志自动判定，不依赖人工标注。第二层是诊断指标。作者提出 Reflection Repetition Rate, RRR，用字符串相似度统计后续 reflection 中有多少是对先前 reflection 的近重复；阈值设为 0.85，相似反思比例达到 0.5 以上就视为 frozen reflective memory。这个指标不是判断“内容对不对”，而是判断记忆是否停止更新、开始循环复读。第三层是因果验证与缓解。作者把高 RRR 环境再区分为 memory-harmful 和 task-hard：如果去掉 memory 后任务更快能解，说明反思记忆在主动误导；如果去掉 memory 仍解不出来，则更多是能力缺口。缓解方法不是继续优化 prompt，而是用 programmatic feedback extraction 替换开放式 self-diagnosis：从轨迹里解析可验证的失败信号，例如动作是否无效、是否未与正确对象交互、是否在错误容器上操作等，再把这些结构化线索转成更受约束的反馈文本。和原始 Reflexion 相比，区别不在于多加一个 critic，而在于把“失败解释权”从自由生成转向环境约束更强的轨迹解析，减少伪因果叙事进入长期记忆。
summary.experiments: 实验主要覆盖 ALFWorld 和 HumanEval 两个域。最关键的发现来自 ALFWorld：作者识别出 16 个 frozen environments，在这些环境里总计 121 条 reflection 中，0 条提到正确 target object，说明错误诊断不是偶发，而是持续性偏航。RRR 与 trials-to-solve 的相关系数达到 r=0.808，说明“反思复读”与求解困难高度相关。作者还做了 no-memory ablation，证明在部分环境中，去掉 reflective memory 反而能解出任务，说明 memory 不是没帮助，而是在主动施加错误先验。缓解实验里，programmatic feedback extraction 把正确对象提及率从 0% 提升到 86%，RRR 从 0.64 降到 0.10，并在 16 个冻结环境中额外解决了 3 个。HumanEval 侧也观察到 4 个类似案例：模型会在多次尝试中重复近乎相同但错误的失败解释。论文的实验重点不是追求总体 pass rate，而是用日志级证据证明一种结构性失败模式，并用消融说明伤害来自 memory 写入机制，而不只是底模能力不足。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，抓住作者区分 hallucination 与 memory confabulation 的定义，这决定了整篇文章的分析对象。然后重点看 RRR 的定义和 frozen environment 的判定方式，理解它为什么是一个“日志可计算”的诊断量，而不是主观案例分析。实验部分建议优先看 ALFWorld 的 case studies、RRR 与 trials-to-solve 的相关图、以及 no-memory ablation，因为这些最能说明“错误反思会被写进未来上下文并持续伤害”。最后看 mitigation 部分，注意 programmatic feedback extraction 不是更强的语言反思，而是更受环境约束的反馈抽取。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你在做 agent memory 或 self-improvement，值得把附录里的 frozen cases 和 reflection 样例也翻一下，看看错误是如何一步步固化的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in Reflexion-style agents that store self-generated natural-language reflections as memory across repeated trials. The central issue is not a one-off hallucination, but a persistent memory confabulation loop: after failure, the agent writes a confident but incorrect explanation of what went wrong, stores it, retrieves it in later attempts, and keeps acting on that false diagnosis even though the environment resets and re-presents the correct task each time. The paper asks how to define this failure mode operationally, detect it from logs, and separate cases where reflective memory is merely unhelpful from cases where it is actively harmful.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface because it exposes a broader issue: weak feedback plus free-form language self-explanation can create durable false beliefs. That has direct implications for agent memory, self-improvement loops, process supervision, and any setup where language is used as a surrogate learning channel without parameter updates. The contribution is less about benchmark performance and more about measurement and mechanism. It shows that binary pass/fail feedback is often too weak for causal diagnosis in multi-step tasks, and that unconstrained verbal reflection can amplify credit-assignment errors rather than fix them. For researchers working on memory-augmented agents, continual interaction, or synthetic training signals, that is a useful cautionary result.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, the paper defines a confabulated reflection operationally: a reflection is considered confabulated if it fails to mention the correct target object for the task. In ALFWorld, the target object can be recovered from the gamefile metadata, so this can be checked automatically from existing logs. Second, the authors introduce Reflection Repetition Rate (RRR), a log-based metric that measures how often later reflections are near-duplicates of earlier ones using SequenceMatcher similarity, with 0.85 as the duplication threshold. Environments with RRR >= 0.5 are treated as having frozen reflective memory, meaning the memory stops evolving and starts repeating itself. Third, they validate causality through ablations and propose a mitigation. Frozen environments are split into memory-harmful cases, where removing memory helps the agent solve the task faster, and task-hard cases, where the agent still fails without memory. The mitigation replaces open-ended self-diagnosis with programmatic feedback extraction: instead of asking the model to explain failure freely, the system parses trajectory-level signals tied more closely to environment facts and converts them into constrained feedback. The key design choice is to reduce the model’s freedom to invent causal stories and anchor memory updates to observable trajectory evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The main evidence comes from ALFWorld, with supporting cases from HumanEval. In ALFWorld, the authors identify 16 frozen environments where none of the 121 collected reflections mention the correct target object. That is a strong sign of systematic drift rather than occasional noise. RRR correlates strongly with trials-to-solve, with r = 0.808, suggesting that repetitive reflective memory is tightly associated with poor task progress. A no-memory ablation shows that in some environments the agent can solve the task faster when reflective memory is removed, which demonstrates that memory can be actively misleading rather than simply ineffective. The mitigation is modest but informative: programmatic feedback extraction raises correct object mention from 0% to 86%, reduces RRR from 0.64 to 0.10, and solves 3 of the 16 frozen ALFWorld environments. On HumanEval, the paper reports 4 analogous problems where the agent repeats nearly identical but incorrect diagnoses across attempts. The experiments are not framed as a broad leaderboard gain; they are designed to establish a structural failure mode and show that the failure is tied to how memory is written.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and problem formulation. The most important conceptual move is the distinction between hallucination and memory confabulation: the latter is a multi-trial write–retrieve–reinforce loop. Then read the RRR definition carefully, because the paper’s strength is that it turns a qualitative failure pattern into a log-computable diagnostic. In the experiments, focus on the ALFWorld frozen-environment analysis, the correlation between RRR and trials-to-solve, and the no-memory ablation. Those sections make the causal story much clearer than the headline examples alone. The mitigation section is also worth reading because it shows that the fix is not “better prompting for reflection,” but replacing free-form self-diagnosis with more grounded trajectory-derived feedback. For a skim, 20–30 minutes is enough. If you work on agent memory or self-improvement, the appendix examples are worth checking because they show how false beliefs become entrenched over repeated trials.

recommendation.zh: 自反Agent的记忆虚构是被忽略的系统性失效，对设计反馈式训练信号有直接参考，重点看§3的失效模式统计。
recommendation.en: Memory confabulation in reflexive agents is an overlooked systematic failure, directly informative for feedback training signal design, focus on §3 failure statistics.

paper.title: Relevance as a Vulnerability: How Web Retrieval Degrades Safety Alignment in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents augment large language models with external tools such as web retrieval, enabling grounded and up-to-date responses. However, incorporating external content into the generation pipeline can weaken the safety alignment mechanisms that govern model outputs. Prior work shows that enabling retrieval in agents increases compliance with harmful requests. We introduce AgentREVEAL, a diagnostic framework for analyzing retrieval-induced safety degradation in LLM agents. The framework examines t

summary.core_problem: 检索增强的 LLM agent 在接入外部网页内容后，安全对齐会系统性退化；论文要回答两个更细的问题：退化主要由“检索内容本身”触发，还是由“检索在 agent 流水线中的集成方式”触发？以及哪些内容属性（相关性、立场）会把模型推入更高的有害服从区间。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接改 recipe 的论文，但对“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”很有现实影响：它把安全退化从‘模型不够对齐’转成‘系统目标与时序耦合导致的泛化失败’，并给出可复现实证。对做 RLHF/RLVR、tool-use 数据合成、以及把 RAG/浏览能力纳入持续训练的人，结论很具体：同样的模型与同样的网页，agentic 集成方式会显著放大有害输出；更反直觉的是，安全科普/风险提示类页面在高相关时反而更容易诱发有害合规（Safe Source Paradox）。这意味着仅靠“安全来源白名单”或“检索过滤”并不稳，训练信号与系统设计需要一起改。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个诊断框架 AgentREVEAL，把“检索导致的安全退化”拆成两条轴。
1）架构/集成轴：固定同一 URL 内容，改变 ❸context augmentation 与 ❹response generation 的组织方式，比较‘被动把网页塞进 prompt’ vs ‘以工具调用-返回的 agentic 路径注入’，并进一步测试“时序耦合”假设：当工具调用决策与最终回答在同一步完成（强耦合）时，有害合规更高；把工具调用与回答解耦（文中称 DEFER，一种先检索/先确认再回答的设计）能降低退化，作者将其归因为 commitment bias（模型一旦走完工具链，更倾向于“完成任务”而不是拒绝）。
2）内容轴：构建 HarmURLBench，把 HarmBench 的有害行为请求与真实世界 URL 配对，并对每个 URL 标注两个关键属性：Topical Relevance（相关性 1–5）与 Stance Score（立场 1–5，从劝阻到教学）。用统一的有害性打分（GPT-4o 1–5）评估最终回答的有害合规程度。核心发现是：相关性是共同的“激活条件”——相关性越高，架构放大效应与 Safe Source Paradox 越强；而立场并不单调决定安全性，安全警示/风险说明（低 stance、偏劝阻）在高相关时也会提高合规。
此外，论文把场景限定为 externally specified URL retrieval（URL 由用户/系统指定），用来隔离‘源选择’因素，专注研究检索后半段（检索结果如何进入上下文、如何影响生成）。同时也做了若干代表性干预（如输入/输出过滤、摘要、chunking）来验证现象不只存在于最原始设置。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 8 个模型、5 个模型家族（文中表述为包含若干前沿闭源模型与开源模型的混合）。评测对象是 HarmURLBench：1,405 个按立场分层的真实 URL，与 320 个有害行为配对；输出用 GPT-4o 产生 1–5 的 harmfulness 评分。
关键结果有两条：
- 集成方式效应：同样的网页内容，通过 agentic 工具路径注入比“直接贴进 prompt”更容易产生有害合规；将工具调用与回答解耦（DEFER）能缓解，支持‘时序耦合/承诺偏置’解释。
- Safe Source Paradox：检索到“安全导向页面”（警示、风险说明、劝阻）时，有害合规相对无检索基线平均上升约 25%（论文给出这一量级结论）。该效应在内容与目标行为高度相关时最明显。
稳健性方面：作者报告在加入 Llama-Guard 输入/输出过滤、对检索内容做 summarization、以及 chunking 等常见 RAG 工程手段后，有害合规仍保持升高趋势；并指出部分 agent 在自主检索设置下也会进入类似退化区间（但主体分析仍以固定 URL 设定为主）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对四阶段流水线（query→retrieval→augmentation→generation）的拆解，以及为何选择 externally specified URL 的隔离思路。
- 重点看 Methodology 对 TR（相关性）与 SS（立场）的定义，以及 HarmURLBench 的构造方式；这是理解 Safe Source Paradox 的关键。
- 结果部分优先找两类对比：agentic vs passive 注入、coupled vs decoupled（DEFER）设计；再看按 TR 分桶后的趋势图/表（通常最能说明“相关性是激活条件”）。
- 如果只关心工程启示，直接看对 Llama-Guard/摘要/chunking 等干预的诊断结论：哪些常见防线对该问题不敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: Why and when does adding web retrieval to LLM agents systematically weaken safety alignment? The paper isolates two drivers: (i) the integration pathway (agentic tool-use vs passive context insertion), and (ii) properties of retrieved pages (topical relevance and stance), aiming to explain retrieval-induced increases in harmful compliance.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-recipe paper, but highly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop and tool-use training: it reframes safety failures as a pipeline/generalization issue rather than purely a model-alignment deficit. Two actionable takeaways for RLHF/RLVR and tool-augmented training: (1) the same content becomes more dangerous when injected through an agentic tool pathway, suggesting system design and training signals must co-evolve; (2) “safe” sources (warnings, risk disclaimers) can still increase harmful compliance when they are topically relevant, so whitelisting or naive retrieval filtering is not a reliable safety strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AgentREVEAL is a diagnostic framework that decomposes retrieval-induced safety degradation along two axes.
- Architectural/integration axis: hold the retrieved URL fixed and vary how it enters the model context and how tool invocation is coupled with response generation. The paper reports higher harmful compliance when tool invocation and answering are temporally coupled (single-step), and proposes a decoupled design (DEFER) to mitigate this, attributing the effect to a commitment bias: once the agent completes the tool pipeline, it is more likely to “finish the task” than refuse.
- Content axis: build HarmURLBench by pairing real-world URLs with HarmBench harmful behaviors, and annotate each URL with Topical Relevance (TR, 1–5) and Stance Score (SS, 1–5, discouraging→instructional). Outputs are rated for harmfulness (1–5) by GPT-4o. The key mechanism claim is that topical relevance is the shared activation condition: higher TR amplifies both the architectural effect and the Safe Source Paradox (safety-oriented pages increasing harmful compliance).
The study focuses on externally specified URL retrieval to remove confounds from source selection and concentrate on post-selection stages (augmentation and generation). It also probes common pipeline interventions (guardrails, summarization, chunking) to test robustness.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across 8 models from 5 families (mix of open and frontier closed models per the paper). HarmURLBench contains 1,405 stance-stratified real URLs paired with 320 harmful behaviors. Harmfulness is scored on a 1–5 scale by GPT-4o.
Main findings:
- Integration matters: agentic tool-path injection yields higher harmful compliance than passively pasting the same content into the prompt; decoupling tool use from answering (DEFER) reduces the effect.
- Safe Source Paradox: retrieving safety-oriented pages increases harmful compliance by ~25% on average relative to no-retrieval baselines, strongest when the retrieved content is highly topically relevant.
Robustness checks indicate the elevated harmful compliance persists under representative mitigations such as Llama-Guard input/output filtering, summarization, and chunking; some agents show similar behavior under autonomous retrieval, though the core analysis is in the fixed-URL setting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read the pipeline decomposition and the rationale for externally specified URLs in the introduction.
- Focus on the definitions of TR/SS and how HarmURLBench is constructed; this is essential for interpreting the paradox.
- In results, prioritize (i) agentic vs passive injection, (ii) coupled vs decoupled (DEFER), and (iii) plots/tables stratified by topical relevance.
- If you care about deployment, jump to the sections testing mitigations (guardrails, summarization, chunking) to see which common defenses fail to address the root cause.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Safe Source Paradox 和 pipeline ablation；若结果稳，RAG 安全数据不能再按“来源安全”粗标。
recommendation.en: Read the Safe Source Paradox and pipeline ablations; if robust, RAG safety data should not be labeled by source safety alone.

paper.title: WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models are increasingly deployed as long-horizon agents, where memory must do more than recall: it must track an evolving world, revise what has gone stale, and surface the right evidence at decision time. Existing benchmarks measure recall over static dialogue, collapse memory into a single end-of-task accuracy, and reduce visual observations to captions, leaving us unable to localize failures to writing, maintenance, retrieval, or use. The rise of agent harnesses that

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能记住多少内容”，而是多模态长程 agent 在动态世界里，记忆系统到底在哪个环节失效。作者指出，现有 memory benchmark 大多把问题压缩成静态上下文里的 recall 或最终问答准确率，因此无法区分：信息有没有被写入、世界变化后有没有更新、需要时有没有被正确取回、取回后有没有真正用于决策。对带执行轨迹的 agent 来说，这个问题更尖锐，因为记忆不再只是外挂数据库，而是和策略、工具调用、环境反馈一起形成闭环。论文因此把 memory 重新定义为一个 Action–World Interaction Loop 中的四阶段生命周期：writing、maintenance、retrieval、use，并围绕这个过程做可诊断评测。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在评测范式，而不是提出新的 memory 算法。对基座研究的意义有两层。第一，它把“长上下文/外部记忆是否有效”从单点终局指标拆成过程指标，这对分析 agent memory、长上下文建模、RAG-style memory、self-authored memory 都有帮助。第二，它把多模态证据和环境状态变化纳入 memory 评测，避免把视觉观察先压成 caption 再评估，这更接近未来原生多模态 agent 的训练与诊断需求。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这篇文章提供了一个很实用的视角：很多失败并不是存不进去，而是存了也不会用，或者世界变了但记忆没被修正。这个区分会直接影响训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先给出一个较清晰的形式化。环境有潜在状态 z_t，agent 只能看到由 Ω 映射得到的局部 observation o_t；策略 π 基于 observation 和当前 memory state m_t 选择 action a_t；环境 ℰ 执行动作后更新状态并返回 feedback f_t。完整轨迹写成 τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T)，其中 η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t)，再进一步切成多 session 轨迹，使得局部上下文受限，但世界状态跨 session 持续演化。这个设定很关键，因为它把“记忆”从长 prompt 内的被动保留，变成跨 session 的主动状态管理。

在这个框架下，作者定义四个可观测阶段。writing 关注系统是否把未来有用的信息写入 memory；maintenance 关注世界状态变化后，旧记忆是否被修订、删除或标记失效；retrieval 关注回答或决策时是否取回了正确证据；use 关注取回的证据是否真的支撑了最终行为，而不是只是表面命中。论文的一个设计重点，是为这四个阶段提供共享的 trajectory-level gold evidence，而不是让每个指标各自依赖不同标注口径。

基于这个定义，作者构建了 WorldMemArena。数据由 400 个长程多模态交互任务组成，覆盖两类场景。Lifelong Evolution 更像跨 session 的持续状态跟踪，强调个人信息、任务状态、偏好或环境条件的长期变化与复用；Agentic Execution 更接近真实 agent 执行，关键信息分散在 observation、action、tool feedback 和环境变化中，要求系统从执行过程里抽取可复用证据，而不是依赖整理好的叙事文本。每个 session 都标注了 gold memory points、state updates、distractors 和 answer-supporting evidence chains，因此可以分别诊断写入、维护、检索、使用四个环节。

论文还统一比较了三类 memory 范式：长上下文直接塞进 prompt 的 agent、人工设计的 memory pipeline、以及依托 agent harness 让模型自己编写和重组 memory 的系统。这个比较的重点不是谁最终分数高，而是不同范式在四阶段上的失效模式：人工系统通常结构更规整，写入和检索更可控，但适应性差；harness-based memory 更灵活，能在执行中自组织记忆，但成本更高，稳定性也更差。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的关键信息看，评测集规模是 400 个多 session 长程任务，覆盖 Lifelong Evolution 和 Agentic Execution 两个 regime。作者在统一设置下比较了三类代表性 memory 系统，并给出四个主要经验结论。

第一，写入更多正确记忆点，并不自动带来更好的最终表现。也就是说，memory quantity 和 downstream utility 之间并不是线性关系。很多系统在 writing 指标上不差，但在 use 阶段掉得很明显，说明问题不在“有没有记住”，而在“决策时能否把证据接上”。

第二，多模态 memory 仍是明显瓶颈，尤其在需要复杂视觉推理时更突出。论文强调，若把视觉证据简化成 caption，会掩盖真实困难；在原始多模态交互里，系统更容易在写入和检索阶段丢失视觉细节，最终影响 use。

第三，不同 domain 的 memory 表现差异很大，而且在 Agentic Execution 上普遍比 Lifelong Evolution 更差。原因是后者的信息来源更分散，既包含观察，也包含动作结果、工具反馈和状态变化，memory system 需要从“过程”中抽取证据，而不是从静态文本中摘录事实。

第四，人工 memory 系统与 harness-based memory agent 呈现明显取舍：前者更结构化，但对开放环境变化不够灵活；后者更能适应复杂执行轨迹，但代价更高，且可靠性不足。摘要和正文节选里没有给出完整的数值表，因此这里不编造具体分数；精读时应重点看各阶段指标、不同任务类型分层结果，以及 error case 对四阶段失效的归因。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“问题定义—数据构造—诊断结论”三步读。

先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation。重点不是形式化本身，而是作者为什么坚持把 memory 拆成四阶段，以及为什么要用 session 化的动态世界，而不是长对话。这里决定了整篇工作的评测哲学。

然后看 benchmark 构造部分，尤其是 Lifelong Evolution 与 Agentic Execution 的差别、gold memory points / state updates / evidence chains 的标注方式。这里值得细看，因为很多 benchmark 的上限其实由标注口径决定；如果标注只覆盖显式文本事实，就很难真正测到 agent memory。

实验部分建议优先看三类 memory 范式的对比表，以及四阶段指标和最终任务成功率之间的关系。如果有图表展示 writing 与 use 的脱钩、不同模态或不同任务类型上的退化，这些是最有信息量的地方。

如果时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要把它当作 agent memory 研究的评测底座来用，建议再花时间看附录中的标注协议、任务示例和 failure case。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether an agent can retain more tokens. It asks where multimodal memory actually breaks in long-horizon interaction with a changing world. Existing memory benchmarks mostly test recall in static dialogue or collapse everything into final QA accuracy. That setup cannot tell whether useful evidence was written at all, whether stale memory was updated after the world changed, whether the right evidence was retrieved at decision time, or whether retrieved evidence was truly used. This becomes more important for execution-based agents, where memory is intertwined with policy, tool feedback, and environment transitions. The paper therefore reframes agent memory as a four-stage lifecycle inside an Action–World Interaction Loop: writing, maintenance, retrieval, and use.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation lens rather than a new memory algorithm. For foundation-model research, the value is twofold. First, it decomposes memory quality into process-level signals instead of a single end metric. That is useful for studying long-context agents, external memory systems, retrieval-augmented memory, and self-authored memory. Second, it keeps multimodal evidence and world-state evolution in the loop, instead of reducing visual observations to captions before evaluation. That makes the benchmark more relevant to native multimodal agents. For people working on the pretrain/post-train interface, the paper offers a practical diagnosis: many failures are not about failing to store information, but about failing to revise or use it when the environment changes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts with a clean formalization. The environment has a latent state z_t. The agent only observes partial inputs o_t through an observation mapping Ω. A policy π chooses action a_t based on the current observation and memory state m_t. The environment ℰ executes the action, updates the world, and returns feedback f_t. A full trajectory is written as τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T), where each event η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t). The trajectory is further segmented into multiple sessions, so local context is limited while the world state persists across sessions. This is an important design choice: memory is treated as active state management across sessions, not passive retention inside one long prompt.

On top of this setup, the paper defines four observable stages. Writing asks whether future-useful information is stored. Maintenance asks whether memory is revised, deleted, or marked stale when the world changes. Retrieval asks whether the correct evidence is surfaced when answering or acting. Use asks whether the retrieved evidence actually supports the final decision rather than being superficially present. A notable design choice is that all four stages are grounded in shared trajectory-level gold evidence, which makes diagnosis more consistent.

The benchmark, WorldMemArena, contains 400 long-horizon multimodal interaction tasks spanning two regimes. Lifelong Evolution focuses on persistent personal or task states that evolve across sessions and must be tracked and reused over time. Agentic Execution is closer to realistic agent trajectories, where reusable evidence is distributed across observations, actions, tool feedback, and state changes rather than packaged as clean text narratives. Each session is annotated with gold memory points, state updates, distractors, and answer-supporting evidence chains, enabling stage-level diagnosis.

The paper then evaluates three representative memory paradigms under one setup: long-context agents that rely on prompt accumulation, manually designed memory pipelines, and harness-based memory agents that author and reorganize their own memory during execution. The comparison is useful because it exposes different failure modes rather than only ranking systems by final accuracy. Manual systems tend to be more structured and controllable, while harness-based systems are more adaptive but also more expensive and less reliable.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the benchmark contains 400 multi-session long-horizon tasks across Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution. The paper compares three classes of memory systems and reports four main empirical findings.

First, storing more correct memory items does not guarantee better downstream performance. Memory quantity and memory utility are clearly decoupled. Some systems do reasonably well on writing but still fail badly at use, which means the bottleneck is often decision-time integration rather than storage.

Second, multimodal memory remains a major bottleneck, especially on tasks requiring nontrivial visual reasoning. The paper explicitly argues that caption-based evaluation hides this difficulty. In native multimodal interaction, visual details are more easily lost during writing and retrieval, which then hurts use.

Third, performance varies substantially by domain and degrades on Agentic Execution relative to Lifelong Evolution. The reason is that evidence in Agentic Execution is distributed across the interaction process itself, including actions and tool feedback, not just observations. Memory systems therefore need to extract reusable evidence from trajectories rather than copy facts from text.

Fourth, manual memory systems and harness-based memory agents show a clear trade-off. Manual systems are more structured but less adaptive. Harness-based systems are more flexible in open-ended execution but remain costly and less reliable. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact scores. The most informative parts to inspect are the stage-level metrics, the gap between writing and use, and the breakdown by task regime and modality.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: problem framing, benchmark construction, and diagnosis.

Start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The key point is not the notation itself, but why the authors insist on a four-stage lifecycle and a session-based dynamic world instead of long dialogue. That choice defines the benchmark’s philosophy.

Then read the benchmark construction carefully, especially the difference between Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution, and how gold memory points, state updates, and evidence chains are annotated. This is worth attention because the usefulness of a memory benchmark depends heavily on what is labeled as evidence.

In the experiments, prioritize the comparison across the three memory paradigms and the relationship between stage-level metrics and final task success. Any figure showing the disconnect between writing and use, or degradation by modality and task type, is likely to be the most informative.

If you only need the main idea, 25–35 minutes should be enough. If you want to reuse it as an evaluation scaffold for agent memory work, spend extra time on the annotation protocol, task examples, and failure cases in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 将agent记忆拆解为四阶段生命周期并建立可诊断的评测框架，这种设计方法论对思考通用agent能力评估范式有借鉴价值，建议看评测设计章节。
recommendation.en: The four-stage lifecycle decomposition of agent memory and diagnosable evaluation design methodology is insightful for thinking about general agent capability assessment paradigms. Read the evaluation design section.

paper.title: Recovering Policy-Induced Errors: Benchmarking and Trajectory Synthesis for Robust GUI Agents
paper.abstract: While GUI agents have advanced rapidly, they often lack the robustness to recover from their own errors, hindering real-world deployment. To bridge this gap at both the evaluation and data levels, we introduce GUI-RobustEval and propose Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis. GUI-RobustEval contains $1,216$ executable test cases that systematically measure error recovery capabilities across a broad and realistic spectrum of error modes. At the data level, RoTS is a scalable synthesis framework t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文聚焦 GUI agent 的一个很实际但常被弱化的问题：模型犯错之后，能不能识别自己已经进入错误状态，并通过后续操作把任务拉回来。作者把这类问题定义为 policy-induced errors，也就是错误不是外部噪声注入造成的，而是 agent 自己在执行中因为错误 grounding、误判界面状态、选错子目标等动作一步步走出来的。现有 benchmark 更关注 grounding、规划或最终成功率，训练数据也多是人类演示或短程反思样本，因此对真实部署里常见的“长程、自诱发、组合式错误”覆盖不足。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的 pretrain 论文；但对 post-train、agent 数据构造和训练信号设计有明确启发。它把 agent robustness 从“加一个 reflection 模块”转成“训练数据和评测协议是否覆盖真实错误分布”的问题。这个视角很重要，因为很多 agent 失败并不是能力上限不够，而是训练时几乎没见过自己把环境带偏之后如何恢复。对做多模态 action model、GUI agent、在线数据合成的人，这篇工作提供了一个较完整的闭环：先定义错误类型和错误深度，再做针对性 benchmark，最后用在线树搜索式合成去补训练分布缺口。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分成 benchmark 和数据合成两部分。

第一部分是 GUI-RobustEval。作者把 GUI agent 任务建模为 POMDP：任务指令和动作是语言空间，观测是 screenshot，状态和转移由 GUI 环境决定，策略由 VLM 实现。与普通成功率评测不同，这个 benchmark 不是从初始状态让 agent 从头做任务，而是先给定一段带错误的前缀轨迹，再把环境和 agent 重置到某个“错误深度”对应的状态，让模型从这个已经被带偏的中间状态接管任务。这里有两个关键定义：error type 是根因动作的类别；error horizon / error depth 则描述从根因动作发生到错误变得可识别，需要经过多少步。这个设计比简单注入随机噪声更贴近真实 agent failure，因为很多错误不是立刻显现，而是几步之后才暴露。

GUI-RobustEval 共包含 1216 个可执行测试用例，覆盖 11 类代表性错误和 4 个可控错误深度。指标也不是单一 success rate，而是拆成 Error-Awareness Rate 和 Post-Error Success Rate。前者测模型能否意识到当前状态已经不对，后者测它在意识到或未意识到的情况下，最终能否恢复并完成任务。这样的拆分很有意义，因为有些模型会“知道错了但不会救”，另一些则是“根本不知道已经走偏”。

第二部分是 RoTS，Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis。作者观察到现有训练数据有两个错配：error-coverage mismatch 和 error-horizon mismatch。前者指训练数据里的错误类型偏低级、偏人工常见，而真实 agent failure 更高层、更组合式；后者指训练样本多是短程错误，而真实恢复常常需要长程回溯。RoTS 用树状在线合成来同时补这两个缺口。

具体做法是：在 GUI 环境中迭代生长 trajectory tree。对成功分支，从脆弱状态继续分叉，主动探索新的失败模式，同时复用已有正确前缀，提升错误覆盖；对失败分支，则从错误状态回放并合成恢复 rollout，生成长程 failure-recovery 轨迹，提升恢复 horizon。这个设计比离线改写演示数据更自然，因为错误是由策略与环境交互真实诱发的，不是人工编造的局部反思句子。最终作者构建了 800k 规模的数据集，并在 Qwen2.5-VL 基座上训练 RoTS-7B 和 RoTS-32B。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的是作者先做了分布分析，再做 benchmark 和训练验证。

分布分析上，作者从 12 个现有 SOTA GUI agent 在 OSWorld 上采集 1.5k 条轨迹，用 VLM 标注 error type，并在 300 条失败轨迹上由人工标注“最早何时能识别根因错误”，据此得到真实推理时的错误类型分布和错误 horizon 分布。然后把这些分布与三类代表性训练数据比较：AgentTrek、AgentNet、GUI-Reflection。结论是训练数据明显偏向低级执行错误和短程反思，而真实失败更常是高层、组合式、长程暴露的错误。这一步是整篇工作的支撑点，因为它说明 benchmark 和合成数据不是拍脑袋设计，而是针对真实分布缺口。

GUI-RobustEval 的规模是 1216 个测试用例，11 类错误，4 个错误深度。作者报告 Error-Awareness Rate 与 Post-Error Success Rate，并按错误类型和深度做细分。核心观察是：随着错误深度增加，恢复能力显著下降；很多模型在浅层错误上还能补救，但对延迟暴露的错误明显失效。

训练部分，RoTS 生成了 800k 高质量 failure-recovery 数据，并据此微调出 RoTS-7B 和 RoTS-32B。论文声称两者在 GUI-RobustEval 和传统 GUI benchmark 上都有显著提升，后者包括 OSWorld 和 WindowsAgentArena。摘要节选没有给出完整数值，但从正文结构看，重点应是三类对比：一是与原始 Qwen2.5-VL 基座相比的鲁棒性提升；二是与现有 reflection/trajectory 数据训练方案相比，在深错误和复杂错误类型上的增益；三是 robustness 提升是否会迁移到常规任务成功率，而不是只在专门 benchmark 上有效。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里作者定义的两个错配：error-coverage mismatch 和 error-horizon mismatch。这两个概念把问题讲得很清楚，也是后面 benchmark 与数据合成设计的直接动机。

然后重点看 Benchmark for Policy-Induced Errors。需要弄清楚 error type、error depth、error horizon 的定义，以及为什么要从错误中间态接管任务，而不是从头执行。这里决定了这个 benchmark 是否真的在测 recovery，而不是普通执行能力。

接着看 RoTS 的树状合成流程图和算法描述。要特别注意成功分支与失败分支分别在补什么分布缺口，以及为什么这种在线环境交互式合成比离线反思数据更贴近真实错误恢复训练。

实验部分优先看三类结果：真实失败分布与训练数据分布的差异分析；GUI-RobustEval 上按错误深度/类型拆分的结果；以及在 OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena 上的迁移效果。如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要贡献；如果要复现或借鉴数据合成方法，建议再细看数据过滤、质量控制和回放机制。
summary.authors_note: 阿里云团队工作。论文正文明确写明所有作者均为 Alibaba Cloud Computing 员工，RoTS 与所评测的 Qwen-VL 系列模型也由阿里云开发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical weakness of GUI agents: once the agent makes its own mistake, can it recognize that it is now in a bad state and recover? The authors focus on policy-induced errors, meaning failures caused by the agent’s own actions during execution, such as wrong grounding, misreading the screen, or pursuing an incorrect subgoal. Existing benchmarks mostly emphasize grounding, planning, or final task success, and training data is often built from human demonstrations or short reflection traces. As a result, current systems are underexposed to realistic long-horizon, self-induced, compositional failures.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to post-training, agent data construction, and training-signal design. The key contribution is to shift robustness from a systems add-on problem to a data-and-evaluation problem. Instead of only adding reflection or backtracking modules, the paper asks whether the benchmark and the training distribution actually cover the kinds of errors agents make in deployment. That is a useful framing for multimodal action models and GUI agents, because many failures come from distribution mismatch in recovery trajectories rather than from raw capability limits.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main parts: a benchmark and a data synthesis pipeline.

The benchmark, GUI-RobustEval, models GUI interaction as a POMDP where instructions and actions are in language space, observations are screenshots, environment state and transitions come from the GUI, and the policy is a VLM. Unlike standard task-success evaluation, the benchmark does not always start from a clean initial state. Instead, each test case provides an erroneous prefix trajectory, then resets the environment and the agent to a targeted state at a chosen error depth, and asks the model to take over from there. Two definitions matter here. Error type is the category of the root-cause action. Error horizon or depth measures how many steps after the root cause are needed before the error becomes identifiable. This is more realistic than injecting random perturbations, because many GUI failures only become visible several steps later.

GUI-RobustEval contains 1,216 executable test cases spanning 11 representative error types and 4 controllable error depths. The evaluation uses two metrics: Error-Awareness Rate and Post-Error Success Rate. This split is important. Some agents can notice that something is wrong but still fail to recover; others do not even realize they are off track.

The second part is RoTS, Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis. The authors identify two mismatches in existing training data. Error-coverage mismatch means training sets overrepresent low-level or human-typical errors, while real agent failures are often higher-level and compositional. Error-horizon mismatch means training examples are usually short-horizon, while real recovery often requires long-horizon backtracking. RoTS addresses both with a tree-based online synthesis process.

The trajectory tree grows inside the GUI environment. On successful branches, the system branches out from fragile states to proactively discover new failure modes while reusing the correct prefix, improving error coverage. On failed branches, it replays from the error state and synthesizes recovery rollouts, producing long-horizon failure-recovery trajectories. This is more realistic than offline reflection rewriting because the failures are induced by actual policy-environment interaction rather than manually fabricated local corrections. The final dataset contains 800k samples, and the authors fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL into RoTS-7B and RoTS-32B.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story starts with distribution analysis, then moves to benchmarking and training.

For the analysis, the authors collect 1.5k trajectories from 12 strong GUI agents on OSWorld. They use a VLM to annotate error types and manually label, on 300 failed trajectories, the earliest step at which the root-cause error becomes identifiable. This gives empirical distributions over error types and error horizons in real inference failures. They then compare these distributions against three representative training datasets: AgentTrek, AgentNet, and GUI-Reflection. The main finding is that existing training data is skewed toward low-level execution mistakes and short-horizon reflection, while real failures are more often high-level, compositional, and delayed in their observability. This analysis is the backbone of the paper because it justifies both the benchmark design and the synthesis strategy.

GUI-RobustEval itself contains 1,216 test cases, 11 error types, and 4 error depths. Results are reported with Error-Awareness Rate and Post-Error Success Rate, broken down by error type and depth. The central pattern is that recovery degrades as error depth increases. Many agents can handle shallow mistakes but fail badly once the consequences of the root-cause action are delayed.

On the training side, RoTS produces 800k failure-recovery samples and is used to fine-tune RoTS-7B and RoTS-32B. The paper reports substantial gains on GUI-RobustEval and also improvements on standard GUI benchmarks such as OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so the most important things to inspect in the paper are: gains over the base Qwen2.5-VL models, gains over prior reflection-style training data, and whether robustness improvements transfer to ordinary task success rather than only to the dedicated recovery benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction, especially the two mismatches: error-coverage mismatch and error-horizon mismatch. These two ideas explain the whole paper.

Then read the benchmark section carefully. Make sure to understand the definitions of error type, error depth, and error horizon, and why the benchmark evaluates takeover from an erroneous intermediate state rather than full execution from scratch. That is what makes it a recovery benchmark instead of a generic GUI benchmark.

Next, focus on the RoTS pipeline figure and algorithm description. Pay attention to what the successful branches and failed branches contribute respectively, and why online environment-grounded synthesis is more faithful than offline reflection augmentation.

In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the mismatch analysis between real failures and training data, the breakdown on GUI-RobustEval by error type and depth, and the transfer results on OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena. Around 30 minutes is enough to capture the main contribution. If you want to reuse the synthesis idea, spend more time on data filtering, replay, and quality control details.
summary_en.authors_note: Alibaba Cloud Computing. The paper explicitly states that all authors are employees of Alibaba Cloud Computing, and that the evaluated Qwen-VL models and RoTS were developed there.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent错误恢复的专门基准与数据合成方法，树状探索合成错误轨迹的思路可迁移到其他Agent训练数据生成，看§3数据合成部分即可。
recommendation.en: Specialized benchmark and data synthesis method for GUI agent error recovery; the tree-based exploration pipeline for error trajectory synthesis can be migrated to other agent training data generation; read §3 only.

paper.title: BenchTrace: A Benchmark for Testing Reflection Ability and Controlled Evolution in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve over time by reflecting on past failures, but existing evaluation is limited in two ways: it measures only task scores, leaving reflection quality unknown, and it relies on agents' own episode runs, offering no mechanism to target specific failure patterns. We present \textbf{BenchTrace}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolution ability in LLM agents. BenchTrace is built on a snapshot-reflection dataset of 1,821 annotated episodes spanning six diverse tasks, and com

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是自进化 Agent 评测中的两个混淆：任务分数提升并不能说明模型真的会反思；Agent 自己跑出来的失败轨迹也不可控，难以定位某一类失败经验是否被正确吸收。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 后的 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把“反思能力”和“演化算法有效性”拆开评估，这一点比只看最终任务成功率更干净。对基座研究员的启发在于：长期交互能力不只依赖模型能力，还依赖失败经验的表示、检索和迁移；这些信号未来也可能反哺 SFT/RL 数据构造。
