paper.title: LLMs Corrupt Your Documents When You Delegate
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are poised to disrupt knowledge work, with the emergence of delegated work as a new interaction paradigm (e.g., vibe coding). Delegation requires trust - the expectation that the LLM will faithfully execute the task without introducing errors into documents. We introduce DELEGATE-52 to study the readiness of AI systems in delegated workflows. DELEGATE-52 simulates long delegated workflows that require in-depth document editing across 52 professional domains, such as

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“模型能不能完成一次编辑任务”，而是“当用户把一段较长、较专业、需要多轮修改的文档工作委托给 LLM 时，模型能否在长链条操作里保持文档完整性，不持续引入细小但累积的破坏”。作者把问题定义为 delegated work 下的 document fidelity：模型既要执行编辑指令，又不能在未被要求的地方删改、漂移、格式损坏或语义失真。难点在于，这类任务很难做大规模自动评测，因为多数专业文档没有标准参考答案，且真正风险来自多轮交互后的误差累积，而不是单轮成功率。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要在评测范式，而不是提出新的训练方法。它补上了一个长期被低估的能力维度：长程编辑中的保真性与可逆性。现有很多基准更关注一次性问答、代码生成或短上下文编辑，但真实委托式工作更像反复修改同一份 15k token 左右的文档。作者用 round-trip relay 把“无参考答案的复杂编辑”转成可自动评估的问题，这对后续研究训练目标、编辑型 agent、长上下文鲁棒性、文档级 memory 和 error accumulation 都有直接启发。更具体地说，这篇工作提醒人们：短程 benchmark 上看起来可用的模型，在 20 次交互后可能已经把文档腐蚀到不可接受；因此只看单轮 pass rate，会系统性高估模型在真实知识工作中的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个关键设计。第一是 round-trip primitive。每个环境给定种子文档 s、一个正向编辑指令 x→ 和对应逆向指令 x←。模型先执行正向变换得到 t，再执行逆向变换得到 ŝ。若模型既正确执行任务，又不引入额外破坏，则 ŝ 应与原文 s 尽量一致。作者为不同领域设计了 domain-specific similarity function，而不是只用通用字符串匹配；这点很重要，因为代码、配置、乐谱、晶体学文件、字幕等文档的“等价”标准不同。第二是 relay 机制。由于每个 round-trip 理论上都应回到原文，作者可以把多个 round-trip 串起来，形成 20 次 interaction 的长流程，并观察 reconstruction score 随步数衰减的曲线。这样就把长程委托中的误差累积显式量化了。

基准本身覆盖 52 个职业领域、310 个工作环境，分布在 Science & Engineering、Code & Configuration、Creative & Media、Structured Record、Everyday 五类。每个环境包含真实种子文档、5–10 个复杂编辑任务和 distractor context，用来模拟真实工作里同目录或同项目中的无关材料。评测时每一步是独立单轮 session，这个设定有取舍：它避免 agent state 污染，突出“给定当前文档和指令，模型能否稳健编辑”；但也没有利用跨轮工具记忆或外部校验，因此更像测模型原生文档操作能力。

作者还专门验证了 backtranslation-style 评测不会被模型轻易投机取巧：模型需要真的执行编辑，而不是简单复制输入，否则无法在正向任务上通过。附录里还讨论了可逆编辑假设的边界条件，以及相似度函数与不同文档格式的匹配问题。这些细节决定了 benchmark 是否可信。
summary.experiments:
实验规模上，作者在 DELEGATE-52 上评测了 19 个 LLM。核心结果很直接：当前模型在长程委托编辑中会持续腐蚀文档。前沿模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude 4.6 Opus、GPT 5.4 在 20 次交互后平均仍会损失约 25% 的文档内容；全部模型平均退化约 50%。作者定义“ready for delegated work”为某领域在 20 次交互后 reconstruction score 仍达到 98% 以上。按这个标准，52 个领域里只有 Python 是大多数模型都接近可用的领域，说明程序性、语法约束强的文档更容易保持保真，而自然语言和小众专业格式更脆弱。

作者还做了几类有价值的分析。第一，领域差异：Python、Database 这类结构强、可验证性高的领域表现较好；earning statements、music notation 等自然语言或小众符号系统表现差。第二，因素分析：文档更长、交互更长、存在 distractor context 时，退化都会加重，而且不是线性叠加，而是会在 relay 中复合放大。第三，短程指标失真：2 次交互后的表现不能可靠预测 20 次交互后的表现，这说明很多现有短 benchmark 低估了长期稳定性问题。第四，agentic harness 无明显帮助：给模型套一个基础 agent 外壳，并没有显著改善 DELEGATE-52 上的结果，说明问题不只是 prompt engineering，而是模型内部的编辑保真能力不足。

从全文给出的数字看，benchmark 的单个环境文档长度约 15k tokens，任务数 5–10 个，环境总数 310。最关键的结果不是某个模型第一，而是 degradation curve 的普遍下滑形态：即便最强模型，曲线也没有接近“平台期”，而是在多轮后持续掉分。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三部分。第一看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，理解 round-trip 与 relay 的评测逻辑，这是整篇工作的核心。第二看 benchmark construction 部分，重点看 52 个领域如何选、每个环境由什么组成、相似度函数如何按领域定制；如果这部分不可信，后面的结论就站不住。第三看主结果图，尤其是不同模型在 interaction step 上的 degradation curve，以及按领域分组的结果。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）主文中对“20-step readiness”的定义；2）短程与长程不一致的分析；3）agentic harness 无效的实验；4）附录里关于 shortcut validation 和 similarity metric 的说明。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种 round-trip 评测能否迁移到训练阶段，作为编辑保真性的自监督信号；二是为什么代码域明显更稳，究竟来自 tokenizer、格式约束、训练数据密度，还是可逆编辑更容易被模型内化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more specific question than standard editing benchmarks: not whether an LLM can complete one edit, but whether it can preserve document integrity over long delegated workflows. In this setting, a user hands off a real professional document and expects the model to make requested changes without silently deleting, drifting, or corrupting unrelated content. The hard part is evaluation. For many professional document types, there is no gold reference after each edit, and the real failure mode is cumulative corruption over many interactions rather than low single-turn task success.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation framework for long-horizon document fidelity. That matters for foundation-model research because many current benchmarks overestimate readiness for real knowledge work: they focus on one-shot QA, short editing, or domains with easy verification. DELEGATE-52 instead measures whether models remain trustworthy after repeated edits on long, domain-specific documents. The paper is useful less as a new training method and more as a warning about a missing capability axis: long-horizon preservation under iterative editing. It also provides a reusable setup for studying error accumulation, long-context robustness, editing-oriented agents, and training signals for document-faithful generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two central ideas. First, a round-trip editing primitive. Starting from a seed document s, the benchmark defines a forward instruction x→ and an inverse instruction x←. The model applies the forward edit to obtain t, then applies the inverse edit to reconstruct ŝ. If the model both follows instructions and avoids unintended changes, ŝ should match s. Because exact string match is too crude across heterogeneous document types, the benchmark uses domain-specific similarity functions tailored to formats such as code, configuration files, subtitles, crystallography files, and music notation.

Second, the paper composes these reversible edits into a relay. Since each round-trip should ideally return to the original seed, multiple round-trips can be chained to simulate long delegated workflows. This turns long-horizon reliability into a measurable degradation curve: reconstruction quality after 2, 4, ..., 20 interactions. That is the key move that makes cumulative corruption visible.

The benchmark covers 52 professional domains and 310 work environments across five broad categories. Each environment contains a real seed document, 5–10 complex edit tasks, and distractor context to mimic realistic working conditions. Each edit is executed in an independent single-turn session. This choice isolates the model’s native document-editing reliability rather than mixing in persistent agent state or external verification. The paper also validates that the backtranslation-style setup does not reward trivial copying: models must actually perform the forward edit, otherwise they fail the task. The appendices discuss assumptions behind reversibility and the limits of similarity metrics, which are important for trusting the benchmark.
summary_en.experiments:
The large-scale study evaluates 19 LLMs on DELEGATE-52. The headline result is that current models steadily corrupt documents under long delegated workflows. Even frontier systems such as Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude 4.6 Opus, and GPT 5.4 lose about 25% of document content on average after 20 interactions. Averaged across all tested models, degradation is around 50%.

The paper defines a model as ready for delegated work in a domain if it retains at least a 98% reconstruction score after 20 interactions. Under that criterion, Python is the only domain, among 52, where most models are close to being usable. This domain pattern is informative: strongly structured and easily verifiable formats like Python and databases are much more robust, while natural-language-heavy or niche symbolic formats such as earning statements and music notation are much more fragile.

Several targeted analyses are especially useful. Longer documents, longer workflows, and distractor context all worsen degradation, and the effects compound over time rather than staying local to a single step. Performance after only two interactions is not predictive of performance after twenty, which shows why short-horizon benchmarks are misleading for delegated work. The paper also tests a basic agentic harness and finds no meaningful improvement, suggesting that the bottleneck is not simply prompting or orchestration but the model’s underlying editing fidelity. The benchmark instances themselves are substantial: each environment uses roughly 15k-token documents and 5–10 edit tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, start with the introduction and the figure that defines the round-trip and relay setup. That is the conceptual core. Then read the benchmark construction section carefully enough to understand how domains were selected, what an environment contains, and how similarity is computed per domain. After that, go straight to the main result figures showing degradation over interaction steps and the domain breakdown.

If time is limited, focus on four things: the 20-step readiness criterion, the mismatch between short-horizon and long-horizon performance, the ablation on distractor context and workflow length, and the experiment showing that a basic agentic harness does not fix the problem. The appendices are worth checking for shortcut validation and metric design. A solid skim should take about 30–45 minutes. Two deeper follow-up questions are especially interesting: whether round-trip reconstruction can become a training signal for document-faithful editing, and why code-like domains are much more stable than natural-language or niche professional formats.

recommendation.zh: 把“长程编辑会越改越坏”做成可复现实验，适合拿来做内部 agent/编辑器回归测试；重点看指标定义是否把“必要改写”误算成腐化。
recommendation.en: Turns long-horizon document drift into a reproducible benchmark—useful as an internal regression test for agents/editors; scrutinize whether the corruption metric conflates legitimate rewrites with errors.

paper.title: AlphaEval: Evaluating Agents in Production

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent基准多为“回顾性整理”的任务（需求明确、指标确定、输入单一），与真实生产环境评估严重脱节：生产需求往往欠规格、隐含约束多、输入是跨来源的多模态文档、交付物长链路且质量由领域专家主观评判并随时间演化。论文要解决的是：如何把真实公司生产需求系统化地转化为可复现、可自动化的评测任务，并用统一框架衡量不同模型+脚手架（scaffold）在生产型Agent任务上的表现差异。
summary.importance: 对“预训练方法/数据/Scaling/Tokenizer”直接贡献不大，但对基座研究的间接价值在于：它提供了更贴近真实分布的评测信号，能暴露“模型能力提升≠生产可用性提升”的落差，并强调scaffold/产品形态对最终效果的影响幅度可与模型本身相当。这类基准可能反向影响预训练数据配比与后训练目标（例如更长交付物、更强文档理解/跨源整合、对隐含约束的遵循），但论文本身主要是评测与构建方法论。
summary.technical_approach:
AlphaEval包含两部分：
1) requirement-to-benchmark构建流水线：与企业合作获取真实需求，通过“合作对接—需求引导/澄清—任务形式化—迭代验证”四阶段，把模糊业务需求转成可执行、可复现的评测任务，并尽量保留生产复杂性（多源文档、多模态、长交付物、隐含约束）。
2) 统一评测框架：将任务评估拆成可组合的多种范式（参考答案校验、形式逻辑验证、rubric评分、基于执行的验证），并提供标准API与Docker沙箱执行；同时把LLM-as-a-Judge/Agent-as-a-Judge作为跨范式组件，用于更贴近专家主观标准的综合评判。
此外，论文强调“同一模型在不同agent产品/脚手架上差异巨大”，因此评测对象是model–scaffold configuration而非仅模型。
summary.experiments:
基准规模：94个生产任务，来自7家公司，覆盖6类O*NET职业域。
评测对象：6个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro Preview、Kimi K2.5、GLM-5、MiniMax M2.5）通过4种商业agent产品（Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor）形成14种配置。
关键结果：
- 最佳配置（Claude Code + Opus 4.6）平均仅64.41/100，显示研究基准到生产的显著落差。
- scaffold影响可达11分：同为Opus 4.6，Claude Code为64.41，而Codex为53.45。
- 领域差异大：Technology Research约62.0，而Human Resources约30.0，说明单一总分难以代表生产就绪度。
（更多错误分析与“分数到经济价值”的映射在正文后半部分；若关注基座训练启示，建议重点看失败类型分布。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约40–60分钟）：
- 先读Introduction与他们对production evaluation三大结构性差异的定义（欠规格、主观评判、持续演化）。
- 再看方法部分的四阶段构建流程与任务评估范式分类图（taxonomy），理解其“可复用构建框架”而非仅一个静态榜单。
- 实验部分重点看：model vs scaffold的对比、按职业域拆分的雷达/柱状图、以及错误分析章节。
如果你的目标是预训练研究：把它当作“更真实的能力需求清单”，提炼哪些失败模式可能需要通过数据配比/合成数据/后训练目标来补齐。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent benchmarks are typically retrospective and well-specified, with deterministic metrics and clean inputs—unlike production, where requirements are underspecified with implicit constraints, inputs are heterogeneous (often multi-modal) and fragmented across sources, deliverables are long-horizon professional artifacts, and success is judged subjectively by evolving domain-expert standards. The paper addresses how to turn authentic production requirements into reproducible, automated evaluation tasks, and how to evaluate real model+scaffold agent configurations under production-like conditions.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining/scaling/tokenizers, but it provides a more realistic evaluation signal that can reveal gaps masked by research benchmarks. Two takeaways relevant to foundation-model research: (1) “model improvements” may not translate to “production readiness” under ambiguous constraints and long deliverables; (2) scaffolding/product integration can shift scores as much as changing the base model, complicating how we interpret capability gains. Over time, such benchmarks can influence data/target design (document understanding, cross-source synthesis, constraint following), though this work is primarily about evaluation methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AlphaEval contributes:
- A requirement-to-benchmark construction pipeline (partner engagement → requirement elicitation → task formalization → iterative validation) designed to preserve production complexity while making tasks automated and reproducible.
- A unified evaluation framework that composes multiple paradigms—reference verification, formal logic verification, rubric-based scoring, and execution-based verification—exposed via a standardized API with Docker sandboxing.
- LLM-as-a-Judge / Agent-as-a-Judge are treated as cross-cutting components to approximate domain-expert, multi-criteria judgments.
Crucially, the unit of evaluation is a model–scaffold configuration, reflecting that agent products/scaffolds materially affect outcomes.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmark: 94 production-grounded tasks from 7 companies across 6 O*NET occupational domains.
Evaluated: 6 frontier models (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, Kimi K2.5, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.5) deployed through 4 commercial agent products (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), totaling 14 configurations.
Findings:
- Best setup (Claude Code + Opus 4.6) reaches only 64.41/100 on average.
- Scaffold matters ~as much as the model: Opus 4.6 scores 64.41 via Claude Code vs 53.45 via Codex (~11-point gap).
- Large domain variance: e.g., ~62.0 in Technology Research vs ~30.0 in Human Resources, suggesting aggregate scores hide readiness differences.
(The paper also includes error analysis and a score-to-economic-value framing; consult those sections for actionable failure modes.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the three structural mismatches between benchmarks and production (underspecification, subjective judgment, continuous evolution).
- Review the construction pipeline and the evaluation-paradigm taxonomy figure to understand the reusable framework.
- In results, focus on model-vs-scaffold comparisons, per-domain breakdowns, and the error analysis.
If your goal is pretraining research, treat the benchmark as a “capability demand map” and extract recurring failure patterns that might motivate data mixture changes or post-training objectives.

recommendation.zh: 当作生产分布评测方法论读：只看任务构建与scaffold影响那部分，结论是“模型变强≠上线变好”，但对预训练改法不给硬证据。
recommendation.en: Read it as a production-distribution eval methodology: skim task construction and scaffold-effect analysis—strong reminder that better models don’t guarantee better prod outcomes, but it offers little direct pretrain guidance.

paper.title: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦“长时程（long-horizon）任务”中LLM Agent性能随任务步数/依赖链增长而非线性崩溃的问题：现有研究缺少跨领域一致的horizon定义与诊断框架，往往只报总体成功率，无法回答两个关键问题：Where（在哪个horizon开始坏、坏得多快）与Why（失败机制是什么、随horizon如何迁移）。作者要建立一个可系统扩展任务步数并做结构化失败归因的跨域诊断基准。
summary.importance: 对预训练本体影响间接，但对“基座能力瓶颈定位/评测方法学/训练目标设计”有价值：它把长时程退化从单一指标变成“失败成分随horizon结构性迁移”的可测对象，并给出可扩展的任务族构造与失败模式标注流程。对基座研究的启发是：仅靠scale base model不足以解决长链任务，瓶颈更集中在planning与memory（尤其catastrophic forgetting）等机制层面，可能需要在预训练/持续学习/记忆建模/执行时控制上引入新目标或新架构。
summary.technical_approach:
HORIZON基准的设计要点：
- 两层框架：用“agent-independent”的任务结构度量来刻画horizon与依赖结构，并通过“controlled task extension”把同一任务族系统性拉长，避免把agent低效（重复失败导致动作变多）误当作任务本身长时程。
- 跨四域：Web、OS、Embodied、Database，构造可比较的horizon递增任务族。
- 失败归因：提出trajectory-grounded的LLM-as-a-Judge流水线，对超长轨迹做结构化失败模式标注；并用小规模人工标注验证judge可靠性。
- 分析范式：不仅看成功率曲线，还看失败模式组成随horizon变化（planning相关、memory相关、执行相关等）的占比迁移，从而回答“为什么坏”。
summary.experiments:
关键实验信息（来自正文片段）：
- 评测对象：多家SOTA agent/模型家族（GPT-5 variants与Claude-4）。
- 数据规模：跨四域收集3100+ trajectories。
- Judge验证：在40条轨迹pilot上，人类标注者一致性κ=0.61；human–judge一致性κ=0.84，支持用judge做大规模失败归因。
- 主要发现：随着horizon增加，失败不只是成功率下降，而是失败构成发生结构性转移；planning相关失败（如subplanning errors）与memory相关失败（如catastrophic forgetting）逐渐占主导。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（skim级）：
- 先读Introduction把握两大RQ与“跨域horizon不可统一”的动机。
- 重点看HORIZON章节：两层度量/任务扩展如何避免把agent低效当成长任务，这是基准可信度的核心。
- 快速浏览judge流水线与验证（κ=0.61/0.84）以判断失败归因结论的可信度。
- 最后看分析结论部分：失败模式随horizon迁移的图表/表格。预计45–60分钟可抓住方法与主要发现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses why LLM-based agents degrade sharply on long-horizon tasks. Prior work is fragmented across domains with inconsistent horizon definitions and mostly reports aggregate success rates, making it hard to compare failures or understand mechanisms. The authors aim to answer: (RQ1) where agents break as horizon increases, and (RQ2) why failures emerge—via a cross-domain diagnostic benchmark with controlled horizon scaling and structured failure attribution.
summary_en.importance: Indirect for pretraining, but valuable for foundation-model research as an evaluation/diagnosis methodology: it reframes long-horizon degradation as a shift in failure composition (not just lower success), and provides a scalable way to attribute failures from long trajectories. The key takeaway for base-model researchers is that scaling alone is insufficient; dominant bottlenecks at long horizons are planning and memory (including catastrophic forgetting), suggesting the need for new objectives/architectures or execution-time control mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
HORIZON introduces:
- A two-layer design: agent-independent task-structure metrics plus controlled task extension to systematically increase required dependent steps, separating true task horizon from agent inefficiency (e.g., looping).
- Four domains (Web, OS, Embodied, Database) with horizon-parameterized task families for cross-domain comparison.
- A trajectory-grounded LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline to label failure modes from very long traces, validated against expert labels.
- An analysis protocol that tracks both success-vs-horizon curves and how failure-mode proportions shift with horizon (planning vs memory vs execution, etc.).
summary_en.experiments:
Reported empirical setup and findings (from the excerpt):
- Evaluated SOTA agent systems across GPT-5 variants and Claude-4.
- Collected 3100+ trajectories across four domains.
- Judge validation on 40 pilot trajectories: inter-annotator agreement κ=0.61; human–judge agreement κ=0.84.
- Main result: long-horizon failure reflects a structural change in failure composition; planning-related failures (e.g., subplanning errors) and memory-related failures (e.g., catastrophic forgetting) become dominant as horizon grows.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim guide:
- Read the Introduction for the two research questions and the argument that horizon is domain-dependent.
- Focus on the HORIZON benchmark construction: the two-layer metrics + controlled extension are the core methodological contribution.
- Skim the judge pipeline and its validation (κ numbers) to gauge attribution reliability.
- Review the analysis section figures/tables showing failure-mode composition shifts with horizon. ~45–60 minutes is enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 别看总成功率，直接用它的“失败成分随horizon迁移”诊断框架定位瓶颈；只读诊断定义与失败归因那几节就够。
recommendation.en: Useful as a failure-decomposition lens for horizon collapse (not just success rate); skim the horizon definition + failure attribution sections and ignore the rest.

paper.title: Sanity Checks for Agentic Data Science

summary.core_problem: 如何为“能自动做数据分析并给出统计结论”的Agentic Data Science(ADS)管线提供轻量、可操作的可靠性/可证伪性检查，避免模型给出看似自信但其实由噪声驱动的结论。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为方法与评测范式：把PCS(Predictability-Computability-Stability)框架引入ADS输出的“事后审计”，用扰动测试将ADS结论变成可证伪对象；对数据分析类Agent的可信度评估与部署风控有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两类基于“合理扰动(perturbations)”的sanity checks：通过对输入数据/分析流程做受控扰动，观察ADS是否能稳定区分信号与噪声，并据此将输出归类为(1)稳定信号(2)噪声响应(3)对偶然因素敏感；整体是轻量外部验证层，而非改模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在可控信噪比的合成数据上验证：sanity checks的指标随信噪比变化而变化，能暴露“虚假乐观结论”；摘要未给出具体模型规模、真实数据集、与强基线系统化对比与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide lightweight, actionable reliability checks for agentic data science pipelines so that automatically generated statistical conclusions can be falsified and are less likely to be driven by noise.
summary_en.importance: Adapts the PCS (Predictability–Computability–Stability) perspective to post-hoc auditing of LLM-driven data analysis, offering a practical risk-control layer for deploying data-science agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes sanity checks based on controlled, ‘reasonable’ perturbations to the input data and/or analysis workflow; by measuring stability of conclusions under perturbations, outputs are categorized as stable signal, noise response, or sensitivity to incidental factors—without modifying model training.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrated on synthetic datasets with controllable signal-to-noise ratios, where the proposed checks track SNR and expose overly optimistic false conclusions; the abstract does not specify models, real-world datasets, strong baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 对做 agentic 分析管线的人很实用：PCS 式扰动把结论变成可证伪对象；只读 sanity check 清单与案例，能直接落地到上线风控。
recommendation.en: Practical for agentic analytics pipelines: PCS-style perturbations turn outputs into falsifiable claims; read the sanity-check checklist and examples—easy to port into deployment risk controls.

paper.title: SLALOM: Simulation Lifecycle Analysis via Longitudinal Observation Metrics for Social Simulation

summary.core_problem: LLM 智能体社会模拟面临“有效性危机”：现有评估常用终态/结果对齐（point-matching），却忽略过程是否社会学上合理，导致“停钟问题”（stopped clock）——即便最终结果对了，也可能通过错误机制或不可信轨迹到达。
summary.importance: 对生成式社会科学而言，政策推演与机制解释依赖“过程可信”而非仅“结果相似”。LLM 推理黑箱且随机，使得传统 ABM 的机制校验更难；若不能验证轨迹与阶段性结构，模拟可能在关键机制上失真却仍通过终态检验，进而误导解释与决策。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 SLALOM（Simulation Lifecycle Analysis via Longitudinal Observation Metrics），将验证从“终态正确”转向“过程保真”。核心做法：
1) 以 POM（Pattern-Oriented Modeling）为思想：不拆解黑箱内部机理，而要求模型同时匹配多尺度、多变量的经验模式；
2) 将智能体交互的文本日志转为多变量时间序列（如情绪/情感、波动性、观点多样性、信息熵/一致性等可由 NLP 指标或嵌入距离提取的潜变量）；
3) 引入 SLALOM gates（阶段性“路标/闸门”约束）：每个 gate 用时间窗 t_window、变量范围 [V_min,V_max]、以及指标集合 M_k 定义，作为二值过滤器；轨迹若在对应阶段未进入“有效性区域”则剪枝，避免“走错路但到终点”；
4) 在通过 gates 的候选轨迹上，进行多维动态时间规整 DTW（Dynamic Time Warping）对齐，将模拟轨迹与经验真值在时间伸缩下匹配，并聚合多指标对齐分数，得到过程相似度而非单点误差。
论文的三条关键假设：社会现象存在可复用的阶段结构（危机生命周期/社会戏剧四阶段等）；文本痕迹可作为社会内部状态代理并可量化为时间序列；政策分析所需的“生成充分性”可用“穿越相同有效性区域/阶段序列”来界定，而非逐点复刻。
summary.experiments: 在给定的全文片段中，作者主要阐述问题、假设与框架设计（POM 启发、文本到时间序列、gates 剪枝、多维 DTW 对齐）。未提供可复述的具体实验设置、数据集、对比基线或定量结果细节；因此此处只能概括其计划性的评估范式：以经验时间序列为真值，比较不同模拟轨迹在多指标、多阶段上的 DTW 对齐分数，并用 gates 进行阶段性可行性筛选，以检验“过程保真”而非仅终态匹配。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读：详细技术分析 + 建议）
- 重点章节：Introduction（停钟问题与黑箱有效性动机）、Assumptions（三假设决定适用边界）、SLALOM Framework（gates 定义与剪枝逻辑、多变量 DTW 聚合）。
- 重点概念/创新点：
  1) 从 outcome verification 转向 process fidelity；
  2) 将 POM 的“多模式同时匹配”迁移到 LLM 社会模拟验证；
  3) 文本日志→多变量时间序列的可操作化；
  4) SLALOM gates 作为阶段性约束与结构化剪枝；
  5) 多维 DTW 用于跨时间尺度/速度差异的轨迹对齐。
- 精读建议：逐条检查三假设是否在你的任务域成立（是否存在稳定阶段结构、文本指标是否能代表潜变量、何谓有效性区域）；然后推导 gate 的设定方式（时间窗与阈值如何从经验数据估计、指标集合如何选取）；最后关注 DTW 在多变量聚合时的权重/归一化与鲁棒性（噪声、指标相关性、过拟合到指标选择）。

skim（泛读：方法概述 + 建议）
- 只看：Introduction（问题与贡献一句话抓住）、Assumptions（适用前提）、SLALOM Framework 中 gate 定义与 DTW 思路（把握“阶段闸门 + 多维轨迹对齐”两件事）。
- 泛读目标：理解 SLALOM 解决的是“轨迹是否像”而非“终点是否像”，以及它如何用 gates 把验证拆成分阶段的可行性过滤，再用 DTW 做整体过程相似度评分。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心主张是：在 LLM 智能体社会模拟中，机制不可见并不意味着无法验证；应以“多变量、跨尺度的时间结构模式”作为可观测约束，把验证从终态对齐升级为生命周期轨迹对齐。SLALOM 通过阶段性 gates 与多维 DTW，将“过程可信”形式化为可计算的匹配问题，从而缓解停钟问题并为政策分析提供更稳健的有效性证据。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-agent social simulations face a validity crisis: common evaluation relies on end-state/point matching, ignoring whether the trajectory is sociologically plausible. This yields the “stopped clock” problem—getting the right final outcome via the wrong (or hallucinated) process, especially problematic given opaque and stochastic LLM reasoning.
summary_en.importance: For generative social science and policy analysis, process fidelity matters as much as outcomes because explanations and interventions depend on credible mechanisms over time. With LLMs as black boxes, outcome-only validation can certify simulations that are mechanistically wrong, undermining interpretability and decision support.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SLALOM (Simulation Lifecycle Analysis via Longitudinal Observation Metrics) shifts validation from outcome verification to process fidelity:
1) POM-inspired stance: instead of inspecting micro-mechanics, require simultaneous matching of multiple observed patterns across scales.
2) Convert unstructured interaction text logs into multivariate time series (e.g., sentiment/affect, volatility, diversity, entropy/cohesion proxies via NLP and embedding-based measures).
3) Introduce SLALOM gates—phase/waypoint constraints defined by {t_window, V_min, V_max, M_k}. Gates act as binary filters: trajectories that miss phase-specific validity regions are pruned.
4) For surviving trajectories, compute multivariate Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) alignment against empirical ground truth and aggregate alignment scores across metrics to quantify lifecycle-level similarity under time distortions.
Underlying assumptions: social phenomena exhibit archetypal phase structures; text traces can proxy latent social states; “generative sufficiency” can be defined as passing through the same validity regions/phases rather than exact replication.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper primarily details motivation, assumptions, and the framework design (text-to-time-series, gates, multivariate DTW). Concrete experimental setups, datasets, baselines, and quantitative results are not included in the excerpt; thus we can only summarize the intended evaluation: compare simulated vs. empirical multivariate trajectories using gate-based phase feasibility filtering plus DTW-based process alignment scoring.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper argues that black-box LLM agents can still be validated by shifting attention to observable temporal structure: require simulations to match multivariate lifecycle patterns, not just final outcomes. SLALOM formalizes this via phase gates and multivariate DTW alignment, aiming to mitigate the stopped-clock problem and provide stronger evidence of sociologically plausible dynamics for policy-relevant simulations.

paper.title: Mind the Gap Between Spatial Reasoning and Acting! Step-by-Step Evaluation of Agents With Spatial-Gym

summary.core_problem: 现有空间推理/导航类评测多为一次性输出，难以反映交互式决策与回退；本文提出交互式环境评测以量化“空间推理到行动（acting）”的能力差距。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为Benchmark/评测系统：提供Gymnasium环境将2D网格路径规划抽象为序列决策任务，并系统比较one-shot vs step-by-step vs 带回退的交互设置，揭示交互格式对不同强度模型的非一致影响（弱模型受益、强模型受限），对Agent评测范式有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Spatial-Gym：将路径规划约束推理做成可交互episode；支持逐步行动与可选backtracking；用人类、随机与A*作为参照基线，并对多模型在不同交互协议下的成功率与完成情况进行对比分析。
summary.experiments: 500个episodes；评测8个模型，三种设置（one-shot、step-by-step、step-by-step+backtracking）；最佳模型GPT-OSS 120B成功率16.0%，显著低于人类98.0%；step-by-step对弱模型最高提升约+5.4%，对强模型最高下降约5.6%；backtracking提升完成度但对成功率提升主要发生在弱模型上。

summary_en.core_problem: Measure the gap between spatial reasoning and interactive acting in agents, since one-shot spatial/planning evaluations fail to capture sequential decision-making, interaction, and recovery behaviors such as backtracking.
summary_en.importance: Provides an interactive Gymnasium-based benchmark that contrasts one-shot vs step-by-step vs backtracking-enabled protocols, revealing that interaction formats can help weaker models yet constrain stronger ones—informing how agent evaluation should be designed.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Spatial-Gym, an interactive 2D grid path-planning environment formulated as episodic sequential decision-making with optional backtracking; evaluates agents’ success and completion under different interaction protocols and includes human, random, and A* references.
summary_en.experiments: Runs 500 episodes evaluating 8 models under three settings (one-shot, step-by-step, step-by-step+backtracking). Best model (GPT-OSS 120B) achieves 16.0% success vs 98.0% for humans. Step-by-step improves weaker models by up to +5.4% but reduces stronger models by up to 5.6%; backtracking increases completion and mainly boosts success for weaker models.

recommendation.zh: 交互式空间评测对agent有用，但对预训练指导有限；扫one-shot vs step-by-step对强弱模型反转的那组图即可。
recommendation.en: Interactive spatial eval is useful for agents but weakly actionable for pretraining; just inspect the plots where one-shot vs step-by-step flips across model strength.

paper.title: SAGE: A Service Agent Graph-guided Evaluation Benchmark

summary.core_problem: 如何评测面向客服场景的服务型对话agent在多样用户行为下对SOP流程的严格遵循与鲁棒性，并实现可扩展、可自动化的评测。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测框架贡献：把SOP形式化为动态图结构以便精确验证“流程合规+路径覆盖”，并引入对抗意图分类与可扩展机制；但偏垂直“客服agent”评测，通用性有限。
summary.technical_approach: SAGE 将非结构化SOP转为 Dynamic Dialogue Graph，用 Rule Engine + Judge Agents 对 User/Service Agent 交互进行双轴评估（逻辑合规与覆盖）；提供 Adversarial Intent Taxonomy 生成更具攻击性的用户意图，并用模块化扩展机制降低跨域部署成本与支持自动合成对话数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据规模、参与评测的模型/agent、对比基线与量化结果细节。

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunicatio

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating customer-service dialogue agents for strict adherence to SOP workflows and robustness to diverse (including adversarial) user behaviors, in a way that is scalable and automatable.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a benchmark/evaluation framework that formalizes SOPs as graph structures to enable precise compliance checking and coverage measurement, with an extensible design tailored to service-agent assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGE converts unstructured SOPs into a Dynamic Dialogue Graph and evaluates user–service-agent interactions along two axes—logical compliance and path/coverage—using a rule engine plus judge agents. It also introduces an Adversarial Intent Taxonomy to generate more challenging user intents and a modular mechanism to ease cross-domain deployment and support automated dialogue synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, evaluated agents/models, baselines, or detailed quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 偏客服垂直评测，通用训练启发不多；但把SOP图结构化做路径覆盖/合规验证的思路可作benchmark备查，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Mostly a vertical customer-service eval; little to change pretraining priors, but the SOP-as-graph compliance/coverage idea is a handy benchmark reference—no need to read beyond the core formulation.
